jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in leading operational excellence of the Restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in all areas of Restaurant operations.

Your Impact and Responsibilities:

• Purpose of the position:Executes Restaurant operations functionsActs as manager on duty and opens and closes the RestaurantManages cash handling and ensures accountability
• General to the role:Enforces Raising Cane’s policies and standardsExecutes shift management meeting Raising Cane’s operations and safety standardsUses required tools, forms and logs to support shift execution, document results and take corrective action when neededDeploys Crewmembers during a shiftProvides exemplary customer serviceUtilizes reward and recognition program for the Crewmembers in the RestaurantAuthorizes employee functions requiring manager approval (e.g. discounts, promotions, timeclock overrides, etc.)Ensures cleanliness of the Restaurant and ensures the facility is in good working orderCompletes other duties as assigned

Essential Functions:

The following requirements describe what is needed to successfully perform the role. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to support individuals with disabilities:

• Lift and carry up to 50 lbs., bend, kneel, twist, and reach overhead or below the waist

• Must be 18 years of age or older

• Able to recognize and analyze problems, set goals, create and convert plans into action to solve problems
• Proficient in a variety of technology systems including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and Outlook) and ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly

• New Restaurant opening experience

jobs.title: Steward / Dishwasher
jobs.description:
The Steward/Dishwasher is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, sanitation, and organization of all kitchen equipment, dishware, and back-of-house areas. This role is essential to supporting kitchen and restaurant operations by ensuring a steady supply of clean tools, cookware, and service items while maintaining the highest sanitation standards.

• Wash, sanitize, and polish all dishes, glassware, utensils, pots, pans, and kitchen equipment
• Ensure all cleaning is performed according to food safety and sanitation standards
• Maintain cleanliness and organization of dishwashing station and surrounding areas
• Operate dishwashing machines safely and efficiently, ensuring proper chemical usage and water temperatures
• Sort and properly store clean dishware, cookware, and service items in designated locations
• Remove trash, recycling, and waste from kitchen and service areas regularly
• Clean and sanitize kitchen floors, drains, walls, and work surfaces as needed
• Assist kitchen team by providing clean equipment and tools in a timely manner during service
• Break down and clean kitchen equipment at the end of service (grills, ovens, prep stations, etc.)
• Refill cleaning supplies, chemicals, and sanitizing solutions as needed
• Follow all HACCP, OSHA, and food safety guidelines at all times
• Support basic kitchen organization and cleanliness throughout shift
• Assist with receiving and storing deliveries when needed
• Maintain dish machine and report any maintenance or operational issues immediately

• Kitchen or Stewarding experience preferred
• Strong work ethic and reliability required
• Ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team
• Understanding of basic sanitation and cleanliness standards preferred
• Ability to work flexible schedule including nights, weekends, and holidays
• Ability to communicate effectively and efficiently with leadership and coworkers
• Food handler certification required as of start date

jobs.title: Site Safety Manager
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The Site Safety Manager is responsible for the safe and accident-free operation of their site. This includes identifying any potential safety hazards and implementing plans to prevent these dangers.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Coordinates and administers the Site Heath, Safety, environmental and Security Program for multiple locations.
• Investigates unsafe conditions and incidents, performs plant safety, security and environmental inspections and coordinates the corrective actions towards resolution.
• Ensure sites of responsibilities comply with Federal, State, Local & Veolia’s Health & Safety Standards.
• Recognize potential hazards and risks by implementing daily, weekly, monthly walk throughs.
• Conduct Monthly Safety Inspection Reports and track findings to closure.
• Report hazards and regulatory concerns to Project Managers & Regional VP of Operations.
• Ensure that all employees, subcontractors/vendors and visitors comply with applicable Veolia’s H&S policies & procedures.
• Complete, track and investigate incident/injury reports, near misses.
• Conduct root cause analysis investigations and develop corrective actions for all incidents.
• Develop and review site-specific safety related written SOPs and Job Safety Analysis (JSA).
• Ensure H&S files (documentation) are maintained to include training records, equipment inspection logs, industrial hygiene evaluations, and procedures certifications.
• Be accessible and visible to the employee population by monitoring, evaluating and addressing employee safety concerns and issues.
• Coordinate and monitor monthly site safety committee meetings.
• Deliver and distribute employee safety training requirements, safety alerts and monthly awareness, communications, concerns and suggestions.
• Provide new employee and contractor safety orientations.
• Ensure compliance and monitor requirements with the Process Safety Management (PSM) Standard.
• Coordinate site specific emergency planning programs. Develop and review site emergency programs (fire, hurricane, chemical spills, etc.).
• Implement fire and emergency drills.
• Participates and coordinates all visits of federal, state and insurance inspectors and follows up on their recommendations.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Associate’s Degree or equivalent.
• Bachelor’s degree in occupational or environmental health strongly preferred.
• Experience in developing and coordinating safety programs and delivering safety training is a plus.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Working knowledge of OSHA (Occupational Safety and Hazards Administration) regulations and requirements.
• Working knowledge of State and Federal laws, local ordinances, and other rules and regulations associated with facility and employee safety and security.
• Competent to implement site specific safety procedures; i.e.; Hazard Communication, Process Safety Management, Electrical Safety, Emergency Management plan, etc.
• Must complete a physical fitness test to wear a respirator (if applicable) and any required safety equipment necessary to perform these duties.
• Must demonstrate the ability to handle multiple tasks and changing priorities in a fast paced environment.
• Requires competency with software applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint with ability to download, manipulate and report data. Ability to learn other programs including Caribou, OPS32, MP-2 and Triple-I database software.
• Must demonstrate effective communication skills (verbal, presentation and listening) to interact with all levels of personnel. Demonstrated ability to prepare accurate, effective, complete and easily understood written communications and reports.
• Must be able to respond to emergencies at the plant during off hours and weekends.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Certified on first-aid and CPR.
• Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Associate Director, IT, Solutions Analyst (Private Debt Servicing) - Sentry/Broadridge
jobs.description:
The Solution Analyst owns the front-end analysis that turns an emerging business need into a clearly defined, well-understood piece of work, with the outcome, scope, and rationale established before delivery begins.

This is a Solution Analyst role within our loan administration and private debt servicing area. This is a business process outsourcing service: we service loans and private debt on behalf of clients, calculating and collecting borrower interest and allocating it to lenders, maintaining the loan records that downstream reporting and fund valuation depend on. The role brings deep loan-servicing and private-debt operational knowledge into the front-end. In some cases this servicing links into wider fund administration offerings we provide, and in others it stands alone.

The role sits within Tech Solutions as a deployable analytical and subject-matter-expert resource, not permanently embedded in any one team, and is deployed against the pipeline of work in this area.

What you'll do

• Act as the subject-matter expert and analytical lead for the platforms and processes that support our Private Debt offerings: loan administration, loan agency and CLO.
• Cover the loan lifecycle from deal and position set-up through interest and fee calculation, drawdowns, repayments, and lender allocations, to the front-end shaping of solutions, so the work handed to delivery teams reflects how loan servicing actually operates and where it can be improved.
• Protect the integrity of the loan data that flows into downstream reporting and fund valuation, making sure that what the servicing platform produces is timely, accurate, and fit for the processes that depend on it.
• Conduct front-end analysis, covering feasibility, operating-model implications, data quality, and readiness, before a delivery team picks the work up.
• Collaborate across stakeholder groups to define and document business requirements, translating current-state analysis, requirements, and gaps into a clear solution intent.
• Retrieve the information needed to do the analysis directly, querying data, reviewing system configuration and behaviour, and running analysis using AI tooling where it helps.
• Work alongside Solution Owners at the front-end to shape intent and acceptance criteria for the parts of the work that carry the most complexity.
• Represent technical limitations and implementation realities back to business stakeholders, and business intent back to engineers.
• Identify risks a delivery team would not otherwise see, including data gaps, downstream impacts, operational-readiness concerns, and regulatory implications.
• Partner with Integration Quality Engineers on cross-team and cross-solution test scenarios that no single team can cover.
• Support adoption readiness where value realisation depends on more than the build, including communications, training, data clean-up, and operational change, particularly where readiness work spans teams.
• Recognise patterns across the business area, including recurring themes, overlaps, and opportunities for reuse, feeding roadmap shaping.
• Create and maintain supporting product documentation, including system overviews, functional narratives, and use cases.

Required

• 8+ years of experience in loan administration, loan agency, or private debt / private credit servicing, ideally within a fund services, asset servicing, or agency-lending environment.
• Hands-on experience with Sentry (Broadridge). Experience in similar platforms would also be valuable (e.g. Allvue, Wall Street Office)
• Experience or exposure to system integrations using APIs, SQL, S3, Snowflake and similar technologies.
• Strong working knowledge of the syndicated and bilateral loan operating model: interest and fee accruals, coupon and amortisation schedules, drawdowns and repayments, PIK, unfunded commitments, and the pro-rata allocation of borrower interest to lenders.
• Demonstrable understanding of the loan life cycle end to end - from document interpretation and extraction of loan economics, through reporting build and integrations to downstream systems, all underpinned by reconciliations to safeguard data integrity.
• Substantial experience gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements, and translating them into clear solution intent and acceptance criteria.
• Experience modelling business processes and produce analytical artefacts such as process models, use cases, procedural guides, and scenarios.
• Experience driving requirements-gathering sessions using a variety of elicitation techniques (user story mapping, event storming etc).

Preferred

• Understanding of how loan servicing connects into fund accounting and NAV production, including exposure to a private markets accounting platform such as Investran, is a plus.
• Experience using AI tools to accelerate the development of prototypes and proof-of-concepts (POCs).
• Experience of platform implementation, configuration, or migration projects.

jobs.title: Director, Security
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

The Director, Security is responsible for leading Riot Platforms' security strategy across all office spaces and data center locations. This role is primarily focused on physical security system design, critical infrastructure protection, protective operations, and security operations at scale, with close partnership across Operations, Facilities, Engineering, IT/OT, Construction, HR, and Cybersecurity to safeguard people, assets, and operations.

Reporting to Riot’s VP, Security, this leader will build and manage a high-performing security organization, establish design standards and operational frameworks across sites, and ensure Riot's office spaces and data centers operate with best‑in‑class security, resilience, and compliance. This role requires a blend of technical design expertise, operational leadership, and executive influence to protect personnel and critical environments.

This position will be hybrid based in our Austin, Texas office.

What you'll do

• Lead the global physical security strategy, standards, and roadmap for Riot's data center portfolio, ensuring alignment with business objectives and executive priorities.
• Direct the design, engineering, and implementation of advanced physical security systems (e.g., access control, CCTV, intrusion detection) for all data center projects, from concept to full lifecycle management.
• Partner with Operations, Facilities, and Engineering to safeguard personnel and critical infrastructure (power, cooling, network, mining hardware) against physical threats and ensure operational resilience.
• Lead security risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with relevant regulations, standards, and internal policies—including ASIS standards, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 physical security controls, and NFPA codes—across the data center footprint.
• Direct incident response activities for physical security breaches and emergencies, collaborating with internal teams and external agencies (e.g., law enforcement) as required.
• Build and oversee a Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) providing 24/7 monitoring, and lead adjacent protective programs including executive protection, workplace-violence prevention, travel-risk management, and insider-threat detection.
• Manage key security vendors, integrators, and consultants, and optimize the capital and operating budget for data center security investments.
• Foster strong partnerships with IT, OT, Cybersecurity, and other departments to ensure integrated security solutions and a unified approach to risk.

What you'll bring

• Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent education/experience considered.
• 15+ years of progressive security operations leadership at a global scale.
• 10+ years of experience specializing in large-scale / mission-critical center environments.
• Proven expertise in managing third‑party vendors, leading global product/site launches, and navigating international data center regulations.
• Deep knowledge of physical security principles, technologies, risk management, and incident response in high‑availability environments.
• Strong technical understanding of cloud services, networking, and critical infrastructure (power, cooling, ICS/OT).
• Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and lead global teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive complex initiatives in a fast‑paced, 24/7 environment.
• Willingness to travel regularly to Riot data center locations.

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.

• Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.

• Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Market Sales Manager - Detroit (GolfNow)
jobs.description:
GolfNow is seeking a Market Sales Manager to drive sales, retention, and account growth across GolfNow’s suite of software, technology, and marketing solutions. This role owns the full sales cycle across assigned accounts, with a strong focus on expanding adoption of GolfNow’s tee sheet, point of sale, handheld POS, and related SaaS solutions that help golf course operators run more efficient, profitable businesses.

Why This Role Matters

This role directly supports GolfNow’s growth by expanding client relationships, increasing technology and product adoption, improving tee time utilization, and strengthening market penetration. Success in this role will help golf course partners grow rounds, revenue, and operational efficiency while advancing GolfNow’s position as a trusted technology, SaaS, and marketing partner.

This is a remote role supporting the GolfNow platform, with regular in-market travel to engage golf course partners and prospects. Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the greater Detroit area.

What You’ll Do

• Own the full sales cycle across assigned markets, including account planning, relationship development, discovery, solution selling, negotiation, retention, expansion, and closing opportunities across GolfNow’s tee sheet, point of sale, handheld POS, and related SaaS solutions.
• Build trusted advisor relationships with golf course partners, prospects, and multi-course operators by understanding their business challenges and aligning GolfNow technology and marketing solutions to their goals.
• Retain and grow an existing book of business by identifying partner needs, uncovering expansion opportunities, and positioning GolfNow solutions that support measurable business outcomes.
• Prepare and present customized GolfNow solutions that address partner needs across operations, revenue management, golfer engagement, tee time utilization, and technology adoption.
• Become a market expert by developing detailed knowledge of local golf courses, competitive dynamics, decision-makers, market trends, and sales opportunities.
• Track sales activities, pipeline progress, revenue performance, retention opportunities, product adoption, and partner insights in CRM system.
• Partner with regional leadership and internal teams to analyze market opportunities, execute sales and marketing strategies, and improve key performance metrics including client growth, retention, product adoption, tee time utilization, and golfer engagement.

Technology Competency

• Develop strong product fluency across GolfNow’s core technology platforms, including tee sheet, point of sale, handheld POS, and related SaaS solutions.
• Effectively demonstrate how GolfNow technology supports golf course operations, revenue growth, payment efficiency, staff productivity, and golfer experience.
• Partner with internal product, support, onboarding, and account teams to support successful implementation, adoption, retention, and expansion of GolfNow technology solutions.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of relevant SaaS sales, digital marketing, account management, business development, or technology sales experience.
• Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, close new business, grow an existing book of business, and retain customers in a recurring revenue or SaaS environment.
• Experience selling software, point of sale, payments, online distribution, marketing technology, or similar business technology products, preferably within hospitality, recreation, golf, sports, payments, or point of sale environments.
• Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, discovery, and negotiation skills.
• Comfort using CRM tools such as Salesforce, along with strong computer and internet-based research skills.
• Business acumen, problem-solving ability, and a track record of meeting or exceeding goals.
• Ability to travel extensively, including weekends or short-notice business needs.

Bonus Points For

• Experience selling tee sheet, point of sale, handheld POS, payments, reservation, inventory, or business management software.
• Experience working with golf courses, resorts, hospitality operators, multi-location businesses, or owner-operated businesses.
• Sales development, sales strategy, market expansion, or customer retention experience.
• A college degree or equivalent relevant experience.

You’ll be successful here by demonstrating Versant’s “How We Do It” behaviors: building Trust with partners and teammates, using Teamwork to collaborate across regional and internal teams, practicing Transparency through clear communication and accurate pipeline reporting, showing Agility in a dynamic sales environment, and bringing an Entrepreneurial Spirit to identify opportunities, solve problems, and grow the business.

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Versant, you’ll be part of a portfolio of brands that inform, entertain, and connect audiences across culture, sports, business, entertainment, and beyond. In this role, you’ll help shape the future of GolfNow’s market presence by partnering directly with golf course operators and resort leaders to solve real business challenges.

This role offers flexibility while maintaining meaningful opportunities for in-person collaboration with clients, teammates, and business partners. You’ll join a team that values accountability, partnership, clear communication, adaptability, and an entrepreneurial mindset.

jobs.title: Sales Data Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description:
Lakeshore Learning helps educators and families find tools that make learning meaningful, and great decisions at Lakeshore start with great data.

As a Sales Data Analyst on our Sales Operations team, you'll turn raw data into clear, reliable reporting that our sales and cross-functional teams use every day to make smarter decisions. This is a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in getting the numbers right and telling a clean, honest story with data.

A day on the job looks like this:

• Build, maintain, and distribute sales reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses that track pipeline activity, customer trends, and sales performance.
• Extract and transform data from Salesforce, Data lake and warehouse systems, and business intelligence platforms to support accurate, consistent reporting across the organization.
• Run routine data audits and validation checks to catch gaps, flag inconsistencies, and keep reporting outputs trustworthy.
• Partner with Retail, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Bid, IT, and other teams to understand reporting needs, troubleshoot data issues, and deliver timely insights.
• Document reporting processes, support tool maintenance, and continuously look for ways to improve how we build and share data.

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

• 2+ years of experience in sales analysis, business analysis, data analysis, or a closely related field
• High proficiency in Excel, including Power Query, and experience working with a CRM such as Salesforce
• Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI or a comparable platform
• Demonstrated ability to audit, validate, and maintain data accuracy across reporting workflows
• This is a fully remote role; reliable home office setup and self-directed work habits required

Preferred:

• Experience supporting sales operations or working alongside sales and marketing teams
• Familiarity with data lake environments or enterprise data extraction processes
• Exposure to documenting reporting processes or supporting tool migrations

What sets you apart:

• You catch the error before anyone else does — and you fix it without being asked
• You can translate a messy data request into a clean, useful output without needing every detail spelled out
• You communicate what the data actually says, not just what stakeholders hoped to hear
• You manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or dropping the ball on routine deliverables

And here’s our end of the bargain!

At Lakeshore, we pay local market wages for employees that reside within Los Angeles and Orange Counties. For employees residing outside of Los Angeles and Orange Counties, pay is based on national market.

For this position, new employees joining Lakeshore are typically brought into the organization at a hourly rate between $22.35-$24.03 depending on relevant experience & skillset.

This range is indicative of projected hiring range. The annual base compensation will take into account each candidate's relevant experience, location, and skillset.

• Bonus eligible
• Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding
• Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage—EPO, PPO and HSA
• 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
• Flexible benefits—choose what you like, ignore the rest
• On-site preschool for our employees’ children
• On-site employee gym for all levels/fitness needs
• Generous employee discount
• Casual dress…and we really mean it

At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.

We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it’s a great experience to be part of. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Experience in bridge design and transportation structures.

• Experience with MicroStation and/or AutoCAD.

jobs.title: Veterinary Practice Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire an experienced Practice Manager pre-opening to help build the operational foundation for our grand opening in November of 2026. The Practice Manager will serve as the primary onsite business and operational leader, partnering closely with the Veterinarian owner and regional field leadership to build a high-performing, financially healthy, and well-run urgent care practice.

Pre-opening responsibilities and opportunities:

• Practice setup and facility preparation.
• Equipment ordering, tracking, unpacking, and stocking.
• Pre-opening referral marketing.
• Vendor connections.
• Support in Practice Management System setup and workflow.
• Supply purchasing, tracking, unpacking, and stocking.
• Reviewing budgeted pro forma with regional operations leaders and expense tracking.
• Reviewing and analyzing operational KPIs, reporting cadence, and opening performance targets.
• Support Staff interviewing, hiring and training in preparation for the grand opening.
• Staffing labor planning, and schedule build.
• Building workflows and accountability standards that support patient flow, client experience, productivity, and financial performance.
• The successful Practice Manager will be comfortable owning both people leadership and business performance. This individual should be able to understand practice financials, manage labor and staffing to demand, monitor key performance indicators, identify operational opportunities, and build action plans that improve hospital performance while maintaining an excellent client and team experience.

General practice manager duties:

• Partner with the veterinary regional manager and medical leadership on staffing strategy, organizational structure, performance management, compensation recommendations, scheduling, and other personnel decisions that impact hospital performance.
• Build and manage employee schedules based on forecasted patient demand, operating hours, productivity expectations, and labor targets; proactively adjust staffing as business needs change.
• Lead ongoing coaching, training, performance management, and accountability. Set clear expectations, provide timely feedback, develop team members, complete performance reviews, and implement corrective action when needed.
• Recruit, hire, onboard, develop, and retain team members who align with the culture and operational needs of the hospital. Partner with HR and regional leadership on compensation, performance concerns, and separations in accordance with company policies.
• Develop and execute local growth initiatives in partnership with Marketing and regional leadership, including community outreach, referral relationships, client experience, reputation management, and other activities that support patient volume and revenue growth.
• Maintain strong employee-management communication, resolve team concerns appropriately, and create a culture of accountability, engagement, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Maintain a strong understanding of the client and patient workflow from arrival through discharge and identify opportunities to improve throughput, wait times, communication, and the overall client experience.
• Remain willing and able to step into frontline operations when needed while maintaining primary accountability for leadership, business performance, and hospital operations.
• Ensure client concerns are addressed promptly and professionally; identify recurring themes and implement operational solutions that improve service and retention.
• Exercise sound, unbiased business judgment when managing people, resources, and hospital priorities, including appropriate recommendations regarding performance or disciplinary action.
• Own inventory and purchasing controls to maintain appropriate supply levels while managing cost, pricing, waste, and working capital. Monitor inventory performance, controlled substances, equipment needs, vendor pricing, and returns.
• Ensure hospital compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements, including DEA/controlled substances, OSHA, safety, and required operational standards.
• Ensure payroll and timekeeping are accurate and timely while actively managing overtime, schedule efficiency, and overall labor performance against hospital targets.
• Manage vendor relationships at the hospital level, ensuring appropriate service, competitive pricing, and timely resolution of operational issues.
• Partner with medical leadership to ensure appropriate urgent and emergency patient workflows, escalation processes, and operational readiness.
• Own day-to-day hospital business performance and routinely review key metrics such as revenue, transactions, average client transaction, labor, COGS, productivity, client demand, and profitability.
• Partner with regional leadership to build and manage the hospital budget, understand monthly P&L performance, explain material variances, and execute corrective action plans when performance is off target.
• Develop staffing plans that balance patient demand, service levels, team wellbeing, and financial expectations; actively manage overtime, productivity, and labor efficiency.
• Use data and operational reporting to identify trends, diagnose root causes, prioritize opportunities, and drive measurable improvement in hospital performance.
• Maintain ownership of hospital execution by establishing clear priorities, assigning accountability, following up on commitments, and closing the loop on operational issues.
• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of veterinary practice management. Candidates should have demonstrated responsibility for staffing, financial performance, operations, and team leadership. CVPM or equivalent management certification is preferred but not required.

• Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to understand and manage practice-level financial performance, including revenue, labor, COGS, expenses, budgets, and profitability.
• Proven ability to use operational and financial KPIs to identify opportunities, develop action plans, and hold teams accountable for measurable results.
• Strong people leadership skills with demonstrated experience building teams, managing performance, navigating difficult conversations, and developing future leaders.
• Excellent communication and partnership skills with the ability to work effectively with doctors, support teams, regional leadership, and partners.
• Highly organized, technologically proficient, and comfortable learning and managing practice management systems, scheduling tools, reporting platforms, and other business systems.
• Strong understanding of veterinary hospital operations, including patient flow, scheduling, inventory, client service, staffing models, and clinical support workflows.
• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and making timely decisions using data, business judgment, and available resources.
• Self-directed and solutions-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership, follow through, and continuously improve hospital performance.
• Flexible availability based on hospital needs, including the ability to support opening/closing operations, peak demand periods, and occasional weekends or holidays as required.

jobs.description:
The Asset Strategy Leader is an experienced and established leader with the ability to influence across multiple functions and levels within Abbvie who serves as the matrix leader with overall accountability for an asset from discovery to end of life cycle.  He / she guides and directs the creation and execution of a comprehensive asset strategy and phase appropriate brand strategies for one or multiple asset(s).  This responsibility requires consideration and integration of all functional activities relevant to the successful development, registration, manufacture and commercialization, of the asset throughout its lifecycle with specific emphasis on ensuring an integrated strategy across these elements.  Serving as the primary face of the asset at AbbVie, the Asset Strategy Leader works with governance, functional leaders, and other cross-functional groups and external development partners, to advance and optimize the value of the asset consistent with its prioritization in the overall portfolio. This is not an entry point to a leadership position, but will require someone with a broad exposure to all the activities involved in successfully developing and launching assets and brands (Development, Discovery, Development Sciences, Operations, Commercial, Market Access, Regulatory, Safety, Project Management, Medical Affairs, etc., and substantial cross-functional interaction during your career) to draw upon past experiences that will provide the best outcomes for the progress, registration, reimbursement and life cycle of one or more assets or brands.  The position will require broad leadership skills with enterprise level thinking.

This position is based on site at one of AbbVie’s main locations (e.g., Irvine, Lake County, San Fransisco, New Jersey).

Responsibilities

• Chairs an Asset Strategy Team (AST). In this capacity, serves as the enterprise leader who is the project’s primary point of contact for Pipeline Governance and senior management.
• Has a broad vision for the asset and leads the effort to create, articulate and gain endorsement of an integrated cross-functional Global Asset Strategy and Brand Strategy for all aspects of product development, commercialization and lifecycle management and ensures timely, multidirectional and comprehensive interactions with Pipeline Governance within the Pipeline Operating Model, including close liaison with the key governance bodies of Aesthetics Device Governance Board, Tri-Function Review and other ad hoc governance requests within Abbvie.
• Ability to put asset recommendations in context of Abbvie’s enterprise objectives
• Maintains primary responsibility for the ensuing deliverables, including a functionally aligned Global Asset Strategy and Product Development Plan (PDP).Reviews and analyzes emerging data objectively to drive team toward recommendations that highlight opportunities, address potential risks and proactively provide appropriate mitigations.
• Builds strong, collaborative peer-to-peer relationships with governance team members and executives to enable optimal timely, multi-directional, and comprehensive interactions with PCM Governance at pre-specified milestones and as program issues or opportunities arise.
• Has a deep understanding of the role and value of each function on the team, to know how to solicit timely input. Collaborates with AST functions to ensure program is appropriately resourced and stays within allocated budget and champions requests for incremental resources when appropriate. Works continually with supporting teams to ensure that strategy and executed plans are consistent with the Target Product Profile (TPP), Asset Plan and PDP, tracking progress in conjunction with the Portfolio Project Manager, with attention to committed timeline and budget.
• Ensures that the AST continually validates the viability of the program from a scientific and commercial perspective. Develops clear, prospective Go/No-Go decision points and serves as a champion for the program, using objectivity and judgment to analyze, interpret and present data to Pipeline Governance and senior management.
• Strategic advisor to cross-functional teams (e.g., Global Brand Team, CMC, Integrated evidence strategy team, Value and Access team, Regulatory strategy, etc.).Ensure development and alignment with deliverable team co-chairs for key plan deliverables such as the Integrated Evidence Plan, Regulatory Strategy plans, Brand plans, Operations LRP plans.
• Establishes close, ongoing ties with across Asset and deliverable team members and enables a culture of inclusivity, psychological safety, and empowerment. Maintains a function-neutral position in prioritizing actions and making decisions, with an eye toward optimizing asset and portfolio value in a timely and high-quality fashion. Coaches and mentors team members, consistent with the High Performing Teams (HPT) model. Enables the AST to focus on strategy and decision-making, and optimal communication of issues to support teams and leadership.
• Represents the AST at interactions with external parties (e.g., Advisory Boards, regulatory interactions) when these engagements require broad cross-functional contributions. Exhibits exceptional executive presence and clear communication with all levels of management.
• Works with team members to maintain a comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of the competitive environment in the field and to assess for potential impact on ongoing programs. Stays abreast of professional information, industry trends, and emerging technology through conferences, medical literature, and training to augment expertise in drug development and the pharmaceutical industry. Develops a comprehensive understanding of how AbbVie’s assets are positioned relative to competitor assets
• Understands what’s important and focuses the team and stakeholders there as well. Asks the right question and seeks all points of view in order to find the best path forward.

• Relevant experience (minimum of 5 years to 8 years; 10+ years preferred) as a leader in a pharmaceutical/biotech Commercial, R&D, Regulatory or Operations setting; deep expertise in a relevant discipline associated with drug development and /or commercialization and ideally experienced in multiple areas of the industry, often with multiple therapy areas, phases of development.
• Demonstrated a high-level of strategic thinking, leadership, and problem-solving, with the ability to swiftly apply new knowledge to asset strategy and enterprise priorities.
• Ideally experienced across multiple device product development, particular emphasis on aesthetics programs.
• Have had the experience of following a single asset and associated brands through all the phases of the development and commercialization of a single asset will be preferred but achieving as an aggregate of experience across multiple assets is also acceptable.
• Demonstrated ability to lead. motivate and elicit top performance from teams in a cross functional, highly matrixed pharmaceutical/biotech environment, preferably with global scope, in any discipline which involves a broad understanding of all phases of drug commercialization.
• Ability to objectively exercise judgment and create pragmatic solutions to address complex cross-functional problems, and to be accountable for obtaining stakeholder advice to make informed decisions, to move a program forward in the face of uncertainty or incomplete data. Can stand alone or take unpopular decisions to ensure appropriate organizational decisions.

jobs.title: Account Manager

Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder?

• Je werkt voor een toonaangevende organisatie binnen voedselveiligheid en kwaliteitszorg.

• Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen je eigen klantenportfolio.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Account Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor een eigen klantenportefeuille binnen de foodsector. Je onderhoudt relaties met bestaande klanten, denkt mee over hun uitdagingen en adviseert over passende oplossingen op het gebied van voedselveiligheid, kwaliteitszorg, inspecties en opleidingen.

Je stelt accountplannen op, bewaakt de klanttevredenheid en signaleert mogelijkheden om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen. Daarnaast ben je actief bezig met het genereren van nieuwe business en weet je potentiële klanten te overtuigen van de meerwaarde van Eurofins Bureau de Wit.

Je voert advies-, relatie- en verkoopgesprekken, stelt offertes op en volgt commerciële voorstellen op. Daarnaast vertegenwoordig je Eurofins Bureau de Wit tijdens netwerkbijeenkomsten, beurzen en branche-evenementen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van sales, inspectie en kwaliteitszorg om klanten optimaal te ondersteunen.

De functie bestaat voor ongeveer 60% uit relatiebeheer en 40% uit acquisitie.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

• Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau.
• Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring in accountmanagement, sales of business development.
• Je hebt ervaring binnen de foodsector, voedingsmiddelenindustrie, foodservice, groothandel of een vergelijkbare markt.
• Je bent commercieel, zelfstandig en resultaatgericht.
• Je herkent kansen in de markt en weet deze om te zetten in duurzame klantrelaties.

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
• Een salaris tussen €4.047,00 en €5.000,00 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van ervaring.
• Een (volledig elektrische) leaseauto, die je ook privé mag gebruiken.
• 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra verlof te kopen.

• Winstdelingsregeling en individueel keuzebudget voor extra flexibiliteit.
• Inclusieve werkomgeving met keuzevrijheid voor feestdagen die jij belangrijk vindt.

Over Eurofins Bureau de Wit

Eurofins Bureau de Wit ondersteunt organisaties binnen de foodsector met advies, inspecties, kwaliteitszorg en opleidingen. Dagelijks helpen wij producenten, verwerkers, retailers en andere organisaties om te voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving en hun kwaliteitssystemen verder te verbeteren.

Als onderdeel van Eurofins maken wij deel uit van een internationaal netwerk van laboratoria en specialisten. Vanuit onze inhoudelijke expertise en praktijkgerichte aanpak ondersteunen wij klanten bij het waarborgen van voedselveiligheid en kwaliteit. Daarmee leveren wij een belangrijke bijdrage aan veilige voedingsmiddelen voor consumenten in Nederland en daarbuiten.

Bij Eurofins investeren we in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers met opleidingen, trainingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je krijgt de vrijheid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en je eigen succes vorm te geven binnen een organisatie die continu groeit.

Solliciteren

Is deze vacature iets voor jou? Stuur dan je cv naar ons op. Ook als je twijfelt of je helemaal past, kijken we graag samen naar jouw talent en mogelijkheden.

Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op via corporaterecruitment@ftbnl.eurofins.com. We vertellen je graag meer.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Digital Product Manager is responsible for shaping, delivering, and continuously improving digital products that create meaningful customer experiences and measurable business value. This role owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and performance of digital capabilities across web, mobile, eCommerce, omnichannel, and internal platforms. The ideal candidate combines customer empathy, analytical discipline, technical fluency, and strong cross-functional leadership to turn business goals and user needs into successful digital solutions.

What Would You Do? The Specifics.

• Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for assigned digital products.
• Translate customer needs, business objectives, market trends, and data insights into prioritized product requirements and user stories.
• Own and manage the product backlog, balancing customer impact, revenue opportunity, operational needs, technical feasibility, and delivery capacity.
• Partner closely with UX, engineering, analytics, marketing, operations, merchandising, customer support, legal, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
• Lead product discovery activities, including customer research, competitive analysis, journey mapping, usability testing, and opportunity sizing.
• Drive agile ceremonies and delivery alignment, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, acceptance criteria, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
• Use data, experimentation, A/B testing, and performance reporting to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continuously improve product performance.
• Coordinate go-to-market planning, launch communications, stakeholder training, and adoption support for new digital capabilities.
• Monitor product health, customer feedback, defects, accessibility considerations, and operational issues; prioritize enhancements and fixes accordingly.
• Communicate roadmap progress, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and results clearly to executive leaders and cross-functional partners.

Work Experience

• 4-6 years in product management, digital product ownership, eCommerce, technology delivery, UX, business analysis, or a related discipline (Required)
• Demonstrated experience managing digital products through the full lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch, optimization, and ongoing support. (Required)
• Experience using analytics tools and product performance data to inform prioritization and decision-making. (Required)
• Experience with eCommerce, omnichannel retail, customer account platforms, scheduling, checkout, payments, personalization, search, or digital marketing capabilities. (Preferred)
• Experience with conversion rate optimization, funnel analysis, customer journey analytics, SEO, accessibility, privacy, or experimentation programs. (Preferred)

Education

• Four year college degree or equivalent experience. in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (Required)
• Master's Degree MBA (Preferred)

Licenses, Certifications, Professional Affiliations

• Certified Scrum Product Owner, Product Management certification, Agile certification Upon Hire (Preferred)

Additional Skills

• Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and backlog management. (Required)
• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and translate complex concepts into clear business and customer outcomes. (Required)
• Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. (Required)
• Customer-first mindset with a strong ability to understand user needs and pain points. (Required)
• Strategic thinking with the ability to connect product decisions to business outcomes. (Required)
• Analytical rigor and comfort working with quantitative and qualitative insights. (Required)
• Strong collaboration skills across business, technology, creative, and operational teams. (Required)
• Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing demands. (Required)
• Clear, concise communication for both executive and delivery-team audiences. (Required)
• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Figma, GA4/GA360, Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, Optimizely, or similar platforms. (Preferred)

Taking Care of our People!

We understand the importance of financial health and security, and because of that, we provide competitive compensation to all associates. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including health and dental insurance, 401k retirement savings with company match, flex spending account, paid personal time off, paid company holidays, parental leave, employee eyewear discount, and much, much more. At National Vision, we strive to deliver opportunities for professional growth and long-term career fulfillment. We provide training programs and access to educational courses and pride ourselves on the ever-increasing amount of promotions from within.#LI-SH1

jobs.title: Store Delivery Driver
jobs.description:
As a Delivery Expert you are the mechanism for delivering fast and delectably delicious pizzas to our hungry customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, punctuality and sense of urgency are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week, and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have one years of driving history
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check
• Must pass Motor Vehicle Record Check, meeting company-specific standards

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of customers, sales, supply chain, finance, and operations.

Whether you're coming from account management, customer service, supply chain, or commercial operations, this position offers a unique opportunity to build broad business expertise, gain customer-facing experience, and develop into larger commercial leadership roles over time.

Why This Role?

This isn't just another operations position. It's a career-building opportunity designed with growth in mind.

You'll start by owning customer relationships and operational execution for assigned accounts while learning the business and developing commercial expertise. As your experience and impact grow, you'll have opportunities to take on larger, more complex customers, greater strategic responsibility, and expanded business ownership.

Success in this role can lead to progression into higher-level sales operations, account management, customer strategy, and commercial leadership opportunities.

What You'll Do

• Own day-to-day execution and customer success for assigned accounts, serving as a trusted partner and primary point of contact.
• Drive forecasting, supply planning, and service performance to ensure customer needs are met and business goals are achieved.
• Proactively identify risks, solve problems, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver solutions and maintain a seamless customer experience.
• Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and Operations to align priorities and close gaps to plan.
• Monitor account performance, contract commitments, and key business metrics while communicating progress, risks, and recovery plans.
• Take increasing ownership of customer relationships and business results as you grow into larger accounts and expanded commercial responsibilities.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• 3+ years of experience in account management, customer service, supply chain, commercial operations, or a related field.
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across teams.
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
• Self-starter mentality with a desire to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility.
• Experience in a matrixed or cross-functional organization is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr. QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role:

The Senior QA Engineer on the Duro Design team defines, builds, and scales the quality systems that ensure hardware engineers can rely on our platform every day. You’ll architect and implement quality strategy across our modern stack—from frontend interfaces to backend services—embedding confidence into how we design, ship, and operate software. This role partners closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teammates in a fast-moving, highly autonomous environment.

We’re looking for engineers who think systemically about risk, embrace experimentation, and leverage modern AI-powered workflows to elevate quality across the organization. This is a hybrid role based in Los Angeles, CA (3 days per week in office).

A day in the life of our Senior QA Engineer:

• Quality Strategy Ownership: Define and evolve our end-to-end quality strategy, determining what gets tested, at which layer, and how coverage maps to real user risk.
• Test Architecture: Design and maintain scalable test infrastructure across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers using modern frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, and Playwright.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner early with product and engineering teams to ensure features are testable by design and quality is embedded before code reaches production.
• Full Stack Validation: Validate React interfaces, GraphQL APIs, and PostgreSQL data integrity to ensure system-wide reliability.
• CI/CD Optimization: Architect and refine test pipelines in GitHub Actions (or similar) to balance speed, coverage, and deployment confidence.
• Experimentation & Analytics: Leverage PostHog session replays, feature flags, and analytics to detect regressions, surface edge cases, and proactively identify risk.
• AI-Driven Quality Engineering: Utilize AI-augmented development workflows to generate test scaffolding, explore edge cases, and increase velocity while maintaining rigorous standards.
• Continuous Improvement: Lead regression analysis and incident retrospectives, transforming defects into systemic improvements that strengthen long-term product resilience.

Required:

• 8+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering or software engineering with strong ownership of quality systems
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, and Playwright
• Experience testing React frontends and GraphQL-based APIs
• Experience working with PostgreSQL and validating data integrity across service layers
• Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar)
• Strong architectural thinking with the ability to design scalable, maintainable quality systems
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Comfort operating in autonomous, fast-paced environments
• A product mindset with the ability to anticipate risk across the full feature lifecycle

Nice to Have:

• Experience building PLM, PDM, or hardware/manufacturing industry software
• Background in performance, load, or stress testing
• Experience with visual regression testing tools (Percy, Chromatic, BackstopJS)
• Familiarity with contract testing (Pact or similar)
• Experience defining release readiness criteria or quality SLAs
• Experience working in AI-augmented development environments

How We Build

We don’t hire testers. We hire engineers who elevate quality.

At Duro, AI is integrated into our engineering workflows. Engineers leverage AI-powered development environments to orchestrate tasks, structure context, and accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards of craftsmanship.

We value:

Architectural intuition — understanding systems before implementing them

Precision in communication — clear requirements produce strong outcomes

Pattern recognition — knowing when to abstract, reuse, or experiment

Product taste — recognizing quality and refining toward excellence

Intellectual curiosity — continuously improving how we build

We optimize for engineers who can look at a roadmap, anticipate where quality risk will concentrate, and design systems that enable teams to ship quickly with confidence.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $150,000 to $175,000 annually. Actual compensation packages within this range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate and role requirements, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days per week in our Los Angeles office)

jobs.title: Senior Medical Director, Hematology – Lymphoma (Lacutamab)
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Medical Director, Hematology – Lymphoma leads the medical strategy for the Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma (CTCL) disease area within Hematology Medical Affairs, driving both brand medical strategy and external engagement with Opinion Leaders, community physicians, medical societies, and top accounts.

This role offers an experienced Medical Director the opportunity to lead medical strategy for a complex hematologic malignancy, engaging across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities while shaping how Sobi supports the CTCL patient and provider community. The Senior Medical Director will also lead launch preparatory efforts for lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2.

The Senior Medical Director serves as the lead medical voice for lymphoma and lacutamab, conceptualizing and implementing the US medical strategy for the disease area. This person reports to the Vice President, Head of Hematology Medical Affairs, partners closely with Field Medical to engage HCPs, medical organizations, payers, and patient advocacy groups, and acts as the medical lead on the Brand Team.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Strategy & Launch Leadership

• Serve as the lead medical strategist for CTCL and lacutamab, providing strategic leadership for medical strategy, brand-aligned tactics, and external clinician engagement across academic, community, and multidisciplinary care settings
• Own launch readiness for lacutamab, including disease education, unmet need articulation, and evidence generation planning
• Contribute analytic expertise and insights to Medical Affairs deliverables

External Engagement & Field Medical Partnership

• Partner with Field Medical to develop and enhance KOL and key institution engagement plans, positioning Sobi as the scientific partner of choice for CTCL across the hematology-oncology community
• Collaborate with Field Medical on resource needs and development of field materials and tactics specific to CTCL and lacutamab
• Lead planning and execution of advisory boards and educational activities (webinars, medical roundtables, symposia, congress presence)

Insight Generation & Evidence

• Generate and share medical insights with the field team; analyze insights to inform strategy and tactical adjustments
• Contribute to evidence generation projects, real-world evidence studies, and publications supporting the CTCL disease area and lacutamab

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build strong collaborative relationships with Market Access, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Sales, and Marketing
• Act as the medical lead on the Brand Team and support cross-functional initiatives across the organization

Culture

• Contribute to a strong team culture within Hematology/Oncology Medical Affairs, grounded in mutual respect and constructive challenge toward shared goals

Required

• MD, PhD, or PharmD
• 5+ years of Medical Director experience
• Pre-launch and/or launch experience
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex scientific concepts for varied audiences
• Strong ability to form meaningful, bi-directional relationships with the medical community
• Strong scientific and clinical acumen, with strategic and analytical capability
• Demonstrated leadership across core Medical Affairs functions (evidence generation, publications, medical education, strategy development)
• Willingness and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, team-based environment with colleagues at all levels
• Self-starter with strong interpersonal skills and a results-driven, solution-oriented approach
• Ability to travel up to 50%, primarily domestic
• Patient-focused mindset

Preferred

• Background in Hematology-Oncology

Competencies & Attributes

• Strong scientific curiosity with the drive to lead in a complex, evolving disease space
• Adept, nimble, and energetic in a fast-paced, dynamic, collaborative environment
• Hands-on, "roll up one's sleeves" approach
• Drive for results with urgency and innovation
• Comfortable operating within a "one team, common purpose" culture

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $250,000 – $320,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to jennifer.partyka@sobi.com.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Science Liaison, Lymphoma (Lacutamab)
jobs.description:
Sobi is hiring for 3 Sr MSL, Lymphoma (Lacutamab) openings. Candidates can work remotely anywhere in the continental U.S., with a strong preference that they're located within 30-40 minutes of a major airport.

As the Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Lymphoma (Lacutamab), you will serve as a field-based scientific expert on cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) and lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2. You will build trusted scientific relationships, exchange balanced medical information, and generate actionable insights that inform US Medical Affairs strategy and launch readiness.

You will support Sobi's rare disease portfolio in the hematology franchise and serve as a trusted scientific resource across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities. You will collaborate with academic, community, and multidisciplinary care teams, always in accordance with regulatory, legal, and compliance requirements.

This is a field execution role within Hematology Medical Affairs. You will contribute insights and a field perspective to the CTCL medical strategy, which is led by Medical Affairs leadership.

What You Will Do

Scientific Engagement and External Relationships

• Serve as a primary field-based scientific point of contact for Sobi Medical Affairs within your assigned geography.
• Develop and maintain meaningful, two-way relationships with opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, medical organizations, investigators, and other stakeholders involved in CTCL care.
• Exchange accurate, fair, balanced, and scientifically rigorous information on CTCL, lacutamab, relevant clinical data, disease biology, treatment approaches, and the evolving care landscape.
• Engage across academic, community, and multidisciplinary settings, including hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology practices.
• Respond appropriately to unsolicited scientific inquiries and connect stakeholders with Sobi resources in line with applicable policies and procedures.

Medical Insights and Strategy Execution

• Identify, document, and share high-quality field insights on unmet needs, clinical practice, patient pathways, evidence gaps, stakeholder perspectives, competitive developments, and the treatment landscape.
• Partner with Medical Affairs leadership and cross-functional colleagues to interpret insights and inform adjustments to medical strategy, tactics, educational priorities, and engagement plans.
• Execute territory-level medical plans aligned with the US CTCL and lacutamab medical strategy, adapting engagement to local and regional stakeholder needs.
• Support key institution and stakeholder engagement planning, helping establish Sobi as a trusted scientific partner in CTCL.

Launch Readiness, Education, and Congress Support

• Contribute to lacutamab launch preparedness through disease-state education, articulation of unmet need, scientific exchange, stakeholder mapping, and field execution of approved medical tactics.
• Provide internal and external scientific training on CTCL disease biology, preclinical science, clinical data, evidence gaps, and relevant outcomes.
• Participate in or support advisory boards, medical roundtables, webinars, symposia, and other educational activities at local, regional, and national levels.
• Represent Sobi Medical Affairs at scientific and medical congresses, and synthesize and communicate key updates and implications to internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate to identify and develop field resources and scientific materials specific to CTCL and lacutamab.

Evidence Generation and Clinical Development Support

• Provide field-based support to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations, including site identification and recommendations, investigator engagement, communication facilitation, site initiation support, and patient accrual support.
• Identify evidence gaps and potential research opportunities, and communicate them to appropriate internal partners.
• Contribute scientific and field perspectives to evidence generation activities, real-world evidence initiatives, publications, and medical education programs, as appropriate.
• Support investigator-sponsored research and other research collaborations in accordance with company processes and governance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Territory Leadership

• Partner with colleagues in Medical Affairs, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, and other functions, while maintaining the independence and integrity of the Medical Affairs role.
• Serve as a scientific resource to internal stakeholders and contribute to cross-functional initiatives consistent with Medical Affairs objectives and company guidelines.
• Demonstrate excellence in territory planning, stakeholder prioritization, documentation, follow-through, and management of multiple projects and competing priorities.
• Contribute to the broader Field Medical organization's success by sharing best practices, supporting colleagues, and fostering a collaborative, respectful, patient-focused culture.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is marked by:

• Scientific credibility and curiosity
• Strategic territory leadership
• Insight generation and synthesis
• Trusted stakeholder partnership
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Clear, balanced communication
• Agility and a solution-oriented approach
• Operational excellence
• A patient-centered mindset

What You Bring

Required and Preferred Qualifications

• Education: Accredited doctorate degree in a life-science, health-science, or basic-science discipline, such as PharmD, PhD, DNP, DSc, MD, or DO.Candidates with another advanced health degree and extensive relevant industry or clinical experience may be considered.

• Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrated ability to initiate and sustain credible scientific relationships and respond effectively to the needs of key stakeholders.
• Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and listening skills, including the ability to shape and articulate a clear scientific story.

• Execution: Proven strategic thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, project management, and prioritization skills. Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable in a dynamic environment.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.

The base salary range for this role is $215,000 - $230,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

• Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience working in a cost management role in the construction industry.

• Experience of leading cost management on medium or large sized construction projects of medium to high complexity.
