jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYGALDRY

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to superintelligence, and addressing the problem of rising compute costs and energy bottlenecks. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Sygaldry Technologies is seeking an exceptional accounting leader to serve as our Assistant Controller / Controller. This is the first dedicated accounting hire and the number two in finance. You will own the accounting function day to day, including close, controls, systems, and audit, with real autonomy and direct exposure to the leadership team and board-facing work.

You're joining at a genuine inflection point, with the chance to architect the finance stack, building on the tools and processes already in place and introducing new ones as we scale. We recently completed our first external audit, and we are migrating off QuickBooks onto a modern GL platform. As the first dedicated accounting hire, you'll build the capacity, controls, and systems a growing, multi-entity hardware company needs: owning and administering the GL, establishing segregation of duties, running the close, handling cost, WIP, and fixed-asset accounting as we scale toward production, and growing into full ownership of the annual audit. With operations across multiple entities, locations, and currencies, the role carries real international and multi-entity scope.

We're looking for someone who spots when a system or process is holding the team back, makes the case for the change, and has the experience to implement it end to end.

Strong Accounting Managers ready to step up into this scope are encouraged to apply; title and level (Assistant Controller through Controller) are calibrated to experience.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Finance systems & administration — own and administer the GL and connected finance systems; complete the migration off QuickBooks, and proactively identify, propose, and implement system and process improvements as the company scales.

 - Cost, WIP & fixed-asset accounting — own inventory and work-in-process for our hardware builds and the fixed-asset subledger for lab and production equipment — capitalization, depreciation, and roll-forwards — scaling the approach as we move toward production.

 - Multi-entity & international accounting — own consolidation across our US and international entities, multi-currency accounting and FX, intercompany transactions, and transfer pricing.

 - Controls & scalable process — establish segregation of duties and scalable controls across procure-to-pay, payroll, and journal entries as the finance team grows, partnering with the Head of Finance on the approval and authorization structure.

 - The monthly and quarterly close — run it end to end and drive the cadence toward a tight 4–5 business day close.

 - Audit — partner on our current audit and grow into full ownership of the annual audit: workpapers, PBC management, and the day-to-day auditor relationship.

 - Procurement & spend controls — serve as the accounting point of contact in our spend-management / procurement system, verifying that transactions are correctly coded and supported before they route for final approval and sync to the GL.

 - Core accounting operations — oversee AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense, managing the third-party bookkeeping partner who handles much of the day-to-day.

 - Routine technical accounting — apply GAAP to recurring areas independently, and partner with the Head of Finance on complex policy positions (R&E capitalization under §174, revenue recognition as commercialization approaches).

 - Reporting support — provide clean, reconciled actuals that feed monthly management reporting and board materials.




YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Hands-on cost, WIP, inventory, and fixed-asset accounting in a manufacturing, hardware, or physical-product environment, including subledger ownership, capitalization, and depreciation.

 - Multi-entity, multi-location, and multi-currency experience, including consolidation and foreign-currency accounting.

 - 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including full ownership of a close cycle.

 - CPA required.

 - System deployment and administration — you've led or been core to an ERP/GL implementation (NetSuite, Campfire, Rillet, or similar) and can administer one, with the initiative to spot a system or process gap, make the case, and drive the change.

 - Experience operating within a spend-management / procurement (P2P) system (e.g., Ramp, Zip, Airbase, Coupa).

 - Has been through external audits (Big Four or national firm) and can own the company side of one.

 - Comfortable in a lean, high-autonomy function, including hands-on with the technical work, and able to manage an outsourced bookkeeping partner rather than relying on a large in-house team.

 - Strong technical GAAP foundation and the judgment to know what to escalate.

 - Direct, low-ego communicator who prefers signal over ceremony.

 - Experience at a venture-backed startup that scaled toward or through an IPO.

 - Exposure to SOX / ITGC readiness or public-company reporting.

 - Deep tech, quantum, or advanced-hardware manufacturing experience.




HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.




CULTURE & BENEFITS

 - Visa Sponsorship - We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation - We value your contribution and invest in your future with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Benefits - Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection - Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off - We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to to contribute to our mission, please reach out at letsbuild@sygaldry.com

Location: On-Site in Ann Arbor, MI Headquarters

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN

We are a small, high-output team building across a complex technical surface: consumer marketplace, provider-facing scheduling tools, interoperability infrastructure, revenue cycle tooling, and AI-augmented workflows. We don't scale headcount to scale output. We scale leverage through AI-native development practices, tight feedback loops, and engineers who own outcomes rather than tickets.



As Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead a cross-functional engineering team and remain a hands-on contributor. We expect roughly 30% of your time to be spent writing code, reviewing architecture, or directly shaping technical decisions. This is not a role for someone who wants to move fully into management. It's a role for someone who finds that combination energising.



You will report to our CTO and partner closely with Product, Operations, and Data to ship the systems that run our business. You are expected to be genuinely AI-native: not just comfortable with AI tooling, but actively shaping how your team uses it. That means deploying agents, building evaluation frameworks, and coaching engineers to work at a level of throughput that wasn't possible two years ago.



As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:



 - Lead and develop a team of engineers across multiple product domains, owning velocity, process, performance, technical growth, and team culture

 - Remain a consistent technical contributor by writing production code, leading design reviews, and pairing with engineers on complex problems.

 - Define and enforce engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing discipline, deployment practices, and incident response

 - Drive the team's AI-native operating model by identifying where AI agents can replace or accelerate engineering workflows, building evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, and coaching engineers to leverage AI tooling as a primary development instrument rather than an occasional aid

 - Partner with Product to refine roadmaps, push back on scope where necessary, and ensure the team is working on the highest-leverage problems at any given time

 - Own the architecture of your team's systems by making build vs. buy decisions, managing technical debt deliberately, and ensuring the stack can support the growth trajectory of the business

 - Contribute to Scan.com http://Scan.com's broader engineering culture through interview loops, cross-team design reviews, engineering all-hands, and the institutional knowledge that makes a small team punch above its weight
   
   


WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams in a startup environment. You have operated with limited resources, changing priorities, and a high bar for individual output, and you have thrived in that context.

 - Genuine AI-native fluency: you have deployed AI agents in production engineering workflows, you understand evaluation frameworks and can design them for non-trivial tasks, and you have coached teams to use AI as a primary tool rather than a novelty. Candidates who cannot speak concretely to this will not be competitive

 - Active technical contributor with strong engineering fundamentals. You write production-quality code in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, can lead a system design discussion at a senior level, and have not been out of the code for more than a year

ABOUT THE TEAM:
The Company Secretariat (CoSec) team oversees business compliance across specific jurisdictions through integration with local regulatory authorities and third-party services. By abstracting market-specific legal and operational complexities within the Tide application, the team ensures that members can rely on robust, automated compliance management. Building upon the foundational architecture established in the UK, current initiatives focus on transforming the service into a market-agnostic platform capable of dynamically adapting to diverse data sources. This entails orchestrating complex cross-domain data integrations, ensuring accurate data transformation, and propagating post-filing updates and metadata to downstream systems once external third-party processing is complete.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

• Lead and own the end-to-end delivery of company secretariat functions, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory requirements and market-specific nuances.

• Architect, build, and maintain scalable distributed systems for seamless business management and compliance platforms with sustainable long-term strategy.

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Director
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Job Title: Regional Marketing Director

Department: US Marketing

Location: Remote-Field

REGIONAL MARKETING DIRECTOR

Overview of Role:

The Regional Marketing Director will play a critical role in supporting the successful commercialization of Summit Therapeutics' oncology portfolio by developing and executing regional marketing strategies and customer engagement initiatives that align with the Company's overall brand and commercial strategy.

The Regional Marketing Director will serve as a key partner to the field organization, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate national brand strategies into impactful regional execution. This role will develop differentiated engagement strategies for key customers and thought leaders, leverage customer insights to enable highly personalized interactions, and support congress, advisory board, and promotional speaker initiatives.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute regional marketing strategies and educational initiatives that align with national brand strategy, commercial objectives, and the evolving needs of the oncology marketplace.

• Develop and execute robust customer engagement plans for National and Regional Thought Leaders, including identification, segmentation, engagement planning, and coordination of appropriate cross-functional interactions.

• Partner closely with Sales and other customer-facing teams to translate national marketing strategies into effective regional execution plans and identify opportunities to enhance customer engagement.

• Develop and enable a 360-degree view of regional and national thought leaders, integrating available customer insights, engagement history, affinity data, affiliations, and other relevant information to help field teams appropriately personalize customer interactions.

• Partner cross-functionally to identify customer insights and regional market dynamics and translate those insights into actionable recommendations for the broader commercial organization.

• Support the identification, recruitment, contracting, and execution of regional and national commercial advisory boards, ensuring appropriate planning, coordination, and execution in partnership with relevant stakeholders.

• Develop and execute national and regional congress strategies and plans, with a particular focus on Tier 1 and Tier 2 congresses, to maximize customer engagement, educational opportunities, and commercial impact.

• Partner with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to develop pre-, during-, and post-congress engagement strategies and ensure effective follow-up with priority customers and thought leaders.

• Support the recruitment, education, contracting, and execution of the Promotional Speakers Program, working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure effective and compliant program execution.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to ensure coordinated regional execution.

• Create and participate in regular regional insight-sharing forums with the field organization to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

• Serve as a key conduit between the field organization and the broader Commercial organization, ensuring regional customer insights inform national marketing strategy and execution.

• Ensure all regional marketing activities and customer engagements are executed in accordance with Company policies, applicable laws and regulations, and established compliance requirements.

• All other duties as assigned

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare marketing, with demonstrated experience supporting commercial products and/or launches.

• Demonstrated experience developing and executing regional marketing strategies and customer engagement plans within the U.S. pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.

• Experience working within oncology is required with lung cancer experience preferred

• Demonstrated understanding of the U.S. healthcare environment and experience engaging with National and Regional Thought Leaders and other key healthcare stakeholders.

• Experience supporting commercial advisory boards, speaker programs, congress strategy/execution, and other customer engagement initiatives.

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$190,000—$228,000 USD

jobs.title: Frontend Architect
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA or San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About The Job

Navan is an all-in-one travel, corporate card, and expense management solution that eliminates the hassles of corporate travel & expense management while giving finance leaders real-time spend visibility and control.

The Frontend Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of Navan's frontend infrastructure and developer experience across the organization. This role is central to architecting and maintaining the frontend platform that enables 20+ engineering teams to deploy independently while maintaining high quality standards. The Frontend Architect is essential to our mission, building shared libraries, developer tooling, and infrastructure, evolving the platform for both human and AI-assisted development, and driving performance and reliability initiatives.

What You'll Do

• Architect Micro-Frontend Infrastructure: Design and evolve micro-frontend platform using Module Federation in React & Angular. Create and maintain shared NPM packages enforcing consistency and patterns across the organization. Drive team collaboration through architectural governance, review processes, and cross-functional alignment.

• Drive Developer Platform Strategy: Create developer tools and automation that streamline workflows and boost productivity across engineering teams. Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for frontend implementation, browser testing, debugging, framework migrations, and delivery—from a task specification to a validated pull request. Author technical documentation and mentor engineers through code reviews.

• Enable Reliable Coding Agent Workflows: Structure repositories, component libraries, documentation, and development environments so engineers and coding agents can reliably build, test, and extend the platform. Establish clear component contracts, runnable examples, predictable build and test commands, and reusable skills and integrations that provide relevant company context and actionable validation feedback.

• Establish Shared Patterns for AI-Powered Experiences: Partner with product and AI platform teams to establish shared UI patterns for AI-powered experiences, including streaming responses, progress visibility, cancellation, error recovery, and user approval of consequential actions. Design reusable components with clear contracts that reduce integration time across teams.

• Strengthen Testing and Validation: Establish fast, reliable feedback through component tests, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI gates so changes can be validated consistently across teams. Define validation and human review requirements for AI-generated changes.

• Drive Adoption and Measurable Outcomes: Pilot new workflows with engineering teams, measure delivery time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage cost, and turn successful approaches into supported company standards. Verify that tools, integrations, and workflows operate successfully in the teams and environments where they are adopted.

• Partner on Secure AI-Assisted Development: Work with Security and the AI platform team to establish scoped tool access, safe handling of secrets and sensitive data, and clear accountability for agent-generated changes. Define appropriate human review and approval boundaries for frontend workflows.

• Drive Reliability & Performance: Lead optimization initiatives to reduce bundle size and costs. Spearhead framework migrations delivering critical security fixes. Implement performance monitoring and optimization strategies that reduce latency and improve load times.

What We're Looking For

• At least 8 years of experience in frontend software development

• At least 3 years of experience in frontend architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact

• Deep expertise with React and TypeScript; experience with Angular is highly valued

• Experience with micro-frontend architectures (Module Federation, single-spa, Web Components, or similar approaches)

• Strong knowledge of build tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup) and monorepo management

• Experience with testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and establishing testing standards across teams, including component testing, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI validation

• Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver production changes, with the ability to evaluate generated code, design effective validation, and explain where human review is necessary

• Ability to demonstrate improvements in engineering delivery, quality, or reliability from AI-assisted workflows and drive adoption across teams

• Practical understanding of scoped tool access, secrets, sensitive data, and accountability for AI-generated changes, in partnership with Security and AI platform teams

• Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and drive consensus across multiple teams.

• Nice to have: Experience with observability platforms, CDN optimization, Next.js or other meta-frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

jobs.title: Dishwasher & Porter, OPENING TEAM
jobs.description:
We are excited to announce our 2nd Naked Farmer in St. Pete, FL! We cannot wait to serve you! We will be opening in Fall 2026 and are excited to begin accepting applications!

Naked Farmer is a farm-to-table fast casual restaurant serving seasonal vegetables in Florida, North Carolina, and Tennessee. We are a restaurant group looking to build on a culture of driven curiosity and ambitious innovation, finding and implementing new solutions to offer a simple, healthy, affordable meal. Our mission is to build a better food system by connecting farmers to the community. Naked Farmer is currently seeking exceptional candidates to join our team. We seek friendly, energetic, highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Experience is not necessary. We will help teach you how to be successful in your role!

DISHWASHER & PORTER

Compensation: $17-$18 per hour

Naked Farmer is a pioneering farm-to-table restaurant group with multiple locations across Florida, cooking and serving scratch-made, healthy, and affordable meals. Our restaurants celebrate the seasonality of vegetables and the spirit of innovation, striving to create a sustainable food system that strengthens the connection between farmers and the community.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join our dynamic kitchen team as a Dishwasher, where your role is crucial in maintaining the backbone of our food service operations. You will be responsible for upholding the highest standards of cleanliness and organization. This position involves a variety of tasks, including the proper storage and rotation of produce and food orders, ensuring our cooking items and tools meet our stringent quality standards, and maintaining a spotless work environment.

BENEFITS:

• Competitive salary and a vibrant work culture

• Profit-sharing incentives

• 401(k)

• Annual paid vacation

• Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance

• Opportunities for career progression within our rapidly growing company

• A complimentary Naked Farmer meal daily

• Flexible work schedule

At Naked Farmer, we are cultivating the next generation of hospitality talent. Our scratch-based kitchens are a hub for individuals passionate about real, good food. You will mentor and inspire those eager to share their enthusiasm for hospitality, ensuring their shifts are enjoyable and efficient. As part of our community, you will engage in ongoing education, flavor discovery, and the pursuit of culinary excellence. If you are driven by a sense of purpose and a craving for shaping the future of food, join us on our mission to build a better food system.

YOU WILL:

• Efficiently put away and rotate produce and food orders, ensuring freshness and longevity.

• Inspect all cooking utensils and equipment to guarantee they meet our standards for quality and cleanliness.

• Skillfully operate kitchen machinery, including knives, ovens, grills, food processors, and blenders, adhering to strict food safety and sanitation protocols.

• Consistently follow and enforce food safety and sanitation guidelines, setting the standard for best practices within the kitchen.

• Thoroughly open/close and clean your station, ensuring you and your fellow team members are positioned for success.

• Occasionally assist with food preparation as needed.

• Wash dishes by hand and by operating dish machinery.

• Remove garbage from restaurant, bus tables and retrieve dishes from dining areas.

• Be flexible and willing to take on additional responsibilities as requested to support the team’s needs at any time.

YOU HAVE:

• A commitment to cleanliness and organization.

• A strong work ethic and desire to do the right thing even when no one is looking, and even when it’s not in your interest to do what’s right.

• A keen eye for detail and a dedication to maintaining high standards of kitchen hygiene.

• Familiarity with using various types of kitchen equipment and a willingness to follow safety guidelines.

• An understanding of food safety and a commitment to uphold sanitation standards.

• The ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

• Flexibility and openness to perform various tasks and support the team beyond your primary duties.

• Dependable transportation to/from work.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER:

Born during a global pandemic, Naked Farmer quickly adapted, delivering fresh food directly from farm to doorstep. Our ethos is founded on resilience, transparency, and telling the story of the farmers behind our local food supply. With a commitment to becoming 100% locally sourced, we are now embarking on an expansion phase, opening new locations and furthering our mission of transparency in sourcing and cooking while supporting local farmers, communities, and chefs.

And yes, all employees enjoy complimentary Naked Farmer meals every day—don't miss out on the sweet potatoes.

Join us as we build the future of food together.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global IT Operations
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Global IT Operations to lead and scale our worldwide IT Operations organization and help define the next generation of employee technology services. Reporting to the Sr. Director, IT this role is the primary global leader accountable for IT Operations performance, service delivery excellence, employee technology experience, and operational outcomes across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

This leader will evolve IT Operations from a primarily reactive support model toward a data-driven, automation-first, and increasingly agentic operating model. The role will combine strong operational discipline with practical application of AI, analytics, and workflow automation; including capabilities that can retrieve knowledge, diagnose issues, orchestrate approved actions, and resolve common requests with appropriate human oversight.

The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking operator and people leader who can modernize support organizations, challenge legacy processes, build secure and governed AI-enabled services, and translate emerging technology into measurable improvements for employees and the business.

Your Mission

Core Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a globally distributed IT Operations organization supporting employees across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with accountability for Service Desk, Tier 1–3 Support, Executive/VIP Support, End User Computing, Endpoint Management, and related workplace operations.

• Own global service accountability while establishing clear regional operating responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths, service standards, and performance expectations.

• Design and implement a metrics-based operating model focused on service quality, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, employee experience, resilience, and continuous improvement.

• Own and continuously improve key performance indicators such as SLA attainment, MTTR, First Contact Resolution, backlog health, escalation rates, CSAT, employee experience, endpoint compliance, service reliability, automation adoption, and ticket deflection.

• Develop executive dashboards, reporting, and operational scorecards that provide clear visibility into performance, trends, risks, investment needs, and opportunities for improvement.

• Define and execute a multi-year roadmap for AI-enabled and agentic IT Operations using capabilities such as Microsoft Copilot, Glean, automation platforms, analytics, virtual agents, and workflow orchestration.

• Identify and prioritize high-volume, repeatable processes suitable for autonomous or semi-autonomous execution, including onboarding, offboarding, access requests, software fulfillment, device remediation, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, and incident resolution.

• Lead incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, service continuity, and service improvement initiatives to enhance operational maturity and support effectiveness.

• Use operational analytics and AI-driven insights to proactively identify trends, recurring issues, capacity risks, experience gaps, and opportunities for preventative action.

• Oversee the lifecycle management of endpoint technologies, workplace systems, collaboration platforms, and identity services, ensuring secure, scalable, compliant, and efficient operations.

• Partner closely with Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Identity, and business stakeholders to improve service delivery, strengthen operational controls, support compliance requirements, and drive workplace technology modernization.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global team while fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, innovation, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

You Are/Have

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of progressive IT Operations experience, including 5+ years in a people leadership role.

• Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed global support or IT Operations organizations.

• Experience designing, scaling, or transforming an IT Operations or service delivery operating model.

• Strong understanding of IT Service Management, including incident management, problem management, knowledge management, service improvement, and operational resilience.

• Experience implementing automation, AI-enabled support, virtual agents, workflow orchestration, analytics, or similar technologies in an enterprise environment.

• Demonstrated ability to manage operational KPIs, SLAs, executive reporting, service delivery metrics, and continuous improvement programs.

• Experience with Service Desk, End User Computing, IT Support, or IT Operations teams using Jira Service Management.

• Working knowledge of M365, Entra ID, Intune, Autopilot, endpoint management, and collaboration technologies, or comparable enterprise platforms.

• Proven ability to lead organizational change, challenge legacy processes, and move new capabilities from concept or pilot into production.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, executive presence, judgment, and people leadership skills.

Extra Awesome

• Experience leading Global IT Operations within a SaaS, cybersecurity, or high-growth technology company.

• Experience designing or deploying agentic workflows, Copilot solutions or AI-powered support capabilities.

• Experience with Glean, Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Digital Employee Experience platforms, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.

• Experience managing technology vendors, operating budgets, sourcing decisions, and license or tooling optimization.

• ITIL, Microsoft, HDI, PMP, or related certifications.

Where we Work

Resources

Your Data

Our Commitment to You

jobs.title: Restaurant Team, OPENING TEAM
jobs.description:
Naked Farmer is a farm-to-table fast casual restaurant serving seasonal vegetables in Florida, North Carolina, and Tennessee. We are a restaurant group looking to build on a culture of driven curiosity and ambitious innovation, finding and implementing new solutions to offer a simple, healthy, affordable meal. Our mission is to build a better food system by connecting farmers to the community. Naked Farmer is currently seeking exceptional candidates to join our team. We seek friendly, energetic, highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Experience is not necessary. We will help teach you how to be successful in your role!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an enthusiastic Restaurant Team Member in our scratch-based kitchen, you will be the ambassador of our locally sourced, made-from-scratch ethos. Your role is pivotal in providing a top-notch guest experience by serving and discussing our seasonal menus with passion. You'll ensure that every meal is not only delicious but also served with consistency, precision, and a sense of urgency. Our team will rely on you to be a proactive contributor, eager to take on various tasks to enhance our restaurant's operations, enlighten our guests, and tackle any issues with a spirit of genuine hospitality.

Payrate: $19-$28/hour

BENEFITS:

• Competitive salary and a vibrant work culture

• Profit-sharing incentives

• 401K

• Annual paid vacation

• Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance

• Opportunities for career progression within our rapidly growing company

• A complimentary Naked Farmer meal daily

• Flexible work schedule

At Naked Farmer, we are cultivating the next generation of hospitality talent.

Our scratch-based kitchens are a hub for individuals passionate about real, good food. You will mentor and inspire those eager to share their enthusiasm for hospitality, ensuring their shifts are enjoyable and efficient. As part of our community, you will engage in ongoing education, flavor discovery, and the pursuit of culinary excellence. If you are driven by a sense of purpose and a craving for shaping the future of food, join us on our mission to build a better food system.

YOU WILL:

• Articulate the narrative of our current menu, highlighting the seasonality and origin of ingredients, while delivering meals that delight our guests.

• Expand your culinary horizons by learning about regional produce and preparation methods from our team of skilled chefs.

• Deliver exceptional hospitality that makes each guest feel valued, ensuring meticulous attention to dining spaces, to-go orders, and the coordination of deliveries.

• Engage with diners proactively, anticipating their needs and making their visit memorable.

• Serve as a passionate storyteller for our seasonal selections, the local farms, and the farmers we partner with.

• Efficiently manage a variety of tasks and remain active in the kitchen for prolonged periods. (Note: Physical tasks include lifting up to 25 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally, with accommodations available if needed.)

• Uphold the rigorous food safety standards of both the health department and Naked Farmer.

• End each day with a sense of accomplishment, knowing you contribute to a grander vision of a sustainable food system.

YOU HAVE:

• Passion for real, good food and exceptional guest service

• Curiosity and eagerness to learn and evolve within our growing restaurant group

• An unwavering positive and energetic presence, spreading kindness and optimism daily.

• A strong work ethic, focused on meticulous performance and attention to detail.

• Uncompromising integrity, choosing to do the right thing consistently, even when unnoticed or when it’s not in your self-interest to do so.

• The capability to meet the physical demands of the role, including lifting, with or without reasonable accommodations.

• A team player mentality, valuing collaboration and contributing to the success of our restaurant.

• Outstanding verbal communication skills.

• The ambition to create unforgettable, warm experiences for both team members and guests.

• A sharp eye for detail and a problem-solving mindset.

• An aspiration to advance and grow within our restaurant group.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER:

Born during a global pandemic, Naked Farmer quickly adapted, delivering fresh food directly from farm to doorstep. Our ethos is founded on resilience, transparency, and telling the story of the farmers behind our local food supply. With a commitment to becoming 100% locally sourced, we are now embarking on an expansion phase, opening new locations and furthering our mission of transparency in sourcing and cooking while supporting local farmers, communities, and chefs.

And yes, all employees enjoy complimentary Naked Farmer meals every day—don't miss out on the sweet potatoes.

Join us as we build the future of food together.

Naked Farmer participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility for all newly hired employees.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant Shift Lead - Asheville, NC
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

Veterinary nursing Shift Leads are the glue that holds each shift together—and the spark that keeps it moving. You own the rhythm and flow of each shift, making sure patients get top-tier care and every VEGgie has what they need to thrive. From team huddles and rounds to break coverage and on-the-floor coaching, you’re the steady presence keeping things smooth, safe, and supported. You don’t need to know every detail, but you do keep a big picture view—anticipating what’s next and jumping in wherever needed. You lead with heart, hustle, and a belief that when your team is empowered, great care follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep a clear pulse on patient status, team bandwidth, and shift-wide needs

• Manage daily workflow and help the team pivot when the unexpected hits

• Ensure shift roles are assigned and adapted as needed, with clarity and care

• Jump in on the floor when help is needed—no task is too small

• Coordinate breaks, assist with conflict resolution, and model calm under pressure

• Lead shift transitions, team huddles, and start/end-of-day wrap-ups

• Communicate clearly, direct questions appropriately, and elevate key issues

• Help the team turn downtime into learning time—or just a moment to breathe

• Flag incidents or notable events with a mindset of transparency and growth

• Work with hospital leadership on coverage, call-outs, and ongoing coaching

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) or enrolled in the VEG Credentialing Support Program preferred

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician or assistant role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Strong grasp of clinical workflow and team dynamics

• Confidence in navigating floor operations while guiding others with empathy

• Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills

• Flexibility and a willingness to step in wherever needed

• Leadership instincts, an ownership mindset, and a desire to grow professionally

• Basic computer skills, comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

jobs.title: General Manager - Rare Steakhouse
jobs.description:

The Encore Boston Harbor General Manager will manage the daily operations of their designated restaurant. The General Manager is responsible for operating the outlet efficiently within pre-established cost controls; managing, scheduling and training restaurant staff; monitoring staff performance, maintaining the department in accordance with Health Department standards; and ensuring customer satisfaction through application of outlet and Encore service standards.  Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: the management of the restaurant strategy and ensuring alignment with overall Encore Boston Harbor strategy; maximizing opportunities for restaurant and company success; maintaining all Encore Standards: and ensuring excellent guest and team member experience.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

•    Ensures all Encore Boston Harbor core values and property and restaurant standards are implemented and applied.

•    Manages short-and long-term restaurant goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates operational effectiveness; effects changes required for improvement. Identifies key drivers of success.

•    Manages the restaurant performance, and the accuracy, confidentiality, and thoroughness of restaurant policies and procedures; records and reports.

•    Manages the performance of team members under his/her area of responsibility.

•    Monitors all activities of the restaurant to ensure that all applicable internal policies, federal and state laws, rules, regulations and controls property wide are enforced.

•    Ensures restaurant delivers and maintains a maximum level of property-wide service and satisfaction.

•    Facilitates communication throughout the property by organizing and presiding over regularly scheduled meetings with team members within the restaurant and with other restaurants as appropriate to ensure property wide communication.

•    Responsible for hiring, performance management, and employee engagement within the restaurant.  Provides training opportunities, constructive and positive feedback to team members within area of responsibility.  Creates a motivating environment.

•    Keeps informed of all new developments within the restaurant and makes recommendations designed to maximize restaurant and company success.

•    Effectively manages internal and external guest relations, which will require levels of patience, tact and diplomacy. Responsible for addressing guest and team member issues as appropriate.

•    Manages multiple priorities simultaneously and meets deadlines, often in stressful and high-pressure situations.

jobs.title: Senior Data Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
• Deep expertise in marketing analytics, SQL, building SNF agents, dashboarding, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations

• A rigorous, curious approach to measurement, with the ability to move from business question to analysis, insight, and action

• Remote-first opportunity for US-based employees with the option to work in-person out of our Manhattan office

Start your adventure with Zip

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you’ll sit at the center of Zip’s marketing measurement practice, turning complex marketing data into performance insights that shape decisions. You’ll go beyond reporting what happened to uncover why it happened, what it means, and what teams should do next.

You’ll lead analysis, dashboarding, and reporting support across the marketing organization, partnering closely with all marketing teams - especially growth and lifecycle - and marketing science. As Zip continues to invest in measurement and data infrastructure, you’ll play an important role in building a rigorous, data-driven marketing culture where teams trust the data and use it to make better decisions.

Interesting problems you’ll get to solve

• Own marketing analytics across channel performance, campaign analysis, cohort analysis, and funnel reporting, translating findings into clear recommendations for the business

• Build and maintain dashboards that give marketing teams and senior stakeholders accessible, actionable views of performance and underlying drivers

• Lead ad hoc analyses that answer meaningful business questions, identifying the drivers behind performance and opportunities for action

• Develop clear reporting and executive-level summaries that communicate marketing performance, trends, implications, and recommended next steps

• Partner with marketing and marketing sciences teams to define what matters, determine how it should be measured, and strengthen decision-making through data

• Apply marketing measurement concepts including attribution, incrementality, media mix, and funnel analysis to evaluate marketing effectiveness

• Monitor data quality, identify anomalies or inconsistencies, investigate root causes, and partner with relevant teams to improve the reliability of marketing data

• Build AI-enabled analytical agents, workflows, and models that improve the efficiency, depth, or scalability of marketing analysis, while critically evaluating outputs for accuracy, limitations, and appropriate use

• Use critical thinking and cognitive flexibility to test assumptions, explore alternative explanations, and adapt analytical approaches as new information becomes available

• Present complex findings and recommendations to VP and executive-level stakeholders by synthesizing complex analysis into concise narratives that connect insights to company strategy, financial impact, opportunities and risk trade-offs

• Continuously explore new analytical methods, AI capabilities, and measurement approaches, applying sound judgment to determine when they can responsibly improve the quality of marketing insights

What you’ll bring to the team

• 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, product analytics or a related analytical discipline, including experience operating in highly complex analytical environments.

• Deep SQL expertise and demonstrated experience designing efficient analytical solutions across large and complex datasets.

• Advanced experience with dbt and data modeling, including building scalable, reusable data models and trusted analytical foundations.

• Advanced experience with Tableau or comparable business intelligence platforms and experience developing scalable reporting and visualization solutions.

• Experience with customer or product analytics platforms such as Amplitude and applying behavioral data to product and business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, ambiguous analytical initiatives from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and business impact.

• Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing strategic decisions through clear, evidence-based analytical recommendations.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect customer and product analytics to broader business drivers, including revenue growth, customer retention, operational efficiency and risk.

• Experience establishing analytical standards, shared metrics or reusable frameworks that improve consistency and scalability across teams.

• Experience applying AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to analytics workflows, automation or self-service capabilities.

• Demonstrated ability to mentor other analysts, elevate analytical rigor and contribute to stronger technical and problem-solving practices across a team.

What you’ll get in return

Zip is a place where you’ll get out what you put in. The newness of our sector means we need to move at pace and embrace change, and our promise to you when you join the team is that you’ll feel empowered and trusted to make big things happen quickly.

We want you to feel welcome and as though you have the support to be yourself, and care for yourself at work. Because it’s important to us that you make the most of the opportunities you’ll get to grow your skills and your career, and be surrounded by smart, friendly people and leaders that have your back.

We think these are just some of the best things about being a Zipster. We will also offer you:

• Flexible working culture

• Incentive programs

• Unlimited PTO

• Generous paid parental leave

• Leading family support policies

• Company-sponsored 401k match

• Learning and wellness subscription stipend

• Beautiful Union Square office with a casual dress code

• Industry-leading, employer-sponsored insurance for you and your dependents, with several 100% Zip-covered choices available

Zip is committed to a straightforward and transparent pay structure. The actual base salary will be determined by various individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, location, internal equity, as well as other objective business considerations.

The annual base Pay Range for this position is $92,000 - $125,000. This range reflects our US national compensation band (USN). Additional premium percentages may apply based on our tiered premium strategy.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or commission awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

If hired, employees will be in an 'at-will position' and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

And finally…get to know us

Zip Co Limited (ASX: ZIP) is a digital financial services company, offering innovative, people-centered products.

Operating in two core markets - Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the US, Zip offers access to point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants.

We’re proud to be a values-led business and our values - Customer First, Own it, Stronger Together and Change the Game - guide us in everything we do.

jobs.description:
** This is a casual (non-benefited) position supporting Catherine Gratz Griffin Lake Forest Hospital. Schedule would be 2 weekend call shift per month (12-24 hr. per shift) and 1 overnight call (8pm to 8am) during the week. Additionally filling in to help cover PTO as needed. **

The Chaplain reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A chaplain offers spiritual guidance and pastoral care to patients, families, and hospital staff/medical staff. As representatives of spiritual and/or religious traditions, chaplains use insights and principles of psychology religion, spirituality, and theology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Delivers a ministry of spiritual care, counseling, consultation, worship, prayer, sacraments, and spiritual/ emotional support services to patients, families, and hospital personnel/medical staff for the optimal holistic care of patients.
• Identifies and clarifies ethical dilemmas. Findings will be shared with the Ethics Committee Chairs to determine whether an ethics consult is necessary per site policy/procedure.

• Provides education to patients and hospital personnel/medical staff on Advanced Directives including Power of Attorney for Healthcare and Goals of Care conversations.
• Develops and leads spiritual care services within the hospital in collaboration with other members of the Spiritual Care Department.
• Serves as spiritual liaisons between the hospital and community (both religious and secular) with referrals and information with patient/family permission that is compliant with HIPAA regulations.
• Escalates any concerns or issues following the NM chain of command policies.
• Offers religious services to hospital personnel/medical staff as appropriate and when requested.
• Accepts on call for spiritual care coverage, crises and emergencies as assigned including nights, weekends, and holidays. Manager may assign required minimum on-call shifts.
• Assists in leading CALM/Mindful Moments as assigned or as needed.
• Attends to cultural and spiritual dynamics that may improve patient treatment and family dynamics.
• Maintains chapel/sacred spaces and workspaces in a neat fashion while keeping supplies available and stocked.
• Maintains board certification and/or minimum annual CEU requirements as set by certifying bodies and organization/industry standards.

Education:

• Master’s degree in theology, religion, pastoral care, spiritual care, or divinity from an accredited institution or equivalent combination of education and experience
• At least one (1) unit of Clinical Pastoral Education (CPE) or in process of completing one (1) unit of CPE within 90 days of hire date

Preferred:

• Ordination and/or in good standing within one’s faith tradition or certifying organization

jobs.title: Data Engineer 2
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.

To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.

#LongLiveDogs

What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In

The Farmer’s Dog is seeking a Data Engineer 2 to join our growing group! You will maximize your technical expertise and data analysis skills to develop, implement, and maintain data analytics solutions within the organization. This role will collaborate with cross-functional groups - including data scientists, data engineers, and business partners to gather requirements, design data models, build data pipelines, and deliver practical insights.

You will be critical to ensure data integrity, optimize data workflows, and enabling partners to make effective decision-making rooted in data. If you have a genuine love for data, technology, problem-solving and want to improve how The Farmer’s Dog makes strategic decisions at the company level, then this is the role for you!

One Team: We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.

We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:  Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.

We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:  We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.  We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.  We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.  We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.

We Execute For Impact: We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.

We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.

How You'll Make An Impact

• Build and maintain data pipelines for structured and unstructured data supporting reporting, analytics and AI/ML use cases.

• Write production-level code that processes and validates millions of events per day.

• Develop AI tooling and automation to enhance data engineering capabilities and workflows.

• Ingest data from APIs, databases, file systems, and streaming platforms into our data infrastructure, and build and maintain pipelines for structured and unstructured data that support reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases.

• Establish and maintain robust data governance frameworks across our data warehouse to ensure data integrity, reliability, and security across the organization

• Implement monitoring, data quality checks, and alerting to ensure pipeline reliability and implement automated checks.

• Support production data systems and help resolve data-related incidents.

• Document technical implementations, follow engineering best practices, and foster a collaborative team environment that promotes knowledge sharing, standard methodologies, continuous improvement, and continuous learning.

We're Excited About You Because

• You have 2-4 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related technical field

• You're proficient in Python with experience writing production code, and have solid SQL skills for data transformation and analysis

• You have experience or strong interest in AI/ML workflows and tooling, including data preparation for machine learning models --> bring this one up

• You have practical experience with REST APIs and data integration patterns for ingesting data from multiple sources

• You're familiar with data processing tools like DBT, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks

• You understand ETL/ELT concepts and have built data pipelines independently with minimal guidance

• You're comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions and you have experience communicating technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You're detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and can manage multiple priorities effectively

• You are eager to learn new technologies, expand your skill set in a fast-paced environment, and take initiative to optimize systems.

• You love dogs.

Office Guidelines

We are an in-office culture, made of in-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 - 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion.

Our Belonging Philosophy:

At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships.

We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: “Everyone’s welcome at the dog park.” No matter your background, identity, or role, there’s space for you here. There’s no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it’s about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow.

We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we’re listening and learning from our Team.

Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive.

A Few of Our Best Benefits

• Dog-friendly office in SoHo

• Market-competitive compensation and equity packages

• Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision

• Company supported mental health benefits

• 12 week paid parental leave

• Competitive 401k plan with company match

• Flexible PTO

• Discounted fresh food for your pup

• Your pet interrupting video calls (and in-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit Know Your Rights.

Reasonable Accommodations

TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities.  If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact humansops@thefarmersdog.com.

We're Here to Help

We’re happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process - please reach out at careers@thefarmersdog.com.

We believe in competitive base compensation rooted in location specific market data and performance along with equity ownership in the company that allows every team member to build their personal wealth as the company grows, just as much as we believe in fostering a culture that supports our team members personally, professionally, and holistically. We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. jobs.title: Director, Clinical Scientist
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Director, Clinical Scientist is responsible for leading/contributing to study design and execution of clinical studies in hematology/oncology. As a leader within the clinical organization, this individual will be partnering with clinical operations, translational, and other matrix team members to design and refine clinical plans, authoring key clinical/regulatory documents, and ensuring exceptional delivery and interpretation of clinical data. The Director, Clinical Scientist will strive to drive study enrollment, and build and maintain collaborative relationships with investigators and clinical site staff, CROs, and Summit colleagues. The Director, Clinical Scientist will foster a proactive and thoughtful approach to clinical study execution where obstacles are anticipated and effectively mitigated/resolved.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Leads/Contributes to study design and amendments in collaboration with internal and external scientific stakeholders

• Collaborates with MD, regulatory and other internal partners/stakeholders with authoring and submission of protocols, protocol amendments, regulatory filings, and other regulatory documentation

• Collaborates with clinical operations, data management and CRO to develop and implement the overall data quality plan and leads internal medical data review and safety trend analysis on one or more studies/programs

• Point-of-contact for clinical inquiries from CRO medical monitor and other stakeholders

• Develops and provides input for clinical presentation slides and other materials for internal/external meetings and/or ongoing communications (e.g., investigator meetings, pre-study site selection visits, study coordinator or clinical research administrator training, study newsletters, communications to study sites, etc.)

• Partners with clinical operations and CRO in developing and maintaining study start up documents/resources (e.g., ICF, Lab Manual, EDC, Safety monitoring Plan, etc.)

• Participates in safety meetings and tracks, analyzes, and reviews documentation for any potential safety events

• Leads/Contributes to the development and implementation of communications strategies to support existing and concluded studies. Includes KOL interactions, advisory boards, major medical meetings, congresses and other events, publications and other materials

• Writes and/or reviews abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings, conferences, other events and presentations, and other publicly distributed materials and coordinates further reviews with internal partners and stakeholders

• Coordinates submissions to scientific meetings and/or other appropriate venues or groups

• Writes clinical science sections of meeting packages and assists in the development and review of other clinical documentation required for regulatory submissions and other regulatory processes

• All other duties as assigned

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• MS (or equivalent) required; PhD, PharmD, or MD preferred

• Minimum of 5+ years overall related experience with PhD or like degree; Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in conducting / supporting oncology/hematology clinical studies

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Expertise in interpreting immunology/immuno-oncology translational data in addition to clinical data

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$192,000—$239,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@smmttx.com to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.
