We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a contributor in the APX platform engineering organization on the CloudNet team, you focus on solving real-time problems for mission-critical cloud-native services—and on the quality and reliability our customers expect. You'll work closely with teams operating Axon systems around the world, and your technical influence extends across engineering because every product needs sound guidance for how it connects and scales in Axon's overall networking picture. A typical week blends Kubernetes networking, service mesh (for example Istio and Envoy), ingress and gateways, TLS and certificate automation, DNS and public-edge routing, and production incidents where fixing the issue means tracing HTTP, DNS, load balancing, and cloud edges end to end. In this role, you'll ship automation and reliable cloud-based platforms (we have no data centers, so there is no rack-and-stack in this role).

Work Location: This role is based out of our Seattle office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success

What You'll Do

• Work on a mixed infrastructure and software team that owns critical platform networking for Axon's cloud systems: mesh and ingress, TLS and certificate automation, DNS and edge routing, and the automation that keeps those paths safe and observable.

• Advance Axon's use of Istio-style service mesh patterns that underpin how we scale—building features, hardening what runs in production, and improving how we roll out change.

• Act as a builder and operator: ship infrastructure-as-code and software-backed controls, steward components that must meet strict regulatory expectations (including FedRAMP where applicable), and address vulnerabilities with timely, disciplined change.

• Advise software engineers through design reviews, ad hoc questions, and pair programming when connectivity, ingress, mesh, or TLS behavior is on the critical path.

• Automate operations so the platform stays highly available (targeting four-nines-class reliability for these components). Example: TLS certificate management and automation at scale—where small mistakes can become customer-visible outages if left manual.

What You Bring

• Six or more years working on globally diverse, 24/7, high-volume production systems. Bachelors Degree in Computer Science At least one strong track record from the following (we do not expect every candidate to match every item): Operating critical components or services in Kubernetes clusters at meaningful scale (ingress, gateways, mesh, or similar). Infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery on public cloud (Axon uses Azure; other major clouds are fine). Production software in Python, Go, or Java (including Scala) for infrastructure, tooling, or reliable services—not only one-off scripts. Production ownership of service mesh, ingress, TLS/certificate automation, DNS or public-edge patterns, or secure east-west traffic in cloud environments. Excellent problem-solving skills debugging cloud-native distributed systems (HTTP/TLS, DNS, load balancing, Kubernetes networking). Familiarity with a GitOps-style approach to software and infrastructure delivery. Empathy for software engineers with widely varying depth in networking—meeting people where they are, without talking past them. Note: This role is centered on cloud-native platform engineering and software-backed automation. It is a weaker match if your experience is primarily traditional enterprise network operations (for example campus switching or appliance-only administration) without substantial Kubernetes operations, software delivery, or infrastructure-as-code.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range

$148,500—$237,600 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. Dev Technology Group is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our mission-focused team supporting critical applications for U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). In this role, you'll help keep essential systems running smoothly through proactive monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and coordination with technical support teams.

You'll be part of a collaborative team responsible for monitoring applications around the clock, identifying potential disruptions before they become larger issues, and helping maintain the reliability of systems that support important government operations. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, can manage multiple priorities, and remains focused when responding to time-sensitive technical issues.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Monitor mission-critical applications and systems to identify performance issues, service disruptions, and potential outages before they impact operations.

• Respond to system alerts, troubleshoot incidents, assess severity, and coordinate timely resolution with application, infrastructure, and network support teams.

• Support the Passenger Services Program Directorate's (PSPD) suite of customer-facing applications, helping maintain system availability and performance.

• Track, document, and update incidents, including business impact, root cause, corrective actions, and resolution status.

• Monitor production changes, scheduled maintenance, and system outages, escalating unexpected issues and verifying application functionality following changes.

• Work with technical teams and government stakeholders to communicate system health, performance trends, and emerging concerns.

• Support established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) through timely incident response, escalation, and follow-up.

• Analyze application dependencies and monitoring data to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improved system reliability.

• Assist with root cause analysis (RCA), incident reviews, and recommendations to prevent future disruptions.

• Prepare daily system health updates, executive reports, and monthly program review materials.

• Help incorporate new applications into monitoring processes and recommend improvements to tools, procedures, and documentation.

• Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, and government personnel to ensure consistent communication and reliable operational support.

Required Education, Experience, and Skills:

• 5+ years of experience supporting IT systems, including troubleshooting, application maintenance, system monitoring, or network operations.

• Strong understanding of ITIL principles and experience applying IT service management practices in an operational environment.

• Hands-on experience with automated monitoring and performance management tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Auto Ops, or similar platforms.

• Experience identifying, investigating, documenting, and escalating application or infrastructure incidents.

• Ability to manage multiple systems and priorities while responding effectively to time-sensitive technical issues.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with application, infrastructure, and operations teams.

• Availability to work the designated overnight schedule onsite in Ashburn, VA, with flexibility to support additional shifts as needed.

Preferred Education, Experience, and Skills:

• Experience supporting U.S. Government systems or mission-critical federal applications.

• ITIL certification or willingness to obtain certification within the first year of employment.

Our estimated salary range for this position is $80,000 - $125,000. This presented salary range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Offered salary is based on experience, geographic location, and possibly contractual requirements as appropriate to the role. *Salary could fall outside of this range.

Who We Are

Dev Technology is a growing IT company with an employee-centric culture that works on mission-critical projects for the federal government. We partner with our federal customers to deliver technology services and solutions, and to drive our client’s missions forward through innovation. We use Agile and DevSecOps principles to provide services including application development, biometrics and identity management, cloud and infrastructure optimization, IT and legacy modernization, and data management.

jobs.title: Senior Secure Edge Architect, NOAM Channels & Alliances
jobs.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

Role Overview

The Senior Secure Edge Architect serves as the technical sales lead for SonicWall's Cloud Secure Edge portfolio within North America. The role pairs consultative selling with deep technical expertise, working alongside channel partners (including MSPs, VARs, and Distributors) to design, demonstrate, validate, and close security solutions that meet customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Design, Demonstration, and Validation

• Conduct technical discovery sessions to assess customer architecture, security posture, and requirements, including identity, remote access, and cloud and SaaS usage.

• Design and recommend Cloud Secure Edge solutions, including Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), secure web access, and related cloud-delivered security services.

• Deliver tailored product demonstrations, proofs of concept (PoCs), and technical workshops that map solutions to customer pain points.

• Respond to technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, and provide architecture guidance to partner engineers and customers.

• Provide pre-sales technical guidance on deployment planning and integration with customer environments, and coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, and Support on escalations and feedback.

2. Channel Partner Enablement and Management

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with channel partners to drive joint sales efforts.

• Train and enable partner sales and engineering teams on solution positioning, technical differentiation, deployment best practices, and competitive messaging.

• Collaborate with partners to develop co-marketing strategies, joint sales initiatives, and technical training programs, including partner certification pathways.

• Monitor channel partner performance, providing technical and commercial support to optimize their sales effectiveness.

3. Sales Process Improvement

• Analyze current sales processes and identify opportunities to streamline sales motions and increase efficiency.

• Implement best practices and standardize technical sales processes associated with the Managed Service Provider (MSP) channel, including PoC frameworks, demo environments, and deployment handoffs.

• Collaborate with internal teams to develop technical tools, reference architectures, solution briefs, playbooks, and training materials for the sales team and channel partners.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (preferred but not required).

• Minimum of five years of experience in a technical sales, sales engineering, or solutions consulting role, preferably within the cybersecurity, network security, or IT industry.

• Proven record of accomplishment in meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas.

Skills and Competencies

• Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for managing sales activities and customer relationships.

• Strong knowledge of channel sales and experience working with channel partners, particularly MSPs.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences.

• Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and partners.

• Strategic thinking with the ability to analyze sales processes and implement improvements.

• Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of working independently as well as part of a team.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity and network security concepts, including: Zero Trust SASE and SSE architectures ZTNA Secure Web Gateways Firewalls VPN technologies Endpoint Security

• Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including: TCP/IP DNS Routing TLS

• Experience with Identity and Access Management technologies, including: SAML Single Sign-On (SSO) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Directory services such as Microsoft Entra ID

• Familiarity with cloud and SaaS environments such as Microsoft 365, AWS, and Azure.

• Understanding of APIs, automation, and multi-tenant MSP management platforms.

• Ability to quickly grasp technical products and effectively communicate value propositions to clients and partners.

• Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, Security+, Network+, or vendor-specific certifications are preferred.

Other Requirements

• Willingness to travel within the assigned territory as needed, including customer visits, partner meetings, industry events, and trade shows.

• Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines strong cybersecurity expertise with channel-focused pre-sales experience and has a proven ability to support MSP partners, deliver compelling technical demonstrations, and drive revenue growth through consultative solution selling. Experience with cloud-delivered security, Zero Trust architectures, and partner enablement will be critical to success in this role.

Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?

We provide support and services for 529 education savings, ABLE disability savings and state auto-IRA programs by employing innovative technology and a dedicated team focused solely on our clients’ needs.

Vestwell currently supports 15 different state programs and we’re excited about bringing onboard a Relationship Management Associate to work with the Government Savings Relationship Management team to help service our clients. The ideal candidate will be someone who is client-focused, has great communication, organization and problem solving skills and a proven ability to juggle multiple priorities at once.

What Will You Be Doing?

As an Senior Associate, Relationship Management - Auto-IRA, you will operate as a strategic, independent contributor responsible for supporting the Relationship Management team in delivering value to Vestwell Government Savings clients. This role requires sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage escalated client issues while ensuring alignment with business objectives. You will partner cross-functionally and act as a trusted point of contact for both internal stakeholders and clients.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Develop project plans, monitor progress, and participate in status meetings, while collaborating with the Relationship Management team to execute.

• Use independent discretion and good judgment to handle complaints, troubleshoot problems, and implement solutions independently.

• Partner cross-functionally with Middle Office, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to implement strategies and tactics designed to achieve client objectives.

• Communicate effectively across teams and with clients via written communication, phone, videoconference, and occasionally in person.

• Assist in meeting all client reporting requirements, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.

• Exercises discretion to gather, analyze, and evaluate information to solve client problems using reasoned judgment and expertise.

• Own the response to escalated client issues, independently assessing situations, orchestrating internal resources, and resolving concerns with urgency and professionalism.

• Act as a proactive collaborator within the Relationship Management team and across departments, supporting seamless client experiences.

• Understanding the applicability of regulatory requirements to resolve governance issues and support client success.

• Exercise independent judgment in recommending solutions and improvements to processes, workflows, and client engagement strategies.

• Maintain clear and accurate documentation of communications, project status, and issue resolution for accountability and audit readiness.

Requirements

The Necessities:

• Team mentality and the ability to multitask while attending to a high volume of incoming inquiries

• 1-3 years of experience including client service and retirement related.

• Strong time management skills to ensure the timeliness of all proactive and reactive communications

• Strong commitment to superior customer service

• Positive and proactive attitude

• Critical problem solving skills

• Strong organizational, analytical and prioritization skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $70K - $80K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Emergency Services Full Time Nights Sign On Bonus Eligible
jobs.description:
Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign on bonus. Exception: internal employees who are new graduate RNs seeking their first nursing position are eligible.

The Registered Nurse BSN embodies the attributes of the Relationship Based Care model and performs to PPM core functions. Under the direction of the department leadership, consistently reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the State of Illinois Nurse Practice Act, the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

Relationship to Patient/Family and Community

Care Coordination

• Performs a comprehensive assessment on all assigned patients as evidenced by completed documentation.
• Communicates changes in patient’s condition promptly.
• Utilizes appropriate nursing diagnosis and data from the assessment to derive realistic outcomes and documents them as measurable goals on the plan of care; modifies care plan, if indicated, in order to identify realistic patient goals.
• Identifies and prioritizes patient needs and/or nursing diagnosis for patients and documents.
• Collaborates with patient, family, and other members of the health care team when planning patient care and documents accordingly. Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary.
• Evaluates and documents the patient response to nursing interventions and alters the plan of care as necessary.
• Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary, including palliative care.
• Assures a completed discharge instructions, medication reconciliation and provide information to patient/family regarding the use of the patient portal and other pertinent resources.

Patient Education/Ethic and Diversity

• Supports patient/family/spiritual/cultural needs when assessing the patient and family needs for teaching; identifies the patient's learning level and readiness, and documents education record.
• Utilizes the teach back methodology for advancing patient education about medication side effects and new medication education.
• Utilizes and distributes Krames for patient education /clinical condition.
• Utilizes culture vision as a resource in care planning and delivery.
• Treats patients, families and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity.
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care.
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice.
• Calls for an ethics consult when appropriate.

EBP and Research

• Implements nursing interventions consistent with the established plan of care based on evidenced based care.
• Maintains and advances the professional image and science of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through use of best available evidence utilizing resources such as Ovid/Joanna Briggs, Up to Date, Culture Vision, and other reliable sources of evidence.
• Demonstrates active involvement in clinical LADDER project or process improvement at the unit/organization level.

Healing Safe Environment

• Demonstrates safe medication administration through the use of bar coding
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Conveys complete, timely, and accurate information at bedside shift report/hand-off
• Rounds hourly in collaboration with patient care technician
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment of excellence
• Demonstrates innovation and participation in meeting unit based and organizational quality metrics on the exceptional care dashboard
• Ensures clinical practice excellence that focuses on preventing pressure ulcers, falls, CAUTI’s and central line infections (as appropriate to area of practice).
• Participates as a unit safety facilitator or as identified resource for quality initiatives as requested
• Participates in unit huddles

Relationship to Colleagues

Shared Leadership

• Oversees and directs the work of patient care or support techs; maintains overall accountability for the care of assigned patients.
• Demonstrates effective interpersonal skills in leading and directing others; deals with conflict directly and appropriately.
• Demonstrates proficiency in the charge nurse/preceptor role when assigned; assumes responsibility for coordinating patient care for the entire unit.
• Takes the clinical lead when patient’s condition changes and confers with the primary care physician about the appropriate treatment plan or the need to transfer to the appropriate level of care.
• Serves as a resource and role model for new staff, students, and other system personnel
• Assists with precepting, unit orientation, and mentoring as requested.
• Participates in the peer evaluation process by providing feedback to colleagues on a regular basis, and through participation in clinical case peer review.
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to responsibly accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence.
• Identifies barriers to effective clinical practice and communicates to nursing leadership and practice operations council.

Resource Utilization

• Ensures an appropriate level of care order is documented in the EMR for all admissions.
• Understands and adheres to the charging of supplies.
• Participates in any value based unit/organizational initiative.
• Demonstrates a personal commitment to decreasing utilization overtime hours.

Use of Technology

• Assures all electronic and paper documentation is complete.
• Utilizes the guardrails for the Alaris pump.
• Understands physiologic monitoring and the implications to drive changes to clinical management of the patient.
• Utilizes the bed management system
• Identifies new technologies for unit, hospital or system use.
• Participates in CEOC activities for the advancement and optimization of the medical record as requested.

Relationship to Self

Professional Practice

• Attends internal professional development offerings i.e. Schwartz Rounds, Nursing Grand Rounds.
• Obtains certification in the nursing specialty of practice.
• Demonstrates accountability for his/her professional practice-competencies, ELM learning, dress code adherence
• Participates in professional organization through membership, leadership, or committee work
• Takes assigned lunch breaks.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• Basic Life Support
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

Preferred:

• National Certification in area of specialty

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

jobs.title: Elementary School: Special Education, Aide - Greater Boston (2026-2027)
jobs.description:
Aide at KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School

KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School is looking for committed, compassionate, and culturally competent Aides who have the power to amplify our children’s potential by contributing to creating a school experience that affirms, values, and challenges students each day. KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School Aides work with students who require additional support in order to be successful in the classroom. The Aide works collectively with teachers, school leaders, students, and family members to meet the needs of our students, ensuring their social and academic growth as they gain the skills needed to excel in school and beyond. Aides are crucial in the growth and success of the students on their caseload and work collaboratively with the Lead Teacher to ensure that all students engage in instruction at a level that is rigorous and accessible. Together, we seek to create a professional and authentic environment of joy, excellence, care, and community where educators make long term transformative outcomes for students.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Classroom Responsibilities

• Guide and assist individual students (1:1 support) and/or group of students with the requisite attention needed, which is separate from the general class
• Under the direction of the Lead Teacher and/or Supervisor, complement classroom instruction to help maximize the learning opportunities for students on a caseload including, but not limited to:Assist classroom teachers in creating curriculum modifications for specific studentsProvide support to Lead Teachers, Residents, and/or Fellows by carrying out lesson plans and assisting with learning materialsProvide testing accommodations, including supervising students completing tests in a separate location or during an extended timeReview and correct student work assignmentsAssist in the implementation of behavioral intervention plans which may involve use of positive reinforcement strategies, behavior modification, and other skills or knowledge to ensure safety and success for individual studentsAssist individual students with self-advocacy about particular needs while in the classroomFacilitate and support social interactions and foster the development of positive relationships between students on the caseload and their peers and teachersConstantly assess progress, communicate results clearly, and use data to inform decisions and set goals
• May physically assist with physical needs of students, as needed

School and Professional Responsibilities

• Obtain required requirements for an Aide within one year of hire, which includes one of the following:Associate’s Degree OR48 college credit hours ORPass the ParaPro Assessment with a score of 464 with study resources and support from KIPP MA
• Provide aide coverage and support to other classrooms and grade levels as needed
• Be available for an extended workday, as needed, to support colleagues, students, and families outside of school hours
• Perform necessary support duties including, but not limited to, coverage, bus, lunch, and dismissal duties
• Collaborate with grade level teams to provide support, guidance, and advocacy concerning the students on the caseload
• Dependable attendance according to our school calendar

Regional Responsibilities

• Embody KIPP MA’s Code of Conduct by acting with integrity, leading with humanity, centering self-awareness and critical consciousness, taking personal responsibility, and engaging productively
• Participate and engage in regional professional development and community events as required
• Demonstrated ability to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make reasonable judgments and decisions in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the school
• Self-awareness, flexibility and emotional intelligence to navigate a setting with students who express diverse needs
• The consistent use of interpersonal and self-management skills to effectively support behavioral and emotional needs of students to ensure a safe and inclusive environment, as well as build relationships and manage conflict with students, staff, and caregivers
• Effective communication skills to perform assigned duties and to meaningfully exchange information with students, staff, families and others in person, through written communication, in front of groups, and on virtual platforms
• Physical mobility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead
• Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift and/or carry 20 pounds of materials or supplies and to physically restrain a student to keep from harming themself and/or others in an emergency situation
• Manual dexterity sufficient to perform repetitive hand/wrist/arm motions and to operate a computer and office equipment

KIPP MA aides are supported in their demanding work by experienced and dedicated leadership and staff who have themselves proven successful in the teaching role. Our leaders maintain consistent school-wide systems and procedures - academic, behavioral, cultural, logistical - designed to permit aides to do their best work.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, there will occasionally be other duties as assigned that aides will engage in to help promote a positive and safe learning environment and culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Deep alignment with KIPP MA’s mission and values, including the unwavering belief in the high potential of all students
• Demonstrated ability to drive student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment (preferred)
• Possess an Associate’s Degree OR have completed 48 college credit hours OR pass the ParaPro Assessment with a score of at least 464 within a year of hire
• Experience and/or training in proper physical/tactical restraint procedure (preferred)
• Experience and/or training in proper ABA techniques for student support (preferred)
• Computer literacy and baseline familiarity with Google Suite
• Pass Criminal Background Checks

What We Offer

The minimum base salary for this exempt position is $37,000 to $50,000 (per 1.0 FTE/45 hours per week). The role includes a $1,000 signing bonus—and an annual $2,000 retention bonus in subsequent years, as well as other bonuses, when eligible. This role follows our School Year calendar. For more about what we offer, how to apply and more about KIPP MA, please visit this link HERE.

KIPP MA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in building a vibrant and welcoming school community that advances our mission of ensuring that all KIPP students graduate with the skills and confidence to lead fulfilling lives. This includes a commitment to attracting and developing individuals who understand the experiences of the students and communities we serve. We hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Ruby)
jobs.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

This role is open for multiple levels and titles. Final title/compensation will be determined by how your interview weighs against our core competencies during your interview cycle

Position summary

You will work on small teams to build scalable applications for our government—designing, implementing, and delivering services that millions of Americans depend on. You care deeply about working on technology that improves people’s lives, but don’t think technology is always the answer. You are passionate about building large-scale systems that are inclusive, well-designed, fast, scalable, and secure, and you'll help set high standards for our teams in terms of simplicity, empathy, and accessibility.

The Senior Software Engineer in this role will be focused on Ruby on Rails and developing end to end systems for one of Nava's major government partners. The objective is to modernize an existing legacy enterprise platform to improve its public facing processes, and experiences which will enable users to have more access to the programs and services that they need, in real-time, in a more user friendly and uncomplicated way. This individual will be involved in everything, from strategy, and planning through to post production testing, and support.

What you'll do

• Work with fellow Nava engineers to design, review, and build well-crafted software

• Collaborate with government partners and other contractors to architect, implement, and deploy new systems and improvements to existing systems

• Work in an agile manner to efficiently ship new features that meet user needs

• Create tools and processes to automate our development, testing, and production workflows

• Write and review technical documentation, performing code reviews

• Participate in an on-call rotation to support production systems and investigate issues when they occur

• Take part in hiring activities (e.g., submitting referrals, conducting interviews, and attending interview debriefs), as needed

Required skills

• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Typescript

• At least 12 years of experience of full-stack engineering contributing development initiatives, in a fast paced, dynamic environment in a self directed manner, that required minimal supervision

• Meaningful experience working on web-based systems, both front-end and back-end

• Experience working on large-scale applications and systems

• An adaptive, empathetic, collaborative and positive mindset

• Ability to think holistically around engineering issues

• Knowledge of engineering fundamentals and architecture

• Expertise developing well-crafted software

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, technical and otherwise

• Strong Client services experience

• Experience with modern web development frameworks

• Experience designing and implementing application architectures and code that is highly scalable, available, and performant

• Self-directed, requiring minimal supervision

• Ability to work with others on a team

• Previous experience as a software engineer

• Aptitude for giving, receiving feedback and ability to nurture team health

• Experience with testing, specifically automated testing

• Knowing code quality tools such as Linter

• Experience with system design such as designing systems that will be sustainable with high usage, designing a front end and back end that talk to each other

Desired skills

• Willing to work east coast hours

• Connection to Paid family medical leave programs

• Connection to Maryland Government

• Engineering management experience

Compensation

$153,000—$171,000 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States

Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Location

jobs.title: Behavior Therapist, Andover
jobs.description:
Behavior Therapist (BT) — ABA Therapy

Starting at $24–$26/hr | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM | No Evenings or Weekends

ANNA Autism Care is hiring passionate Behavior Therapists (BTs) to deliver evidence-based, 1-on-1 therapy to children with Autism using the Naturalistic Developmental Behavioral Intervention (NDBI) approach. Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification is a condition of employment for this role with paid training time and extensive clinical supervision at our center-based Autism care centers across Massachusetts. 

What ANNA Autism Care Offers:

 - Competitive Pay + Retention Bonus: $24–$26/hr starting pay, plus a $400 retention bonus after 6 months of employment.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, and paid time off.

 - Consistent Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM. No evenings, no weekends.

 - Full-Time Hours: 25–35 hours per week with a stable clinic-based schedule working with 5–7 clients in a clinical pod.

 - Paid Training & Weekly Supervision: Extensive paid onboarding plus weekly clinical supervision and ongoing mentorship from BCBAs.

 - Career Advancement: Clear promotion paths for BTs at every stage, including BCBA sponsorship for top performers (Master's in ABA tuition covered by ANNA).

 - Supportive Team Culture: Monthly team lunches, seasonal celebrations, summer events, and a community that grows together.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Implement individualized ABA therapy plans under BCBA supervision to teach new skills in communication and socialization while reducing any challenging, injurious behaviors.

 - Deliver play-based, child-centered therapy using the NDBI framework.

 - Collect accurate session data to measure each client's progress toward treatment plan goals, and communicate progress with clinical supervisors.

 - Assist BCBAs with assessment procedures (e.g., preference assessments and skill or behavior assessments) as directed.

 - Comply with applicable supervision standards, including participating in scheduled BCBA supervision and completing all required supervision and session documentation.

 - Obtain and maintain active Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification in good standing, including BACB supervision, renewal, and ethics requirements.

 - Build positive relationships with children and families, providing caregivers with daily updates.

 - Maintain a safe, organized and engaging therapy environment.

Qualifications:

 - Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification — required as a condition of employment. Certification must be maintained in good standing throughout employment.

 - Available Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM.

 - Passionate about working with children with Autism and eager to grow in the ABA field.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Degree in Psychology, Education, Child Development, or related field preferred (not required).

 - Experience working as RBT preferred.

 - Able to perform physically active tasks: sitting on the floor, crawling, running, lifting up to 50 lbs, and maintaining close proximity to clients during sessions.

Apply today! ANNA is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.



ANNA is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, disability, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're passionate about our mission but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need."

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with strong front-end expertise in React and practical back-end experience with Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will build responsive, intuitive web applications; integrate user interfaces with scalable services and databases; and collaborate with product, design, quality assurance, and engineering partners to deliver reliable software. The ideal candidate combines sound engineering practices with strong user-experience awareness, analytical problem-solving, and attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and deploy responsive, accessible, and visually consistent user interfaces using React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Translate wireframes, mockups, and product requirements into reusable, maintainable front-end components.
• Develop and maintain back-end APIs and services using Java and Spring Boot.
• Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
• Write and optimize SQL queries to support application functionality, performance, and data integrity.
• Improve application speed, scalability, reliability, and usability through performance analysis and sound engineering practices.
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, quality assurance professionals, and engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.
• Use Git, npm, and related development tools to maintain code quality, version control, and build automation.
• Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, and contribute to continuous product improvement.
• Participate in Agile planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives.
• Stay current with modern front-end, back-end, cloud, and user-experience practices.

• Three or more years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands-on front-end development experience.
• Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Experience with Node.js and npm-based development workflows.
• Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, including the ability to implement and maintain straightforward back-end APIs.
• Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write efficient, well-structured database queries.
• Experience integrating web applications with RESTful APIs; GraphQL experience is also welcome.
• Proficiency with Git or a comparable version-control platform.
• Strong understanding of responsive design, usability, browser compatibility, and front-end performance.
• Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with strong attention to detail.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• One or more years of experience working in an Agile software development environment.
• Experience with DevOps practices, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
• Familiarity with AWS or another cloud platform.
• Experience with browser debugging, profiling, and performance-testing tools.
• Knowledge of secure coding practices, API authentication, and scalable application design.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Non-CDL Driver
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Responsible for the safe collection, transportation, and delivery of regulated medical waste, sharps waste, pharmaceutical waste, and related healthcare waste streams between customer locations and designated treatment or disposal facilities. Ensures all manifests, shipping documents, and waste containers are properly prepared and compliant with applicable DOT, OSHA, state, and company regulations. Provides professional customer service while maintaining safety, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Primary Duties /Responsibilities:

• Perform daily inspections of assigned vehicle to ensure safe operation and compliance with company standards.
• Collect, transport, and deliver regulated medical waste, sharps containers, non haz-pharmaceutical waste, and other approved waste streams between customer locations and treatment facilities.
• Review manifests, tracking documents, container labeling, and shipping paperwork for accuracy and regulatory compliance.
• Verify that waste containers are properly packaged, labeled, and closed prior to transportation.
• Provide excellent customer service while servicing healthcare facilities, laboratories, pharmacies, research facilities, and other customers.
• Assist with loading, unloading, and movement of waste containers using appropriate equipment and safe work practices.
• Report vehicle issues, incidents, accidents, customer concerns, or compliance issues to management promptly.
• Maintain required transportation records, inspection reports, route documentation, and company paperwork.
• Assist with facility housekeeping, container staging, and other operational support activities as needed.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Education / Experience / Background:

• High School diploma or General Educational Development (GED) required
• Prior 26ft box truck driving experience required

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

• Knowledge of DOT regulations related to transportation of regulated medical waste preferred
• Strong customer service and communication skills
• Ability to safely operate company vehicles and equipment
• Strong attention to detail when reviewing manifests and shipping documents
• Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks and customer locations
• Strong teamwork and problem-solving skills

Required Certification / Licenses / Training:

• Valid Driver's License required
• 40-Hour HAZWOPER training preferred but not required
• Experience in the Regulated medical waste field preferred but not required

Pay Range: $26 to $28 per hour

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. Pay and benefits for employees represented by a union are outlined in their collective bargaining agreement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.description:

• Operate order pickers, standard forklifts, and pallet jacks to accurately pick, transport, and stage materials
• Efficiently load, unload, and sort palletized and non-palletized freight
• Use handheld scanning devices to track inventory and shipments

• Handle heavy materials, including coils, equipment, and large components
• Work in a safe and efficient manner while adhering to company policies
• Maintain productivity and accuracy while working at heights

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

jobs.title: Senior Industry Manager –Transmission & Distribution Segment
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Industry Manager leads market strategy and business development for the Transmission and Distribution (T&D) segment. This role is responsible for understanding customer needs, market trends, competitive dynamics, and application opportunities, then translating those insights into practical strategies that support growth for Phoenix Contact in the T&D market.

The Senior Industry Manager partners with Sales, Product Management, Application Engineering, Engineering Services, customers, channel partners, and industry stakeholders to identify opportunities, support strategic pursuits, strengthen solution positioning, and improve Phoenix Contact’s ability to serve utilities, OEMs, EPCs, consultants, integrators, and other participants in the T&D ecosystem.

Responsibilities

• Market Intelligence and Domain Strategy • Maintain a current understanding of the T&D market, including utilities, OEMs, EPCs, consultants, integrators, competitors, regulations, technology trends, and customer investment priorities. • Identify market changes, customer challenges, and application needs that create growth opportunities for Phoenix Contact. • Define priority applications, customer segments, and market opportunities where Phoenix Contact can compete and grow. • Provide clear market recommendations supported by customer input, competitive information, and business potential.

• Customer and Opportunity Development • Identify and prioritize customers, partners, and industry stakeholders that are important to growth in the T&D segment. • Support strategic customer engagements by helping define customer challenges, business value, application fit, and recommended approaches. • Work with sales teams to qualify opportunities and focus time and resources on customers with strong business potential.

• Application and Solution Positioning • Develop a strong understanding of common T&D applications and connect customer requirements to relevant Phoenix Contact products, services, and solution capabilities. • Collaborate with Product Management, Application Engineering, and Engineering Services to validate technical fit, delivery requirements, risks, and support needs. • Translate customer and market input into practical solution positioning, sales guidance, and product feedback.

• Sales Enablement and Market Activation • Create and maintain practical tools, messaging, training materials, and guidance that help sales teams position Phoenix Contact effectively in the T&D segment. • Provide input for account planning, opportunity strategy, customer presentations, value propositions, and go-to-market activities. • Share lessons learned from customer engagements, pursuits, and market activity to improve future sales and business development efforts. • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure market activity is aligned, actionable, and connected to commercial priorities.

• Industry Engagement and External Relationships • Build relationships with customers, consultants, EPCs, OEMs, integrators, associations, standards organizations, and other stakeholders in the T&D market. • Represent Phoenix Contact in appropriate industry forums, customer meetings, conferences, and strategic business discussions. • Use external relationships and industry

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; engineering, business, economics, or a relevant technical discipline preferred. Advanced degree is a plus.

• Ten or more years of progressive experience in the T&D segment or a closely related power, energy, utility, industrial, or infrastructure market, with experience in business development, industry management, product marketing, solution selling, program leadership, or application support.

• Demonstrated ability to understand market needs, define business opportunities, and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

• Strong knowledge of T&D customers, applications, technologies, standards, buying processes, and market participants.

• Proven ability to influence customers, partners, sales teams, technical teams, and senior leaders without direct authority.

• Ability to connect customer needs, technical requirements, product capabilities, and commercial execution.

• Excellent executive presentation, writing, facilitation, and communication skills in English; additional language capability is a plus.

• Working knowledge of CRM, market and account intelligence, Microsoft 365, analytics, collaboration, and virtual-presentation tools.

Essential Job Functions

• Must be able to travel by air

• Must be able to sit for extended periods of time

• Must be able to communicate effectively in English

• Must be able to lift 25 lbs.

• Must be willing and able to travel overnight approximately 35% to 55% of the time, including domestic and international travel.

• Regular and on-time attendance.

Perks & Benefits

Phoenix Contact offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, and a generous time off package. There are also a wide variety of additional benefits available including 16 weeks fully paid maternity leave & 10 weeks fully paid paternity leave, life insurance, short & long-term disability, assistance, and more!

jobs.title: Research Associate Intern
jobs.description:
Our Research Associate Interns are involved in diverse, challenging assignments within a stimulating, collegial work environment. As a Research Associate, you will participate in project teams with senior consulting staff, working alongside internationally recognized experts in financial and regulatory economics, corporate finance, energy, and competition. You will have an opportunity to support our Principals, Academic Advisors, and Outside Experts as they serve as expert witnesses before courts and arbitration panels on behalf of law firms, corporations, and government agencies in the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and elsewhere.

Research Associates Interns at Brattle are experienced professionals who bring valuable expertise and education to our team. This role is ideal for those who have advanced beyond the Research Analyst level and are continuing to grow their skills as they prepare for the Associate role.

Major Responsibilities:

Data Management and Quality

• Understand, perform, and supervise statistical/econometric analyses

• Use state of the art tools most suited to problem at hand

• Help Associate(s) spot conceptual flaws in other parts of the project analysis

• Define RA tasks, help RAs start their work and keep them on schedule

• Give timely feedback, positive and constructive, to RAs when appropriate

• Assess whether model is conceptually doing what is needed for the project and translate institutional knowledge into realistic but tractable model

• Produce documents/spreadsheets that are professionally formatted/edited and free of errors

• Support modeling tasks as needed

• Understand and solve complex calculations and/or data transformations

• Be able to reverse engineer and/or replicate opponent's analysis for evaluation and criticism

• Create compelling graphics/tables/charts to support the relevant arguments (without associate guidance)

• Manage documents in a manner that is transparent to others outside of the project team

• Regularly offer creative solutions to project and other problems

• Ensure both technical and conceptual quality in all work

• Regularly contribute to the conceptual foundation of projects

• Perform interchangeably with junior level associates in the majority of situations

Research and Project Participation

• Develop institutional expertise in a particular area of Brattle work and have an expertise regarding several information sources (knowing where to get industry information) – is viewed as the go to person for at least one area

• Regularly be responsible for multiple tasks simultaneously

• Develop awareness of impact of work on deadlines and be able to flex as appropriate to ensure compliance with little guidance

• Draft several aspects of final report: client memos, proposals, presentations, etc.

• Independently determine the data or information research needs based on the end results desired by the associate or principals

• Provide insightful analysis, rather than descriptive summaries, for written work products

• See connections and applications from one project to others and can articulately explain to others

• Regularly contribute to firm initiatives, e.g. recruiting, training, and business development

• Develop a leadership “presence” and regularly take a “front seat” role on projects

• Teach technical and project management skills to other RAs either through tutoring, training or Brown Bags

• Formally and informally mentor junior staff members

The ideal candidate will possess:

• Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline along with 3 – 4 years of experience in economic consulting or industry, preferably in the competition and antitrust space

• Our project work is done almost exclusively on teams, so it’s critical that our Research Associate’s work well with others

• Intellectual curiosity and creativity as we are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity

• A high degree of ownership and commitment. Successful Research Associates are committed to delivering their best work product and taking ownership of their work.

• Expertise in Excel as well as other data applications is desired

The anticipated base gross salary for this position in San Francisco, CA is $2,500.00 per week.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement.

THE EMPLOYER

The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com​.​​​​​

jobs.title: Demand Generation Specialist
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

The Demand Generation Specialist plans, executes, and optimizes integrated, multi-channel campaigns that generate demand for Relias B2B SaaS solutions and contribute to pipeline and bookings goals. This role bridges campaign support and independent campaign ownership, combining creative thinking, data analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and persistent curiosity to uncover opportunities and improve performance.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

• Executing and managing integrated demand generation campaigns that support pipeline and bookings goals:Plan, execute, and maintain defined multi-channel campaigns across email, webinars, events, content, organic and paid social, paid search and display, retargeting, and other relevant tactics. Build campaign briefs, timelines, audience strategies, messaging recommendations, and stakeholder communications that translate business objectives into clear campaign plans. Coordinate campaign activities and deliverables across channels to ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on time.
• Using customer, market, and audience insights to inform campaign strategy and execution: Conduct audience, market, customer, and campaign research to understand needs, challenges, buying behaviors, and engagement opportunities. Identify potential audiences, content opportunities, and lead-generation sources that can improve campaign reach and effectiveness. Apply research and campaign learnings to audience selection, messaging recommendations, channel decisions, and future campaign planning. Monitor campaign and funnel performance and recommend opportunities to improve results
• Monitoring campaign performance across the funnel, including engagement, lead conversion, pipeline contribution, and other relevant measures:Analyze campaign data to identify patterns, trends, performance gaps, and potential root causes. Translate campaign findings into actionable recommendations and optimization opportunities. Use campaign results and learnings to continuously improve execution and inform future campaigns.
• Partnering cross-functionally to deliver coordinated demand generation programs: Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Content, Creative, Events, Client Success, and other stakeholders to execute integrated campaigns. Coordinate priorities, timelines, campaign requirements, and deliverables across stakeholders. Maintain clear communication throughout campaign execution and surface risks, dependencies, or opportunities that may affect delivery or performance. Incorporate relevant stakeholder and customer-facing feedback into campaign execution and optimization.
• Contributing to continuous improvement and scalability of demand generation practices: Bring forward creative ideas and respectfully challenge assumptions to improve campaign effectiveness. Use AI and emerging technologies to support campaign planning, audience and market research, content and messaging development, analysis, optimization, and workflow efficiency. Explore and new tools and approaches that improve the quality, speed, or scalability of campaign execution Identify opportunities to improve team processes, workflows, and ways of working. Share campaign learnings and effective practices that can strengthen future demand generation efforts.

YOU HAVE WHAT IF TAKES IF YOU HAVE:

• 1+ years of experience in marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, marketing communications, or a related field
• Experience supporting or executing marketing campaigns, projects, or programs
• Experience using data or performance results to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement
• Skill in planning and executing integrated demand generation campaigns: Translates business objectives into defined campaign plans, briefs, timelines, audience strategies, channel activities, and stakeholder communications across relevant marketing channels.
• Ability to apply customer, market, and audience insights to campaign decisions: Uses research, customer needs, buying behaviors, engagement patterns, and campaign learnings to inform audience selection, messaging recommendations, content opportunities, and channel choices.
• Skill in monitoring and analyzing campaign and funnel performance: Uses engagement, lead conversion, pipeline contribution, and other relevant measures to identify trends, performance gaps, and potential root causes.
• Ability to translate campaign data into actionable recommendations: Connects performance findings to practical optimization opportunities that improve campaign execution, engagement, conversion, and future planning.
• Ability to coordinate integrated campaign delivery across multiple stakeholders and channels: Manages campaign requirements, priorities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables while keeping stakeholders informed and surfacing risks or opportunities.
• Ability to communicate effectively across functions: Builds collaborative working relationships with Sales, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Content, Creative, Events, Client Success, and other partners to support coordinated execution.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with increasing independence: Organizes work, follows through on commitments, identifies opportunities or challenges, and proposes solutions within defined campaign responsibilities.
• Ability to adapt and continuously improve campaign practices: Learns new tools and processes, operates effectively through ambiguity, and applies creative and AI-enabled approaches that improve the quality, efficiency, or scalability of campaign execution.
• Bachelor’s Degree

IT WOULD ALSO BE GREAT IF YOU HAD...

• Degree related to Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or related discipline
• Experience in B2B SaaS, healthcare, technology, growth marketing, or other complex solution environment
• Exposure to CRM, marketing automation, campaign reporting, digital analytics, or AI-powered marketing tools.

IN OFFICE REQUIREMENT:

Relias values collaboration and wants to ensure that our team members have opportunities to work with their teams regularly for professional development opportunities. Our flexible hybrid work environment requires that you live in the state of North Carolina, within a commutable distance to our office (~1-hour commute). You would be expected to work in our Morrisville, NC Headquarters (close to the Raleigh/Durham airport) approximately 30 days/quarter.
