jobs.title: Senior Manager, Virtual Care Operations
jobs.description:
About the role:

The Senior Operations Manager owns the daily performance of the Care Concierge function for a dedicated pod of health system clinics, and manages the people who deliver it.

You are accountable for how Care Concierge agents are staffed, trained, coached, and held to a consistent standard across a 24/7 operation, so that clinics meet their SLAs without escalation. Success is measured on three outcomes: meeting SLAs by clinic at the lowest achievable cost per visit, converting scheduled appointments into completed visits, and preventing patient and partner escalations.

A full pod supports 35+ Care Concierge staff working both in-person and remotely, so you will lead through Team Leads rather than a long list of direct reports. Leads own shift supervision and first-line issue resolution. You own pod performance, including the Leads themselves, and developing them into capable supervisors is a core expectation of the role.

This role requires in-office presence in our New York office four days per week.

People Management

• Leadership & Coaching: Manage and develop Team Leads with a consistent 1:1 cadence across day and overnight teams.

• Talent Lifecycle: Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and schedule coverage for a 24/7 operation.

• Talent Development: Build an internal bench to promote Leads and Senior Agents from within.

Run Daily Operations

• Operating rhythm: Manage clinic queues, monitor team performance, and clear blockers in real time.

• SLAs: Own SLA performance and act on leading indicators before they become patient or partner escalations.

• Workflow: Maintain SOPs, review workflows, and drive appointment conversion improvements.

Manage escalations

Per the SOP for routing clinical and non-clinical escalations:

• Non-clinical: Resolve operational, access, scheduling, and behavioral issues that exceed Lead authority.

• Clinical: Identify clinical, safety, and privacy issues and route them immediately to the right clinical or compliance owner, with documentation.

Analyze and report

• Interpret pod-level data and give the Director clear insight on performance.

• Provide inputs for volume and staffing models and flag forecast-versus-actual variances.

Partner-facing operational execution

The commercial relationship sits with the program and account layer. You are the operational executor behind it.

• Launch readiness: Support new clinic launches and rollouts, making sure staffing, training, and SOPs are ready before go-live.

• Partner execution: Translate partner requirements into trainable processes and represent Care Concierge in operating meetings.

• Commitments: Give clear status updates on open issues and escalate any change to partner commitments to the program layer and Director.

Work cross-functionally

• WFM and Operational Excellence: Partner on scheduling, workflow improvement, and surfacing friction early.

• Clinical Operations: Serve as primary counterpart for clinical escalations and staffing.

• Growth, Account, and Program teams: Act as the operational counterpart supporting partner relationships.

What we are looking for

• 5+ years in customer-facing operations, contact center, or healthcare operations, including 2+ years directly managing a team.

• 3+ years leading frontline staff, with preference for distributed, shift-based team experience, including managing through a supervisory layer.

• Epic experience is required.

• Strong sense of ownership. This role is accountable for outcomes it does not fully control.

• Willingness to get into the details of partner operations.

• Analytical capability: able to read performance data, find the pattern behind it, and act.

• Comfort working across several systems and channels at once (Epic, Salesforce, Slack, Teams, Google Suite).

• Strong written communication and documentation discipline.

• Sound judgment about what to escalate, what to route, and what to resolve.

• Strongly Preferred: health system or multi-site practice operations experience; prior call center or contact center management; experience in a regulated, compliance-heavy operating environment.

Benefits & Perks:  #LI-Hybrid

• Monday to Thursday onsite work schedule with Fridays remote

• Weekly lunches (Mon, Tues, and Thurs) and stocked kitchen with healthy snacks and beverages

• Monthly social committees for company events

• 18 vacation days, 9 company holidays, 5 sick days, and 2 personal days

• Stock options for every full-time employee

• Paid parental leave

• 401k benefit

• Commuter Benefits

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options

Compensation:

$120,000—$140,000 USD

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We’re founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. Offer amounts are determined by multiple factors such as a candidate's experience and expertise.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, citizenship, military or veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. We’re deeply committed to building teams as diverse as the patients we serve and strive to cultivate an environment where everyone can bring their most authentic self to work. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.

We are committed to maintaining the integrity of our hiring process and ensuring a safe environment for all candidates. All communication for job offers from K Health will come from email addresses ending in @khealth.com. K Health will never ask you to provide financial information about yourself during the recruitment process. We will never use personal email accounts or other domains for official correspondence. Our official job postings are only listed on our official website and reputable job boards. Be cautious of job offers from sources other than these platforms.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to join our Rexel USA team in Baton Rouge, LA!

Summary:

jobs.title: Stage - Platform Engineer (basé à Aix-en-Provence) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Implanté en France et aux Etats-Unis, Gojob est le pionnier du recrutement par l’IA.
Notre mission : Développer de l’innovation de pointe pour rendre le marché du travail plus fluide et accessible, et accompagner chaque individu avec dignité.Chez Gojob, “We staff instantly, at scale and with care”.
Membre de la promotion French Tech 120 (FT120) depuis 2021 & élue au Next 40 en 2025, deux fois saluée par le prestigieux classement du Financial Times, labellisée B Corp en 2023, Gojob continue son ascension sur le marché de l'emploi.
Notre projet se base sur 3 piliers :
L’Innovation : Notre écosystème 100% tech, nos infrastructures data et notre IA “Aglaé” - l’Intelligence Artificielle Gojob - révolutionnent les process de recrutement et réinventent l'accompagnement de l’individu. Sourcing, matching, pré-qualification, gestion, onboarding, suivi, formation… chez Gojob, la technologie est partout. 
L’Efficacité : Nous nous engageons auprès de nos clients sur des résultats opérationnels concrets et transparents: 95%+ de taux de service et un temps de staffing de 24 minutes en moyenne. Pour nos “Gojobbers”, nous offrons un accompagnement unique (services financiers, formations en ligne, support 24/7, etc…) et adapté à leur parcours professionnel. 
L’Impact : Labellisée B-Corp et Entreprise Économique et Solidaire (ESS), notre mission est inscrite dans nos statuts et nous pilotons notre activité avec des indicateurs liés à notre impact sur le marché de l’emploi. 
Quelques chiffres clés:
80 000 recrutements effectués pour les Grands Groupes et ETI
40% de croissance des revenus en 2024
25M€ investis en Recherche & Développement
2 000 000 de candidatures traitées par l’IA chaque année
20 000 conversations gérées par l’IA chaque semaine
2 000 000 000 scores de “matching” calculés par l’IA chaque semaine


🚀 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous rejoindrez une squad aux côtés de Software Engineers, Product Builders, Data Engineers et d’un PM. Vous travaillerez sur de vrais sujets produits, de leur conception jusqu’à leur mise en production.
À l’issue du stage, l’aventure pourra se poursuivre en CDI.
🌟 A quoi ressemblera votre quotidien
Dans le périmètre de votre squad, vous livrez principalement des features innovantes à fort impact : vous êtes amené·e à comprendre le besoin avec les utilisateurs et votre Product Manager, à définir une solution technique correspondante, à l'implémenter en suivant les bonnes pratiques de l'équipe tech Gojob et vous assurez de sa mise en production et de son bon fonctionnement.
Dans le scope des guildes, vous serez amené·e à travailler sur des sujets techniques transverses qui vous passionnent et qui auront un fort impact sur vos pairs (améliorations DX, optimisations CI/CD, infrastructure scaling, architecture, librairies transverses, sujets IA…).
Et c’est aussi partager des valeurs au sein de l’équipe tech :
Passion : on aime apprendre, partager et faire évoluer nos pratiques. Meet-ups, talks, conférences ou BBL font régulièrement partie de la vie de l’équipe.
Pragmatisme : on privilégie les solutions simples et efficaces, avec un objectif clair : créer de la valeur rapidement, sans sur-ingénierie.
Humilité : le feedback fait partie de notre quotidien. On partage ce qui fonctionne comme ce qui peut être amélioré, avec transparence et bienveillance.
En termes de stack tech, de quoi parlons-nous ?
Backend — NestJS, Node.js, REST, GraphQL
Frontend — React, TanStack Router, TanStack Query
Langage — TypeScript de bout en bout
Data — PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery
Infra & CI/CD — GCP, Kubernetes, GitLab
Testing — Jest, avec une pratique du TDD
GenAI — Claude, LangChain, LiteLLM, Langfuse
🤖 L’IA au service de nos équipes
L’IA ne se limite pas à nos produits : elle fait partie de notre façon de travailler. Les développeurs utilisent notamment Claude pour construire des features, investiguer et corriger des bugs, avec un harness que nous faisons évoluer en continu.
Côté tech : les devs s’appuient sur Claude pour construire des features et corriger des bugs, et nous améliorons en continu notre harness (l’outillage et les conventions qui encadrent l’IA dans notre code).
Côté produit et ops : les PM et les équipes opérationnelles construisent elles-mêmes leurs apps, publiées sur notre app store interne.
🎁 Ce qui vous attend
De l’autonomie et de l’impactVous ne serez pas là pour exécuter des tickets. Vous prendrez progressivement en charge des sujets de bout en bout, participerez aux décisions techniques et produit, et verrez directement l’impact de ce que vous construisez sur nos utilisateurs.
Cet impact est aussi social : en 2025, 35 % de nos intérimaires étaient des jeunes ni en emploi, ni en études, ni en formation (NEET), soit plus de 5 400 jeunes accompagnés vers l’emploi.
Une vraie culture d’ingénierieDéploiement continu, pair programming, TDD, Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture… Nous cherchons en permanence à améliorer notre façon de construire, sans transformer nos pratiques en dogmes.
Du temps pour apprendre et progresserFormations internes et externes, veille, guildes, partage de connaissances : l’apprentissage fait partie du quotidien. Chaque semaine, notre Tech Book Club nous permet également d’approfondir ensemble des sujets techniques, avec des dizaines de livres disponibles.
Une équipe ouverte sur l’extérieurNous participons régulièrement à des meet-ups et conférences comme Sunny Tech, NodeConf ou DevOps D-Day, pour apprendre mais aussi partager nos pratiques avec la communauté.
Sans oublier une rémunération attractive (1000e en M1, 1500e en M2!), accompagnée d’un cadre stimulant et des opportunités de développement
 
🔍 Votre profil
Vous préparez un BAC+5 en école d’ingénieur
Vous cherchez un stage de fin d’études d'une durée de 6 mois (avec une convention de stage française)
Vous parlez couramment français
Vous avez une première expérience en développement web, notamment sur TypeScript (front et back)
Vous êtes proactif·ve, vous aimez partager vos connaissances, vous former et proposer des améliorations sur le produit
Vous êtes user-centric : vous pensez avant tout à la valeur ajoutée pour l’utilisateur lors de la conception d’une feature
Vous avez l’habitude de travailler sur des cycles de delivery courts et vous êtes familier·ère avec les principes de CI/CD sur des environnements Cloud
Et surtout, vous êtes passionné·e, volontaire et humble !
🤝 Le process de recrutement
Un échange téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un Talent Acquisition Manager ou un Engineering Manager
Un kata en développement avec un lead de l’équipe
Une demi-journée dans nos locaux : exercices en pair (développement et architecture), déjeuner avec l'équipe, entretien avec Nicolas (CTO)

jobs.title: Underwriter/Sr. Underwriter, MPL(West Coast Region)
jobs.location: Remote - West; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About At-Bay

At-Bay is the world’s first InsurSec provider designed from the ground up to help businesses tackle cyber risk head on. By combining industry-leading insurance with world-class cybersecurity technology, At-Bay offers end-to-end prevention and protection for the digital age. With 98% of cyber insurance claims in the past five years coming from small and mid-size businesses with revenue under $2B, providing an integrated solution to help manage risk is more critical than ever.

At-Bay helps its 35,000+ customers close their security technology and skills gap — all through their cyber insurance policy — making them less likely to be hit with a ransomware attack. As a full-stack insurance company, At-Bay offers multiple lines of specialty insurance, including Cyber, Tech E&O, and Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL) policies.

Role Overview

As an Underwriter / Senior Underwriter, Miscellaneous Professional Liability, you'll play a key role in growing At-Bay's MPL portfolio by underwriting new and renewal business, developing strong broker partnerships, and making sound risk selection and pricing decisions.

You'll own and grow a book of business, evaluating a diverse range of professional liability exposures while balancing growth opportunities with underwriting profitability. Beyond day-to-day underwriting, you'll collaborate with leadership, product, and technology teams to refine our underwriting appetite, improve workflows, and identify opportunities to expand our market presence.

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical underwriting judgment with a commercial mindset. Someone who enjoys building broker relationships, takes ownership of outcomes, and is excited about contributing to a growing business in an entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Do

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Underwrite new and renewal MPL business, evaluating professional exposures, loss history, financial information, contractual obligations, and other relevant risk characteristics.

• Assess, select, price, and structure risks in accordance with underwriting guidelines, authority levels, and profitability objectives.

• Negotiate coverage, pricing, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements with brokers to deliver competitive solutions while maintaining underwriting discipline.

• Manage and grow a profitable book of business, balancing new business production, retention, pricing adequacy, and portfolio performance.

• Monitor portfolio trends, market conditions, and emerging professional liability exposures to identify opportunities and inform underwriting decisions.

Broker Relationships & Business Development

• Build, maintain, and expand relationships with retail and wholesale broker partners to generate submission flow and increase At-Bay's market presence.

• Develop and execute territory and broker engagement strategies to drive new business, retention, and sustainable GWP growth.

• Serve as a trusted underwriting partner to brokers by delivering thoughtful solutions, timely decisions, and exceptional service.

• Represent At-Bay at broker meetings, industry events, and other business development opportunities.

• Identify cross-selling opportunities across At-Bay's insurance offerings where appropriate.

Strategy, Collaboration & Innovation

• Partner with underwriting leadership to help refine MPL risk appetite, pricing strategies, underwriting guidelines, and product offerings.

• Collaborate with product, actuarial, claims, technology, and other cross-functional teams to improve underwriting performance and the broker experience.

• Leverage data, analytics, and technology to make informed underwriting decisions and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.

• Contribute market intelligence and broker feedback to help shape At-Bay's go-to-market strategy and future product development.

• Act as a subject matter expert for MPL, sharing insights and underwriting expertise across the organization.

What We're Looking For

• Experience underwriting Miscellaneous Professional Liability (MPL), Professional Liability (E&O), or closely related specialty commercial insurance products.

• Strong understanding of professional liability exposures, coverage forms, policy terms, exclusions, pricing considerations, and risk selection.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, exercise sound underwriting judgment, and make informed decisions while balancing growth and profitability.

• Experience developing and managing broker relationships, with a commercial mindset and a track record of driving new business opportunities.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate underwriting decisions and collaborate effectively with brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Comfortable using technology, data, and analytics to improve underwriting decisions and operational efficiency.

• Highly accountable and detail-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of your book of business and the outcomes of your work.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in helping build and scale a growing insurance product within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• A team-first approach, with the ability to share knowledge, collaborate across functions, and contribute to the success of the broader organization.

Our estimated base pay range for an Underwriter is $90,000-$115,000 and a Senior Underwriter role is $110,000-$145,000 per year. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to market data, location, internal equitability, domain knowledge, experiences and skills. In general, if the position sparks your interest we encourage you to apply - our team prioritizes talent.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Mobile
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Product Designer - Mobile

Product Design

Ebury Valencia Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

We’re looking for an experienced mobile-first Product Designer to help shape world-class native mobile experiences for Ebury clients.

Using your design expertise and deep understanding of mobile interaction patterns, you’ll translate complex financial workflows into simple, intuitive experiences designed specifically for mobile.

In this role, you’ll own end-to-end design for key areas of the Ebury mobile experience - from discovery and interaction models through detailed design, prototyping, engineering partnership and launch. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations to define problems, explore opportunities and ship high-quality native experiences.

This role may be hired at Product Designer II (Level 3) or Senior Product Designer (Level 4), depending on the level of autonomy, product judgement and scope demonstrated through the interview process.

What you’ll do

• Own end-to-end design for key journeys within the Ebury mobile app, from prioritisation and concept through detailed design, implementation and launch.

• Design mobile-first experiences, rather than adapting desktop or web interfaces to smaller screens.

• Apply a strong understanding of iOS and Android conventions, navigation models, gestures, native behaviours, accessibility and platform constraints.

• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations to translate strategy into actionable design, identifying high-impact problems and driving alignment on priorities.

• Simplify complex financial workflows for mobile, balancing client needs, business goals, security requirements and technical constraints.

• Craft elegant, intuitive mobile interactions with strong attention to hierarchy, motion, feedback, states and edge cases.

• Prototype, test and iterate quickly, using research and data to understand behaviour and validate interaction models before implementation.

• Use tools such as Claude, Codex, Figma Make or other AI-assisted prototyping and coding tools where they help you explore interactions, build functional prototypes, test assumptions or improve your own workflow.

• Critically evaluate generated solutions and use your own product and design judgement to determine what should ultimately ship.

• Contribute mobile patterns and components to our design system, ensuring the system supports native experiences rather than simply reproducing web patterns.

• Partner closely with mobile engineers through implementation to ensure quality and polish at launch.

• Contribute to design culture through critiques, workshops and reviews - raising the bar through craft and collaboration.

What you’ll need

• Relevant professional experience within Product Design or UX, with scope and expectations assessed according to Level 3 or Level 4.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong mobile product work, including shipped native iOS and/or Android experiences.

• Strong understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, navigation, gestures, states and platform conventions.

• Experience working closely with mobile engineers and understanding the practical constraints involved in building native applications.

• Strong visual craft, with expertise in layout, typography, hierarchy and interaction design on smaller screens.

• Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance client needs, business goals and technical realities and make deliberate, data-informed trade-offs.

• A strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity about new ways of working. We care less about proficiency in a particular AI tool and more about your ability to break down problems, question assumptions, experiment quickly and find creative ways to turn ideas into working experiences.

• Comfort moving beyond static design files - using prototypes, AI-assisted tools, code or other methods when they provide a faster or better way to understand a mobile interaction.

• Proven collaboration skills across Design, Product and Engineering.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.

• Fintech experience, or experience within similarly complex, data-heavy or regulated products, is strongly preferred.

Why Ebury?

• Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

• Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.

• Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

• Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.

• Central Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury!

You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Fabienne zigrit

jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description:
Axogen is committed to building and maintaining a strong and gratifying company culture that fosters professional growth. Our hands-on and personal approach makes transitioning to a new job a seamless and enjoyable process. Most benefits are effective on day one!

Axogen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Why you’ll love working at Axogen:

• Educational assistance available for all employees

• Matching 401(k) retirement plan

Axogen Mission and Business Purpose

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by making restoration of peripheral nerve function an expected standard of care. We aim to lead the markets we serve by always requiring the solutions we offer patients and caregivers provide an improved benefit-to-risk profile as compared to existing standards of care. To ensure we deliver improved benefit-to-risk solutions, we will guide and expect the market and design requirement specifications underlying our engineering, business development, and clinical research activities, objectively target advancements in standards of care.

Job Summary of the Sr. Clinical Research Associate

This Sr. CRA position will operate as the main point of contact for assigned sponsored study sites and investigator-initiated studies. The Sr. CRA will perform investigator set up and site management activities in adherence to all applicable regulatory guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs) including site GCP compliance, trouble shoot issues and facilitate resolution, and monitor safety at the site. The Sr. CRA will assist with training and onboarding activities for new CRAs. The Sr. CRA will coordinate with Clinical Research Managers to establish monitoring plans and ensure assigned CRAs execute according to the plan. They assume accountability for assigned study site performance, providing high quality data, according to established timelines.

Requirements of the Sr. Clinical Research Associate

• Must have a bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline at a minimum.

• Four years previous clinical research experience in Phase III –IV studies. Research experience in device, trauma, orthopedic, or reconstructive surgery is a preferred

• Strong knowledge of anatomy and physiology

• Experience with assisting in protocol design, study document creation, and database design/maintenance

• Capable of working on clinical monitoring issues of moderate scope

• Demonstrates the ability to build relationships with clinical sites/investigators to ensure compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements

• Ability to read and critically interpret relevant literature. Serve as a resource for clinical knowledge.

• Oral and written communication skills are essential

• Exercises judgment on routine clinical procedures and practices to determine appropriate action

• Strong interpersonal skills, exceptional organizational and time-management skills

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

• Ability to manage and coordinate CRA activities as needed for assigned study projects

• Ability to quickly adapt to changes in departmental priorities and goals to meet company strategies and directives

• Knowledge of GCP/IHC regulatory requirements

• Must be willing to travel (50% of time)

• Consistently anticipates and finds ways to overcome obstacles to achieving the goals

• Holds himself/herself accountable for taking tasks all the way to completion

• Can clearly communicate important company goals and what he/she needs to do in order to accomplish them

Responsibilities of the Sr. Clinical Research Associate

The specific duties of the Sr. Clinical Research Associate include but are not limited to:

• Assist with development and implementation of protocol design, study training documents, study documents, and plan management for sponsored and investigator initiated studies.

• Conduct Site Qualification, initiation visits, on-site monitoring visits, co-monitoring visits, and site closure visits of all phases of clinical studies.

• Interfaces with clinical sites/investigators on-site and through off-site administrative site management to ensure compliance with protocols and regulatory compliance

• Ensures compliance with protocol and all regulatory policies, procedures and/or guidelines during clinical studies by training/guidance of investigators/study coordinators, and follow-up of corrective actions

• Prepares and/or tracks required documentation for clinical sites (contracts, budgets, IRB documentation)

• Conduct orientation and onboarding and training activities for new CRAs.

• Coordinate with Clinical Research Managers to establish monitoring plans and ensure assigned CRAs execute according to the plan.

• Assumes accountability for assigned study site performance, providing high quality data, according to established timelines.

• Assists Clinical Operations staff and study site staff to quickly identify, effectively resolve issues, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

• Assists with the development and maintenance of study databases

• Review, retrieve, and report study data as the requirements dictate or as appropriate

• Prepares reports of study progress to upper management

Location

111 West Oak Ave., Tampa, FL  33602

Benefits/Compensation

This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits offered for this position include Health, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Paid Time Off, 9 Paid Holidays + 3 Floating Holidays, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Medical Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Caregiver Leave, Basic Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Disability Insurance, as described in more detail in summary plan descriptions.

Salary Range

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Onboarding & Activation
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Product Designer - Onboarding & Activation

Product Design

Ebury Valencia Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to help shape the future of Ebury’s onboarding and activation experiences. You’ll work on some of the most complex and important parts of our product - helping businesses successfully onboard, verify their identity and access Ebury’s financial services while balancing customer needs, regulatory requirements, risk controls and operational efficiency.

In this role, you’ll own end-to-end design across onboarding and activation journeys - spanning customer-facing experiences and internal operational workflows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Compliance and Risk teams to define problems, simplify complexity and deliver experiences that help customers successfully start and grow with Ebury.

This role may be hired at Product Designer II (Level 3) or Senior Product Designer (Level 4), depending on the level of autonomy, product judgement and scope demonstrated through the interview process.

What you’ll do

• Own end-to-end design for onboarding and activation journeys, from discovery and problem definition through detailed design, implementation and launch.

• Design experiences across customer-facing onboarding flows and internal operational workflows, balancing user needs, business goals, compliance requirements and operational realities.

• Simplify complex, multi-step processes such as identity verification, KYB/KYC requirements, document collection, review processes and account activation.

• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Compliance and Risk teams to identify high-impact problems, align priorities and deliver meaningful improvements.

• Design responsive experiences across web and mobile, ensuring onboarding journeys feel clear, consistent and intuitive across devices and platforms.

• Partner with mobile designers and engineers to shape mobile-first experiences and ensure onboarding workflows translate effectively into native mobile environments.

• Create elegant, intuitive solutions with strong interaction design and visual craft, paying close attention to states, edge cases, error handling and moments of uncertainty.

• Prototype, test and iterate quickly using research, data and feedback to validate ideas and improve customer outcomes.

• Use modern tools such as Claude, Codex, Figma Make or other AI-assisted workflows to accelerate exploration, prototype solutions, test assumptions and improve your workflow.

• Explore new ways of working that help move from ambiguity to tangible solutions faster, while maintaining a high bar for quality and customer experience.

• Contribute to and extend our design system, improving reusable patterns and components that help teams ship consistent experiences faster.

• Partner closely with Engineering through implementation to ensure quality, accessibility and polish at launch.

• Contribute to design culture through critiques, workshops and reviews - raising the bar through craft, collaboration and thoughtful problem solving.

What you’ll need

• Relevant professional experience within UX or Product Design, with scope and expectations assessed according to Level 3 or Level 4.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, problem solving and craft, including examples of complex workflows, journeys or products where you simplified difficult problems for users.

• Experience designing complex digital experiences, ideally within fintech, financial services, SaaS, healthcare, legal technology or other regulated environments.

• Experience designing onboarding, identity verification, KYB/KYC, compliance, risk or workflow-heavy products is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of how to balance user experience with business requirements, regulatory constraints and operational needs.

• Experience designing responsive and adaptive experiences across web and mobile, with an understanding of platform conventions and constraints.

• Strong interaction design skills, including information architecture, flows, states, edge cases and system thinking.

• Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify opportunities, make deliberate trade-offs and use data and research to inform decisions.

• Curiosity and creativity in how you approach problems. We care less about proficiency in a specific AI tool and more about your ability to break down problems, question assumptions, experiment quickly and find better ways to move from an idea to a validated solution.

• Comfort working beyond traditional design boundaries - using prototypes, AI-assisted tools, code, data or other methods when they help you better understand or solve a problem.

• Proven collaboration skills across Design, Product, Engineering and cross-functional teams.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.

• Ability to balance and prioritise multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Why Ebury?

• Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.

• Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

• Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.

• Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.

• Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.

• Central London Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury!

You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Fabienne Zigrit

#LI-FZ1

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our team in Boston. This role is ideal for an experienced full-stack or backend-oriented engineer who enjoys building scalable systems, collaborating across product and engineering, and contributing to high-impact platform capabilities.

You will work closely with engineering, product, and data teams to design, build, and maintain services and user-facing functionality that support Pixability’s video advertising optimization platform. • Ability to work from the Boston office two days per week, specifically Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ad tech, analytics platforms, or marketing technology.

• Familiarity with AI/ML-powered product development, LLM integrations, recommendation systems, or workflow automation.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Pre-training
jobs.description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/.

This setting breaks nearly every assumption of datacenter training: communication-efficient training across different parallelism axes, fault tolerance as nodes join and drop mid-run, heterogeneous compute and networks, and robustness to malicious participants. Our published methods include Subspace Networks https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01260, Factored Gossip DiLoCo https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22768, AsyncMesh https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22442, and Sentinel https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03592.

As a Research Scientist you'll build the training system that takes Protocol Learning from the 8B run to frontier scale: large models on heterogeneous hardware, in physically different regions, connected by ordinary internet.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Distributed pretraining: Implement and optimize model-parallel training. Data, pipeline, and tensor parallelism for large models on heterogeneous GPUs under low-bandwidth, high-latency links.

 - Performance optimization: Implement techniques that reduce communication overhead while maintaining model convergence in challenging network environments.

 - Elasticity and fault tolerance: Make runs survive node churn. Robust checkpointing, state synchronization, and recovery as participants join and leave.

 - Run instrumentation: Build the monitoring that shows throughput, bottlenecks, and model quality across hundreds of devices.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on distributed training (required): You've trained models across many devices in PyTorch with FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, or your own implementation. You understand data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism.

 - Strong engineering: Production-quality Python. Concurrency, failure handling, profiling before optimizing.

 - Evidence of execution: Shipped systems, research code, open-source work, or serious personal projects.

 - Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience training or serving large language models such as Nemotron, Qwen or OLMo.

 - Experience with P2P networking and NAT traversal.

 - Experience with post-training and RL.

 - Experience with inference and serving systems.

 - Experience at proprietary, open-weight and open-source AI labs


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity-Heavy Package: We offer significant ownership for key technical contributors in addition to a high base salary.

 - Remote-First Culture: Flexible work environment with team members distributed globally.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Optional full visa sponsorship and relocation support to either Australia or the US.

 - Open Problems: Training and serving frontier models on hardware you don't control, over networks you don't own, mostly has no published answers yet. You'll write some of the first ones.


FYI'S

 - We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones.

 - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken).

 - Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help.

We are backed by Union Square Ventures https://www.usv.com/ and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.

Purpose:

The Change Management Specialist supports and, for assigned initiatives, leads the execution of change-management strategies that enable adoption, behavior change, and achievement of business outcomes. Working within the AbbVie-wide RISE framework, this role conducts stakeholder and change-impact assessments, supports readiness and engagement planning, develops communications and learning solutions, coordinates change champions and stakeholder activities, and monitors adoption and reinforcement. The Specialist partners with the Director, Associate Director, Manager, project teams, process owners, sponsors, and subject-matter experts from project inception through implementation and stabilization. The Specialist formally reports to the Director, Change Management and receives day-to-day work direction, coaching, or initiative-level supervision from the Associate Director and/or Manager.

Responsibilities:

• Execute change-management strategies and plans for assigned initiatives, aligning stakeholder engagement, communications, learning, readiness, adoption, and reinforcement.
• Support or lead stakeholder mapping, change-impact assessments, readiness assessments, change-risk identification, and change-saturation monitoring.
• Translate assessment findings into audience-specific engagement, communication, learning, and reinforcement plans in partnership with the Manager and project team.
• Coordinate and facilitate focus groups, working sessions, awareness sessions, town halls, and other engagement activities to gather feedback, build understanding, and identify adoption barriers.
• Develop clear, engaging, audience-appropriate communications, presentations, executive updates, job aids, FAQs, success stories, and other change materials aligned with approved standards and brand guidelines.
• Support the design, development, coordination, and evaluation of eLearning, instructor-led, blended-learning, and performance-support solutions using approved tools and processes.
• Coordinate change champion/advocate activities, including enablement materials, feedback collection, communications, and issue escalation.
• Collect, analyze, and report readiness, participation, proficiency, adoption, feedback, behavior-change, and other relevant success metrics, identifying actions to improve adoption and reinforce new behaviors.
• Maintain integrated change-management deliverables, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items in alignment with project plans and governance requirements.
• Capture lessons learned, contribute reusable assets and case studies, and recommend improvements to change-management tools, templates, and ways of working.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred in communications, education, instructional design, organizational development, business, human resources, or related field.
• Familiarity with learning, collaboration, content-management, survey, reporting, and project-management tools preferred
• 3+ years’ experience in change management, organizational development, project management, communications, learning and development, business process improvement, or related discipline.
• Experience supporting changes to processes, systems, roles, operating models, or ways of working.
• Working knowledge of a structured change-management methodology and willingness to learn and apply the AbbVie-wide RISE framework.
• Experience conducting stakeholder interviews, impact assessments, readiness assessments, focus groups, or similar discovery activities.
• Demonstrated ability to develop audience-centered communications, presentations, job aids, training materials, and other change deliverables.
• Ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to identify adoption barriers and recommend actions.
• Strong facilitation, organization, prioritization, collaboration, and follow-through skills.
• Ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different organizational levels and across cultures.

Research Scientist - Decentralized Training and Inference Verification
jobs.description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/.

Our training and inference network is trustless, and the workers are GPUs scattered across the world. Many things can go wrong in this system. An inference worker can return tokens from a cheaper model, or a highly quantized version of the one it's supposed to run. Even with the right model, it can sample with the wrong parameters. Training faces its own attacks, and Agora showed what a permissionless run deals with in practice: participants who disrupt training by dropping updates or flooding the system, free-riders who submit trivial work and collect the rewards, poisoned updates that plant backdoors, attempts to extract private data from gradients and activations, and contributors who inflate their reported work to claim rewards they didn't earn. Sentinel https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03592 is our first published answer on the training side. Your primary role is to come up with efficient algorithms and systems that verify the work: that tokens came from the claimed model and sampling parameters, and that training contributions are what they claim to be.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the threat model: You enumerate what a malicious or careless worker can do across pre-training, post-training, and inference — training disruption and denial-of-service, free-riding, model poisoning and backdoors, data extraction from gradients and activations, reputation and reward manipulation — and you keep that model current as the network grows.

 - Design and calibrate the tests: You build statistical verification methods with stated error rates, tune them with rigorous benchmarks, and keep false positives and false negatives controlled across heterogeneous hardware, including different GPUs and Macs.

 - Ship the verifier: You build and run the verification service in the inference path, and you live with its mistakes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Verification systems, shipped or published: You've built a calibrated statistical decision system with stated error rates and lived with its mistakes. Publications in inference and training verification count; fraud detection, anti-cheat, and experimentation platforms count as much as papers do.

 - Statistical depth: Deep expertise in statistics and probability, with the ability to design experiments, calibrate decision thresholds, and defend the error rates you claim.

 - Technical background: You know the solution space for verifying untrusted compute, from statistical testing to re-execution, cryptographic proofs, and trusted hardware, and you can argue what fits a permissionless network and what doesn't.

 - Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with large scale Pre-training and RL post-training.

 - Familiarity with decentralized ML security and adversarial threat models, such as poisoning, Sybil, collusion, and replay.

 - Experience at proprietary, open-weight and open-source AI labs


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity-Heavy Package: We offer significant ownership for key technical contributors in addition to a high base salary.

 - Remote-First Culture: Flexible work environment with team members distributed globally.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Optional full visa sponsorship and relocation support to either Australia or the US.

 - Open Problems: Training and serving frontier models on hardware you don't control, over networks you don't own, mostly has no published answers yet. You'll write some of the first ones.


FYI'S

 - We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones.

 - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken).

 - Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help.

We are backed by Union Square Ventures https://www.usv.com/ and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Research ability: Publications (papers and blogposts) in distributed inference or a nearby field, such as LLM serving systems, pipeline parallelism over slow networks, or decentralized training, are a strong signal. So is unpublished work you can walk us through.

 - Low-bandwidth networking: Experience with systems that run in low-bandwidth, high-latency settings like the public internet is a strong signal.

 - Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.


NICE TO HAVE

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Post-Training
jobs.description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.13332). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning https://pluralis.ai/blog/a-third-path-protocol-learning/.

Agora gave us a pretrained 8B model. Post-training is how we make it useful for agentic use-cases. But every post-training stack you've seen assumes a datacenter — synchronous rollouts, fast interconnects, trusted workers. Ours gets none of that. It has to run on consumer GPUs, and Macs spread across the public internet, training a model whose weights no single participant ever holds, with rollouts arriving from a geo-distributed inference pipeline at high latencies. Your primary role is to make RL post-training work here anyway — the algorithms and the system, end-to-end.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build the post-training stack: You build the RL training loop end-to-end: rollout ingestion from the geo-distributed inference pipeline, reward computation, policy updates, and getting updated weights back out to the network. You set the direction, and you make things happen.

 - Invent the algorithms: Standard RL recipes assume on-policy rollouts from fast, trusted hardware. You adapt them to asynchronous, high-latency, partially trusted generation: staleness tolerance, off-policy corrections, and communication-efficient policy updates.

 - Ship first post-trained models: You build the evals that show the models are improving, and you take the first decentralized post-trained release from run to public artifact.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on RL post-training: You've run RL post-training on large language models — RLHF, RLVR, or reasoning-focused RL — and touched the systems layer yourself: rollout generation, async training loops, weight synchronization. Not just launched jobs on someone else's stack.

 - Strong engineering: Production-quality Python and PyTorch: concurrency, failure handling, profiling before optimizing.

 - Research ability: Publications in RL post-training, asynchronous or distributed RL, or nearby fields are a strong signal. So is unpublished work you can defend in detail.

 - Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience training over slow networks, or with decentralized or federated setups.

 - Familiarity with serving-engine internals such as vLLM or SGLang — our rollout pipeline is a serving system.

 - Experience with reward modeling or building verifiable-reward datasets.

 - Experience with P2P networking and NAT traversal.

 - Experience at proprietary, open-weight and open-source AI labs


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity-Heavy Package: We offer significant ownership for key technical contributors in addition to a high base salary.

 - Remote-First Culture: Flexible work environment with team members distributed globally.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Optional full visa sponsorship and relocation support to either Australia or the US.

 - Open Problems: Training and serving frontier models on hardware you don't control, over networks you don't own, mostly has no published answers yet. You'll write some of the first ones.


FYI'S

 - We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones.

 - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken).

 - Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help.

We are backed by Union Square Ventures https://www.usv.com/ and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.description:

The Director of Product Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining and executing the vision, growth strategy, profitability, and lifecycle management of US Conec’s product portfolio. Must Haves

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Chef De Cuisine, you are responsible for all culinary oversight in our scratch-based kitchen operation. As an extremely efficient individual with a passion for executing food excellence and hospitality, you run a strong kitchen by showcasing advanced business and culinary acumen. You own and take pride in order/inventory management, prep management, and health and safety standards within the four walls of your restaurant. You are the subject matter expert in your areas of focus in the kitchen and serve as a vital resource for your team and peers. In our operation centered around innovation, you are always looking at food quality, cost, and training as data points for you and your team to grow.

Staying organized and detail-oriented in a fast-paced environment is key to your role as Chef de Cuisine. We are constantly evolving our menu and testing new initiatives to improve business operations. You will effectively multitask and train your culinary team through the day-to-day shifts, to ensure your team is well-equipped to execute anything and everything on our menu. Our Restaurants run using a traditional brigade system. As Chef de Cuisine, you are the second in command. You report directly to the Chef Operator and the Sous Chefs and Chefs-in-training report directly to you. • Manage our kitchen facilities, following up with all maintenance on culinary equipment, cleanliness, and organization of your restaurant.

• Collaborate with your Chef Operator to manage labor and food cost.

• Build your kitchen team by assisting in interviewing, hiring, providing performance improvement, and disciplinary action.

• Actively give feedback through the DIRECT model, monitoring the effectiveness of your team by providing timely positive and critical feedback.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Dashlane

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane, including how we work, how we hire, and the benefits of being a Dashlaner.

About the Role:

As an Account Executive, you will be a key member of the team carrying Dashlane's mission: to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Compromised credentials remain the leading cause of breaches, and Dashlane is moving up-market fast, from password manager to the credential security layer for the modern enterprise. You will drive that expansion by building a proactive, outbound-driven motion that reduces our reliance on inbound leads. This role is designed for a top-performing individual contributor with a track record of success in the commercial or mid-market space who is ready to step up and run larger, more complex deals. You will own deals end to end, from self-sourced first contact through multi-stakeholder consensus to close, while instilling urgency that shortens sales cycles. You will work alongside SDRs, channel partners, solutions engineers, and fellow account executives to capture pipeline across all four revenue streams: inbound, outbound, channel, and SDR. As a trusted voice on our product and the broader cybersecurity stack, you will earn credibility with CISOs and IT leaders and help shape how the sales team wins. This role is based in New York, with travel to industry and channel events.

At Dashlane you will:

• Generate at least 40% of your pipeline through self-directed outbound prospecting of decision-makers

• Map buying organizations, multi-thread across stakeholders, and build consensus to move deals forward as you transition into larger deal sizes

• Consistently execute full-cycle sales processes as a high-performing individual contributor, creating urgency that shortens sales cycles

• Maintain disciplined pipeline management, clear opportunity staging, and accurate, predictable forecasts

• Build productive relationships with channel partners to expand deal reach and velocity

• Partner with SDRs and internal teams to capture pipeline across inbound, outbound, channel, and SDR streams

• Master Dashlane's value proposition and the cybersecurity stack, with a focus on credential management

• Represent Dashlane at industry and channel events

Requirements:

• 2+ years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS or technology sales.

• Proven track record of quota overachievement and strong performance as an individual contributor.

• Proven ability to proactively prospect, open doors, and self-source pipeline without relying solely on inbound leads.

• Experience leveraging channel partners and SDR teams to expand deal reach and pipeline velocity.

We're Also Looking For:

• Experience or exposure closing complex, multi-stakeholder mid-market deals or enterprise opportunities (a strong plus).

• Methodical approach to pipeline management with a history of clean opportunity staging and accurate forecasting.

• Eager to leverage and integrate modern AI tools and sales engagement technology into daily research, prospecting, and call prep workflows.

• Familiarity with credential management, identity/IAM, or the enterprise cybersecurity stack.

• Creative, persistent approach to prospecting and engaging senior IT and security leaders.

• Collaborative approach with a drive to share best practices and elevate team performance.

What Dashlane offers you:

• Equal Parental leave - regardless of gender, up to 20 weeks fully paid leave to take care of their new baby, within the first year of birth or adoption

• Mental health services through Spring Health and well-being days

• Mentorship program - select your mentor from our internal pool and continue your learning path!

• Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents

• Unlimited PTO

• Betterment 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays and sick leave

• Donation matching program - give back to the community and support actions that lead to positive social impact under the historically marginalized communities. Every donation will be matched by Dashlane, up to $500 per year

• Weekly lunch in the office and monthly happy hour

• Team buildings & seasonal social events and many more

Salary Range:

The target total compensation (OTE) for this role is $170,000 – $200,000, which includes base salary and variable components

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, and other opportunities at Dashlane.

Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Dashlaners.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at Dashlane to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

Location-Specific Information:

You will be based in New York with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections, while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane:

As a truly international company—founded in France and distributed across France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives. We value all aspects of diversity: gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, ethnic origin, social background, age, lifestyle, and more. We are committed to hiring a diverse community and fostering a culture where everyone is heard and belongs. See more about this here.

Your interview experience:

To know what to expect once you’ve sent your application, read about how we interview and hire at Dashlane. Feel free to browse our blog to find more information about our product and how we work.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Jr. Data Quality Analyst will ensure continuous improvement of the program's data quality through solutions and strategies that address business challenges. This role involves working closely with data operations and reporting teams to design, develop, and execute automated data reporting solutions with the highest standards of quality and performance. This role requires a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a SAFe Agile environment. The Data Quality Analyst will play a critical role in improving the quality and accessibility of data solutions to support the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) in detecting and preventing fraud, waste, and abuse within government-sponsored health programs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Analyze data from a variety of sources, identify and correct errors and inconsistencies, and develop and implement processes to improve data quality.

• Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of APS data.

• Work with a range of data types, including structured and unstructured data, and use a variety of tools and techniques to analyze and improve data quality.

• Use tools and techniques such as statistical analysis, data cleansing and transformation tools, and data governance frameworks.

• Develop and implement data quality policies, procedures, and standards.

• Document processes, prepare reports, and make recommendations for process improvements.

• Develop new processes and procedures to enhance operations.

• Collaborate with other teams to implement changes or updates to existing reports.

• Demonstrate advanced Excel expertise, including the use of pivot tables, formulas, and conditional formatting.

• Present responses and findings to business owners, customers, and leadership.

• Provide support for ad hoc analysis to meet customer needs.

• Perform statistical tests on large datasets to determine data quality and integrity.

• Collaborate with the internal team to improve data collection and storage processes.

• Analyze and identify data quality issues and develop methods to address data quality problems.

• Review and understand artifacts related to data ingestion and transformation as they apply to data validation and analysis.

• Provide quality assurance reports using tools such as Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, and Tableau.

• Streamline internal processes focused on organizational support using tools such as Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, and Tableau.

• Perform ad hoc data analysis to support programmatic questions and stakeholder requests.

• Work as part of a project team to determine project requirements, goals, implementation, and schedules.

• Develop scripts and dashboards to monitor the accuracy and quality of data flow.

• Maintain data accuracy and quality checks by regularly monitoring and reviewing dashboards and reports.

• Provide training for internal users and customer stakeholders.

• Provide technical leadership within the data analytics team and mentor junior team members.

• Conduct peer reviews of team members' work outputs for quality assurance.

• Use data analytics tools, including SQL, R, and Python, and data visualization tools, including Tableau, Power BI, and AWS QuickSight.

• Apply knowledge of databases, including PostgreSQL and Oracle, and data modeling.

• Assess and evaluate timely data reporting and data solutions against client requirements.

• Ensure customer satisfaction through follow-up, client responsiveness, and thorough communication.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to provide input on testing progress and challenges.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 2+ years of experience in a data quality analysis role.

• Experience with Agile methodologies, including SAFe and Scrum, and tools, including Jira and Confluence.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, Agile, deadline-driven environment.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

• Experience in healthcare IT and an understanding of regulatory requirements such as HIPAA.

jobs.title: Box Office Manager, Chesapeake Baysox
jobs.description:
Attain Sports brings a community-focused, values-driven, and player-centric approach to connect diverse groups and create impact through the power of sports. The company was formed in 2021 and presents an affordable, family-friendly sports and entertainment portfolio that brings a commitment to community engagement, customer service, innovation, and the professional growth and development of its family of athletes and employees.

Attain Sports owns and manages four baseball teams: the Baltimore Orioles Double-A affiliate Chesapeake Baysox, the Baltimore Orioles High-A affiliate Frederick Keys, the MLB Draft League Aberdeen IronBirds, and the Atlantic League Professional Baseball Club Spire City Ghost Hounds. Additionally, Attain Sports is an owner of the United Soccer League (USL) Championship Club Loudoun United FC.

The Chesapeake Baysox are seeking a highly organized, customer-focused, and sales-driven individual to serve as Box Office Manager. This position is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Baysox box office while also playing an active role in generating ticket revenue through the sale of season tickets, group outings, hospitality areas, ticket packages, and other Baysox ticket products.

The Box Office Manager will work closely with the ticket sales team and other departments to provide an exceptional experience for Baysox fans from the point of purchase through their visit to Prince George’s Stadium. This position will play an important role in maintaining accurate ticket operations, delivering strong customer service, and helping the organization achieve its annual ticket revenue goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Box Officer Operations

• Manage the day-to-day operations of the Chesapeake Baysox Box Office.

• Oversee ticket transactions, account management, ticket exchanges, reprints, will call, and other ticket-related customer service needs.

• Maintain a high level of accuracy and professionalism throughout all box office operations.

• Ensure ticket orders, payments, account information, and related records are processed accurately and efficiently.

• Assist customers with mobile and digital ticketing and troubleshoot ticketing issues as needed.

• Manage incoming phone calls, emails, and in-person inquiries related to tickets and customer accounts.

• Coordinate Box Office preparation and operations for all Baysox home games and other stadium events.

• Assist with the setup and maintenance of game events, ticket products, seating manifests, promotional offers, and pricing within the ticketing system.

• Help ensure inventory is properly managed and ticketing information is accurate across all sales channels.

• Assist with ticket reconciliation and reporting following games and events.

• Maintain organized records and follow established cash-handling and financial procedures.

• Coordinate with Finance on ticket payments, deposits, refunds, adjustments, and reconciliation as needed.

• Help recruit, train, schedule, and supervise seasonal and game-day box office staff.

• Ensure the Box Office provides a professional and welcoming experience for all guests.

Ticket Sales and Revenue Generation

• Actively sell Chesapeake Baysox ticket products, including season tickets, partial plans, group outings, hospitality areas, and other ticket packages.

• Prospect for new business through outbound phone calls, emails, networking, referrals, and other sales activities.

• Respond promptly to inbound ticket sales leads and inquiries.

• Build relationships with businesses, community organizations, schools, youth sports organizations, nonprofits, and other potential group customers.

• Conduct ballpark tours and meetings with prospective customers when appropriate.

• Develop relationships with existing customers to encourage renewals, additional purchases, referrals, and increased engagement with the Baysox.

• Maintain an active sales pipeline and consistently follow up with prospective customers.

• Meet or exceed established individual ticket sales goals and activity expectations.

• Accurately document sales activity, customer interactions, and opportunities within the organization’s CRM and ticketing systems.

• Participate in ticket sales campaigns, community events, networking opportunities, and other revenue-generating initiatives.

Customer Service and Fan Experience

• Serve as a primary point of contact for Baysox ticket customers and season ticket members.

• Develop strong relationships with customers and provide timely, professional, and solution-oriented service.

• Handle customer concerns and ticketing issues professionally and work toward appropriate resolutions.

• Assist customers with understanding available ticket products and recommend options that best meet their needs.

• Help create a welcoming and positive experience for fans visiting Prince George’s Stadium.

Game-Day Responsibilities

• Oversee Box Office operations during Baysox home games and select stadium events.

• Ensure appropriate staffing and preparation prior to gates opening.

• Troubleshoot ticketing and customer service issues throughout events.

• Support the ticket sales department with group experiences, hospitality areas, season ticket holders, and other customer needs.

• Work collaboratively with Stadium Operations, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, and other departments to ensure smooth game-day execution.

• Maintain accurate ticketing and financial procedures throughout each event.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• Previous experience in ticketing, sales, customer service, sports, entertainment, hospitality, or a related field preferred.

• Previous experience working with Tickets.com preferred.

• Strong interest in sales and willingness to actively prospect and develop new business.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong customer service skills and ability to interact professionally with a wide range of customers.

• Comfortable making outbound sales calls and communicating with prospective customers.

• Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently.

• Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to maintain professionalism when handling confidential customer and financial information.

Additional Information

Attain Sports values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

• Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
