jobs.title: Senior Services Solutions Architect – AI, Advanced Services
jobs.location: New York, New York; Raleigh, North Carolina
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is looking for a Senior Services Solution Architect to lead the development of Advanced Services capabilities across AI data platforms and production AI, helping customers turn enterprise data and AI use cases into validated, production-ready solutions.

This is a senior, innovation-focused Professional Services role responsible for identifying customer and market opportunities, shaping technical approaches, validating them through customer engagements and pilots, and maturing successful concepts into scalable, repeatable services and capabilities.

You will act as a senior Advanced Services technical authority for AI, working closely with our AI pre-sales teams, Product Engineering, partners, and delivery organizations. You will combine strong AI and data architecture expertise with hands-on experimentation to help customers progress from use-case definition and prototype through data preparation, model and retrieval evaluation, integration, and production.

The role sits at the intersection of AI, enterprise data and customer execution. It is not a generic AI application-development role, nor an infrastructure-only role. The focus is applying AI to real customer problems, proving what works, and establishing the data, architecture and operational foundations required to run it successfully in production.

What You'll Do

• Shape AI Services Strategy: Help define the Advanced Services strategy and capabilities for AI, identifying customer needs, emerging use cases, technology trends, and opportunities to accelerate adoption.

• Validate AI Requirements: Work with strategic customers to understand AI use cases and translate them into the data, platform and services requirements necessary to move from concept to production.

• Architect AI Data Solutions: Design architectures spanning enterprise data, preparation and transformation, retrieval, embeddings, vectorization, knowledge architectures, model integration, and AI consumption.

• Drive DataStream Services: Develop discovery methodologies, corpus assessment, deployment patterns, reference architectures, sizing, retrieval optimization and production-readiness approaches around DataStream and associated AI data pipelines.

• Lead Pilot-Led Innovation: Work in an FDE-style model with customers through discovery, prototype, MVP and pilot phases, iterating rapidly and turning successful approaches into scalable delivery capability.

• Productionize AI Solutions: Help customers move from experimentation into production, addressing model and retrieval quality, performance, observability, governance, resiliency, operational readiness, and lifecycle requirements.

• Bridge Pre-Sales and Delivery: Partner closely with AI FSAs, AI specialists, Product Engineering, partners, and delivery teams to transition emerging AI opportunities into executable customer engagements.

• Influence Product and Services Direction: Capture learning from real customer deployments and create feedback loops into Product Engineering and the wider organization to improve products, architectures, and future services.

• Accelerate Services Growth: Influence pipeline and strategic opportunities by translating complex customer requirements into credible architectures, pilots, and repeatable engagement models.

What You Bring

• AI Expertise: Proven experience designing, prototyping, and deploying enterprise AI/ML or GenAI solutions, with the ability to operate beyond proof-of-concept environments.

• AI & Data Architecture: Strong experience across data preparation, ingestion, transformation, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vectorization, and modern enterprise data architectures.

• GenAI and Retrieval Expertise: Practical experience with RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, model integration, and evaluation methodologies.

• Model & Retrieval Understanding: Strong understanding of how model selection, inference, embeddings, retrieval and evaluation affect the design of enterprise AI data platforms. You do not need to be a model developer or data scientist.

• Production AI Experience: Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, observability, deployment automation, model and data lifecycle management, performance tuning, reliability, and operationalization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Programmatic Sales (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for an ambitious Senior Manager, Programmatic Sales with a good book of connections across San Francisco and the California state. jobs.title: Materials & Inventory Specialist
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As Materials & Inventory Specialist, you will be an integral member of Xona’s Supply Chain organization, supporting R&D, satellite manufacturing, and external contract manufacturing partners. You will help coordinate the flow of flight hardware and electronic components from receiving through inventory, kitting, consignment, production, and shipment.

A key part of this role will be supporting PCBA production by preparing, tracking, and reconciling customer-furnished electronic components consigned to external assembly partners. You will work closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Production, and contract manufacturers to ensure materials are available, traceable, and delivered where they are needed to support prototype and low-rate production schedules.

Responsibilities

 - Perform incoming receiving processes for hardware, electronic components, raw materials, and other production materials, including quantity verification, packing-list documentation, three-way match support, and management of partial receipts.

 - Inspect incoming hardware, components, and raw materials for damage, quantity discrepancies, traceability requirements, and required documentation.

 - Maintain accurate inventory records for flight hardware and production materials, including serialized, lot-controlled, and revision-controlled inventory.

 - Coordinate material requirements for PCBA builds with Supply Chain, Engineering, and external assembly partners.

 - Prepare and issue electronic component kits for PCBA assembly, including verifying part numbers, revisions, quantities, lot/date codes, and traceability documentation against applicable BOMs and build requirements.

 - Track and reconcile consigned inventory at external suppliers, including material consumption, shortages, excess material, unused components, and material returned following completion of builds.

 - Kit and issue inventory to internal manufacturing, integration, and test teams in accordance with BOMs, work orders, and production requirements.

 - Maintain organized and controlled inventory locations in accordance with 5S, ESD, FOD, and other applicable material-handling requirements.

 - Perform regular cycle counts, investigate inventory discrepancies, and support inventory reconciliation and corrective actions.

 - Support material configuration changes, nonconforming-material dispositions, and movement of inventory between programs, builds, and storage locations.

 - Coordinate movement of hardware, assemblies, components, and kits between cleanrooms, warehouse areas, production areas, and external suppliers.

 - Pack and crate outgoing shipments and prepare associated shipping and material documentation.

 - Operate motorized lift equipment, pallet jacks, cranes, and lifting fixtures.

 - Identify opportunities to improve inventory controls, material-flow processes, PCBA consignment processes, and supporting ERP/MRP systems as Xona scales production.

 - Adhere to applicable safety, quality, ESD, FOD, and configuration-control requirements and contribute to a safe, organized, and collaborative work environment.

Desired Qualifications

 - 2–4 years of materials, inventory, production control, supply chain operations, or related experience in the aviation, space, defense, electronics, or other high-reliability manufacturing industries.

 - Experience supporting PCBA manufacturing, electronics production, or external contract manufacturers strongly preferred.

 - Familiarity with electronic component handling, including part numbers, manufacturer part numbers, date/lot codes, moisture-sensitive devices, and ESD-sensitive components.

 - Experience working from BOMs, work orders, kit lists, and production schedules.

 - Experience with inventory transactions, cycle counts, material issuance, receiving, and reconciliation.

 - Experience handling serialized, lot-controlled, revision-controlled, or expiration-controlled materials.

 - Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and inventory-management software.

 - Familiarity with Quality Management Systems such as ISO 9001 or AS9100.

 - Understanding of domestic and international shipping requirements and ability to prepare shipping documentation. Familiarity with HTS codes, ECCN basics, Incoterms, and controlled-item handling is preferred.

 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy in inventory records, documentation, and material transactions.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple material requirements, builds, and supplier interactions simultaneously.

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively across Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Production, and external manufacturing partners.

 - Ability to identify material risks, discrepancies, and shortages and drive them to resolution with appropriate stakeholders.

 - Flexibility and adaptability to evolving program needs, production schedules, and priorities.

 - Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and support the scale-up of systems, software, and material-control processes.

 - Able to manage long durations of standing, grasping, sitting, pulling, and physical bending movements to support various manufacturing and test processes. Must be able to lift at least 40 lbs unassisted.

For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

jobs.title: Director, Programmatic Sales (Washington DC)
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for a top-performing Programmatic Sales Director to work a specified list of agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across Washington and the greater DC area. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of revenue growth and has a book of healthy, strong relationships across the Washington region.

Day In The Life:

As a Programmatic Sales Director you will drive demand for Wunderkind display & video ad inventory from agencies & advertisers across DC agency and brand accounts, ultimately meeting/exceeding revenue goals by:

• Developing a holistic understanding of the Wunderkind product offering and how its differentiation can best serve your clients' needs

• Building relationships with multiple layers of decision makers in the programmatic buying cycle (in-house marketers, agencies, and trading desks)

• Developing and executing effective sales strategies to qualified targets

• Working hand-in-hand with account managers to ensure accounts are being serviced properly and revenue is maximized

• Acting as liaison between the market and our internal team to ensure our product continues to evolve with buyers' needs

Required Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree plus experience related to digital media or digital advertising

• At least 8+ years experience required in online programmatic advertising sales, of which at least 5 were in a sales role.

• Ownership and growth of the largest/most strategic territory within the assigned pod to deliver on team and individual revenue targets

• Extensive experience in the programmatic industry with a track record of successfully impacting business growth

• A robust network of contacts across the buy side with whom you’ve built rapport and trust

• Experience working with DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other optimization platforms is a plus

• Experience selling CPA, CPC, and CPM marketing campaigns

• Motivated, tenacious, and resourceful

• Persuasive and compelling

• Comfortable in a high-growth environment where roles and responsibilities may shift

• Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for the marketing technology space and a healthy dose of humility

The base salary range for this role is $135,000.00 to $155,000.00 and the role attracts on-track variable earnings of up-to-equal value. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

jobs.title: Director, Programmatic Sales (Atlanta)
jobs.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for a top-performing Programmatic Sales Director to work a specified list of agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across Atlanta and the greater Georgia area. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of revenue growth and has healthy client relationships.

Day In The Life:

As a Programmatic Sales Director you will drive demand for Wunderkind display & video ad inventory from agencies & advertisers across Georgia agency and brand accounts, ultimately meeting/exceeding revenue goals by:

• Developing a holistic understanding of the Wunderkind product offering and how its differentiation can best serve your clients' needs

• Building relationships with multiple layers of decision makers in the programmatic buying cycle (in-house marketers, agencies, and trading desks)

• Developing and executing effective sales strategies to qualified targets

• Working hand-in-hand with account managers to ensure accounts are being serviced properly and revenue is maximized

• Acting as liaison between the market and our internal team to ensure our product continues to evolve with buyers' needs

Required Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree plus experience related to digital media or digital advertising

• At least 8+ years experience required in online programmatic advertising sales, of which at least 5 were in a sales role.

• Ownership and growth of the largest/most strategic territory within the assigned pod to deliver on team and individual revenue targets

• Extensive experience in the programmatic industry with a track record of successfully impacting business growth

• A robust network of contacts across the buy side with whom you’ve built rapport and trust

• Experience working with DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other optimization platforms is a plus

• Experience selling CPA, CPC, and CPM marketing campaigns

• Motivated, tenacious, and resourceful

• Persuasive and compelling

• Comfortable in a high-growth environment where roles and responsibilities may shift

• Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for the marketing technology space and a healthy dose of humility

The base salary range for this role is $130,000.00 to $150,000.00 and the role attracts on-track variable earnings of up-to-equal value. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. This may vary depending on living location and market rate.

• Conduct 6M analysis.

Bachelor Degree of Science in Engineering. Five to seven years of experience with proven success in production process, design, development, and qualification.

jobs.title: Project Leider Bouw
jobs.description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.



We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.



Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.



Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ en ons bedrijf https://www.monumental.co/about/. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal  https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumentalinteressant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns



Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.



Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.



Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.



We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.



De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.



Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.



Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.



Wat je gaat doen

 - De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

 - Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

 - Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

 - Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

 - Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

 - Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.



Wat we zoeken

 - Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

 - Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

 - Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

 - Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

 - Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

 - Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

 - Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

 - Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

 - Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.



Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.



Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: iwanttojoin@monumental.co – vertel ons over het meest interessante of uitdagende project waaraan je hebt gewerkt, waarom je bij ons wilt werken, en stuur je cv of portfolio mee.



Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan.



Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Quality Technician is responsible for performing daily verification activities to ensure that all raw ingredients, raw materials, packaging, and finished products comply with all applicable regulations and meet or exceed the customer’s expectations and to act when predefined standards are not met. This position will also help manage product quality tracking systems, state regulatory standards, internal and external audits, etc. The goal for this role is to ensure compliance with all Green Thumb policies and procedures, as well as applicable federal, state, county, and municipal laws, ordinances, and regulations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Supports the Quality Department and ensures all employees understand and follow all standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Perform incoming inspections of materials received and ensure compliance with all specifications and requirements.

• Execute in-process and finished product sampling as required.

• Conducts positive release of all finished goods, which includes review of in-process batch documentation, packaging, labeling, logbooks, test results against internal specifications, and other production paperwork as required.

• Ensures good documentation practices are followed and all records are filed and maintained accordingly.

• Assist with segregation, control, and disposition of non-conforming product.

• Identify, recommend, and perform quality training as needed.

• Ensure maintenance and control of production quality records.

• Assist Quality Manager and production personnel in the investigation of root causes of quality incidents and non-conformances and assist with documenting and performing corrective and preventative actions.

• Continually study the existing quality system and make recommendations for improvements.

• Perform improvement projects as identified.

• Monitors compliance to established current Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) guidance.

• Expected to adhere to safe work practices, follow general GMP and food safety guidelines, maintain sanitary conditions and ensure that product quality is maintained. Report to management any conditions or practices that may adversely affect product safety, product quality or personnel safety.

• Maintain and foster a positive work atmosphere.

• Perform pre-operation inspection and sanitation verification of production areas as required.

• Perform allergen and environmental swabbing activities as needed.

• Must pass all required background checks

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• Must possess valid driver’s license

• Must be a minimum of 21 years of age

jobs.title: AI Voice Evaluation Specialist - 3 month contract
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About this Role:

This role is a 3-month, W2, full-time contract (40 hours per week.)

Scope of the Role:

We are looking for detail-oriented Voice Specialists to evaluate the performance of AI models through real-time, voice-based conversations. In this role, you will interact with two different AI models using the same assigned scenario, carefully compare their responses, and provide structured evaluations based on defined quality criteria.

The goal of the evaluation is to create a fair, consistent comparison between models and identify which model delivers the stronger overall conversational experience.

What You’ll Own:

• Review an assigned scenario and roleplay a natural conversation with two different AI models.

• Conduct comparable conversations with Model A and Model B, keeping the scenario, conversational approach, and overall interaction as consistent as possible.

• Maintain approximately the same number of conversational turns with each model to support a fair comparison.

• Record your voice during each interaction and pay close attention to the quality and behavior of the model's responses.

• Evaluate each model across five defined evaluation dimensions.

• Identify and categorize relevant error clusters that may occur in the audio or conversation.

• Compare the performance of Model A and Model B based on the evaluation criteria and your observations.

• Select the model that demonstrated the stronger overall performance according to the defined evaluation framework.

• Write a detailed rationale explaining your final preference, referencing specific examples and observations from both conversations.

• Apply evaluation guidelines consistently across different scenarios and model interactions

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have

• Bachelors Degree

• Strong attention to detail and ability to notice subtle differences in conversational quality.

• Excellent listening and comprehension skills.

• Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to explain observations clearly and objectively.

• Ability to consistently follow detailed evaluation guidelines.

• Comfort speaking naturally and role-playing different conversational scenarios.

• Ability to compare two interactions fairly without allowing personal preferences to influence the evaluation.

• Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.

• Reliability and consistency when completing structured evaluation tasks.

• Familiarity with AI assistants, voice-based AI, or conversational systems

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $20-$25 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. About Abacum



Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.



Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.



We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.



Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

About the Role

 - Own end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform.

 - Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes.

 - Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model.

 - Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery.

 - Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes.

 - Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform.

 - Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience.

 - Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating.

 - Contribute directly to how we deliver: developing/deploying Ai to speed up delivery and enhance the customer experience, refining templates, sprint cadences, and design-phase practices as we continually evolve our methodology.

 - Mentor junior delivery team members and, where relevant, partner-side consultants on delivery standards and quality bar.

What You Bring

 - 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

 - Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff.

 - Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers.

 - Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them.

 - Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus.

 - Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components.

 - Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

 - Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies.

 - Excellent at client-facing communication, comfortable presenting to and influencing senior finance stakeholders.

 - Formal Project Management Qualifications are a plus, not a requirement.

Benefits

 - Competitive compensation including equity package

 - Competitive vacation policy

 - Medical Insurance

 - L&D budget

 - Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

 - Language courses (English / Spanish)



Our Values


Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.



Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.



Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.



Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.



Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Director of IDD Residential Services
jobs.description:
What You Will Do:

The Director of IDD Residential Services (Area Director) oversees all residential programs and services across the assigned geographic region. You’ll provide leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight to ensure high-quality services for individuals with disabilities while supporting operational growth and developing new business opportunities.

This high-impact leadership role includes oversight of budget management, staffing, licensing, compliance, policy development, program performance, marketing, and proposal preparation. You’ll work closely with Area Managers, Program Directors, support staff, and the state management team to drive operational excellence, strengthen leadership teams, and ensure consistency and compliance across all programs.

This position focuses heavily on leadership development, operational excellence, compliance oversight, financial performance, and strategic growth initiatives to support the long-term success of residential IDD/DD services throughout the region.

Responsibilities:

• Leadership & Team Development: Lead, mentor, and support Area Managers and Program Directors across assigned residential programs while promoting accountability, collaboration, communication, and operational consistency. Support recruitment, staff development, retention, and leadership growth initiatives across the region.
• Community & Relationship Building: Build positive relationships with families, community partners, referral sources, and external stakeholders while representing Dungarvin throughout the community and supporting regional partnership and growth opportunities.
• Compliance & Operational Oversight: Oversee residential program operations to ensure compliance with state regulations, licensing requirements, Medicaid Waiver standards, HCBS expectations, and organizational policies. Maintain readiness for audits, inspections, operational reviews, and escalated situations across all programs while supporting consistent, person-centered service delivery.
• Financial & Performance Management: Monitor operational performance, staffing trends, budgets, expenses, and program performance across assigned services while partnering with leadership teams to support financial health, operational stability, and long-term program success.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in human services or a related field required, including Psychology, Counseling, Sociology, Allied Health, or Human Services.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience within residential IDD/DD services, group homes, or community-based programs required.
• Leadership Experience: 2+ years of leadership experience overseeing multiple programs, sites, or leadership teams preferred.
• Program Knowledge: Understanding of person-centered supports, residential operations, Medicaid/CIH/HCBS Waiver services, and compliance standards in accordance to IDOH and CARF.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs and the ability to adapt to new technology platforms.
• Licensure & Transportation: Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets agency insurance requirements.

Nice-to-Haves:

• Industry Expertise: Experience supporting multi-site residential IDD/DD programs.
• Regulatory Knowledge: Knowledge of Indiana-specific disability service regulations and HCBS standards.
• Leadership Development: Experience mentoring leaders or supporting operational growth initiatives.
• Operational Insight: Budgeting, financial oversight, or performance management experience.

Skills Crucial for Success

• Leadership: Inspire, guide, and mentor program directors and staff.
• Decision Making: Evaluate complex situations and implement sound, timely solutions.
• Organization & Time Management: Manage multiple programs, projects, and priorities effectively.
• Problem-Solving: Identify operational or service challenges and implement corrective actions.
• Adaptability: Thrive in a dynamic environment with evolving programmatic, staffing, and operational needs.
• Customer-Centric Mindset: Ensure the needs of individuals served remain central to all decisions
• Communication: Clearly convey expectations, provide feedback, and build relationships with staff, families, and external stakeholders.

Why You’ll Love This Job

This is your opportunity to lead and shape services for individuals with disabilities in Indiana while working in a collaborative and mission-driven environment. You’ll have the autonomy to drive operational excellence, mentor a talented team, and make a meaningful impact on the lives of the people and families we serve. With a dynamic mix of leadership, strategy, and community engagement, no two days are the same—and your contributions will be visible and valued every step of the way.

At Dungarvin, diversity and inclusion are a part of what makes our organization strong. Together, we can continue to work towards an inclusive culture that supports our employees and persons served. Dungarvin is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT MINDLY 


Mindly is an international product company — a marketplace for psychologists and their clients. We have over 1,000,000 clients in more than 40 countries worldwide, with a primary focus on Tier-1 markets. Mindly is one of the fastest-growing companies in the HealthTech sector globally. Our goal is to help people live healthy, happy, and fulfilling lives. We are growing extremely fast and are already profitable! This puts our company in the top 1% of the fastest-growing profitable tech companies in the world! You can read more about us in this article https://en.ain.ua/2024/01/16/mindly-raises-a-2m-seed-round-while-growing-rapidly/.





WHY IS THIS INTERESTING?

 - Join a fast-growing, #1 product in its niche

 - Influence strategic product decisions — we actively listen to our team, so your input will directly impact functionality, user experience, and the product’s future

 - High level of autonomy - we put a lot of trust in our team

 


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Analyze new feature rollouts to determine their true value to the user and impact on the product

 - Dig deep into data to uncover product growth points, focusing on user retention, activity, and drop‑offs

 - Define, build, and track core metrics—retention, activation, engagement, and conversion—to keep a pulse on product health

 - Conduct deep analysis of A/B tests, guiding the process from generating hypotheses to formulating actionable insights

 


YOUR SKILLS:

 - 2+ years of experience in product analytics

 - Strong proficiency in writing SQL queries (experience with BigQuery is a major plus)

 - Hands-on experience with visualization tools (Tableau or similar). You know how to build dashboards that turn raw data into a clear story

 - You don’t stop at building reports; you strive to understand the "why" behind the data and use it to influence product decisions

 - You can translate complex data into plain language that clearly answers the question: “What’s next?
   
    


WILL BE A PLUS: 

Practical knowledge of A/B testing. You can independently run tests, understand statistical significance, and interpret results (chi-square, z-test, and Mann–Whitney don't scare you!)

 


HOW WE GET THINGS DONE?

We are remote-first, but we also have offices in Ukraine, so you can mix and match if you prefer. Ideally, you should be in the CET or EET time zone

 


HOW DO WE UNWIND?

We offer our team 20 working days of paid vacation. We’re also very flexible with days off :)

 


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

 - A fast-growing product company where you are a key part of our success

 - Competitive salary

 - Therapy on Mindly

 - A strong team of A-players

 


CANDIDATE JOURNEY:

 - Screening interview 

 - Technical Interview with the team

 - Final Interview with the Co-founders

 - Offer 🎉

 


OUR VALUES:

 - Honesty and transparency: always tell the truth, no matter what it is

 - Empathy and understanding: treat others the way you want to be treated

jobs.title: Sleep Support Specialist - DFW
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSPIRE MEDICAL SYSTEMS

Inspire is the first of its kind medical device designed to make a difference in the lives of those living with Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). We are revolutionizing the sleep industry with our FDA-approved medical device, designed to reduce OSA severity for those who cannot tolerate or get consistent benefit from CPAP. Inspire Medical Systems is committed to enhancing patients’ lives through sleep innovation.  We are steadfast in our commitment to prioritize patient outcomes, act with integrity and lead with respect. With positive persistence at our core, we are committed to all those we serve.

WHY JOIN OUR FAST-GROWING TEAM

At Inspire, we value people – your diverse experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts. We elevate voices and encourage learning opportunities to build a professional network that grows into community. We embrace a people-first culture by offering excellent benefits, 401k matching, ESPP, flexible time off (FTO), and tuition reimbursement.

If you’re passionate about making a difference in people’s lives and want to work with innovative technology, come be a part of our great team!

ABOUT THIS POSITION

The Sleep Support Specialist role is for a highly-trained specialist dedicated to optimizing Inspire Upper Airway Stimulation (UAS) therapy outcomes once the system has been implanted. This position provides expertise and leadership in the areas of clinical sleep medicine, specifically polysomnography, PAP therapy and patient care management and is responsible for performing tasks that will ensure the success of Inspire therapy. Through empiric learning and customer interactions, this position will furthermore aid research and development of Inspire UAS therapy. This position must be based in geographic territory.

OPPORTUNITIES YOU WILL HAVE IN THIS ROLE

• Assist with customer training for new Inspire UAS commercial & clinical sites.

• Train new customers to use the Inspire Programmer System.

• Train new customers to use the current Inspire UAS titration algorithm and how to perform Inspire UAS device programming.

• Assist with future development and improvements to the UAS titration algorithm.

• Develop and research new methods to improve training materials to ensure adequate and efficient training of new commercial and clinical sites.

• Provide direct on-site support for Inspire UAS titration sleep studies at night, troubleshooting appointments (day and night), and awake endoscopy and drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) day-time appointments when needed for advanced programming support.

• Provide remote (via internet or phone) support for Inspire UAS titration sleep studies at night and other troubleshooting appointments.

• Assist with coverage of a therapy support phone line as part of an “on-call” coverage team fielding questions from both allied healthcare professionals and patients.

• Develop long term relationships with customers to provide high quality and reliable therapy support services.

• Work within a changing weekly schedule, which is dependent upon numerous factors including upcoming sleep studies and weekly customer support needs.

WHAT YOU CAN BRING TO OUR GREAT TEAM

Required:

• High school degree or equivalent

• Meet one of the following experience requirements: 1+ year of experience in a sleep laboratory as either a sleep technologist or an allied health care professional, with the primary responsibility of sleep apnea care and management, along with a Registered Polysomnographic Technologist certification (RPSGT), Registered Sleep Technologist (RST) certification, and/or a clinical sleep educator certification 5+ years of experience in the field of sleep medicine, including having worked a majority of time in a sleep clinic, sleep laboratory or durable medical equipment (DME) company.

• Experience manually scoring and/or interpreting sleep studies

• Demonstrated knowledge of at least one polysomnography (PSG) software suite.

• Strong understanding and working knowledge of computer programs related to OSA therapy management (electronic medical record (EMR) system, patient tracking system, polysomnography recording software etc.).

• Demonstrated creative and effective problem-solving skills which will be needed to troubleshoot, and support Inspire UAS titration sleep studies.

• Ability to travel up to 50+%.

• Ability to work varying hours including overnight sleep studies.

• Ability to meet any future credentialing requirements.

Preferred:

• Associates degree

• In depth knowledge of PSG preparation and setup.

• In depth knowledge of Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) titration as defined by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM).

• In depth knowledge of Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome (OSA) pathophysiology, diagnosis, treatment and long-term care management. Knowledge of the most current AASM guidelines: The AASM Manual for the Scoring of and Associated Events.

• Registered polysomnographic technologist certification (RPSGT), Registered Sleep Technologist (RST) certification, or clinical sleep educator certification.

AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in New York to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. We are looking for demonstrated performance in a constantly changing, ambiguous environment and problem-solving leadership with limited oversight.

This role will manage Holding Company agency relationships with a focus on the C-Suite, Agency Investment Leads, Brand Teams, Buying Teams, Programmatic Buying Arms and Data Analytics & Strategy Teams. In partnership with senior leadership, this role will develop a strategy specific to assigned holding companies, while driving AccuWeather’s media, data, measurement and analytics revenue. This position requires extensive knowledge of the changing agency & media landscape, the drive to develop industry-transforming strategies and the ability to build relationships with senior agency management and brands direct. The ideal candidate has media agency planning experience, a deep knowledge of measurement & analytics used to evaluate performance, ability to develop and effectively communicate creative ideas and solutions along with a proven ability to influence multiple levels of an organization.

This position will be located onsite at AccuWeather’s New York City office with the expectation of being in office with teammates three days a week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Achieve and exceed revenue goals set by the company for existing and new accounts. Focus on selling AccuWeather digital advertising products to advertising agency and brand direct partners maintaining and fostering positive relationships across both new and existing clients.

• Build and elevate relationships at the highest levels within the assigned agencies, C-Suite, Senior Agency Influencers to continuously uncover strategic opportunities to drive AccuWeather revenue on a global, regional, and local level.

• Serve as internal voice of the agency customer to help shape product and marketing roadmaps. Assess the revenue potential of assigned account list and identify highest value targets.

• Prospect new business opportunities within territory through regular, thoughtful outreach to new clients/agencies with face-to-face meetings, presentations, events, entertainment and other related efforts.

• Identify revenue opportunities to grow existing clients/advertising agencies relationships.

• Client account management including, but not limited to: maintaining contact lists, establishing meeting cadence with (internal and external) key stakeholders, seeking out new relationships/contacts, developing quarterly business reviews, organizing and coordinating agency education initiatives (cross discipline agency days and/or training sessions), fulfilling ad hoc client requests, campaign performance reviews along with client entertaining.

• Consistent pipeline maintenance, and strong internal communications skills to ensure leadership and cross functional partners are apprise of pipeline updates, progress to goal, territory updates and opportunities, along with challenges

• Contribute to AccuWeather’s tentpole senior-level events, conferences and activations within assigned agencies.

• Collaborate with internal specialists (i.e. marketing, strategy, data, operations/analytics) as needed to meet revenue requirements and to continuously identify relevant opportunities for agencies/brands.

• Contribute to agency holding company partnership level agreements, with opportunity to lead specific initiatives in addition to capturing revenue opportunities at the account level

• Be a trusted thought leader to both external stakeholders and investment teams by leading consistent customer and prospect education initiatives and events.

• Operate at the ‘tip of the spear’, immersing in industry shifts (in-housing, rise of independent agencies and consultancies etc.) and competitive offerings, to bring an ‘outside-in’ perspective, framing new sales initiatives and recommendations

• Demonstrate thought leadership in the industry; act as an ambassador and spokesperson for AccuWeather in the advertising community.

• Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

• BA/BS degree required with 5+ years digital ad sales experience with a focus on digital media, programmatic, first party data and analytics; experience executing large scale brand partnerships across channels ideal.

• High performer – achieve and exceed revenue targets through effective sales strategies, performance optimization and development of innovative campaign strategies.

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically about a particular industry and/or product set to achieve customer goals and KPIs; ability to think creatively to solve problems to maintain and grow revenue, and to break new business

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with strong presentation skills in both small and large groups.

• Familiarity with agency holding companies and strong relationships across the agency and brand direct

• Ability to work collaboratively amidst cross-functional teams including but not limited to strategy, marketing, ad operations and analytics.

• Tenacious and driven self-starter who takes a hands-on approach in discovering new business opportunities and proactive outreach with a focus on high-value prospects.

• Hunter mentality – focus on cold outreach and prospecting to secure meetings with new clients and expanding relationships with existing.

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to build internal networks to accomplish goals through collaboration with resources across teams.

• Driven and solution-oriented and can overcome obstacles to drive projects through completion and can balance the need for quick turnaround with longer-term strategic efforts.

• Strong writing and copy-editing skills.

• Comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, start-up environment

• Strong belief in AccuWeather's vision and goals

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Demonstrated marketing abilities, programmatic advertising expertise and experience pitching first party data

• Exhibits a high level of competency in oral and written communication skills

• Demonstrated expertise in building relationships with senior agency decision makers.

Pay Transparency: AccuWeather offers a competitive salary commensurate to experience in the range of $130K - $150K base + commission.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

jobs.title: Director, Features System Engineering
jobs.description:
Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. 


About You:
You are a systems engineering Technology leader who has built and run the function strategically, not just practiced it. You have partnered with business and product teams to lead the system and sub-system expectations, requirements, and verification strategy on new product development programs, and you know how to turn an ambiguous concept into a defined, testable, certifiable system. You have defined the behaviors and functions of autonomous, AI-enabled systems, ideally in Product Architecture, Mission Autonomy, Vehicle Autonomy, and you can coach,explain and drive the design intent and the safety case to engineers, executives, customers, suppliers, and regulators with equal credibility.
 
You have worked as part of an engineering and technology organization on safety-critical systems, so you know how to keep safety and human factors at the forefront while the schedule is pushing hard. You set the systems engineering plans, processes, and standards that let a small, fast-moving team execute without losing rigor, and you stay close enough to the work to own significant architecture, requirements, and interface decisions yourself. You align hardware, software, safety, and flight controls around a shared technical picture, and you hold the line when disciplines disagree.
 
You build and develop managers and engineers as readily as you build architectures. You hire strong systems talent, mentor them into technical leaders, and earn trust across engineering through judgment rather than title. You are drawn to the hardest version of this problem: bringing autonomy to certified commercial and military aviation, where the technology is new, the stakes are real, and the playbook is still being written.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta.  - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

About the role

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About the Role:

We build an advanced data platform that helps demanding enterprise and public-sector customers turn large, complex datasets into high-quality, structured data for AI. We're a small, senior team that values ownership, correctness, and strong engineering. We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help build and operate the product end to end, and to work closely with the customers who use it. You'll spend most of your time building, with regular chances to join customer conversations, help deploy the platform in their environments, and see how it's used in the field. It's a great fit for an engineer who enjoys working with customers and wants to grow into a more customer-facing role.

What You'll Do:

• Build features end to end across our Rust backend and TypeScript/React frontend, from the data model and APIs to a polished, interactive web application.

• Design data models, APIs, and ingestion pipelines that are fast and reliable at scale.

• Help deploy, configure, and support the platform in cloud and customer environments, including AWS GovCloud, on-premises Kubernetes, and air-gapped or classified networks.

• Build data connectors and integrations that bring customer data into the platform and fit it to their workflows.

• Join customer conversations, demos, and occasional on-site visits to understand how the product is used, and turn that feedback into product improvements.

• Contribute to architecture, code quality, performance, and security as the product grows.

What We're Looking For:

• 5+ years building and shipping production software.

• Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility (U.S. citizenship required).

• Strong backend skills in a modern systems or application language (we work primarily in Rust; we're happy to help a strong engineer ramp up).

• Solid SQL and PostgreSQL fundamentals — indexing, transactions, and query performance.

• Proficiency with TypeScript and React and an eye for clean, responsive UIs.

• Experience deploying and running services with Docker and Kubernetes.

• Strong communication skills — able to explain technical work clearly to customers and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have:

• Customer-facing, consulting, or solutions-engineering experience.

• Experience deploying software in classified, air-gapped, or other regulated environments.

• AWS/EKS (including GovCloud), infrastructure-as-code, and STIG or RMF experience.

• Experience with data-intensive applications, data pipelines, or Python for data work.

• Familiarity with AI training data, annotation, or data-labeling workflows.

Core Technologies:

• Rust · TypeScript / React · PostgreSQL · Python · cloud object storage · Docker · Kubernetes · AWS (including GovCloud). (Additional components shared during the interview process.)

Eligibility:

• U.S. citizenship and an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility are required. This role is open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. (remote) or hybrid in the Washington, DC area, with occasional travel to customer sites.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

jobs.title: Customer Experience and Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Bedrock is looking for a Customer Experience and Enablement Lead to help our partners and their crews confidently adopt autonomy on the jobsite. Closely supporting our Commercial, Operations, and Product leaders, you’ll design the onboarding, training, and field engagements that prepare customers for deployments and help crews build the skills to succeed.

This is a senior, hands-on role within Marketing for someone who combines customer advocacy, program design, strong writing, and community-building instincts. You’ll personally develop the materials that support the partner experience, build meaningful connections with customer leaders and field crews, and turn their feedback into better training, communications, and enablement.

You’ll also own the strategy for Bedrock University—starting with practical resources for our earliest partners, then developing structured pathways toward certification for on-site Autonomy Technicians. You’ll also build our customer and field advisory-board programs into more frequent ways for customers to offer feedback and learn from one another. This role focuses on scalable programs and partner readiness, rather than individual account management, help-desk support, or deployment execution.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design the customer-facing onboarding experience alongside our Commercial team, ensuring customer leaders and field crews understand what to expect from day one

 - Own the communications, materials, collateral, and content that support onboarding, deployments, crew training, and ongoing enablement.

 - Equip Bedrock’s field teams to deliver consistent onboarding and training through clear facilitator guidance, reusable materials, and practical tools.

 - Write and develop training resources, guides, presentations, and other materials with input from technical and safety experts, field operations teams, and creative partners.

 - Build programs that strengthen crew confidence and readiness, making our technology approachable, practical, and relevant to day-to-day jobsite responsibilities.

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Bedrock University, evolving practical training resources and workshops into structured learning pathways, skills assessments, and eventual certification for on-site Autonomy Technicians and other supporting roles.

 - Own the community and program mechanics of customer and field advisory boards, including member engagement, communications, meeting cadence, participation, and follow-through

 - Partner with Commercial, Product, and Ops to ensure the right insights are collected through advisory board experiences to inform technical roadmap and future GTM motions

 - Develop ongoing opportunities such as webinars for customer leaders and field crews to exchange ideas, share practical experiences, and learn from one another.

 - Establish workflows and measures that help Bedrock understand crew readiness, training effectiveness, partner participation, and the quality of field feedback.

 - Travel regularly to customers, active jobsites, training activities, and advisory-board gatherings to build relationships and keep programs grounded in field realities.

 - 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in customer enablement, customer education, workforce development, training, community programs, partner engagement, or a comparable discipline.

 - A strategic, hands-on program builder who can connect partner needs, field realities, and business priorities into practical, scalable experiences.

 - Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical input into clear, useful materials for audiences with different responsibilities and levels of familiarity.

 - Experience designing onboarding, training, or learning programs that build confidence and prepare people to apply new skills in their work.

 - Strong community-building and facilitation instincts. You can earn trust, encourage participation, and create useful exchanges among customer leaders, crews, and internal experts.

 - The ability to learn unfamiliar subjects quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and work with technical and safety specialists to ensure materials are accurate and appropriate.

 - Strong project leadership and operational discipline. You can coordinate multiple stakeholders, create structure from ambiguity, and move work from concept through delivery.

 - A collaborative, low-ego working style and genuine respect for the people in the field.

 - Construction or field-operations experience is a plus, but not required. Experience building an academy, certification pathway, advisory-board program, or peer-learning community is helpful.


LOCATION AND TRAVEL

This is a primarily in-office role, with San Francisco or Austin as preferred locations. Regular travel to customer sites, jobsites, training activities, and partner gatherings is required.

jobs.description:

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia.  - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Mid-Market Lead, you will be the strategic driver behind scaling and optimizing our Mid-Market AE organization in the Eastern US. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Mid-Market segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Mid-Market buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities.

 - Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 7+ years of SaaS or technology sales experience, with meaningful experience leading or scaling Mid-Market AE teams.

 - Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Mid-Market or velocity-oriented sales environment.

 - Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor.

 - Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels.

 - Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership.
