jobs.title: Director of Sales Strategy and Enablement
jobs.description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the Role

We’re looking for someone with strong sales instincts, analytical depth, and a builder mindset to help us grow revenue and improve how we sell.

You’ll work directly with our CEO and Co-Founder and partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to identify opportunities, develop solutions, and put them into practice. Your work will span sales funnel optimization, customer and competitive insights, pricing and packaging, and building AI-powered tools that make our sales team more effective.

You’ll personally analyze data, listen to customer conversations, build workflows and tools, and run experiments. Success means delivering measurable improvements in conversion, revenue per consultation, and sales productivity.

What You'll Do

Revenue strategy and sales performance

• Analyze the full customer journey—from lead acquisition and consultation booking through enrollment—to identify where we lose opportunities and how to improve.

• Turn funnel data, sales conversations, and lost-deal patterns into specific actions around qualification, recommendations, follow-up, and closing.

• Build reporting that helps the team understand conversion, average package value, sales cycle, acquisition efficiency, and performance by channel, program, and salesperson.

• Partner with sales leadership to implement improvements and measure their impact.

Customer insights, competitive intelligence, and new offers

• Regularly review prospect calls and work directly with Enrollment Managers to understand customer needs, objections, and buying decisions.

• Study market offerings, pricing, positioning, sales experiences, and proof of outcomes.

• Translate those insights into recommendations for new programs, bundles, package features, and positioning.

• Partner with delivery teams to assess feasibility and economics, launch pilots, and determine what should scale.

AI tools and automation

• Personally prototype and build tools that help our sales team prepare for calls, recommend programs, create proposals, follow up, and access relevant information.

• Use AI-assisted coding, low-code tools, and workflow automation to move quickly from an idea to a working solution.

• Connect tools with our CRM and existing systems, with appropriate attention to data quality, permissions, and reliability.

• Own rollout, documentation, adoption, and ongoing improvement; measure whether tools save time and improve results.

Revenue systems and processes

• Own improvements to CRM workflows, lead routing, pipeline stages, follow-up automation, and sales-to-Student-Success handoffs.

• Maintain clear definitions and reliable data so teams can make decisions from a consistent view of performance.

• Identify manual work and operational bottlenecks, then implement practical solutions.

• Prioritize projects based on expected commercial impact and effort, and carry them through to completion.

What You'll Bring

• Approximately 5–8 years of relevant experience across Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, Growth, or commercial business operations.

• Relevant experience managing and growing a team

• Strong sales judgment developed through direct selling or close, sustained work with a sales team. You understand discovery, objections, buying motivations, and how deals progress.

• A record of personally delivering improvements in conversion, deal value, sales productivity, or revenue growth.

• Hands-on experience configuring a CRM, building workflows, and using data to diagnose business problems.

• Practical experience building AI tools or automations that other people actually use. You can show us what you built and explain your contribution.

• Strong analytical skills, including comfort with spreadsheets, funnel analysis, dashboards, and experiment measurement.

• The ability to move from an ambiguous problem to a working solution with limited direction.

• Clear communication and the ability to earn trust with salespeople, technical partners, and senior leaders.

Particularly relevant experience

• Consultative B2C sales, education, marketplaces, or high-consideration services.

• Pricing, packaging, competitive research, or launching new offers.

• HubSpot or a comparable CRM; automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier; and AI-assisted development tools.

• SQL, APIs, or scripting skills that help you independently build and troubleshoot solutions.

• Bonus: Prior experience as an Account Executive, sales consultant, founder, or early commercial hire.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days: Develop a clear understanding of our sales process, customer conversations, funnel performance, and systems. Identify the highest-value opportunities and ship an initial improvement.

Within 60 days: Launch useful sales tools and automations along with measurable commercial experiments, with clear ownership, adoption, and success criteria.

Within 90 days: Show evidence of impact, establish a prioritized roadmap, and create a repeatable process to turn insights into improvements.

Why this role

You’ll work directly with the co-founder, have access to real customer feedback, and own projects from initial insight through implementation. You’ll have room to shape how we sell, what we offer, and how we use AI across the revenue organization.

Why You'll Love Inspira

• Amazing people with a great vision and values

• Mission-driven team culture focused on student success

• Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

• Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid

• Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)

• Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

• 401(k) with company match

The targeted OTE for this role is: $180K-$220K OTE. Actual compensation is dependent upon several factors, including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team and geographic location. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive will be finalized at the offer. The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company.

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

Of the 10 million Americans struggling with opioid misuse, only 1 in 10 receive treatment. This is an accessibility crisis, and we are on a mission to solve it by bringing life-saving care to the 89% currently left behind. Through a single app, Bicycle Health combines Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) with behavioral healthcare, drug screening, therapy, and peer support.

We’re looking for Nurse Practitioners and Physician Assistants to join us full-time in a 40-hour-per-week, W-2 role with a schedule designed to offer both structure and flexibility. We are not currently hiring 1099 or part time providers.

The Provider position at Bicycle Health is a remote full-time addiction medicine clinical position with responsibility for the continuity care of a panel of adult patients under care primarily for opioid use disorder.  The Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant will assess new patients presenting for telemedicine-based care of opioid use disorder, determine appropriateness of enrollment in our care setting, and manage their continuity OUD treatment from initial induction through the duration of their care.  The Nurse Practitioner also addresses co-occurring mental health conditions directly when appropriate, and also via referral and care-coordination with outside providers.  The NP/PA participates actively in regular clinical team meetings and quality improvement activities, collaborates with our program physicians and therapists, and reports to the regional medical director.

✅ Limited Call - there are on-call responsibilities but most providers are on-call once every 2-3 months on average. Call is one week at a time (Monday to Monday).

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

 - Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the financial services industry.

 - Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

 - Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

 - Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

 - Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

 - Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

 - Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

 - Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

 - At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

 - Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

 - Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

 - Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

 - Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

 - Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

 - Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

 - Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

 - High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

 - Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

 - Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and creative hands-on senior scientist to join the Cell Culture Process Development group within PDS&T Biologics at AbbVie Bioresearch Center in Worcester, MA. As part of the Cell Culture Development organization, you will support process development and technology transfer activities for cell culture processes, contributing to the clinical manufacturing and commercialization of therapeutic proteins in the AbbVie pipeline. Additionally, you will be a part of a team that provides subject matter expertise and experimental support for the production of commercial biologics. The ideal candidate will work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a dynamic team environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and characterize highly-productive CHO cell culture processes suitable for cGMP biotherapeutic manufacturing within project timelines, performing technical transfer, and manufacturing support activities.
• Lead and execute scientific research and development initiatives to reduce cost of goods (COGs) by significantly improving platform processes and workflows, deepening scientific understanding, and applying new methods and technologies. These include cell metabolic modeling, perfusion technology, and a suite of Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools.
• Design, execute, and analyze cell culture experiments using Design of Experiments (DOE) principles and report data summary packages for multi-variate analysis.
• Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with colleagues in other functional areas (Analytical Development, Cell Line Development, Discovery, Manufacturing, and Quality). Effectively communicate scientific data and concepts to internal and external audiences through reports, presentations and manuscripts. Author and review technical reports, protocols, and other key documents.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, documentation and GMP compliance.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with minimum 10 years of experience, or Master’s Degree or equivalent education with minimum 8 years of experience. Or PhD with no minimum years of experience, in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, or a related discipline.
• Proven ability to independently design experiments, troubleshoot technical issues, and deliver high-quality scientific output.
• Strong understanding of cell biology with extensive hands-on experience with mammalian suspension cell culture
• Theoretical and practical knowledge to carry out the job functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Understanding of cell culture processes (e.g., cell culture process development, process scale up and scale down, recombinant protein production, protein characterization).
• Demonstrated experience in cell metabolic modeling and process modeling using mechanistic model and/or machine learning algorithms.
• Familiarity with bioreactor perfusion processes.
• Demonstrated experience in applying Process Analytical Technology (PAT) to improve cell culture processes.
• Hands-on experience with upstream mammalian suspension cell culture using bench scale bioreactors, AMBR, and shake flasks.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Strong scientific curiosity with a passion for problem-solving and optimization. Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail and ability to multi-task. Strong organizational, planning and trouble-shooting skills.

About Us:
Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.
 


About the Role
Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it.
You'll join an international support team that serves customers, partners, prospects, and internal colleagues. Our Tier 1 team provides round-the-clock support, while Tier 2 handles deeper technical investigations. This role brings additional engineering depth to that work, particularly in troubleshooting SDKs and complex payments integrations.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly on difficult cases while helping teammates develop their technical skills. We also want this hire to help lay the foundation for a potential Tier 3 support function. That expansion and any future team leadership role are subject to leadership approval, rather than guaranteed next steps.
We expect roughly 60% of your time to focus on complex customer tickets, most of them from our top-tier accounts. The remaining time will involve retrospectives, customer advocacy, cross-functional projects, and coaching.

jobs.title: Community Placemaking and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE — built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the reason tenants feel like they belong to something. Not just a building, but a community — one with its own energy, its own rituals, and a sense that someone actually cares about how their days go.

As a Senior Community Manager, you design and oversee the full tenant programming experience: from the annual event calendar to day-of execution, from building communications to the tenant app. You lead the team that brings it all to life, and you're accountable for the engagement numbers that show it's working.

This role requires the creativity to design programs people actually want to attend, the operational discipline to run them well, and the relationship skills to make tenants feel personally connected to the building. The programming is the vehicle. The feeling is the product.

At buildings where this role works well, tenants renew leases partly because of what you've built. That's the bar.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants show up. Event attendance is strong, app engagement is growing, and the building has a reputation for actually doing things worth coming to.

• Tenant relationships feel personal. People know your name, tell you things, and trust that you'll follow through.

• Building communications are consistent, on-brand, and actually read. The app, signage, and newsletter work together as one voice.

• NPS and tenant satisfaction scores are trending upward, and you can trace them back to specific programs and decisions.



YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You get energy from making people feel seen and connected. It's not just about organizing events. It's about noticing who's new, who needs an introduction, who's been having a rough week — and doing something about it.

• You're equally comfortable with strategy and execution. You can think through a quarterly programming calendar and then personally staff a Thursday afternoon activation. Both feel important to you.

• You understand that community doesn't happen by accident. You've built programs that worked and ones that didn't, and you learned from both. You have a framework for what drives engagement and why.

• You lead through relationships, not authority. Your direct reports work hard because they want to, not because you've told them to. You invest in people and it shows.

• You're genuinely curious about your tenants. You know what companies are in your building, what they're working on, what they care about. That knowledge makes your programming better and your relationships stickier.



NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather stay behind the scenes than be the face of a program. This role requires daily visibility and genuine warmth in person.

• You find the detail work (signage, supply checks, survey follow-up) more frustrating than fulfilling.

• Predictable routines appeal to you more than dynamic, fast-moving days.

• People management (coaching, feedback, performance conversations) feels like a distraction from your real work. Here, it is part of your real work.

• You don't see community programming as central to building value. Here, it's one of the primary drivers of tenant retention.



WHAT YOU OWN

Community programming and building communications:

• Design and execute a dynamic calendar of tenant events focused on values that build community and engagement.

• Manage all aspects of community events including budgeting, vendor management, onsite execution, and reporting.

• Manage event marketing including updating the tenant app, digital and physical signage, and the building newsletter.

• Own the tenant experience app: content creation, audience management, timely building notices, adoption strategy, and negotiating local perks and partnerships.



Amenity management:

• Oversee ordering, restocking, receiving, and inventory of amenity supplies.

• Keep all amenity spaces spotless at all times.

• Document and escalate maintenance and facilities issues through proper channels.

• Maintain clean, organized supply closets.

• Support leasing teams in showcasing building amenities.



Tenant relationships:

• Build strong bonds with occupiers so their days feel personalized and productive.

• Meet with tenant leads at least once a year.

• Build relationships proactively outside of common space interactions.

• Execute in-suite activations when appropriate.

• Own the tenant onboarding process so new occupants know what's available.

• Deliver on Surprise and Delight and monthly interaction standards.

• Deploy customer sentiment surveys and create action plans for any detractors.



Service culture:

• Champion Industrious service standards and hospitality principles.

• Model and deliver on any new hospitality standards.

• Communicate and resolve issues confidently, empathetically, and professionally.



WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE



We hire for skills over pedigree, but the strongest candidates will have:

• Experience. 5–7 years in community programming, hospitality, or tenant engagement.

• Community programming or hospitality experience. You've designed and delivered tenant or community programs at scale. You know what drives engagement and what doesn't.

• People leadership. You've managed at least one direct report: set goals, given feedback, and helped someone grow in their role.

• Communications fluency. You write clearly and on-brand. You've managed a content calendar, a newsletter, or a social/app presence in a professional context.

• Organizational discipline. You manage multiple programs simultaneously and don't let details fall through the cracks under pressure.

• Tenant relationship skills. You build trust quickly, follow through consistently, and know how to make people feel genuinely cared for.



COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $105,000 – $115,000, depending on experience.

You'll also be eligible for a 10% annual performance bonus.



Candidate Notice

Experience by Industrious is a CBRE business. These roles are employed by CBRE. We're posting here on the Industrious careers page to reach the right candidates, but your application will be reviewed by the Experience by Industrious hiring team at CBRE and any offer will come from CBRE.

By applying, you consent to your details being shared with CBRE for the purposes of this recruitment process should you be progressed beyond initial review.

jobs.title: Animator & Motion Graphics Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.




WHY THIS ROLE AT POSTHOG NOW?

We have a strong brand and a lot of strong content for you to build on. What we don't have (yet) is someone whose whole job is making it move.

You'll be PostHog's first in-house video animator, and the creative engine behind everything that moves in our visuals.

We take video seriously (although we’re not really so serious https://posthog.com/trash). Our Video team ships documentaries, product launches, ads, social shorts, and more.

Right now, there’s no single owner of motion at PostHog, so the effort comes from several people, each with their own style, and most animation gets added at the very end of post-production. It doesn't move like one brand.

Your job will be to give it one. You'll be the creative engine behind PostHog's animated visuals. Your fingerprints will be on how PostHog moves, everywhere, but primarily in video.

This isn't a pure motion graphics role. We need someone who can also draw. You'll eventually design and illustrate your own assets as well as animate them, and sometimes you might even ship illustrations that never move at all.

Simply put, you care about the craft, have opinions about what makes animation great, and have a showreel that proves it.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

The work spans product launches, feature trailers, changelogs, social shorts, minidocs, animated ads, GIFs on our website, and even icons inside the PostHog app. One day you might be working out how the hedgehog walks; the next, rebuilding our UI in 3D for a launch.

Styles range from clean motion graphics to fully illustrated, character-led animation. If your showreel only has one style in it, this probably isn't the role for you.

We expect you to be:

 - Defining how PostHog moves. You'll shape our motion and animation language more or less from scratch, and you'll bring strong opinions about it to the table.

 - Bringing the hedgehog to life. Our beloved mascot is a 2D, static hedgehog. You'll illustrate and animate it, and work out how it walks, reacts, and shows its personality in motion.

 - Being the go-to person for motion in video. Documentaries, product launches, screen-recorded tutorials, changelogs, social short-form. Sometimes you'll work hand in hand with Alex https://posthog.com/community/profiles/33708 (Video Producer) and Lottie https://posthog.com/community/profiles/27881 (Graphics Lead); other times you'll take an animation-only piece from idea and script all the way to delivery on your own.

 - Making our product look good in motion. Recreating and reimagining the PostHog UI in 3D space for "screenshare-plus" visuals, and animating icons that live inside the app itself.

 - Building the toolkit. Animated logos, brand elements, lower thirds, transitions, and motion templates that make every future video faster to produce.

 - Working beyond video. Motion for ads and campaigns, GIFs and animated icons for the website, and pure illustration work alongside our Graphics team.


EXAMPLE PUBLIC PROJECTS

 - PopQuiz https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QeU5MmpqBg0

 - Changelog https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GkiiahgoLCU (in different styles https://youtu.be/e_SICQg2Wak)

 - Hackathon documentary https://youtu.be/dGaSxBs3OsU

 - Small Teams https://youtu.be/clHDEg9xsvg

 - PostHog in Slack https://youtu.be/SaVTePqaPeM

 - Eggplant animation https://youtube.com/shorts/l-C-FmjHBQk?feature=share




WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

❌ Executing someone else's storyboard frame by frame. You'll get briefs, not blueprints, and we'll expect you to have ideas of your own.

❌ Cutting full videos. We have editors for that. Knowing your way around an edit helps, but it isn't the job.

❌ Picking one house style and never leaving it.

❌ Making corporate explainers where a flat-shaded person waves at a laptop.




YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF:

 - You’re advanced in After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Fresco is a bonus.

 - You have a strong portfolio demonstrating technical excellence, a clear creative point of view, and a wide variety of styles (motion graphics, illustration-led animation, character work).

 - You have illustrated / designed and animated motion graphics. You design and draw your own assets rather than only waiting for someone to hand you files to move.

 - You originate ideas. You've taken work from concept to delivery: come up with the idea, written the script or voiceover, then animated it.

 - You’re a highly creative artist with strong personal standards for quality. You care about the craft.

 - You have a strong opinion about what the best animated film of all time is, and are able to defend your decision to the death. (It's either The Incredibles or Coco.)


NICE TO HAVE

 - You have created content for developer communities or technical audiences.

 - Basic video editing. Enough to rough out how your animation sits in the cut.

 - You have translated product UI / UX into animated assets.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate!

#LI-DNI

jobs.title: QA Associate II
jobs.description:
The QA Associate II is responsible for ensuring the accurate, compliant, and timely release of Twist’s synthetic biology products, with a primary focus on batch record review, raw material and lot release, and quality event support. Working in an ISO 13485 manufacturing environment, this role partners closely with production, equipment, and subject matter experts to investigate quality events, support root cause analysis, and keep documentation and processes inspection-ready. A strong working knowledge of cGMP and IVD regulatory requirements, along with high attention to detail and clear communication, is critical to success in this role. This is a great opportunity for a quality professional who enjoys hands-on, on-site work and wants to grow their impact by mentoring peers and supporting internal and external audits.

Knowledge & Application

• Ensures the accurate and safe release of various synthetic biology products in accordance with company and/or client procedures and requirements.

• Ensures and promotes compliance with applicable ISO, cGMP, IVD Regulations, and company and client SOPs.

• Authors and reviews relevant SOPs, batch records, labels and other documents.

• Manufacturing Batch Record review, control, release, including label verification.

• Materials management (including Raw Material Release), nonconformance disposition and release activity as applicable.

• Collaborates with SMEs to investigate Quality event tickets and assign, approve, or follow up on approval and disposition of these events.

• Review and releases IQOQPQs through collaboration with the Equipment team.

• Support the tracking and trending relevant quality metrics as assigned.

• Support investigations, root cause analysis, and documentation of findings on Quality Events.

• Conduct lab walkthroughs on a periodic basis and report and follow up on findings.

• Effectively influences (by serving as a peer mentor) and trains employees on basic releases and processes.

• Supports internal and external audits via gathering and preparation of audit material.

• Support additional responsibilities as assigned.

• Ability to be on-site to inspect products/materials and release lots.

• Follow regulatory and ISO 13485 requirements.

Complexity & Problem Solving

Executes tasks/assignments that have clear and established processes and procedures. At times, tasks/assignments require occasional adaptation beyond established processes and procedures.

Collaboration & Interaction

Follows established procedures on routine work, receives instructions only on new assignments.

Typical Degree & Years of Experience

• Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in a scientific /engineering related field

• 2-3 years of experience in the medical device/pharmaceutical/biotech industry.

• Minimum 2 years of Quality Assurance or Regulatory Compliance (e.g. GCP, cGMP, GLP) experience.

• Experience working and/or supporting production/laboratories a plus.

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements for IVD Products, ISO 13485, 21CFR820, MDD, applicable experience in medical device, or biotech manufacturing and a thorough knowledge and understanding of cGMP.

• Familiarity with Confluence and JIRA applications desired.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally to achieve business outcomes.

jobs.title: Manager, Quality Management Systems
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Manager of Quality Management Systems to build, maintain, and improve our ISO 13485-certified QMS. In this role, you will own our internal and external audit program and our quality training program. You will keep the QMS compliant across all disciplines and support regulatory initiatives. You will also design and maintain quality programs that meet customer requirements for each product line. The ideal candidate brings deep ISO 13485 expertise, hands-on audit experience, and a strong understanding of the genomics or life sciences space.

What You’ll Do

• Implement and maintain QMS procedures that comply with ISO 13485:2016 and other applicable regulations, and support certification across product lines.

• Own the internal and external audit program. This includes setting the audit schedule, conducting audits, and identifying and resolving nonconformities.

• Manage the local and global audit team.

• Own the quality training program, including curriculum development, training assignments, and completion tracking across all disciplines.

• Lead Quality Assurance initiatives and projects focused on audit, training, and compliance.

• Oversee QMS compliance for all personnel and functions.

• Make sure supplier quality objectives are met.

• Support the product and software development lifecycles with appropriate design controls.

• Maintain monitoring and measurement systems and drive continuous improvement.

• Train and mentor QA team members on QMS principles, ISO 13485, and regulatory compliance.

• Stay current on industry trends and regulatory changes in genomics.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physical/Life Sciences, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

• 7+ years of experience in the medical device or biotechnology industry, with a strong focus on QMS and ISO 13485 compliance.

• Proven experience developing and implementing QMS procedures and conducting internal and external audits.

• Working knowledge of ISO 13485, genomics, and regulatory compliance.

• Hands-on experience with QMS management software.

• Experience with the product development lifecycle and product commercialization, including guiding large-scale programs toward commercialization goals.

• Strong supervisory, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and on a team in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience in the genomics industry.

• Experience with FDA regulations for medical devices and IVDs.

• Experience with EU IVDR.

• Experience with GMP requirements.

• Deep knowledge of risk management and design controls.

• Six Sigma or other quality improvement methodology experience.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals, and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Internal Communications
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Deepgram is scaling fast, and we're doing it as a fully remote, increasingly global company that is starting to build hub offices. As Deepgram grows, clear and effective internal communication becomes increasingly important to keeping our employees informed, connected, and aligned. This role will help ensure that employees understand what’s happening across the company, hear consistently from leadership, and have the context they need to stay connected to our mission, priorities, and each other.

The Senior Manager, Internal Communications will build and evolve the systems, channels, and communications practices that help Deepgram communicate effectively as we grow. This includes partnering with leadership and teams across the company to bring clarity to important company moments, strengthen connections across a distributed workforce, and create a consistent employee experience.

This is a highly cross functional, internal communications role at its core. As an early member of the Communications team, you'll also have the opportunity to contribute to adjacent areas where internal communications expertise is valuable, including executive communications, company narrative, major company moments, and employee advocacy. You'll report to the Head of Communications.




KEY GOALS

 - Keep employees informed and aligned: Develop clear, timely communications that help employees understand what is happening across Deepgram, why it matters, and how it connects to our company priorities and direction.

 - Strengthen connection across the company: Create effective ways for employees to hear from leadership, understand what is happening across the organization, and stay connected to the company and to one another as Deepgram grows and operates across locations and time zones.

 - Build a clear internal communications system: Establish thoughtful channels, cadences, and practices for how information is shared across the company, partnering with functional leaders in those areas, and ensuring employees know where to find information and what to pay attention to.

 - Partner with leadership on employee communications: Help the CEO and executive team communicate clearly and consistently with employees across all-hands, memos, Slack, and other channels, including helping draft and shape communications in their voice.

 - Organize communications for major company moments: Partner with the right people at the right time to ensure unique internal communications strategies exist for important company moments, ensuring employees receive clear, timely, and consistent information about the moments that matter.

 - Make the company narrative clear internally: Partner with the Chief Strategy Officer to help employees understand Deepgram’s mission, strategy, priorities, and company story, translating complex business and technical information into communications that are relevant and accessible to employees.

 - Partner with People on culture and employee experience: Work closely with the People team to develop effective ways to communicate and reinforce important culture and employee experience priorities, including the systems, channels, and moments that help employees understand and experience them consistently across the company.

 - Use data and technology to improve communications: Establish lightweight ways to understand whether communications are reaching employees and achieving their intended outcomes, and use AI and other tools to make the function increasingly effective and scalable.

 - Contribute to broader communications: Support executive communications, company narrative, employee advocacy, and other communications priorities where internal communications expertise is valuable.


MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, & CAPABILITIES

 - Deep internal communications experience: has owned internal comms at a fast-growing company, not just contributed to it

 - Has experience with, or has thought deeply about, keeping a remote or distributed workforce connected to the company's values and to each other

 - Earns the trust of executives: can write in their voice, help them sound consistent over time, push back with candor, and handle sensitive information with discretion

 - Thinks in systems: designs a communications architecture and cadence on purpose, rather than adding more things to an already crowded ecosystem

 - Operates AI-native: uses AI as the default way of drafting, editing, summarizing, and measuring comms, and is excited to build workflows and agents for leverage

 - Writes clearly and quickly across formats, from a CEO all-hands narrative to a crisp Slack announcement

 - Translates complex technical and business news into plain language that works for engineers, researchers, sellers, and operators alike

 - Uses data and feedback to show what's working and iterate, not just ship and move on


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE-TO-HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)

 - 5–8+ years in communications, most of it in internal or executive comms at a high-growth technology company

 - Experience at a fully remote or globally distributed company, ideally through a period of rapid headcount growth

 - Has communicated through major company moments, such as fundraises, launches, leadership changes, or reorgs

 - Has built an employee advocacy program or helped employees act as ambassadors for the company story

 - Experience at an AI, developer-first, or technical B2B company

 - Has built or owned an AI-powered comms workflow or tool, not just used AI tools occasionally

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Senior Software Quality Engineer

The Role

As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, you'll lead testing for complex, high-risk work and help teams find issues early. You'll strengthen test practices, support release readiness, and use customer insights and product health signals to guide improvements.

At Minitab, you'll do more than build software, you'll help transform the future of manufacturing. Every day, the world's leading manufacturers rely on Minitab to increase efficiency, improve quality, reduce waste, and make smarter, data-driven decisions that power better factories and better products. Our smart manufacturing platform connects data across the enterprise to uncover hidden capacity, eliminate bottlenecks, optimize machine performance, simulate improvements before implementation, and accelerate innovation through advanced analytics and experimental design. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with passionate, talented colleagues who are solving meaningful, real-world challenges for global industry leaders. With more than 250,000 users, 30,000 organizations, and 90% of the Fortune 100 trusting Minitab, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact while growing your career in a collaborative, innovative, and customer-focused environment where your ideas matter.

In this role, you will:

• Engage early in requirements and development to improve clarity, identify risks, and champion testability.

• Lead holistic test strategies across multiple components or integrations, including tests that require broad system understanding and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.



Bedrock Robotics, Inc. seeks a Hardware Engineer in San Francisco, CA responsible for designing, manufacturing, and testing its autonomous hardware systems, including high performance computer systems, sensors, controllers, interfaces to machines, and testing equipment.

This position will work with autonomous hardware systems installed on standard heavy construction machinery—excavators, bulldozers, and wheel loaders—to allow that equipment to perform earthmoving work on construction sites autonomously. In this context, “autonomous hardware systems” are the physical electronic components installed on a construction machine that allow it to operate without a human operator in the cab. They consist of: high-performance computer systems (ruggedized onboard computers mounted on the machine that perform the calculations required for autonomous operation); sensors (devices that allow the machine to perceive its surroundings, including cameras, radar, lidar, and GNSS); controllers and interfaces (electronic units that translate the computer's decisions into electrical signals that operate the machine's existing hydraulic, steering, and engine controls); and testing equipment (benches, fixtures, and instrumentation used to verify each of the above components before and after installation on a machine). Working together, these systems continuously collect sensor data, determine the machine's position and what is around it, calculate the path the machine should follow and the movements it should make, and then command the machine's controls to carry out those movements, performing the tasks a human operator would otherwise perform manually.

Specific duties include: (i) defining and designing hardware systems, including component-level architecture for autonomous machines and camera/optics design and performance; (ii) establishing and leading relationships and programs with external vendors to facilitate hardware manufacturing and delivery; (iii) supporting hardware system verification and validation, including working with safety teams to establish/tune requirements and performance metrics for components and systems; (iv) using industry standard tools and knowledge to test standards of hardware systems; and (v) writing reusable, high quality sensor data analysis and testing automation software.

This is a hybrid office-based/work-from-home position within the United States. The employee can work remotely from within the United States but must be able to work in the San Francisco office at least three (3) days per week.

Must have a bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a directly related field plus five (5) years of progressively responsible, post-baccalaureate experience in designing, integrating, and validating electrical hardware systems.

Must have any experience with: (i) high performance computer systems, including x86 or ARM; (ii) robotics sensors stacks, including lidar, radar, camera, or GNSS; (iii) communication protocols and technologies, including CAN, LIN, J1939, FlexRay, or Ethernet; (iv) python or C++/C/Rust; and (v) standardization tools and organizations, including ISO, SAE, and ANSI.

Must be willing and able to travel regionally/nationally up to 15%, to visit hardware testing sites.

Experience can be concurrent.

This position is expected to pay an annual salary of $236,000.

As part of site team, this position requires flexibility and a willingness to support activities across Logistics, Production, and Quality as needed.

jobs.title: Assistant Front Office Manager
jobs.description:
MISIÓN DEL PUESTO:

Asistir al Front Office Manager en la gestión operativa del departamento, garantizando el buen funcionamiento de los servicios de recepción, optimizando la experiencia del huésped y contribuyendo a la consecución de los objetivos del hotel en términos de calidad y rentabilidad. Además, deberá liderar, formar y motivar al equipo para mantener los más altos estándares de servicio.

En ausencia del Front Office Manager, asumirá la plena responsabilidad del departamento, asegurando la continuidad y excelencia en el servicio.

Responsabilidades y funciones:

Atención al Cliente y Calidad de Servicio

• Representar la imagen del hotel con profesionalismo, calidez y eficiencia en cada interacción con los huéspedes.
• Supervisar que todas las tareas orientadas a la comodidad y satisfacción de los huéspedes sean gestionadas con prioridad.
• Resolver incidencias y gestionar reclamaciones de manera proactiva y eficaz, asegurando la satisfacción del cliente.
• Mantenerse informado/a sobre la zona local (historia, lugares de interés, eventos especiales) para asesorar a los huéspedes.
• Garantizar la correcta gestión de llegadas y salidas, especialmente de huéspedes VIP.
• Supervisar y garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de la marca en la atención y el servicio.

Gestión Operativa y Coordinación Interdepartamental

• Asegurar la correcta coordinación entre recepción, housekeeping y otros departamentos para proporcionar una experiencia altamente satisfactoria al huésped.
• Controlar y supervisar los informes de auditoría nocturna, límites de crédito, deducciones y reembolsos.
• Apoyar en la gestión de facturación, caja y elaboración de informes de gestión.
• Controlar los procedimientos de comunicación dentro del equipo para garantizar eficiencia y claridad en la operativa diaria.
• Supervisar el control de costes y la gestión eficiente de los recursos del departamento.

Liderazgo y Desarrollo del Equipo

• Formar, motivar y desarrollar al equipo para alcanzar altos niveles de desempeño y compromiso.
• Implementar programas de formación continua y realizar evaluaciones de desempeño periódicas.
• Asegurar la correcta integración de los nuevos empleados en el departamento mediante procesos de inducción eficaces.
• Mantener reuniones regulares con el equipo para fomentar una comunicación abierta y efectiva.
• Desarrollar iniciativas para mejorar el ambiente laboral dentro del equipo.

Gestión Comercial y Rentabilidad

• Fomentar estrategias de upselling y maximización de ingresos en el departamento.
• Garantizar que el equipo tenga conocimiento de las tarifas, segmentos de clientes y promociones vigentes.
• Identificar oportunidades para mejorar la experiencia del huésped y generar ingresos adicionales.
• Analizar tendencias y reportar riesgos y oportunidades al Front Office Manager para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Recursos Humanos y Cumplimiento Normativo

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas laborales y procedimientos internos en el departamento.
• Gestionar incidencias de bajo rendimiento en coordinación con People & Culture.
• Supervisar el cumplimiento de horarios, vacaciones y control de absentismo.
• Garantizar que todo el personal del departamento asista a las formaciones obligatorias.

• Asumir la responsabilidad de garantizar que todas las tareas sean completadas con precisión y dentro de los plazos establecidos.

jobs.title: Temporary Part Time Floor Leader - Bellevue Square
jobs.description:
Position: Temporary Full Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 30-39 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Bellevue Square Pay

$24.20—$24.20 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in allyship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

jobs.title: Account Executive Director, Fintech
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Socure is seeking a high-performing Account Executive Director, Fintech to drive strategic growth across the fintech vertical, one of our highest-growth verticals. As an Account Executive, you’ll own a greenfield territory and lead high-impact sales efforts for our AI-powered identity and fraud solutions. This is a rare opportunity to help shape market adoption in a category-defining company.

 
 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Greenfield + Upsell:
   Lead growth across both greenfield opportunities and existing accounts, developing expansion strategies that deepen product adoption and maximize account value.

 - Lead Enterprise Sales:
   Manage full-cycle sales—from prospecting to close—targeting high-value SaaS deals with innovative, fast-growing companies.

 - Strategic Prospecting & Relationship Building:
   Build and maintain a robust pipeline through outbound efforts and executive-level engagement.

 - Consultative Selling:
   Align complex technical solutions with customer needs in fraud, analytics, and digital identity.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration:
   Work closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams to align on customer needs and influence the product roadmap.

 - Forecasting & Reporting:
   Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts and support strategic planning.

 - Industry Engagement:
   Represent Socure at industry events and deepen client relationships through in-person meetings as needed.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7–9+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with a consistent record of closing large, complex deals.

 - Experience selling identity verification, fraud prevention, or related risk management solutions.

jobs.title: DataOps Engineer
jobs.description:
The Wow

This role is dedicated to the operational maintenance, governance, and delivery lifecycle of data assets. Unlike infrastructure-focused roles, the DataOps Engineer is responsible for user access provisioning, data platform permission management, deployment releases of analytical pipelines, and service observability (monitoring/alerting) to guarantee data availability and compliance without managing foundational cloud or network architecture.

This role involves active monitoring, incident resolution, design incident prevention plan and engagement with data requests while continuously improving our data processes and systems, providing essential support that ensures optimal data quality.

A taster of what you will be involved with:

• Access & Provisioning: Manage and audit Service Accounts, AWS IAM policies for data pipelines, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) schemas and Role & Permission management on Snowflake.

• Release Management: Execute and automate deployment releases for data pipeline codebases, orchestration logic and database schemas.

• Application Observability: Configure, monitor, and optimize pipeline alerting thresholds in Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix to log task execution failures and data delivery delays.

• Application Orchestration: Manage workflows, task schedules, and environment permissions using Apache Airflow.

• Incident Prevention: Actively design and implement preventive operations strategies, analysing system trends, pipeline bottlenecks, and job failures to eliminate systemic risks before SLA breaches occur.

• Advanced Monitoring & Alerting Engineering: Formulate and maintain sophisticated observability patterns, building real-time dashboards and threshold-based notification alerts inside Coralogix to flag delays, capacity exhaustion, or anomalies.

• Data Integrity & First-Line Response: Perform root-cause analysis on runtime pipeline anomalies and complex data flow errors, collaborating across analytics engineering teams to design permanent, scalable operational remediation.

• Perform rigorous investigations into data quality, identifying discrepancies and implementing corrective actions in collaboration with other teams.

• Collaborate on data engineering initiatives, focusing on the enhancement of existing processes and the development of new solutions to improve overall data workflow.

• Engage in incident monitoring and resolution, escalating more complex issues to second line support as necessary.

• Resource Optimization: Monitor query runtimes and compute consumption metrics to identify underutilized resources, proposing optimizations to maintain technical excellence and cost-efficiency.

• Manage incidents and perform on-call duties on related Technologies required at the Role.

• Drive AI-powered innovation in Data Operations: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent agents and automation to streamline operations, accelerate incident investigations and improve platform reliability. Experiment with emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into practical, impactful solutions.

What we are looking for

Must haves:

• Good experience configuring security structures, service integration privileges, and RBAC governance within enterprise data layers (e.g., Snowflake and AWS IAM).

• Proven expertise managing, deploying workflows, and debugging task execution failures in Apache Airflow.

• Advanced skill in engineering cloud monitoring rules, logging metrics, and automated alert structures using Amazon CloudWatch and Coralogix.

• High proficiency in writing complex SQL queries for dataset analysis and metadata tracking.

• Strong scripting capability in Python or shell environments to automate operational checklists, administrative tasks, and compliance auditing.

Nice to have:

• Familiarity with broader modern data environments (AWS Glue, S3, Athena and Redshift).

• Exposure to data observability concepts and data contract mechanisms.

• Good Data Analysis experience to identify trends and track Data Quality issues.

• Excellent verbal and written English Communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-centric mindset; ability to build positive relationships with internal clients (data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders) and translate complex technical operation issues into clear, actionable updates.

• Strong self-learning mindset: a highly proactive professional driven to explore new technologies, documentation, and industry best practices independently to continuously evolve their skill set.

• Able to set priorities, anticipate risks, and multitask under pressure.

• Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing datasets.

• Experience with scripting languages to automate and streamline tasks.

• Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident resolution methodologies.

• Reliability and strong accountability in managing data operations and supporting team objectives.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with a strong attention to detail.

• Committed to maintaining high standards of data quality and integrity.

• Must hold a valid AWS Certification focused on Operations/Support (such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator)

• A valid Snowflake Certification (such as Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification) to demonstrate deeply validated platform and data governance knowledge.

What we offer

Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone!
