Founded in 1846, today HP Hood is one of the largest and most trusted food and beverage manufacturers in the United States. Our portfolio of national and super-regional brands and licensed products includes Hood, Heluva Good, Lactaid, Blue Diamond Almond Breeze, Planet Oat and more.

Job Summary:

The Loading Dock Worker position has a variety of different assignments which are assigned based on the training level of the employee and business needs in support of achieving the goals of the Concord, NH Warehouse. This job description is meant to serve as an outline of the duties and responsibilities that a Loading Dock Worker may be required to perform during the course of their work-day.

Hours: 5:30pm-2:00am.

Days off: Saturday and one rotating day off.

Essential Functions:

• Review load sheets for delivery routes and verify correct product(s) and amounts are loaded to assigned trailers.

• Rotate product in warehouse to ensure that the correct coded product is shipped to eliminate waste and minimize returns.

• Continuously check for and remove damaged goods to ensure that only quality product is being shipped to customers.

• Load each product according to assigned specification/diagram safely using a variety of motorized equipment such as pushers, squeeze trucks, fork trucks and pallet jacks. Ensure that the proper load bars are in place and the loads are evenly distributed.

• Send loads that are accurate while maintaining a pace that is efficient.

• Accurately identify, select/pick inventory for loading and staging based on customer load sheets. This process may involve “picking” corrugated and un-corrugated product (up to 45 lbs) from shelves, pushing/pulling of 7’ high cases of products (up to 200 lbs) and other packaged and un-packaged product. Process also includes placing products on wheeled racks 5 ½ feet high and moving throughout warehouse.

• Unload trucks/trailers using a hook or pallet jack. Physical labor involved in this activity varies, but can involve pushing/pulling 7 high milk cases (up to 200 lbs) and metal racks (800 lbs).

• Pull empty and full milk cases stacked 7 high (up to 200 lbs) with repetition.

• Manually remove product from conveyor system, then package and/or stage in an efficient manner to maintain production flow requirements.

• Dispose of returned product by manually dumping into disposal system using repetitive motion.

• Wash trailers/trucks after unloading empty cases.

• Work in a cooperative manner with managers, supervisors and peers.

General:

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures. Able to demonstrate knowledge of safety areas reviewed in the safety orientation program.

• Execute assigned duties with minimal supervision.

• Available for required overtime to support business needs and/or critical situations.

• Perform assigned duties satisfactorily and in a timely manner.

• Perform assigned duties following "Good Manufacturing Practices.”

• Actively participate in special teams representing the warehouse department.

• Maintain a clean & safe work environment.

• Perform all other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

• GED or High School Diploma preferred

• Reading & writing proficiency (English language) and ability to identify colors.

• Basic math skills.

• Ability to work well as part of a team.

• Good communication skills.

• Multi-tasked Individual.

• Ability to work independently with little supervision.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience and location.

$26.24—$28.66 USD

jobs.title: Associate Director, Paid Search
jobs.description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for an Associate Director, Paid Search: a senior performance leader who combines deep mastery of paid search advertising systems with strategic vision, team leadership, and executive-level client management. This is not just a tactical execution role; it demands the ability to architect full-funnel paid search strategies across Google, YouTube, Bing, App Install, and the emerging AI search ecosystem (including platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI, some of which don’t have ad services yet), lead a team of practitioners, and drive measurable revenue outcomes across a portfolio of high-growth brands.

The ideal candidate is obsessed with paid search advertising and is a recognized expert in search buying behavior, with a proven track record of selling products through paid search, scaling ad accounts well beyond $1M USD per month, building and mentoring high-performing teams, and serving as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders. You live and breathe ads manager, you’re curious about where AI search is heading, and you think in systems, not campaigns. You hold yourself accountable to the business outcomes that matter.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and serve as a senior leader within the Paid Media practice, owning the strategy, performance, and growth of a portfolio of key accounts. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative, Creator, Analytics, Brand, and Client Strategy teams, and will be responsible for developing the next generation of paid search talent at Darkroom.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

 - Own and drive the overarching paid search strategy across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands, ensuring alignment between media investment, search demand, creative output, and business objectives.

 - Serve as the point of contact for senior client stakeholders, presenting quarterly business reviews, growth roadmaps, and performance forecasts to CMOs and marketing leadership.

 - Partner with the Managing Director to define team OKRs, capacity planning, and service delivery standards across the Paid Search practice.

 - Champion Darkroom’s paid search point of view, staying ahead of auction dynamics, bidding and algorithm changes, and the evolution of AI search products to inform both client strategy and internal best practices.

 - Lead the development of annual and quarterly paid search plans, including budget allocation, channel mix across traditional search, YouTube, and AI search, keyword and audience strategy, and creative roadmaps.

 - Oversee campaign architecture, bidding strategy, optimization frameworks, and testing methodologies across key paid media accounts with aggregate monthly spends ranging from $500K to $5M+.

 - Drive best-in-class performance across Google, YouTube, Bing, App Install, and emerging AI search platforms (Koah, Kontext, and others as they launch ad products), with deep mastery of the paid search auction, bid systems, and market dynamics to convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

 - Set the standard for real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions in response to up-or-down trends on ad platforms, staying close enough to the accounts to lead by example.

 - Pioneer innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search, piloting new platforms as AI search products evolve.

 - Establish and enforce rigorous KPI frameworks (CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM), ensuring data-driven decision-making at every level.

 - Architect and pressure-test attribution models in partnership with Analytics, using platform ad managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to give clients a clear and accurate view of cross-channel performance.

 - Proactively identify growth opportunities through brand and website audits, competitive intelligence, and new acquisition audience targeting, translating insights into actionable channel strategies.

 - Ensure new customer acquisition stays healthy within the broader e-commerce equation, owning the full funnel from offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

 - Develop quarterly strategies and forecasts based on success metrics, ad spend, YoY performance, and projections that ladder into each client’s broader growth plan.

 - Serve as the senior creative strategist on accounts, guiding clients and internal creative teams on ad copy, landing page alignment, short-form video creative for YouTube, and creative testing frameworks.

 - Manage, coach, and develop a team of Paid Search Managers and Specialists, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of accountability and craft.

 - Conduct structured performance reviews and build individualized growth plans for direct reports.

 - Establish internal quality standards for campaign builds, reporting, and client deliverables, and ensure consistent adherence across the team.

 - Act as an escalation point for complex performance challenges and client issues, providing senior-level guidance and resolution.

What you’ll need to be successful:

 - 7+ years of paid media advertising experience, with at least 5+ years specializing in Paid Search and Google in particular.

 - 5+ years managing paid search advertising for high-growth consumer brands with aggregate monthly spends of $1M+ across a portfolio.

 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing a team of 3+ paid media practitioners in a fast-paced agency or in-house environment.

 - Proven track record of scaling Google ad accounts beyond $1M USD/month while maintaining or improving efficiency metrics.

 - Executive-level client management skills: ability to build trust with CMOs and senior marketing leaders, present strategic recommendations with confidence, and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

 - Expert-level command of Google Ads and deep familiarity with YouTube, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), and the emerging AI search ad ecosystem.

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Infrastructure
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

CoreWeave's Global Tax team is an AI native tax team; we are builders at our core. The team supports one of the fastest-scaling infrastructure footprints in the AI industry. We manage tax across roughly 50 data center sites in the United States and an asset base of approximately $22 billion of equipment, hardware, and GPUs — a base that is forecast to more than double again over the next two years. Our Indirect Tax function owns sales and use tax, property tax, business licenses, gross receipts taxes, and the exemption and incentive strategies that make a buildout of this scale economical.

Key Responsibilities:
This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own the direct and indirect taxation of fixed assets at a company adding sites faster than most operators add racks. You are a builder and will bring a forward thinking mindset on how to incorporate AI into everyday tasks to improve and develop the workflows that you own. You will run the US property tax cycle, maintain the tax fixed asset data that drives depreciation and property tax reporting, and be the day-to-day point of contact for our outside property tax advisors. You will support the self-development buildout on construction-period questions and equipment exemptions, and work with Direct Tax on the depreciation inputs that flow into the provision and tax return. There is a clear path here to owning the function outright as the footprint grows.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Global Tax & Innovation, the Manager, Tax Infrastructure will manage the tax reporting and compliance obligations attached to CoreWeave's physical asset base — property tax, tax fixed asset data, and the exemption positions that follow equipment from purchase order through placed-in-service. This role sits at the seam between direct and indirect tax, and partners closely with Tax Operations, Accounting Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Data Center Construction.

In this role, you will:

• Manage the US property tax compliance cycle — filings, assessment review, bill processing, payment approval, accruals, and appeal support — across a rapidly expanding set of sites and taxing jurisdictions.

• Maintain the tax fixed asset data set: reconcile it to the NetSuite asset register and the capital forecast, resolve asset classification and location discrepancies, and prepare the data that supports tax depreciation and property tax reporting.

• Work side by side with Accounting Operations to build a deep working understanding of the fixed asset lifecycle — from purchase order and receipt, through construction-in-progress, capitalization and in-service dating, to inter-site transfers, disposals and retirements — and know what each stage means for property tax reporting and tax depreciation.

• Prepare and update the property tax forecast each quarter, including identifying new locations against each lien date and reflecting construction-in-progress and inventory positions.

• Manage property tax audits and assessment appeals day to day: assemble the asset records auditors request, prepare the valuation and classification support, and act as a direct point of contact for assessors and auditors rather than routing everything through an advisor.

• Serve as the day-to-day contact for outside property tax advisors: manage the calendar, supply clean reconciled data rather than raw extracts, review deliverables, and track fees against scope so advisor spend grows more slowly than the asset base.

• Support Supply Chain, Procurement, and Logistics on the tax consequences of asset movement — receipt location versus use location, third-party logistics receiving models, and exemption certificate and direct pay permit administration.

• Support Data Center Construction and Site Development on self-developed sites, including construction-period questions, sales and use tax on construction inputs versus operating equipment, and construction pay application review — building direct working relationships with those teams rather than working through intermediaries.

• Partner with Direct Tax to deliver fixed asset inputs needed for determination of depreciation methods analysis, placed-in-service determinations, and tax reporting.

• Track capital investment and abatement commitments tied to incentive agreements and prepare the supporting documentation.

• Document and improve the processes and controls behind all of the above so they scale with capital expenditure volume.

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of progressive tax experience, including time in-house or in a service capacity for capital-intensive businesses — data center, cloud, telecommunications, energy, manufacturing, or real estate.

• Hands-on experience preparing or managing US property tax compliance, including real and personal property filings, assessment review, and accrual support.

• Direct experience working in a tax fixed asset register — reconciling asset data, resolving classification and location issues, and producing depreciation reporting from it.

• Working knowledge of federal tax depreciation mechanics, including MACRS, bonus depreciation, and placed-in-service determinations.

• Experience applying sales and use tax to capital equipment, including exemption certificate management and equipment taxability analysis.

• Experience working directly with Accounting Operations and with Supply Chain or Procurement — you can trace an asset from purchase order to receipt to capitalization to return.

• Proficiency with ERP and fixed asset systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle Fixed Assets, or comparable) and advanced Excel; comfort working with large data sets.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred:

• Progress toward or completion of a CPA or CMI (Property Tax) designation.

• Data center construction or development experience, including exposure to construction-in-progress and construction pay applications.

• Cost segregation experience, or experience supporting asset classification studies.

• Exposure to state and local incentives and abatement compliance reporting.

• Exposure to tax technology and automation and genuine interest in using AI tooling to compress compliance cycles.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $115,000 to $153,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Back End Software Engineer - C++ - Spain
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

The Routing team who work on the core logic of the network that decides on how packets traverse the network in the most optimal and resilient manner.  CloudVision is Arista’s enterprise network management and streaming telemetry SaaS offering, serving the world’s largest Financials, Media and Entertainment, Health Care, and Cloud companies. As we continue to scale the service and expand into new markets, we’re looking to grow the team with Software Engineers in our Dublin office.

What You'll Do

CloudVision’s core infrastructure is a scale-out distributed system providing real-time and historical access to the full network state, along with frameworks for building advanced analytics. It’s written in Go and leverages open source technologies like Hbase, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch, Kafka, Kubernetes, Ambassador and Zookeeper under the covers. We’re constantly investing in scaling out the platform and building out richer analytics capabilities in the infrastructure.

On top of this core platform we’re building device management and network analytics applications to fully automate today’s enterprise network, from CI/CD pipelines for network automation, to advanced analytics and remediation for network assurance.

As a backend software engineer at Arista, you own your project end to end. You and your project team will work with product management and customers to define the requirements and design the architecture. You’ll build the backend, write automated tests, and get it deployed into production via our CD pipeline.

#LI-EO1

• BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a relevant experience.
• 5+ years experience in one or more of the following languages; Go, C, C++.
• Experience with network monitoring, network protocols, distributed systems, machine learning or data analytics is a plus.

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Accounting & Finance Transformation
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are seeking a highly motivated and Senior Manager of Corporate Accounting to help drive the next phase of our accounting organization’s evolution. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, controls, and business transformation.

The ideal candidate combines deep accounting expertise with operational leadership capabilities and a passion for process improvement. This individual will help establish a scalable controls environment, lead reporting initiatives, and assist in developing the company's AI governance and controls framework.

Your Mission

Internal Controls & Risk Management

• Design, implement, and continuously improve a scalable internal controls framework across accounting and finance processes.

• Partner with process owners to identify control gaps, evaluate risks, and implement sustainable remediation plans.

• Support SOX readiness, compliance programs, and internal audit activities.

• Develop control documentation, narratives, risk assessments, and testing methodologies.

• Establish governance processes around emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

• Monitor evolving accounting standards and assess organizational impact.

Systems Implementation & Process Improvement

• Support finance transformation initiatives, including ERP, reporting, consolidation, and workflow automation projects.

• Serve as a key accounting stakeholder during system implementations and enhancements.

• Evaluate existing processes and recommend automation opportunities.

• Develop scalable accounting workflows that improve efficiency while maintaining control integrity.

• Assist in roadmap planning for finance technology investments.

Data Integrity & Governance

• Partner with Finance Systems, Business Systems, and Data teams to improve master data quality and governance.

• Support initiatives focused on financial data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

• Develop monitoring processes and controls around critical financial datasets.

• Assist in root-cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues impacting financial reporting.

AI Governance & Controls Framework

• Assist in establishing an AI Controls Center of Excellence within the finance organization.

• Develop policies, standards, and governance frameworks for AI-enabled accounting and finance processes.

• Design controls around AI-generated outputs, model monitoring, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

• Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, and Business Systems to develop an enterprise AI control environment.

• Evaluate opportunities to responsibly leverage AI to improve accounting operations and decision-making.

You Are/Have

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

• CPA required.

• 8+ years of progressive accounting, audit, financial reporting, or finance transformation experience.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, technical accounting, and financial reporting requirements.

• Experience designing and implementing internal controls.

• Proven project management and cross-functional leadership skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Extra Awesome

• Big 4 public accounting experience.

• Experience supporting M&A integrations and carve-outs.

• Experience with system implementations and finance transformation initiatives.

• Knowledge of SOX 404, COSO, and internal audit methodologies.

• Experience with Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or other enterprise financial systems.

• Exposure to AI governance, automation tools, or data governance programs.

Resources

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - US
jobs.description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!







💡YOUR MISSION: BUILD THE AGENT OPERATING SYSTEM FOR NURSES IN THE US

As Founding Product Manager, you’ll be our first product hire in the US and own what the US product is and how it scales. voize started as an AI voice scribe for nursing documentation and has grown into an intelligence operating layer that supports nurses and care leadership to improve care and outcomes. Today we’re live in 1 in 4 care homes in Germany, and with 5 pilots running in the US, your job is to turn them into a scaled business. You’ll report to the Head of Product, Markets, and work closely with our CEO and team in New York.




🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

 - Shape the business. Decide with the CEO and GTM what we sell, to whom, and what the product has to prove first.

 - Pioneer with nurses. Work alongside nurses onsite in hospitals and care homes. Learn from what carers do versus what the workflow says, and build a product they love.

 - Build, test, repeat. Turn our first pilots into evidence: where nurses use voize without being pushed, where they don’t, and why. Form hypotheses about what users need versus what they say and validate them in real workflows.

 - Ship what matters. Write sharp requirements, track honest metrics, and set up the data and feedback you need to make good calls.

 - Make the hard calls on complexity. Decide with Engineering and ML what is reusable platform and what is truly US-specific. Work through EHR integration and compliance trade-offs.
   
   


🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - You’ve shipped into high-stakes, complex regulated environments. Healthcare is the obvious case, but field service, logistics and similar count.

 - Systems thinking comes naturally, and you work fluently with engineers and ML as a peer. You’ve shipped agentic products and use agents in your own daily work.

 - You’re action oriented. You make strong bets with partial information and adapt quickly to new information.

 - You have strong product taste. You know how to be pragmatic, but hold a high bar for what you ship and where you want to go.
   
   


🎯 OUR SUCCESS MINDSET - HOW WE WORK AT VOIZE

 - Resilience is one of your strengths - you see challenges as opportunities, not obstacles

 - Iterative working suits you - you test, learn, and improve constantly instead of waiting for perfection

 - You value open communication and constructive feedback - and contribute to a positive team culture

 - Closeness to nurses sets voize apart - every PM spends regular time on site and builds with the people who use the product, so travel across the US is an essential part of the role.
   
   


🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

 - We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events from our New York Hub and the occasional travel to our Berlin HQ for product or org-wide events

 - We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

 - We work hybrid from our New York hub, with time in the office and flexible working hours.

 - 20 vacation days, 10 sick days, public holidays, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plan, short-term & long-term disability insurance and life insurance and 401(k) retirement plan
   
   

💰 Compensation: The base salary range for this role is USD$170,000-$200,000 based on experience and qualifications. Final offers may vary within this range and do not include equity or other benefits listed above.




✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀

We're looking for entrepreneurial product builders - perhaps hungry founders or engineers who've built before, or zero-to-one product managers who thrive in ambiguity. Your skills and experience will stand out & set you apart - especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.



You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!


We're excited to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building a modern, scalable Data as a Service (DaaS) platform that powers Intuitive’s Digital products and supports over 2,000 engineers across the organization. In this role, you will own and evolve critical components of our real-time and micro-batch data pipelines that power product development, internal tools, and analytics.

Your work will focus on enabling high-throughput, low-latency data delivery through streaming pipelines, dynamic transformations, and APIs, driving discoverability, accessibility, and actionable insights. You will help define the architecture and engineering practices that support self-service analytics and operational decision-making on scale.

As a catalyst for change, you will be at the forefront of reimagining how engineering teams consume and interact with data. Long-term success in this role means building robust, efficient systems and replacing legacy processes with modern solutions that allow teams to move faster, with greater confidence and autonomy.

Responsibilities:

• Design and build scalable, distributed Data as a Service that ingest, process, and serve data from robotics, manufacturing, engineering, and clinical sources in real time and batch modes.
• Develop and maintain robust APIs, data services, and tooling to provide internal teams with secure, efficient, and intuitive access to high-quality data.
• Partner with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to evolve data contracts and models that support emerging use cases and ensure semantic consistency.
• Implement CI/CD practices for data services, including automated testing for data quality, service reliability, and schema evolution.
• Championing a self-service data culture by building discoverable, well-documented data products and guiding teams toward empowered, autonomous data access.
• Act as a technical leader within the data domain driving best practices, mentoring teammates, and continuously improving how data is produced, shared, and consumed across the organization.

Qualifications:

Key Skills & Experience:

• Solid quantitative background in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or 3+ years of hands-on experience in a technically demanding role.
• Proficient in at least two major programming languages such as Python, Go, Scala, C++, or Java, with a strong understanding of software design and architecture.
• Proven experience building data pipelines and working with distributed systems using technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, and Airflow.
• Strong collaborator who actively contributes to code reviews, system design discussions, sprint planning, and KPI evaluations to drive team excellence and technical quality.
• Minimum a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.

Bonus Points:

• Experience working on Data Platform or Infrastructure Engineering teams.
• Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, and Terraform.
• Familiarity with CI/CD best practices for DataOps and deployment automation.

About the Data Services Team:

We are a rapidly growing organization made up of Software and Data Engineers, with a strong DevOps culture, focused on building a next-generation Data as a Service (DaaS) platform. We are seeking a strong technical lead who is passionate about designing scalable, real-time data systems that deliver high-quality, trusted data across the company.

Our platform leverages technologies such as Apache Kafka for real-time data ingestion, Apache Flink for stream processing and transformation, Snowflake for scalable warehousing, and AWS as our cloud backbone. We focus on serving data via APIs and event streams to enable on-demand access, analytics, and machine learning across product and engineering teams.

This is a newly formed group with a mandate to drive meaningful change by enabling fast, reliable, and consistent access to data. We aim to eliminate organizational silos and foster a strong culture of collaboration and ownership. If you see a high-leverage solution to a long-standing data problem, we support tearing down legacy systems and building the right solution provided you have a strong plan and the drive to make it happen.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

jobs.description:

We are looking to increase our network of Creative Directors working in our Broadway studio on project specific, temporary contracts. As a Creative Director in our team/s you will have direct experience on design-based projects and significant experience collaborating directly with Designers across specialisms. You will be able to work regularly within New York - we're unable to consider applications from those working remotely for this opportunity.

Required

• Previous experience leading creative visions

• Experience responding to client briefs and playing a key role in bringing ambitious design ideas to life

Desirable

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.

About the Role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to help scale a world-class, senior-heavy engineering organization working at the frontier of AI inference. You will lead a team of exceptional engineers across areas such as inference systems, performance, kernels, accelerators, and cloud infrastructure while creating the management capacity required for Inferact to keep growing quickly without sacrificing technical quality or execution speed.

This is a deeply technical management role. You will own team execution, hiring, coaching, prioritization, and operating rhythm, while staying close enough to the work to earn the trust of engineers solving hard systems problems. You will partner closely with engineering and company leadership to turn company priorities into clear technical direction, remove blockers, improve how the team works, and help every engineer do the highest-leverage work of their career.



Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, or similar.

 - Demonstrated experience managing strong software engineers in technically demanding systems, infrastructure, ML systems, distributed systems, or performance-oriented environments.

 - Strong technical credibility with the ability to understand architecture, ask useful questions, challenge assumptions, and help unblock senior engineers without becoming a bottleneck or overriding domain experts.

 - Experience owning the full people-management lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, feedback, performance management, career development, team health, and retention.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous company priorities into clear team goals, sequencing, ownership, and execution plans while maintaining urgency in a fast-changing startup environment.

 - Track record of building effective engineering operating rhythms around planning, decision-making, technical reviews, cross-team coordination, and accountability without creating unnecessary process.

 - Strong judgment about when to dive into a technical problem, when to delegate, and how to create leverage for senior engineers rather than competing with them for ownership.

 - 2+ years of management experience with 10+ reports.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience leading teams working on AI / ML infrastructure, model serving, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, compilers, performance engineering, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms.

 - Experience managing senior, staff, principal, research-adjacent, or PhD engineers in an environment where technical credibility and autonomy are especially important.

 - Experience scaling an engineering team through rapid hiring, including interviewer calibration, hiring decisions, onboarding systems, and thoughtful team design.

 - Familiarity with inference systems and adjacent technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, CUDA / Triton, Kubernetes, distributed serving, or accelerator infrastructure.

 - Experience partnering closely with founders or engineering executives in an early-stage company where priorities, team boundaries, and organizational needs evolve quickly.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Built or scaled a small, unusually high-talent engineering team where the technical surface area was specialized and the quality bar was extremely high.

 - Previously remained hands-on as an engineer or technical lead before moving into management and can still reason credibly about complex production systems.

 - Managed teams spanning multiple technical specialties, geographies, or time zones while preserving strong ownership and communication.

 - Helped establish engineering management practices from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature management system.

 - Contributed to open-source infrastructure, AI systems, developer tools, or technically ambitious products used by external engineers.

Logistics

 - Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California and is in-office.

 - Compensation: Depending on background, skills, and experience, the expected annual salary range for this position is $200,000 - $400,000 USD + equity.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
NetBox Labs seeks a Senior Product Designer to help shape the next generation of our platform. We are building products on top of the NetBox data model that help network teams put their data to work, from interactive maps of their network, to compliance on network intended design, to analytics and AI-driven workflows. This role will own design across these applications and how they connect to each other. You will partner with product managers and engineers on day-to-day delivery, and with design leadership on building a design culture and scaling how design works across the company.




WHO YOU ARE

Curiosity drives you. You want to understand how networks actually run and why operators work the way they do. You love rolling up your sleeves and are as happy sketching a flow, building a prototype or sitting in on a customer call. You are energized by complex technical landscapes, where dense data, expert users and messy real-world systems bring out your best work. You have a sharp eye for great design, care about craft and clarity and can explain why something works and how to make it better.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own end-to-end design for platform applications such as Analytics, Visual Explorer, Validation, orAI-driven workflows that customers use directly in the product.

 - Design how these applications interact with each other, NetBox, and our observability products.

 - Turn complex data sets, visualizations, and workflows into clear, usable interfaces for network engineers and architects.

 - Plan and run user research, both qualitative and quantitative, and bring customer insight back to product and engineering teams.

 - Prototype ideas quickly, whether with AI tools, in code, or in Figma, to test concepts with users and engineers.

 - Design in the open. Share work early, invite critique, and keep stakeholders aligned.

 - Contribute to our design system in Figma and partner with frontend engineers on the Storybook component library.

 - Shape how the design team uses AI in its process, and challenge how we work today.

 - Help improve how we use product analytics to inform design decisions.

 - Help define the long-term vision for the platform, exploring what comes next beyond your immediate product area.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 8+ years of product design experience, including enterprise-grade B2B software.

 - Experience designing for technical users, such as network, DevOps, security, or infrastructure engineers.

 - A track record of taking products from MVP to GA, including shaping the first release and carrying the design through to a launch-ready product.

 - Comfort with complex data sets, data visualization, and multi-step workflows.

 - Strong visual design and interaction design skills, shown in a portfolio.

 - Hands-on experience planning and running user research, and acting on what you learn.

 - Active, effective use of AI in your design work, with examples of how it has changed your process.

 - Prototyping skills in any form, from AI tools to code to Figma.

 - Experience working on a design team inside a scale-up, alongside other designers.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, and a habit of designing in the open.

 - Experience in improving how a team works, not just what it ships.

 - Able to work with significant overlap with US Eastern and UK hours.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience designing observability, monitoring, or compliance products.

 - Experience with network management or infrastructure software.

 - Experience using product analytics tools such as PostHog to inform design.

 - Familiarity with design systems built in Figma and Storybook.

Join NetBox Labs. Help design how network teams see, trust, and act on their data.


ABOUT NETBOX LABS:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.




OUR CULTURE AND VALUES: 

 - We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

 - Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

 - We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

 - Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.



NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Executive, AI-Led Managed Services
jobs.description:
Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads. We’re a small but rapidly growing company, which means there’s lots of room for growth and learning opportunities abound!

Apiphani is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all as a fundamental component of our business. Diversity and inclusion are the bedrock of creativity and innovation. Without diversity of experience and thought, we would fail to progress as a company and as a team. Apiphani strives to foster an environment of belonging, where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered.  We embrace the unique experiences, perspective, and cultural background, which only you can bring to the table.

Position Summary

The Territory Sales Executive is a quota-carrying, geographic-territory role responsible for driving new revenue across a defined regional territory of ICP-aligned target accounts within Apiphani's core vertical markets. This role owns the full account and opportunity lifecycle, from account planning through negotiation and close, across SAP consulting, migration, and Day 2/managed services engagements. The ideal candidate is a consultative, quota-proven seller who can efficiently cover a broad territory of accounts across multiple verticals and reposition legacy managed-services conversations as agentic AI-enabled transformation.

Requirements

• 5+ years of quota-carrying transformation and operations/Day 2/Managed Services sales experience

• Proven track record carrying a $3M quota, with demonstrated history of exceeding quota (top 10–20% of company) in prior roles

• Strong SAP domain expertise (both technical and relationships) in regulated industries such as Energy/Utilities, Oil & Gas, Transportation, Industrial Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense, Telecommunications, Pharmaceuticals

• Demonstrated ability to target, engage, and manage a geographic territory of ICP-aligned targets focused on our core vertical markets

• Proven track record identifying, engaging, sustaining, and closing large, complex annuity-based deals in excess of $3M TCV

Key Responsibilities

Revenue & Pipeline Ownership

• Drive new revenue at prospective and existing accounts within an assigned territory, selling across the SAP consulting, migration, and managed services marketplace

Positioning & Storytelling

Cross-Functional Collaboration

$160,000—$180,000 USD

Company Benefits*

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Browser Isolation
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX (US), Lisbon (Portugal), London (UK)

About the team

Cloudflare Browser Isolation runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.

You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.

Scope and growth

At this level, you will be accountable for outcomes across a problem area that may span several components. You will establish technical direction, make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit, and help other engineers succeed while remaining hands-on. This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.

Technologies we use

• Browser engine: Chromium and C++.

• Systems programming: Rust.

• Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.

• Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.

• Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.

What you will do

• Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.

• Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.

• Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.

• Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.

• Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.

• Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.

• Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.

• Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Strong production C++ proficiency, including memory and resource ownership, concurrency, and debugging in substantial codebases.

• A track record of independently leading complex systems or distributed-service improvements across multiple components, from an unclear problem to a reliable production outcome.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases Tempo | US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

We build Tempo, the open-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack.

2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI-driven assistants).

Over the next year, you will help us:

• Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes.

• Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction.

• Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on.

• Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30-day query ranges to match competitors.

• Prepare Tempo for an agent-driven world: larger, burstier, higher-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI-powered workflows, such as assistant-driven triage and “why is this slow?”- style investigations.

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team.

• Deliver significant technical projects. Take well-scoped, multi-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross-team direction.

• Own major components of Tempo. Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team.

• Build APIs for humans and agents. Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably.

• Contribute to operational excellence. Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts.

• Collaborate with Product and sibling teams. Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them.

• Mentor and support engineers. Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid-level engineers.

• Participate in on-call for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post-incident learning.

• Contribute to open source. Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the open.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Example problems you could work on

These are the kinds of projects landing in 2026:

• Trace aggregation and higher-density APIs: extend TraceQL metrics, design LLM-friendly response types, and make Tempo a first-class data source for Grafana’s AI assistant.

• Autoscaling end-to-end: customer limits and Tempo cells, with hysteresis, predictive scaling for spikes, and safe scale-down.

• Agent-scale ingestion and query: guardrails for bursty, high-cardinality, agent-generated workloads.

• Query performance: new data formats, smarter query pipelines, targeted optimizations for common Drilldown and Traces workflows, and 30-day query ranges.

• Rollouts and multi-cell operations: parameterized rollouts, push-button deploys, and the tooling to grow safely into triple-digit cell counts without a proportional increase in alert noise.

• Limits and self-service: drive customer-facing configuration and observability so escalations trend toward zero.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• Technical ownership. A track record of delivering complex, multi-month projects that spanned design, delivery, and operations, and of helping the teammates around you grow.

• Solid systems experience. Significant hands-on experience building and operating distributed data systems in production: ingestion pipelines, storage engines, query execution, or similar.

• Strong software craftsmanship. You write clean, robust, performant software that others can maintain, and you know when to optimize vs. when to ship.

• Strong Go, or a path to it. We write Tempo in Go. Solid experience in other systems languages (Rust, C, C++) translates well.

• Operational mindset. You’ve owned production services, carried a pager, reduced toil, and treated SLOs as a product feature, not a chore.

• Customer focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.

• Collaboration and clear writing. You contribute through design docs, reviews, and shipped code, and you communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

• Experience with tracing, OpenTelemetry, or large-scale observability systems.

• Experience designing query languages, SQL/TraceQL-like engines, or APIs intended to be consumed programmatically (by services or agents).

• Experience with columnar storage formats (e.g., Parquet) or purpose-built on-disk formats for analytical workloads.

• Experience operating multi-tenant, multi-cell SaaS infrastructure at scale on Kubernetes.

• Experience building for AI/LLM consumers: structured APIs, metadata/discovery endpoints, deterministic outputs, evaluation harnesses.

• Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.

• Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).

• Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

How we work

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our senior engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $154,445 - $185.334. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. jobs.title: MMS/RPG Engineer
jobs.description:
Specialization: IBM i / RPG  I  Location: Remote (US)

CapNexus is an AWS consulting partner specializing in AI and cloud engineering. We build and deliver software through agentic engineering: we build and operate the systems that produce code, direct AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and exercise the judgment that keeps AI-generated work correct. Everyone at CapNexus works fluently inside our delivery system, which combines agentic tooling, spec-driven development, evidence-based quality, and AI-augmented delivery governance.

Who You Are and What You'll Do:

CapNexus is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own complex software outcomes: designing and building applications, APIs, and services, and raising the bar for the engineers around you. You'll work through our agentic delivery system, where AI tooling carries the mechanical load and you own the architecture, the correctness of what ships, and the growth of the people you mentor. We care more about how you think about building systems than which language you learned first.

In this role, you'll focus on IBM i: building and supporting RPG applications, the DB2 for i data behind them, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the business.

Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain IBM i applications in free-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, and CL, using ILE concepts such as procedures, service programs, and modules.

• Work with DB2 for i through SQL and DDS, including physical and logical files and subfiles.

• Integrate IBM i applications with other systems through web services, JSON and XML, FTP, and the Integrated File System (IFS).

• Support changes through testing, deployment, and post-deployment, and resolve technical issues directly with client teams.

• Set coding and testing standards for IBM i work, and identify where modernizing an application pays off.

• Own the technical outcome for a system area or major feature set: propose the approach, define the task breakdown, and deliver with minimal escalation.

• Design APIs and data models that account for cost, scale, and failure, and build in observability (logging, tracing, and metrics) from the start.

• Work with Cloud Engineers on infrastructure as code and CI/CD so what you build deploys the same way every time.

• Partner with the Solutions Architect on solution design and with the Engagement Manager on delivery, and turn designs into a build plan the team can execute.

• Set code-quality standards for your area, and mentor Software Engineers I and II through pairing and reviews that teach, including how to direct AI tooling and check what it produces.

• Join architecture presentations and technical deep-dives alongside the Solutions Architect when the client needs your depth.

How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:

You own outcomes on complex work, exercise architectural judgment, and raise the bar for those around you.

• Agentic tooling. Set the tooling approach for a codebase or engagement: which work goes to a conversion engine, which is spec-driven build, where the human-in-the-loop gates belong, and how the toolchain is wired for the problem at hand.

• Spec validation and readiness. Own the quality of the handoff from specification to build. Make sure specs are executable and actually satisfy the requirements, and hold delivered work to a defined readiness bar. When generated code is wrong, fix the spec, not just the output.

• Validating AI output. Be the final judgment on correctness for high-risk changes, including in unfamiliar domains, by designing the evidence that proves behavior is preserved.

• Delivery-system ownership. Design and maintain the project-specific setup of our delivery tooling (steering, agent roles, templates, quality gates, and metrics) as durable capability, not one-off scaffolding.

Judgment over correctness: you can tell when confident, plausible-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• A strong grasp of architecture concepts: event-driven and service-based design, API design, data modeling, separation of concerns, and designing for change.

• Experience owning a significant system from design through production, and mentoring the engineers who built it with you.

• Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

• Hands-on experience with spec-driven or agentic development workflows, where specs drive code generation, for example Kiro, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or Cursor with rules. Using AI only for autocomplete or snippets doesn't count.

• A track record of catching what AI-generated or refactored code gets quietly wrong, and of building the tests and gates that prove behavior is preserved.

• Hands-on experience programming on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries): free-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, CL, and OS/400 commands.

• Strong SQL skills on DB2 for i, plus working knowledge of DDS, subfiles, and older RPG (RPG III and fixed format).

• Experience with IBM i Access Client Solutions or iSeries Navigator, the IFS, and JSON and XML. |

• Experience with Blue Yonder (JDA) MMS.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with AWS or application modernization, such as integrating IBM i applications with AWS services or moving IBM i workloads to modern platforms.

• Experience with Java, including Java on IBM i or RPG-to-Java modernization.

• Experience supporting IBM i in an enterprise data center.

• Background in retail.

Our Culture:

Four keystones guide how we work:

• Customer obsessed, delivery focused. We deliver what we promise. Trust = consistency × time.

• Learning and sharing. We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing.

• Growth and scalability. We value cross-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones.

• All work is strategic. Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts.

We offer:

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more

CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you.

No Agencies Please!
