jobs.title: Infrastructure Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, Texas

About Us

At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us!

About the team

You will be part of the Strategy  Data and Analytics team within Cloudflare’s Infrastructure Strategy department. The Strategy team focuses on building both external and internal relationships that allow for Cloudflare to scale and reach user populations around the world. Our group takes a long term and technical approach to forging mutually beneficial and sustainable relationships with all of our network partners. This team in particular is focused on Cloudflare’s infrastructure budget, strategy, investment plan,  and costs.

About the role

We are looking for an early-career Infrastructure Business Operations Associate to work directly with Cloudflare's Infrastructure Strategy organization. You will help turn complex infrastructure questions into clear analyses, recommendations, and repeatable operating processes. Your work will span capacity and supply planning, infrastructure budgets, procurement, deployment, product and deal economics, and cost management, connecting demand assumptions and investment decisions to execution.

You will be successful in this role if you bring a structured approach while remaining practical and hands-on. You should be comfortable working through ambiguity, reconciling imperfect data, asking thoughtful questions, and communicating a concise answer. You do not need to arrive as an infrastructure expert; curiosity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn quickly matter more.

What you'll do

• Build and maintain analyses for infrastructure budgets, forecasts, actuals, commitments, and variances.

• Support capacity, supply, and investment decisions with scenario models, unit economics, sensitivity analysis, and clear trade-offs.

• Analyze product and deal economics, including cost-to-serve, pricing scenarios, contribution margin, and the operational drivers behind profitability.

• Partner with Product, Finance, and commercial teams to evaluate strategic opportunities and explain how demand, architecture, hardware, capacity, and contract assumptions affect deal margins.

• Track major investments from demand and approval through procurement, manufacturing, deployment, and invoicing; identify gaps, risks, and required follow-ups.

• Turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into structured workplans, gather evidence across systems and teams, and develop decision-ready recommendations.

• Prepare concise executive materials, operating reviews, and written updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and what decision is needed.

• Partner with Finance, Supply Planning, Engineering, Procurement, and operations teams to reconcile data, clarify ownership, and keep work moving.

• Improve recurring workflows using spreadsheets, SQL, AI tools, lightweight automation, and clear documentation; help maintain trusted data and controls.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Approximately 2-4 years of experience in management consulting, business operations, strategic finance, analytics, supply chain, or another quantitatively rigorous role.

• Strong structured problem-solving skills: you can break an unclear question into testable components, identify the important drivers, and synthesize a practical answer.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, product economics, deal modeling, cost allocation, pricing, or margin analysis.

• Comfort working with quantitative data in spreadsheets; experience with SQL, data visualization, or financial and operational modeling is helpful, or you are motivated to learn.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn detailed analysis into concise materials for executive audiences.

• Strong project-management habits, attention to detail, and the persistence to follow issues across multiple teams and systems to resolution.

• Curiosity about internet infrastructure, hardware, AI Infrastructure, capacity planning, and economics; prior infrastructure experience is welcome but not required.

• A practical approach to AI and automation: you use tools to move faster while validating outputs and maintaining sound judgment.

Bonus Points

• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Office Practice Leader II
jobs.description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your role is focused on providing strategic leadership, specifically, developing and leading a high-performance, diverse, and inclusive, leadership team for the Arlington/DC and Baltimore offices  of CannonDesign to achieve growth and outstanding top line results. You will develop and implement a business plan for your office(s) in context with a firm-wide blueprint for developing a network of highly integrated offices that enhance our SFMO (Single-Firm, Multi-Office) culture and grow the firm. Importantly, you will be a leading ambassador of our brand, responsible for demonstrating how our Living-Centered Design ethos comes to life in our culture and in the way we partner with clients.

In this role you will focus the majority of your time on strategy development and execution, and on activities that support the growth and impact of the office(s), including external brand opportunities. You will also be expected to spend time, at a high level, on client leadership opportunities engaged directly on projects.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO

Expectations of success.

• Office Growth: Providing leadership, guidance and support to Office and Market Leaders in the development of new business opportunities with client partners to achieve top line targets, which will support a minimum 10% growth of the office year over year. You will be accountable for the growth and success of the office.

• Strategic Leadership: Leading strategy development and execution. Engaging and partnering with all staff levels in the office and the firm to advance entrepreneurial opportunities, innovative market solutions, and impactful design solutions that differentiate the firm and create opportunities for increased market presence and office growth.

• Market Brand Enhancement: Acting as a leading voice for the office within the Community and Marketplace. Advancing a strategic plan that engages other office leadership in activities that promote and elevate the brand of the office and the firm. Championing Living-Centered Design and bringing our firm’s purpose—to help people continuously flourish—to life in every touchpoint you have with employees, clients and the community.

• Design Culture: Together with Design Leadership be a leading voice in the office for fostering a design-focused culture, understanding, and advocating for the power and impact of a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and integrated response to the opportunities presented by our clients. Empowering our people to realize the importance of design in all that we do and championing innovation in client and team approach.

Areas of Focus

• Business Plan Leadership: Responsible for the leadership and implementation of a yearly strategic business plan for your office, including key strategies for future top line development, branding, and client engagement that advance the growth of the office. You will be responsible for engaging Office and Market Leaders to participate in the process, take ownership, communicate, and champion the initiatives set forth in the plan.

• Top Line Development: Partner with Market Leaders, Service Leaders, Business Development Leaders, Client Leaders, and others to grow the business volume of your office and the firm. Be agnostic to market and champion strategic client development and initiatives that differentiate CannonDesign in the marketplace, promoting the full range of our integrated design services and supporting the advancement of Living-Centered Design in all phases of client engagement. In this role you will be accountable for the overall top line results of the office and have a personal goal of achieving top line success of $3.0M per year in net signed fees.

• Client Leadership Development: Identify, assess, and evaluate Client Leaders and champion the implementation of our client engagement process. Work with the Director of BMBD and other Office and Market Leaders to provide mentorship and training to advance the best practices of client leadership.

• Practice and Market Building: Work with the Regional Director to evaluate and take appropriate action to address the senior talent needs in your office, focusing on building a strong leadership team capable of expanding our impact and growth potential. Work with other leadership to establish actions to implement the firm’s business plan to grow top line, optimize collaboration and integration, and expand our markets and services.

• Staff Development: Champion mentoring and the growth and development of our future leaders of CannonDesign. Work with Human Resources, Market and Office Leaders to identify, assess, mentor and coach the employees in your office. Champion employee engagement activities and own results.

• Adherence to Business Practices: Partner with the Regional Process Director and your office’s Business Practice Leader to champion the best practices of project management, risk management, process improvement, project leadership and office profitability.

• Communication: Represent office leadership and staff in firm-wide meetings, conferences, and events. Communicate outcomes, directions, initiatives, policies, etc. back to the office for implementation or information purposes. Develop and execute internal communication processes to keep staff informed and foster collaboration.

Time Commitments

• 45% of your time should be devoted to activities that advance our brand and develop new business opportunities with client partners focused on the growth of the office, the region, and the Firm.

• 30% of your time should be focused on engaging and partnering with clients on billable project work. As a senior leader of the firm, we expect you to not only find ways to grow top line revenue, but also to partner with clients at a high level. Providing leadership and fostering strong client relationships that lead to high client satisfaction and potential opportunities for future work.

• 15% of your time should be devoted to office leadership including strategy development, practice and market building, business practice support, recruiting and other related staff growth and development activities.

Key Characteristics and Competencies:

• Champions our Living-Centered Design ethos

• Champions an ethical culture

• Demonstrates ownership and accountability.

• Champions collaboration; shows fairness in actions and decisions putting the Firm first.

• Champions entrepreneurial behavior; is open to new ideas, innovative concepts and solutions.

• Demonstrates sound judgment.

• Demonstrates sound approach regarding risk management and mitigation.

• Communicates effectively; energizes, inspires, motivates, and develops high-performing accountable teams.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required. Master's preferred.

• Minimum of 20 years related experience with a proven track record of business development success and top line growth.

• Licensure preferred.

• Additional certifications and/or training relevant to this role is preferred.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Business acumen and proven ability to execute strategy.

• Professional acumen and maturity demonstrated by the ability to communicate authentically and respectfully.

• Some travel required.

The salary range for this position is $180,800 to $226,000 annually.  This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at https://www.cannondesign.com/careers/benefits. Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.

ABOUT OUR FIRM

CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. Als Buitendienst Medewerker Waterbemonstering in Amsterdam en omgeving bezoek je dagelijks klanten om watermonsters af te nemen en metingen uit te voeren. Met jouw werk lever je een directe bijdrage aan de kwaliteit en veiligheid van drink-, proces- en zwemwater.

Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder?

• Je werkt zelfstandig en bent dagelijks onderweg naar verschillende locaties in Amsterdam.
• Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor klanten en het visitekaartje van C-Mark.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Buitendienst Medewerker Waterbemonstering bezoek je klanten in Amsterdam en omgeving om watermonsters af te nemen van drinkwater-, proceswater- en zwemwaterinstallaties. Op locatie voer je metingen uit, zoals het controleren van de pH-waarde en het chloorgehalte. Je registreert de resultaten direct in een digitaal systeem via je smartphone en zorgt ervoor dat alle gegevens correct worden vastgelegd. Vervolgens verpak je de monsters volgens de richtlijnen, zodat deze veilig naar het laboratorium kunnen worden vervoerd voor analyse. Aan het einde van de dag lever je de monsters af bij het centrale verzamelpunt. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar bent onderdeel van een team dat samen zorgt voor betrouwbare resultaten en tevreden klanten.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

• Je bent in het bezit van rijbewijs B.
• Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar.
• Je werkt nauwkeurig en volgt procedures en richtlijnen zorgvuldig op.
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.
• Je beschikt over een VCA-Basis certificaat of bent bereid dit via ons te behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
• Salaris tussen €2.650,00 en €2.800,00 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
• 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra verlof te kopen.
• Een bedrijfsauto voor jouw werkzaamheden.
• Smartphone, werkkleding en alle benodigde materialen om je werk goed uit te voeren.
• Winstdeling, een individueel keuzebudget en een sportvergoeding.
• De mogelijkheid om feestdagen uit te ruilen voor dagen die jij belangrijk vindt.

Over Eurofins C-Mark

Eurofins C-Mark is onderdeel van Eurofins en gespecialiseerd in inspecties, wateronderzoek en bemonstering. Samen met collega's van Eurofins Food, Feed & Water werken we vanuit meerdere locaties in Nederland aan veilige leef- en werkomgevingen. We investeren in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers met trainingen, opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je krijgt veel vrijheid in je werkzaamheden en de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie.

Solliciteren

Is deze vacature iets voor jou? Stuur dan je cv naar ons op. Ook als je twijfelt of je helemaal past, kijken we graag samen naar jouw talent en mogelijkheden.

Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op via corporaterecruitment@ftbnl.eurofins.com. We vertellen je graag meer.

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
POWERING GREAT WORK

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone. Better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps, so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

Trust is at the heart of everything we do, and our Trust and Safety team plays a huge part in protecting it. As a Trust and Safety Specialist, you'll take ownership of more complex vetting cases, identify potential risks and help make sure the trades on our platform meet the standards homeowners expect. You'll also play a key role in supporting and developing the wider team, helping us continuously improve how we work.




THE JOB, UNFILTERED:

 - Own the complex stuff. Independently manage end-to-end vetting for new and existing trade members, with a particular focus on higher-risk categories and more complicated case histories.

 - Spot risks before they become problems. Monitor member activity, reviews, risk indicators and alerts to identify potential concerns and take appropriate action in line with our Trust and Safety policies.

 - Make the right calls. Assess information objectively, exercise sound judgement and escalate concerns when needed, including recommending suspension or removal from the platform.

 - Keep things clear and accurate. Maintain detailed, timely and well-structured case notes so decisions are easy to understand and colleagues can confidently pick up where you've left off.

 - Know how to communicate. Choose the most effective way to engage with members and stakeholders, whether that's over the phone, in writing or through internal channels.

 - Help others level up. Share your knowledge and coach junior colleagues across our UK and outsourced teams, helping improve quality and consistency.

 - Be a go-to expert. Work closely with teams including Legal, Finance and Revenue Operations, providing guidance on vetting processes and more complex cases.

 - Make things better. Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce inconsistencies and support changes that make our Trust and Safety function more effective.

 - Protect sensitive information. Handle personal and confidential data responsibly, ensuring we're maintaining the highest standards of care and compliance.
   
   


THE FIT:

 - Experience in vetting, compliance, risk, fraud prevention, Trust and Safety or a similar environment.

 - Strong attention to detail, with the ability to assess complex information and make accurate, well-reasoned decisions.

 - Confidence managing sensitive or high-risk cases independently, knowing when to escalate.

 - Clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal.

 - Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities without compromising quality.

 - A collaborative mindset and the confidence to share knowledge and support colleagues.

 - Good IT skills and confidence working across different systems and tools.

 - A genuine commitment to protecting customers, maintaining standards and doing the right thing.

 - Experience working in a marketplace, membership-based business or regulated environment.

 - Previous experience coaching, mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.

 - Experience identifying process improvements or helping implement operational changes.

 - Familiarity with risk monitoring, background checks or member verification processes.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)




WHAT YOU GET

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more




HOW THIS GOES

We'll share more about the interview stages and what to expect as you progress, so you'll always know what's coming next.



Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkatrade/form/register-interest and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America’s healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com http://www.ShiftKey.com.

 

The role

We’re a healthcare technology company with two products: a SaaS platform and a two-sided marketplace. Both operate under strict regulatory requirements. This role focuses on the SaaS product, the one our customers depend on to run their day. When it’s down, they feel it.

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll set technical direction for the infrastructure and core systems behind that product and own the results: availability, stability, and the ability to scale. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership, architects, and operations, serve as the go-to expert across our multi-cloud environment, and raise the operational standard for the engineering organization. That means giving architectural guidance on enterprise infrastructure, evaluating new technologies before we adopt them, and defining the practices other teams follow.

Where you’ll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

 

What you’ll be doing

 - Automate complex infrastructure changes using code-driven provisioning and scripting to keep our cloud environments scalable and resilient.

 - Provide architectural guidance across more than one major public cloud provider, enforce architectural boundaries and approval gates, and lead technical evaluations and proofs-of-concept.

 - Deploy, manage, and optimize production container orchestration clusters on managed cloud services, along with GitOps-style continuous delivery.

 - Own observability across all system components: metrics, dashboards, and proactive alerting. Participate in our company-wide incident response and on-call rotation.

 - Develop, document, and routinely test disaster recovery plans and business continuity procedures.

 - Track cloud spend, set up anomaly detection, automate scaling, and propose architectural changes that reduce cost.

 - Guide cross-functional teams through complex implementation challenges and mentor engineers on infrastructure best practices.

 - Develop technical solutions and operational processes that make engineering teams more effective.
   
    

What you’ll need

 - 8+ years across DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including at least 3 in a dedicated DevOps/SRE role.

 - Production experience operating managed Kubernetes on at least two major cloud providers, with an architecture-level understanding of how those platforms differ.

 - Demonstrated experience managing live production infrastructure through declarative infrastructure-as-code, including remote state management and reusable, modular design.

 - Hands-on experience with GitOps delivery tooling, metrics and dashboarding stacks, and automation in a scripting language.

 - A track record of defining technical roadmaps for multi-phase initiatives and executing major platform migrations or infrastructure rollouts.

 - Experience on on-call rotations, leading incident resolution, and applying cloud cost optimization.
   
    

Perks of working for ShiftKey

 - Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.

 - Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.

 - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.

 - Benefits begin on your first day.

 - Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.

 - 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.

 - Paid parental leave.

 - Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

#LI-Remote

 

Our Commitment to Diversity

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive. 



EEO Statement

ShiftKey does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.  ShiftKey is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with a mental or physical disability, please contact: accommodations@shiftkey.com

jobs.title: PHP Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a Mid level PHP Engineer to join our US Loans team!

Our engineering organisation is home to over 200 talented engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines.

You'll be working on a new product we're building within our existing US Loans team. It's built on our established lending platform and codebase, so you'll help shape something new while working alongside experienced engineers who know the domain and the systems well.

You'll have the opportunity to work on everything from building and integrating new APIs to enhance the customer journey, to optimising our lending platforms, and engaging in deep architectural discussions. There's plenty to tackle, and we're excited to find the right people to take on the challenge.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

 - A strong, business-oriented engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must)

 - High degree of ownership and autonomy

 - A good understanding of a modern PHP framework like Symfony or Laravel

 - Strong automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional, Behat)

 - A keen desire to learn and contribute to a highly collaborative team

 - Experience with Domain Driven Design

Desirable

 - Experience working on financial systems

 - Experience with Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing




OUR TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

 - Backend: PHP 8, Symfony 7, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

 3. A live coding technical interview to discuss your coding exercise and dive deeper into your skills.

 4. A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.




LOCATION 

Please note we are only able to hire in the UK and select EU countries on a remote basis




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

jobs.title: Processing Supervisor - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Hours of work are Friday - Sunday 5:15 a.m. - 6:30 p.m. Supervises a team of Production Workers and their daily activities to ensure the needs of all functions within the area are met (production, training, safety, security and housekeeping).  Provides leadership/direction to the team and ensures that all the procedures for food safety and manufacturing high quality products are achieved.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The duties and responsibilities of this position shall consist of, but not be limited to, the following:

Personnel

• Ensure proper staffing is maintained, including interviewing and hiring new team members.
• Implement and monitor training for new hires & ongoing training of current team members.
• Maintain attendance records, counsel team members with poor attendance, & follow up with coaching/discipline as appropriate.
• Evaluate team member work performance, conduct appropriate reviews for team members, address complaints and resolve conflicts, reward or discipline accordingly. Provide input for termination decisions.
• Review, correct, and approve timekeeping tool to ensure team members are paid correctly each pay-period.

Safety

• Enforce all safety rules and company policies; provide appropriate interpretation of company policies and safety policies for team members.
• Immediately report all accidents and deficiencies to management; complete accident investigations and report within 24 hours of incident.
• Verify work and storage areas are maintained, safe, clean, and organized.
• Ensure safety devices are installed and working properly.
• Perform all duties within OSHA and company safety standards; Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO), wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintain safety equipment.
• Complete and review all Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP), and Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures (SSOP) requirements and paperwork. This includes but not limited to Pre-Operational Inspection, Operational Inspections, Pre-Shipment Review, and Corrective Actions.

Quality

• Ensure quality protocols are followed and openly communicated with QC and the Plant Manager in order to fix defects and ensure quality standards are consistently met.
• Maintains quality product by establishing and enforcing organization standards.
• Recommend methods to improve manufacturing processes including equipment performance to ensure product quality and increase efficiencies.
• Supports successful implementation of SQF (Safe Quality Foods) within the facility.
• Drive and support Continuous Improvement (CI) efforts.
• Understand the concepts of FIFO (First-In-First-Out) on perishable products and ensure successful implementation of FIFO throughout packaging operations within the facility.
• Ensure all required sanitation functions are within acceptable standards.

Productivity

• Monitor and track inedible, rework and down time generated by machine.
• Perform production paperwork, receiving, and inventory control procedures with complete accuracy.
• Identifies, through a proactive approach, potential cost-saving and efficiency gain opportunities to improve overall operations.
• Discuss work goals vs. actual output with team members to motivate and engage team members to assure targets are met.
• Identify, control and follow up on losses incurred due to substandard supplies, i.e., time and materials.
• Manage inventory and cost control.
• Implement and monitor weekly requisitions for daily supplies and manufacturing supplies.
• Conduct accurate weekly, period end, and year-end departmental inventories.
• Compile, store, and retrieve production data.

Leadership

• Provides direction to team members to ensure quality products and adherence to productivity goals and cost standards
• Demonstrate professionalism; encourage and insist on positive attitudes and behaviors from team members such as dependability, and trustworthiness in team members.
• Create and cultivate positive work relationships at all levels of the plant/organization.
• Build and support a culture of openness and accountability within (and outside) the assigned department.

Communication

• Communicate with peers, subordinates, and leaders in an effective, timely manner
• Keep Assistant Plant Manager & other leaders informed daily of problems incurred during shift.
• Confer with appropriate personnel to coordinate activities between departments.

Misc. Responsibilities

• Coordinate all functions related to the operations of all processing procedures, and specifications.
• Monitor product coding related to the lot traceability program and ensure its accuracy.
• Performs other duties and responsibilities as necessary.

Schedule

Monday-Thursday

2:30 pm - 1:00 am (hours may vary)

Required Education: High School Diploma or GED*

Required Experience: Minimum of 2 years’ experience in manufacturing and 1-3 years Lead experience

Preferred: 2 years of Supervisory experience, Leadership in food manufacturing industry.

*A high school diploma or GED is equivalent to two years of relevant experience

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE and ABILITIES:

• Able to supervise, instruct, and direct Team Members
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, set priorities, identify and address problems
• Able to organize and prioritize in a multi-tasking environment.
• Ability to communicate professionally with people both inside and outside the organization
• Knowledge of plant/distribution center models and production/logistics processes
• Superior accuracy and attention to detail.
• Planning Skill
• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Must possess math and mechanical aptitude

Solid verbal and written communication skills; must work effectively with all levels of management and employees

Must demonstrated effective leadership, problem solving, presentation, and employee motivational skills.

Proficient in Internet navigation, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

The salary range for this role is $65,000- $80,000 Annually. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear.  The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms.  The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:

Jack Link’s provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

E-VERIFY:

Jack Link’s is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees.  For information about the E-Verify program, please visit:  http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Compliance Core
jobs.description:
Compliance Core builds and operates the platform that customers rely on to evaluate blockchain risk in real time and continuously monitor activity across billions of transfers. Our systems screen transfers and withdrawals, reassess exposure as new information arrives, aggregate risk at the user and organization level, and power datasets used by other teams and customers.

As a Software Engineer II on Compliance Core, you’ll build and maintain the backend services and data processing systems behind these capabilities. You’ll work with engineers and Product partners to deliver customer features, improve performance and reliability, and modernize the platform through incremental changes and safe rollouts.

We’re looking for an engineer who takes ownership of scoped projects, enjoys solving distributed systems problems, and cares about the correctness and operational health of the software they ship. You’ll contribute to design decisions, learn from experienced teammates, and grow your impact as you develop expertise in our systems and the compliance domain.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL:

 - Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support transfer and withdrawal screening, continuous monitoring, and risk aggregation.

 - Develop event-driven data ingestion and processing systems that handle growing volumes of blockchain activity with a focus on correctness, throughput, and latency.

 - Own scoped features and improvements from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support, with guidance on broader architectural decisions.

 - Contribute to platform modernization by improving existing services and helping deliver incremental migrations with safe rollouts.

 - Work with Product and partner engineering teams to clarify requirements, discuss tradeoffs, and deliver changes that address customer needs.

 - Improve automated tests, monitoring, and documentation so the team can understand system behavior and detect problems early.

 - Participate in code reviews, debug production issues, and contribute to incident response and blameless postmortems that improve our systems.


WE’RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools to make the development process more efficient, grounded in strong engineering fundamentals, with examples of how you verified AI-generated output and improved the result.

 - Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, including APIs and database integrations.

 - Proficiency in an object-oriented programming language. We primarily use Java and welcome engineers with experience in other languages who are ready to learn.

 - Experience developing cloud-based services on AWS or another major cloud provider, and an understanding of microservices and distributed systems fundamentals.

 - Experience with SQL and relational databases, including designing data models and writing queries.

 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures or streaming applications, and an understanding of how failures, retries, and duplicate events affect data correctness.

 - A record of delivering well-tested code, diagnosing issues, and taking responsibility for the software they build.

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with engineering and Product partners.

 - Interest in blockchain and cryptocurrencies, or eagerness to learn. Prior blockchain experience is not required.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with Java and Spring, Kafka, or Apache Flink.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or production observability tools.

 - Experience improving or migrating production systems while maintaining service continuity.

 - Experience with customer-facing systems that have strict latency or availability requirements.

 - Background in compliance, payments, fraud, or another regulated domain.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Microsoft Product Partnership
jobs.description:
We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.

The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.

What you get to do in this role:

• Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.
• Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
• Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.
• Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.
• Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
• Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
• Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
• Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.
• Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.

To be successful in this role you have:

• Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
• 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
• Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
• Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
• Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
• Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
• Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
• Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.
• Ability to paint a compelling vision to inspire teams and senior stakeholders across a broad, evolving scope.
• Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
• Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
• Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Junior adviseur legionellapreventie
jobs.description:
Werk jij graag op locatie, denk je graag in oplossingen en heb je interesse in techniek en waterveiligheid? Als Junior Adviseur Legionellapreventie bij Eurofins C-Mark help je organisaties om drinkwaterinstallaties veilig te houden. Je inspecteert installaties, brengt risico's in kaart en adviseert klanten over verbeteringen. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid, goede begeleiding en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder?

• Je werkt op verschillende locaties en geen dag is hetzelfde.
• Je leert het vak in de praktijk, met begeleiding van ervaren collega's.
• Je draagt direct bij aan veilig drink- en proceswater voor organisaties in heel Nederland.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Adviseur Legionellapreventie bezoek je klanten op locatie om drinkwaterinstallaties te inspecteren en risicoanalyses uit te voeren. Je beoordeelt installaties met een technische en kritische blik en signaleert mogelijke risico's op het gebied van legionellapreventie. Vervolgens werk je jouw bevindingen uit in duidelijke rapportages en beheersplannen volgens de geldende richtlijnen.

Je hebt regelmatig contact met klanten, legt jouw bevindingen helder uit en denkt mee over passende oplossingen. jobs.title: Sr. Engineer, Silicon Development Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

We are looking for a senior engineer to improve the reliability, performance, and user experience of the high-performance computing infrastructure that supports silicon development.

This role sits at the intersection of EDA, distributed systems, CI/CD, and developer productivity. You will help engineering teams run simulations, verification, coverage, and other silicon-development workloads with fewer failures, shorter feedback cycles, and better operational visibility.

This role is hybrid, based out of Austin, TX.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

• Hold an advanced engineering degree (BS, MS, or PhD in EE, ECE, CS, or related field) paired with over seven years of hands-on industry experience.

• Bring expertise in Git branch strategies, merge conflict resolution, operational failure debugging, and software engineering repository management practices.

• Possess practical working knowledge of SQL databases, data query optimization, and modern structured data technologies.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to solve complex technical problems, enhance automated testing, and streamline debugging.

• A systems-oriented engineer driven to unblock technical teams, eliminate developer friction, and elevate overall productivity.

What We Need

• Design, build, and maintain reliable build, execution, and simulation flows for verification, functional safety, formal analysis, and EDA processes.

• Analyze system performance bottlenecks, workload patterns, and infrastructure execution to optimize throughput and reduce engineer wait times.

• Build resilient, monitored operational services with automated recovery, actionable diagnostics, and feedback loops for CI/CD and repository health.

• Develop AI-agent workflows, tools, and reusable skills that accelerate problem-solving and streamline software development and testing practices.

• Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to transform recurring hardware and software integration failures into durable system solutions.

What You Will Learn

• Hands-on experience developing infrastructure and automated workflows that support AI-assisted, autonomous engineering on production codebases.

• Opportunities to architect end-to-end infrastructure solutions targeting complex challenges in high-performance computing and semiconductor design.

• Practical expertise applying agentic AI frameworks directly to automated test staging, failure diagnosis, and production-grade engineering workflows.

• Comprehensive technical exposure to industrial EDA toolchains, verification methodology, and hardware execution flows for RISC-V cores.

• Deep proficiency across specialized industrial tools including Python, GitLab, Jenkins, Simscope, SQL, VCS, Cursor, Claude, LSF, Jasper, and Z01X.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Post-training (Data Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training Data Infrastructure, you will build and own the pipelines that produce the post-training data for our large language models (LLMs), from SFT and RL data to synthetic and human-annotated data. You will work closely with researchers and annotation teams so they can iterate on data as quickly as they iterate on models.

Key Responsibilities

 - Build and maintain data pipelines for SFT, preference, and RL post-training data.

 - Own dataset quality, versioning, and reproducibility.

 - Turn research data recipes into production-grade, reusable components.

 - Scale model inference for data generation and model-based grading.

 - Design data formats and schemas that keep post-training datasets consistent and efficient to train on.

 - Collaborate with researchers and engineers to make sure data pipelines keep pace with the needs of cutting-edge language models.
   
   

Qualifications

 - Strong software engineering skills.

 - Experience designing and building large-scale data pipelines for machine learning, ideally for LLM post-training.

 - Track record of running distributed data processing and model inference at scale.

 - Good understanding of post-training methods (e.g., SFT, RLHF, DPO) and how data shapes model behaviour.

 - Excellent communication skills.

This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to Cohere, please reach out. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives at Cohere

 







FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.title: Senior AI Researcher: LLM post-training for hallucination reduction (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Aleph Alpha’s mission is to deliver sovereign, human-centric AI to governmental institutions and large enterprises. To that end, we deliver category-defining AI innovation that enables open, accessible, and trustworthy deployment of GenAI in industrial applications. Our organization develops foundational models and next-generation methods that make it easy and affordable for Aleph Alpha’s customers to increase productivity in development, engineering, logistics, and manufacturing processes. 



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a (Senior) AI Researcher to join our hallucination reduction capability team to push the boundaries in LLM post-training (SFT and RL).

We're one of the few places in Europe training foundation models from scratch. You will be part of a team of (senior) researchers and PhD interns doing cutting-edge research across pre-, mid- and post-training, grounding and specialized models with hundreds of GPUs at our disposal.



WHAT WILL YOU DO

 - Core Research & Development: Design, execute, and scale post-training methodologies (SFT, RL) specifically aimed at eliminating model hallucinations and making them grounded in evidence.

 - Uncertainty & Reliability: Research and implement techniques in uncertainty estimation, calibration, self-consistency, and self-correction mechanisms to enable models to identify and signal when they “don't know”.

 - Post-Training Pipelines: Build and optimize high-throughput, distributed fine-tuning and training pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters.

 - Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design and implement rigorous evaluation methods to benchmark hallucination rates, truthfulness, and reasoning accuracy.

 - Technical Ownership: Drive research projects independently from initial hypothesis to scalable production implementation and technical reports.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on experience fine-tuning or post-training LLMs using modern distributed training frameworks.

 - Track record of research or implementation in at least one of the following domains:
   
   - Hallucination mitigation / truthfulness alignment / grounding in RAG
   
   - Uncertainty estimation, or out-of-distribution detection
   
   - Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluation / alignment, refusal behavior calibration, or claim verification

 - Strong programming skills (Python & PyTorch).
   
   


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Become part of an AI revolution!

 - 30 days of paid vacation

 - Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub https://wellhub.com/de-de/

 - Mental health support through nilo.health http://nilo.health

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Director
jobs.description:
Description

Win new enterprise logos for the leading Pentest as a Service platform. This is a hunter role: your primary mandate is opening and closing net-new accounts across US - North Central, with a secondary responsibility to expand within our install base. You will sell scoped, human-led pentesting to CISOs, AppSec leaders, and engineering buyers, backed by our vetted Cobalt Core community and a platform that gets customers testing in as little as 24 hours.

Your territory covers ND, SD, NE, KS, MN, IA, MO, MI, WI, IL, IN, OH, and KY, with anchor markets including Chicago, Minneapolis, Detroit, Columbus, Indianapolis, Kansas City, and St. Louis. You will own the full cycle, from territory planning and outbound prospecting through negotiation and close.

What You'll Do

New logo acquisition (primary focus)

• Build and run an outbound-led pipeline engine in your territory, combining targeted prospecting, executive outreach, events, and partner-sourced opportunities.

• Research target accounts to identify triggers (compliance deadlines, audits, M&A, new product launches, security leadership changes) and map buying centers across security, product, IT, and engineering.

• Multi-thread new accounts from first meeting to close, navigating procurement, legal, and security review in complex organizations.

• Run discovery that ties pentesting to business drivers such as SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, customer security questionnaires, and secure SDLC goals, then lead scoping conversations that convert to a first engagement.

• Negotiate and close enterprise agreements, structuring initial credit commitments that create a path to expansion.

• Meet prospects in person across the region (25% travel) to build trust and advance deals.

Expansion within the install base

• Partner with Customer Success to identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts: additional assets, new business units, and larger credit commitments.

• Drive renewals and upsell by connecting engagement results and finding trends to customer risk priorities.

Across the territory

• Build and execute territory and account plans that prioritize regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare, and insurance), as well as manufacturing and SaaS.

• Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Channel Partners to create value at every stage of the customer lifecycle.

• Forecast accurately and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.

You Must Have

• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience in SaaS or cybersecurity, with a proven new logo acquisition track record as the core of your background (required).

• Demonstrated success sourcing your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, not just working inbound or inherited accounts.

• A record of meeting or exceeding quota, with a majority of attainment from net-new business.

• Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with $100K+ ACVs and 90-180 day sales cycles.

• Experience selling to CISOs, AppSec leaders, or engineering buyers.

• Ability to expand and renew within an install base while keeping new logo as your priority.

• Residence within the territory (or willingness to be based there).

• Nice to have: experience selling pentesting, AppSec, or compliance-driven security (SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA).

How You Work

• Curious, accountable, and collaborative. You adopt tools like automation, AI, and data insights to sell more effectively, and you take ownership of your number.

Why You Should Join Us

• Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry

• Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities

• Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan

• Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)

• Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)

• Leverage stipends for:

• Wellness

• Work-from-home equipment & wifi

• Learning & development

• Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Commission is uncapped, with accelerators on new logo, plus equity.
