jobs.description:
POSITION: Fixed Term Contract (up to 2 years) - Full/Part Time (minimum of 30 hours per week required)

LOCATION: Fully remote, UK based

SALARY: Up to £28,000 per year

Fixed term contract - This is a 2 year fixed term opportunity created to support the delivery of a specific contract commitment. Any continuation beyond the initial fixed term period would be dependent on the ongoing requirement for the work associated with the contract.  We are unable to guarantee that the role will continue beyond the two year term.

United by our vision. Leading with empathy. Pioneers in curiosity.

Healios exists to bring exceptional healthcare to anyone, anytime, anywhere.  By digitising entire clinical pathways, we enable children, adults and their family members to receive and seamlessly transition between clinical services from the comfort of their home.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do as we strive to be the leading provider of neurodevelopmental and associated mental health services.  You can find out more about us by clicking here!

Healios is all about helping families feel better and that includes our own families too, which is why we embrace diversity in all its forms and offer unparalleled flexibility for our employees. For more information on what it’s like to be a Healios employee, and our hiring processes, take a look at our Notion page.

“Great minds don’t think alike”

From our talented tech teams to our standout clinical expertise, we’re bringing great minds together to build more accessible services.

As the Coordinator for our Needs-Led Pathway , you will play a pivotal role in our team, which we deliver in partnership with Sirona care & health for families across Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG). You’ll keep work flowing through the pathway: supporting families to complete their onboarding questionnaires and paperwork, answering their questions, coordinating their appointments, and linking them with their dedicated Care Navigator clinician.

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure every family has a positive, predictable and respectful experience of the clinical pathway – from their first contact with us through to their final ‘Moving Forward’ conversation – and of how the pathway connects with our Integrated Therapeutic Service (ITS) and our neurodevelopmental (ND) teams. The Needs-Led Pathway supports children and young people from early years up to 18, based on what they need rather than whether they have, or are waiting for, a diagnosis.

Working in a neuro-affirmative way

Many of the children, young people and parents you’ll speak to are neurodivergent. We work in a neuro-affirmative way: we see autism, ADHD and other neurodevelopmental differences as part of who someone is rather than problems to be fixed, and we adapt how we work instead of expecting families to adapt to us. You don’t need to be an expert on day one – we’ll train and support you – but you’ll need to share these values. In this role, they show up in small, practical ways every day:

• Telling families clearly what will happen next, when, and how long it will take – for many people, predictability is an access need rather than a preference

• Writing in plain, direct language, and following up phone or video conversations in writing so families have something to refer back to

• Asking families how they would like to be contacted, and respecting it – unexpected phone calls can be hard for some people

• Using the language families use about themselves and their children (for example “autistic” or “has autism”) and not correcting them

• Remembering that a parent or carer may be neurodivergent too, and that forms, deadlines and phone calls are harder for some families than others

• Not reading a missed deadline, a short reply or a difficult call as a lack of interest – and understanding distressed behaviour as communication

• Noticing and passing on what is going well for a child, not only what is difficult

What you’ll be doing

Coordinating the pathway

• Managing the flow of work through the pathway and its service lines, so that referrals from Sirona move promptly and no family gets stuck

• Booking and coordinating appointments, including Care Navigation Meetings, Core Needs Assessments, Single Session Consultations, four-weekly check-ins and Moving Forward appointments

• Linking families with their dedicated Care Navigator clinician, and passing on what families have already told us so they don’t have to repeat their story

• Sending questionnaires and reminders at the right points in the journey, including the onboarding questionnaires and the closing questionnaire ahead of a family’s Moving Forward appointment

• Supporting families who want to come back to the service after their episode of care, using the agreed re-entry route

Supporting families

• Supporting families and young people to complete onboarding questionnaires and paperwork, including talking it through by phone or video where a form doesn’t work for them

• Arranging alternative formats, interpreters and reasonable adjustments, and recording them so every member of the team knows

• Helping families get set up on, and find their way around, our Healios Connect resource library, including logins and digital access

• Responding to questions from families and young people by email, telephone and message – clearly, warmly and promptly

• Recognising when something a family says may signal a safety or safeguarding concern, and passing it to the duty or Care Navigator clinician straight away, following Healios safeguarding procedures. You won’t make clinical decisions, but you will know how and when to escalate

Records, information and quality

• Keeping accurate, timely records in our clinical record system, and checking the record before asking a family for information we already hold

• Liaising with Sirona, schools and other professionals to gather referral and background information, within data-sharing agreements and information governance rules

• Supporting monthly operational reporting, such as appointment capacity, questionnaire completion and family feedback

• General administration and coordination duties that support the Sirona pathway, clinical and operations teams

• Sharing what you hear from families, so we can keep improving the pathway

What you need to have

If you feel you could be a good fit for the role but do not meet all of the criteria, please do make an application and we will be happy to consider your application.

• Administrative and organisational experience, ideally in a healthcare, education or customer-facing setting

• Good time management, and the ability to switch between tasks without losing track of the detail

• Experience of resolving queries and concerns, and troubleshooting problems

• Experience using MS Word, Excel, Outlook and/or Google Docs, Sheets, Calendar, and confidence learning new systems

• Clear, warm and professional communication, particularly by email and telephone, and the flexibility to adapt how you communicate to the person in front of you

• An understanding of, or genuine interest in, neurodiversity and neuro-affirmative practice, and a willingness to keep learning

• Keeping families and young people at the heart of everything you do

• Good judgement about when to ask for help, and the confidence to escalate concerns promptly

• An understanding of confidentiality and data protection when handling sensitive personal information

• A professional home working environment with a minimum WIFI connection of 2 Mbps up and download speed

• Flexibility to support our mission of bringing healthcare to anyone, anytime, anywhere

• A commitment to ethical practice and adherence to the highest standards of safeguarding of adults and children

It would be great if you also have

• Experience in NHS, children’s, SEND or neurodevelopmental services

• Experience using a clinical record or case management system

• Knowledge of services and support available to families across BNSSG

• Experience supporting families of younger children, including under-5s

• Autism, ADHD or neuro-affirmative training

• Lived experience of neurodivergence, yourself or in your family – we welcome and value this

What’s in it for you

• 33 days holiday (including Bank Holidays)

• Paid Christmas closure (between Christmas and New Year)

• Birthday Leave - paid day off on your birthday

• Life Leave" - 2 days of extra leave to take when things you can't plan for happen

• Enhanced family friendly policies including a phased return to work and receive full pay

• Paid company sick pay scheme

• Contributory Pension Scheme (6% matched)

• Employee Discount to access a private assessment (for ADHD, Autism or a combined assessment) through our Melios service for your child

• Fully personalised flexible benefits package including; Health Cash Plan, Life Assurance, EAP Service, Will Writing, Critical Illness Cover, employee discount and savings portal, Cycle to Work Scheme, Tech Scheme and Wine Club!

• Work from anywhere policy

• Access to NHS and Perks at Work discounts, including the Blue Light Card

• Free access to co-working spaces

• CPD/Growth day per year, plus personal development allowance to invest in your growth Bespoke Healios Training and on demand learning including schedule of monthly CPD for clinicians

• Bespoke Healios Training and on demand learning including schedule of monthly CPD for clinicians

ACCOMMODATIONS
We’re glad to accommodate candidates who need adjustments throughout the hiring process and we're always learning about different accessibility needs to ensure our hiring process is accessible for all candidates. We encourage you to be open about the adjustments you need so we can adapt our interview process. You can read more about Healios being an Inclusive Employer on our Notion page

We are a Disability Confident Employer and operate a Guaranteed Interview Scheme (GIS). This means we are committed to interviewing all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. If you wish to be considered under this scheme, please indicate this when asked about disability on the application form.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

“Do the right thing” is one of our core Healios values. And building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels supported is absolutely the right thing to do. Whether we’re developing a new service line or enhancing one of our products, we need people with different skills, backgrounds, identities and perspectives to ensure our innovations will work for the children and young people we are here to serve. By embracing diversity, we can deliver better care experiences and outcomes, while tackling the inequalities in healthcare provision that exist today.

SAFER RECRUITMENT & PRE- EMPLOYMENT CHECKS

Healios ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation, We will do our absolute best to keep the people that we support, safe from harm. This starts with our recruitment processes.

As part of our pre-employment checks, all employees of Healios will be asked to have a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Dependent on your role within the business, this will either be an Enhanced or Basic. A Protecting Vulnerable Groups (PVG) check will be required. You will also be asked to provide two professional references as a minimum.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Payments Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

 - Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

 - Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

 - Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

 - Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

 - Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

 - Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

 - Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.




REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

 - Expertise in Python.

 - A strong background in backend development.

 - Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

 - Strong test design and security fundamentals.

 - Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

 - The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

 - Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

 - Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

 - Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes.


LOCATION

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot https://polkadot.network/, Polkadot SDK https://substrate.io/, and Kusama https://kusama.network/ — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet.Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.



About the Team

We are looking to hire across our Acceleration Function which includes Runtime, Node, Platform and Applied Engineering. 

 

About the Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager who combines people leadership with strong delivery and project management. This isn't a hands-on coding role, but you'll need enough technical depth to understand architecture, engage credibly with engineers, and support sound decision-making.

You'll focus on team health, execution, planning, and cross-functional coordination, helping the team navigate trade-offs, timelines, and stakeholder expectations. A background as a Technical Project Manager or Engineering Manager in a deeply technical environment would be a strong fit.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead, coach, and support a team of around 9 engineers within one of our functions

 - Create a healthy, high-trust team environment with a strong focus on people management and team care

 - Drive planning, prioritisation, and execution across complex technical workstreams

 - Negotiate timelines and delivery trade-offs with stakeholders in a clear and pragmatic way

 - Build enough technical context to understand architecture discussions and help translate them into executable plans

 - Partner closely with technical leaders and contributors to keep projects moving and unblock delivery

 - Improve team ways of working, communication, and delivery predictability in a distributed environment

 - Support hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of team members as the organisation grows

What You’ll Bring

 - Experience leading engineering or highly technical teams in an Engineering Manager or Technical Project Manager capacity

 - Strong people management skills, with a track record of building healthy teams and supporting individual growth

 - Excellent project and delivery management skills, including planning, dependency management, and stakeholder communication

 - Sufficient technical depth to understand complex system architecture and work effectively with senior engineers

 - Comfort operating in a role that is more focused on leadership and delivery than on hands-on coding

 - Strong judgement when balancing technical complexity, team wellbeing, and delivery outcomes

 - Experience working with distributed teams, ideally across Europe or closely aligned European time zones

 - Nice to have: experience in similarly technical or infrastructure-heavy environments



About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc https://zincwork.com/candidates, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice https://www.parity.io/applicant-notice/ to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome

jobs.title: Therapist Team Leader
jobs.description:
The Spa Therapist Team Leader is responsible for delivering exceptional spa and wellness treatments while supporting the daily operations, service standards, and overall performance of the Spa team.

As a hands-on leader, the role combines professional treatment delivery with team coordination, training, quality assurance, and guest experience management. The Spa Therapist Team Leader serves as the primary point of contact for Spa Therapists during daily operations, ensuring consistent service excellence, efficient resource utilization, and a welcoming wellness environment.

The position also supports the Spa Manager or designated Department Head in maintaining operational standards, developing team capabilities, and promoting the wellness philosophy and values of Our Habitas.

Spa Treatments & Guest Experience

• Perform a comprehensive range of spa and wellness treatments, including massages, body treatments, facials, and other approved therapies, according to qualifications and training.
• Deliver personalized treatments tailored to guests' individual needs, preferences, and wellness objectives.
• Conduct professional guest consultations before treatments, identifying relevant health considerations, contraindications, and preferences.
• Maintain exceptional treatment techniques, service etiquette, and guest care standards.
• Create a relaxing, welcoming, and memorable spa experience.
• Respond professionally to guest requests, concerns, and feedback, escalating complex matters when necessary.
• Maintain guest confidentiality, privacy, and comfort throughout the wellness journey.
• Promote suitable treatments, wellness experiences, and retail products through personalized recommendations.

Team Leadership & Supervision

• Provide daily guidance, direction, and support to Spa Therapists.
• Act as the first point of contact for operational concerns during assigned shifts.
• Lead by example through professional conduct, positive attitude, and exceptional service delivery.
• Monitor team grooming, punctuality, attendance, and adherence to established standards.
• Support the preparation and coordination of daily therapist assignments and treatment schedules.
• Conduct daily briefings to communicate operational priorities, guest preferences, and service expectations.
• Encourage teamwork, accountability, and a positive working environment.
• Identify performance concerns and communicate them promptly to the Spa Manager or designated Department Head.
• Support the onboarding, orientation, and integration of new Spa Therapists.
• Assist in implementing departmental initiatives and improvement plans.

Spa Operations & Coordination

• Support the smooth and efficient daily operation of the Spa.
• Ensure treatment rooms, wellness facilities, and service areas are properly prepared and maintained.
• Coordinate with Spa Reception and other departments to ensure accurate bookings and efficient treatment allocation.
• Monitor treatment schedules to minimize delays and maximize operational efficiency.
• Ensure sufficient availability of treatment products, linens, amenities, and equipment.
• Monitor inventory consumption and report replenishment requirements.
• Assist with opening and closing procedures, including operational checklists.
• Ensure equipment is maintained in good working condition and report defects promptly.
• Support cost-control initiatives by minimizing product wastage and ensuring responsible resource utilization.
• Coordinate operational requirements with Housekeeping, Engineering, and other relevant departments.

Quality Assurance & Service Standards

• Ensure consistent implementation of approved spa treatment protocols and service standards.
• Conduct routine checks of treatment rooms, equipment, and guest facilities.
• Monitor the quality and consistency of treatments delivered by the team.
• Provide constructive feedback and practical coaching to improve service performance.
• Ensure compliance with Our Habitas brand standards and established wellness procedures.
• Assist in resolving service inconsistencies and implementing corrective actions.
• Support guest satisfaction initiatives and continuous improvement of the spa experience.

Training & Team Development

• Assist in identifying training needs and development opportunities for Spa Therapists.
• Conduct practical demonstrations, refresher training, and treatment technique coaching within the scope of approved protocols.
• Support cross-training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
• Monitor team members' progress and provide feedback to the Spa Manager or designated Department Head.
• Encourage continuous learning, product knowledge, and professional development.
• Ensure completion of mandatory training and departmental learning requirements.
• Support the development of junior therapists and help prepare potential future team leaders.

Hygiene, Health & Safety

• Ensure strict compliance with spa hygiene, sanitation, and health and safety standards.
• Maintain proper cleaning and disinfection of treatment rooms, tools, equipment, and reusable materials.
• Ensure appropriate handling, storage, and usage of treatment products.
• Follow established procedures for guest consultations, treatment contraindications, and incident reporting.
• Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and professional grooming.
• Ensure the safe use of treatment equipment and wellness facilities.
• Report accidents, injuries, unsafe conditions, and guest health concerns immediately.
• Comply with applicable Qatar health, safety, and regulatory requirements.

Revenue Generation & Retail Sales

• Support the achievement of spa treatment and retail revenue targets.
• Recommend appropriate treatments, packages, and wellness experiences based on guest needs.
• Promote retail products through professional product knowledge and genuine recommendations.
• Encourage the team to identify suitable upselling opportunities without compromising guest experience.
• Monitor therapist productivity and treatment utilization.
• Support promotional activities and special wellness initiatives.
• Provide suggestions to improve guest engagement, service offerings, and commercial performance.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

• Assist in maintaining accurate treatment records, guest preferences, and operational documentation.
• Monitor daily treatment schedules, therapist assignments, and service productivity.
• Report operational issues, guest complaints, and team concerns to management.
• Support inventory tracking, stock requests, and product consumption monitoring.
• Ensure completion of departmental checklists and required documentation.
• Assist with team attendance monitoring and coordination of duty rosters.
• Maintain confidentiality of guest information and employee records.

Collaboration & Brand Representation

• Work closely with Spa Reception, Guest Experience, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver seamless guest experiences.
• Promote a collaborative and respectful working environment.
• Demonstrate the Our Habitas philosophy of connection, wellness, community, and mindful living.
• Participate in resort activities, wellness initiatives, and special guest experiences.
• Represent the Spa professionally and uphold the reputation of Our Habitas.

• Diploma or professional certification in Massage Therapy, Spa Therapy, Beauty Therapy, or a related discipline.
• Minimum of 3 years of professional spa therapy experience, preferably within a luxury hotel, resort, or established wellness facility.
• Previous experience as a Senior Spa Therapist, Lead Therapist, or in a similar supervisory capacity is preferred.
• Proficiency in a variety of massage and body treatment techniques.
• Knowledge of spa products, treatment protocols, and wellness practices.
• Previous experience coaching or training junior therapists is an advantage.
• Strong understanding of spa hygiene, sanitation, and health and safety requirements.
• Good command of spoken and written English; additional languages are an advantage.
• Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends and public holidays.
• Relevant professional certifications and any required local authorizations.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

8Fleet is hiring! We are a rapidly growing LA-based technology and logistics startup building the operational infrastructure for both autonomous and non-autonomous rideshare fleets. Our drivers are at the center of everything we do, and as we grow in Atlanta, we are building a team to make sure every new driver starts with us trained, set up, and ready to succeed.

We are seeking an Onboarding Supervisor, based in Atlanta, to run our driver onboarding center day to day. You will lead new hire orientation, get drivers set up in our systems, coordinate test drives, and be the go-to person for new drivers through their first few weeks with 8Fleet.

This is a hands-on, on-site role built for someone who is organized, friendly, and comfortable keeping a busy schedule moving. Your work makes sure our Fleet Supervisors get drivers who are ready to hit the road from day one.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, hourly, on-site. Your schedule may flex based on onboarding volume and team needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Run the Onboarding Center: Lead daily new hire orientation (NHO) sessions and keep the onboarding experience smooth, professional, and on time.

 - Driver Readiness: Make sure every new driver completes onboarding materials, understands company policies, and is fully prepared before their first shift.

 - System Setup: Set drivers up in our internal systems, manage their credentials, and keep all paperwork complete and accurate.

 - Test Drives: Schedule, coordinate, and oversee driver test drives, making sure drivers meet our safety and operating standards.

 - Scheduling and Logistics: Coordinate onboarding sessions, trainings, and test drives to keep new drivers moving without delays.

 - New Driver Support: Be the first point of contact for new drivers, answering questions and resolving onboarding issues during their first few weeks.

 - Tracking and Reporting: Track onboarding progress and completion, and flag bottlenecks to the Market team.

 - Collaboration: Work closely with Fleet Supervisors, Market leadership, and operations teams on driver readiness and onboarding quality.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1+ year of experience in operations, customer service, logistics, HR, or another fast-paced, people-facing role.

 - Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple drivers and schedules at once.

 - Clear, friendly, and professional communication, with comfort training and coaching others.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Background in transportation, logistics, or fleet operations.

COMPENSATION

 - $19 per Hour

jobs.title: Expert Mechanical Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
Alice & Bob is developing the first universal, fault-tolerant quantum computer to solve the world’s hardest problems.
The quantum computer we envision building is based on a new kind of superconducting qubit: the Schrödinger cat qubit 🐈‍⬛. In comparison to other superconducting platforms, cat qubits have the astonishing ability to implement quantum error correction autonomously!
 
We're a diverse team of 250+ brilliant minds from over 35 countries united by a single goal: to revolutionise computing with a practical fault-tolerant quantum machine. Are you ready to take on unprecedented challenges and contribute to revolutionising technology? Join us, and let's shape the future of quantum computing together!


The role
In a context where mechanical parts and integration hardware face increasingly demanding requirements in precision, scalability and robustness, particularly under the cryogenic and thermal constraints specific to our platform, the Staff Precision Mechanical Engineer brings dedicated precision-mechanics expertise to the Cryo Hardware Development team and raises its engineering standards in formalization, qualification and validation. Reporting to the Cryo Hardware Development Manager, they will work closely with RF engineers, physicists, and the assembly and procurement teams to design, develop and oversee the full range of mechanical parts and integration hardware, with particular attention to chip-level components (e.g. sample holders and packaging).

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives!

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will be a core technical driver for Robinhood’s global expansion initiatives. You will bridge high-performance frontend interfaces with resilient backend distributed systems, architecting and delivering localized customer experiences—from multi-currency funding and international onboarding to regional asset trading. You will design reusable, extensible platform abstractions that allow Robinhood to scale seamlessly into new international markets while upholding uncompromising standards for security, availability, and compliance. In this role, you will lead complex technical designs, raise the engineering bar across the stack, and collaborate side-by-side with product managers, designers, compliance partners, and platform teams to build financial products for our worldwide community

This role is based in either our New York City, Toronto, or Menlo Park- California offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Full Stack Architecture & Engineering: Develop and maintain high-quality frontend interfaces (React/TypeScript) and scale robust backend services (Go/Python)

• Global Product Launches: Own the technical delivery of critical international capabilities, including localized onboarding funnels, identity verification (KYC/AML), multi-currency funding rails, and region-specific trading experiences

• Growth and User Acquisition: Build and optimize high-leverage growth mechanisms, localized promotion engines, and user acquisition pipelines to accelerate international market adoption.

• Reusable Internationalization Platforms: Architect modular, scalable frameworks and internationalization (i18n/l10n) services that make expanding to future jurisdictions faster, safer, and more reliable

• System Reliability & Observability: Ensure backend services and localized products are built for high availability, low latency, and fault tolerance; implement comprehensive telemetry, automated testing, and participate in production on-call rotations

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Compliance, Legal, and Platform teams to translate jurisdictional requirements into elegant, user-centric technical solutions

What you bring

• Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems across the full stack

• Frontend Depth: Proficiency with modern frontend technologies and frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript) with an emphasis on performance, accessibility, and state management

• Backend & Distributed Systems: Strong experience building scalable distributed services in languages such as Go or Python, utilizing relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis), and working with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka)

• Product Ownership: Proven track record of taking complex features from ambiguity through technical design, phased rollout, production validation, and post-launch maintenance

• API & Systems Design: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, service-oriented architectures, and microservice integration patterns

• Communication & Alignment: Clear, structured communication skills to articulate trade-offs, drive technical consensus across distributed teams, and align with non-technical stakeholders

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health support

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

jobs.title: Senior C++ Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 

 

Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!




YOUR TEAM AND ROLE 

Working on the C++ Functional Team, you'll build the high-performance code at the core of DuckDuckGo's browser using modern C++ and Chromium, and work on related projects. 

 

You can expect to work on projects like:

 - Implement tracker blocking that stops hidden trackers on every site without slowing page loads.

 - Bring VPN and Personal Information Removal into the browser through the DuckDuckGo subscription.

 - Catch startup and responsiveness regressions automatically, so the browser stays fast as it grows.

 

As a Senior C++/Chromium Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from proposal through post-mortem. You'll turn vague problems into clear plans, build them in a large modern C++ codebase, and use metrics to show they worked. Some days that means low-level systems work. Others, it means architecture decisions the whole team builds on. You'll collaborate with design and product, mostly asynchronously, to build features people use to protect their privacy.

 


ABOUT YOU 

 - Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact, complex projects from proposal through post-mortem

 - Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience

 - Advanced modern C++ expertise (C++23 or newer), including memory management, concurrency, and performance profiling

 - Experience driving technical work end-to-end on large-scale C++ codebases

 - Comfort with large build systems, debuggers, and profilers

 - Experience shipping software to a large consumer audience

 - Solid computer science foundation (algorithms and data structures)

 - Bonus: Windows development experience

 - Bonus: experience with browsers (Chromium, WebKit, WebView), game engines, or large desktop applications


COMPENSATION 

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 


HIRING PROCESS 

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire.

 


DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION 

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

 


PLEASE NOTE THAT: 

 - You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

 - Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

 - While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

 - A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

 - By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: F&B Server
jobs.description:
The Food & Beverage Server is responsible for delivering exceptional dining experiences through personalized, attentive, and professional service. The role ensures that guests receive high-quality food and beverage service while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality, cleanliness, and operational efficiency.

As an ambassador of Our Habitas, the F&B Server creates meaningful connections with guests, embraces the brand's values, and contributes to a welcoming and memorable dining atmosphere.

Guest Experience & Service Excellence

• Welcome guests warmly and professionally, creating a positive first impression.
• Deliver personalized, attentive, and engaging service in accordance with Our Habitas standards.
• Present menus, explain food and beverage offerings, and provide recommendations based on guest preferences.
• Take accurate food and beverage orders and communicate them promptly to the Kitchen and Bar teams.
• Serve food and beverages according to established service sequences and presentation standards.
• Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly to requests.
• Handle guest concerns professionally and escalate matters when necessary.
• Build positive guest relationships while respecting privacy and cultural differences.

Food & Beverage Operations

• Prepare restaurant sections and service stations before each shift.
• Ensure proper table setup, including cutlery, glassware, crockery, and table accessories.
• Maintain cleanliness, organization, and presentation of dining areas throughout service.
• Ensure accurate and timely delivery of food and beverage orders.
• Coordinate effectively with the Kitchen, Bar, and other operational departments.
• Monitor table service, replenish beverages, and clear used items appropriately.
• Assist with opening and closing duties, including cleaning, restocking, and equipment preparation.
• Support special events, private dining experiences, and other F&B activities when required.

Product Knowledge & Sales

• Maintain thorough knowledge of menus, ingredients, preparation methods, and beverage selections.
• Understand dietary requirements, food allergies, and available menu alternatives.
• Recommend suitable food and beverage pairings to enhance the guest experience.
• Promote menu highlights, seasonal offerings, and special experiences.
• Apply suggestive selling and upselling techniques naturally and professionally.
• Remain informed about resort facilities, activities, and experiences to assist guests.

Hygiene, Safety & Compliance

• Comply with all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation procedures.
• Maintain excellent personal grooming and hygiene standards.
• Follow proper food handling, storage, and service practices.
• Ensure compliance with HACCP principles and applicable Qatar food safety regulations.
• Report unsafe conditions, equipment defects, and hygiene concerns immediately.
• Follow established procedures for allergen management and guest dietary restrictions.
• Handle equipment and service materials responsibly to minimize breakage and waste.

Cashiering & Administrative Responsibilities

• Accurately process guest orders and transactions through the Point-of-Sale (POS) system.
• Present bills correctly and process payments in accordance with company procedures.
• Ensure proper handling of cash, card payments, and room charges.
• Report billing discrepancies and operational concerns promptly.
• Maintain accurate records of transactions and assigned operational checklists.

Teamwork & Collaboration

• Work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
• Participate actively in daily briefings, departmental meetings, and training sessions.
• Support colleagues during peak operational periods.
• Communicate clearly and professionally with supervisors and team members.
• Demonstrate flexibility in supporting different F&B outlets and service areas.
• Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and respectful working environment.

Learning & Development

• Participate in mandatory training, service development programs, and departmental initiatives.
• Continuously improve food and beverage knowledge and technical service skills.
• Apply feedback constructively to enhance individual performance.
• Demonstrate commitment to personal growth and professional development.
• Support the resort's service excellence and guest satisfaction initiatives.

• High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality-related qualifications are an advantage.
• Previous experience as an F&B Server, Waiter, or Waitress, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, or upscale restaurant.
• Good knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
• Familiarity with POS systems and basic cashiering procedures.
• Good command of spoken and written English; additional languages are an advantage.
• Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards.
• Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

jobs.title: Systems Intern - Validation, Software, Design, Architecture & Packaging (USA)
jobs.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Santa Clara, California, United States
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Overview: A chip isn't a product until it's a working system. These teams cover both ends of that: getting silicon to boot and validate correctly,building the board, power, mechanical, thermal, packaging and IO around it. You submit one application, you have one recruiter screen - then we match you to the specific team below and location that fits best.

• Systems & Silicon Validation: Post-silicon testing of physical chips and integrated systems to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specs.

• System Software: Development of foundational software, including firmware, drivers, and operating systems, that directly controls and interfaces with hardware.

• System Design: The process of defining, integrating, and mapping out hardware components such as PCBs, software modules, and interfaces into a complete product blueprint.

• System Architecture: Define the high-level structural framework, interfaces, and data-flow pathways between the CPU, memory, and peripherals.

• Packaging: A package is what is placed between the silicon and the board; and its design requires detailed electrical, electromagnetic, and mechanical simulations and analysis.

This role is on-site, based out of Austin, TX or Santa Clara, CA.

Who You Are

• Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in EE, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering

• Coursework or projects in embedded systems, microwave and signal integrity, board-level design, or thermal/mechanical engineering using low-level programming (C/C++, Python) or hardware design and/or simulation tools (e.g., CAD, FEA, Verilog).

• Problem solver with strong foundational knowledge in one of these areas: electrical engineering, digital logic, computer architecture, or thermal/mechanical.

• Curious learner who is passionate about the intersection of software, silicon architecture, and the physical constraints of chip packaging and printed circuit boards (PCBs).

What We Need

• Systems & Silicon Validation: Assist in post-silicon testing of physical microchips under real-world workloads to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specifications.

• System Software: Contribute to developing foundational software—including firmware, drivers, and operating systems—that directly controls and interfaces with the semiconductor hardware.

• System Design & Architecture: Help map out, define, and evaluate high-level structural frameworks, optimizing the power delivery and high-speed performance benchmarks of both the silicon components and the underlying PCBs.

• Semiconductor Packaging & Mechanical Design: Design and layout, Electromagnetic (signal integrity and power integrity), mechanical design, and stress analysis

What You Will Learn

• Hands-on silicon experience using industry-standard lab equipment to bridge the gap between theoretical hardware design, physical packaging layouts, and real-world chips.

• Low-level software development by writing production-grade firmware, device drivers, and diagnostic tools that run directly on bare metal.

• Mechanical & thermal engineering for electronics by learning how structural stress, heat dissipation, thermal expansion, and mechanical shock affect the structural integrity and performance of PCBs and packages.

• Cross-functional collaboration working alongside world-class architects, mechanical designers, package engineers, and software teams to understand how complex, large-scale chip ecosystems are built from scratch.

USA Hiring Timelines

This internship opportunity is available throughout our 3 terms with the following corresponding recruitment cycles:

• Winter Term: Jan–Apr work term, Sept–Dec recruit.

• Summer Term: May–Aug work term, Oct–Apr recruit.

• Fall Term: Sept–Dec work term, Jan–Aug recruit.

Please note these timelines are for reference only. Actual timelines may vary.

Compensation for all interns at Tenstorrent ranges from $50/hr - $70/hr including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
About Legend

Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising

Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Great treasury is about more than managing cash. It's about giving a business the confidence to grow, make decisions and move forward.

As Legend and Genius Sports bring their expertise together, our Treasury function is evolving to support a larger, more complex international business. We're looking for a Treasury Manager to join our team in St Helier, Jersey and play a key role in shaping how we manage cash, liquidity and financial risk across the Group.

Reporting to our Group Head of Treasury, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day treasury operations that keep our business moving. From providing clear visibility of our cash position to managing covenant reporting and global banking activities, you'll make sure we have the right information, controls and processes in place to operate with confidence.

This isn't just about keeping things running. You'll have the opportunity to challenge existing processes, introduce smarter ways of working and help build a more efficient, scalable Treasury function through better systems, data and automation.

If you're a hands-on treasury professional who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership and making a real impact, this is an opportunity to bring your expertise to a business that's continuing to evolve.

We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact:

• Keep our cash working smarter. Own short-term liquidity forecasting, strengthen cash visibility across the Group and identify funding needs, risks and opportunities before they become challenges.

• Bring confidence to our financial commitments. Take ownership of covenant calculations, compliance monitoring and lender reporting, delivering accurate, forward-looking insights that support better financial decisions.

• Make global treasury operations run seamlessly. Manage banking relationships and administration, account mandates, cash movements and controls, ensuring our operations remain accurate, efficient and well-governed.

• Stay one step ahead of financial risk. Monitor FX exposures and hedging activities, support financial risk analysis and highlight emerging risks to help protect the Group's financial position.

• Build a smarter Treasury function. Challenge existing processes, improve forecasting and data quality, strengthen controls and help introduce technology and automation that make our operations more scalable.

What You'll Bring:

• Hands-on treasury experience. A background in corporate treasury, cash management or corporate finance within a commercial environment, with the confidence to take ownership and deliver independently.

• Strong cashflow and liquidity expertise. Experience building and managing forecasts, investigating variances and translating financial data into meaningful insights.

• Knowledge of debt and covenant reporting. Practical experience preparing or managing covenant calculations, monitoring compliance and supporting accurate lender reporting.

• A solid understanding of treasury operations. Experience managing banking administration, mandates and cash management processes, alongside an understanding of FX exposure and financial risk.

• An analytical mindset with an eye for improvement. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, combined with an interest in using systems, technology and automation to work smarter.

• Sound judgement and a collaborative approach. Strong attention to detail, the ability to spot and escalate risks, and the confidence to work independently while building relationships across Finance.

The Interview Process:

• Initial conversation with our Talent Partner – A 30-minute Zoom call to learn more about you, your experience and what you're looking for in your next move.

• Meet our Finance & Treasury team – A 60-minute Zoom interview to explore your treasury expertise, approach to problem-solving and how you could contribute to the team.

• Practical task & presentation – You'll have a few days to complete a relevant treasury exercise before presenting your approach and recommendations to the team.

• Final conversation with our Finance & People team – A 60-minute interview at our St Helier office to get to know each other better, explore how we work and answer any remaining questions.

Additional Information

When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com, and we'll do all we can to support you.

jobs.title: Regional Director, GU Oncology Sales
jobs.description:
Location: East US Region

Natera is seeking an experienced Regional Director to build, lead, and develop a team of Clinical Oncology Specialists focused on Genitourinary (GU) cancers across the Eastern United States.

This specialized sales team will drive adoption of Natera’s Signatera™ molecular residual disease (MRD) test, with a primary focus on Urologic Oncology. Key call points include Urologic Oncologists, GU Surgical Oncologists, Radiation Oncologists, Medical Oncologists, Pathologists, and other healthcare providers involved in the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of patients with genitourinary cancers.

Signatera is a personalized, tumor-informed circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) assay designed to detect molecular residual disease and monitor disease recurrence. Across GU cancers, including bladder, renal cell carcinoma, and testicular cancers, Signatera provides highly specific molecular insights that can help clinicians better assess recurrence risk, monitor disease status, and inform individualized patient management strategies.

The Regional Director will drive sales performance, ensure sales goals and management objectives are achieved or exceeded, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and execute business strategies aligned with Natera Oncology's broader corporate objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Hire, coach, develop, and lead a team of approximately 10 Clinical Oncology Specialists focused on GU cancers, driving Signatera adoption and achieving regional sales objectives.

• Establish a strong field leadership presence through strategic business planning, coaching, CRM utilization, Core Oncology Sales collaboration, and regular field engagement.

• Develop and execute regional sales strategies targeting Urologic Oncologists, GU Surgical Oncologists, Medical Oncologists, Pathologists, and other key stakeholders across academic and community oncology settings.

• Build and strengthen relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) specializing in GU cancers, particularly within major academic medical centers, leading urology practices, and community oncology networks.

• Drive awareness, education, and adoption of Signatera within GU Oncology, with an emphasis on bladder, kidney, and testicular cancers.

• Develop expertise in Natera's molecular diagnostics technology, clinical evidence, and service offerings, effectively representing the company with KOL physicians, academic and community medical directors, and executive-level stakeholders.

• Oversee recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, and performance development of GU Clinical Oncology Specialists.

• Conduct regular field visits with sales professionals to provide coaching, reinforce clinical and commercial knowledge, and support individual and team performance.

• Collaborate closely with Natera's Core Oncology Sales team and cross-functional partners to align account strategies, expand market opportunities, and maximize commercial effectiveness.

• Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving clinical evidence in GU Oncology to identify opportunities for growth and regional expansion.

• Develop and execute regional business plans aligned with sales objectives, market opportunities, and available resources.

• Optimize regional and territory alignment to maximize market coverage, sales productivity, and return on investment.

• Establish best practices for territory management, strategic account planning, physician engagement, and sales execution.

• Attend relevant local, regional, and national oncology and urology conferences, industry meetings, and training sessions.

• Support career development and succession planning by providing ongoing mentorship and leadership development opportunities.

• Ensure all employees complete required training related to HIPAA/PHI privacy, company policies, compliance, and security within 30 days of hire.

• Support Signatera and Natera's broader Oncology portfolio as needed.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field required; MBA preferred.

• Minimum of 10 years of successful sales experience within Oncology, Molecular Diagnostics, Clinical Diagnostics, Urology, Medical Devices, or the diagnostic laboratory industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of sales leadership experience, preferably within Oncology, Specialty Diagnostics, or a related healthcare market.

• Experience in Genitourinary (GU) Oncology, Urologic Oncology, Urology, or GU Surgical Oncology strongly preferred.

• Experience selling into academic medical centers, large healthcare systems, and/or community oncology practices preferred.

• Experience launching new products, developing specialized markets, or leading teams through periods of significant growth preferred.

• An equivalent combination of academic and professional experience will be considered.

• Ability to travel up to 75%.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong leadership and coaching skills with the ability to recruit, develop, motivate, and retain high-performing sales teams.

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable regional sales plans.

• Understanding of the GU Oncology landscape, including key physician specialties, treatment pathways, and market dynamics.

• Knowledge of molecular diagnostics, ctDNA, MRD testing, and precision oncology preferred.

• Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), physician stakeholders, and healthcare executives.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market opportunities, competitive trends, and sales performance to drive growth.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams, including Core Oncology Sales, Marketing, and Medical Affairs.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex business environments.

• Results-oriented leadership style with a strong sense of accountability, urgency, and adaptability.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Gmail, and Salesforce.com.

Why Join Natera?

Join Natera and play a pivotal role in advancing precision oncology for patients with genitourinary cancers.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead a specialized sales team at the forefront of molecular diagnostics, driving adoption of innovative MRD technology across the GU Oncology landscape.

As Regional Director, you will have the opportunity to build and develop a high-performing team, establish strategic partnerships with leading Urologic Oncologists and cancer centers, and help expand access to Signatera's personalized approach to cancer monitoring.

Compensation & Benefits

The total on-target earnings package includes a competitive base salary and uncapped quarterly commissions. Additional compensation includes a car allowance and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

The compensation package listed is for 1st year OTE, which are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. On-target earnings (OTE) represent the total potential income an employee can earn by achieving 100% of their performance goals. It combines a base salary with commissions and serves as an estimated figure rather than a guaranteed amount, providing a guideline based on average performance outcomes.

On-target earnings (OTE)

$240,000—$280,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Principal SRE
jobs.description:
Mobile Wave Solutions is a professional services company specializing in software development as a service. We are committed to delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' evolving needs. With a growing team of over 120 engineers and a mission to empower businesses globally, we provide expert teams to deliver robust solutions and drive innovation.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to own the health, performance, and delivery of the infrastructure of one of our client. 

You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, operations, and quality measuring how their systems actually behave, automating away manual work, and making their path from commit to production fast and dependable. 

This is a hands-on role for a seasoned engineer who treats operations as an engineering problem and sets the bar for others. You'll define what "reliable" means for the systems in concrete, measurable terms, establish the practices the team operates by, and use modern tooling, including AI/AIOps, to monitor, alert, and respond intelligently rather than reactively.

As a senior member of the team, you'll also mentor other engineers and help shape our reliability strategy. 




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the infrastructure. Build, maintain, and scale the systems our product runs on, with reliability and cost-efficiency as first-class concerns

 - Measure the non-functional. Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for availability, latency, throughput, and scalability. Make system behavior visible and quantifiable to the whole team

 - Automate relentlessly. Identify and eliminate toil. Replace manual operational work with code, infrastructure-as-code, and self-healing systems

 - Build a seamless delivery process. Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines so engineers can ship safely and frequently with fast feedback

 - Collaborate across functions. Partner closely with software engineers and QA to embed reliability and quality early - through testing strategy, deployment practices, and shared ownership of production

 - Apply AI to operations. Use AI/AIOps to automate remediation, surface anomalies, reduce alert noise, and improve the signal quality of monitoring, reporting, and on-call

 - Lead incident response. Drive blameless postmortems and turn incidents into systemic improvements

 - Set the standard. Define reliability and operational best practices, and mentor engineers across the team to raise the bar




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in an SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering role, with a track record of owning systems end to end

 - Strong grasp of reliability engineering fundamentals: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and reducing toil

 - Hands-on experience designing modernising and operating CI/CD pipelines

 - Solid infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform / Pulumi / CloudFormation)

 - Experience with cloud platforms (GCP / AWS / Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / Docker)

 - Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language for automation (Python / Go / Bash)

 - Strong observability experience: metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting (NewRelic, Prometheus / Grafana / Datadog / OpenTelemetry)

 -  Applied experience using AI/AIOps to automate, measure, report, and alert - anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, noise reduction, or automated remediation

 - A collaborative mindset and comfort working alongside engineers and QA toward shared reliability goals

 - Demonstrated technical leadership—mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, and influencing engineering practices


YOU WOULD IMPRESS US IF YOU HAVE

 - Prior experience working with Google Cloud Run

 - Experience introducing AIOps tooling into an existing observability stack

 - Background in performance and load testing. 

 - Familiarity with security and compliance practices (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR)




OUR BENEFITS 

 - Remote Office – Option to work remotely or hybrid

 - Parking Space – Free parking available

 - Fun Office Space – Game zone and relaxation area

 - Health Insurance – Private health insurance, including dental care

 - Holidays – 5 extra days after your 1st and 5th year with us

 - Personal Development – Company-sponsored training and development

 - Employee Referral Programme – Competitive bonus for successful referrals

 - Social Events – Celebrating success together

 - Family Insurance – Add insurance coverage for a family member

 - Multisport Card – Fully covered sports pass
