jobs.title: Quantum R&D Engineer - TWPA Design
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



As a Quantum R&D Engineer - TWPA Design, you will act as a domain expert on the physics and architecture of our Josephson Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifiers and will translate product specifications into TWPA architectures. You will focus on pushing the fundamental limits of our microwave engineering, solving complex simulation-to-fabrication mismatches, and spearheading the integration of advanced on-chip components.



What you'll be doing

 - Translate product specifications & features into TWPA layouts and circuit designs through simulations.

 - Drive the miniaturisation of our TWPA architectures and successfully design and integrate critical peripheral components on-chip

 - Research directions include extending bandwidth, improving noise performance, and integration of peripheral functions like pump coupling and isolation.

 - Present findings and technical proposals clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and product decisions.

 - Stay informed of relevant literature and state-of-the-art techniques in parametric amplification, actively contributing new ideas and approaches to the team.
   

Your Profile

 - PhD or equivalent industry experience in quantum-limited amplification, parametric amplifiers (e.g. TWPAs, JPAs), or closely related superconducting microwave circuits.

 - Deep expertise in non-linear metamaterials, Josephson circuits, and mixing processes.

 - >3 years of hands-on experience with advanced microwave design and simulation (e.g., CST, HFSS) with a proven track record of matching simulations to cryogenic measurement data.

 - Track record of independent, creative problem-solving in a research and development setting.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present technical findings and influence decisions across disciplines.

 - Passionate about qubit readout amplification; pushing amplifier performance to the physical limits and thrive in a fast R&D environment.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Financial Controller (Remote - Work from Anywhere)
jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position
Work from anywhere!

Position overview

As Financial Controller, you will own the integrity of financial reporting across the Xapo group, a Bitcoin-first, regulated credit institution headquartered in Gibraltar.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams and take each cycle from first draft to sign-off: consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, the multi-entity close, regulatory returns to the GFSC and FCA, and the external audit.

You will apply IFRS to crypto assets, shape our accounting positions and policies, and work with our finance transformation team to build AI and automation into the close and reporting process.

Responsibilities

Financial reporting and control

• Prepare the group’s consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, from first draft to sign-off.

• Run month-end and year-end close for a multi-entity group in Gibraltar and the UK, including consolidation and intercompany eliminations.

• Oversee the statutory accounts of each group entity.

• Make sure the internal control system stays accurate and keeps its integrity.

Regulatory reporting

• Lead regulatory reporting to the GFSC and FCA, including prudential returns on capital and liquidity and periodic management accounts.

• Work with Data, Operations, Compliance and other teams to prepare client asset reporting.

• Keep up with regulatory change and update reporting when requirements change.

External audit

• Run the group external audit from planning through fieldwork, queries and sign-off.

• Be the main contact between Xapo and the auditors, answering technical questions and keeping the audit on timetable.

Technical accounting

• Support the Director of Finance on technical accounting, including the treatment of crypto assets under IFRS.

• Write technical accounting positions and contribute to decisions on finance systems and infrastructure.

• Help draft accounting policies, memos and decision records.

Tax

• Own tax compliance and manage the external tax advisors, including the tax treatment of crypto assets.

Systems, process and automation

• Improve finance processes and NetSuite reporting.

• Work with the finance transformation team to build AI and automation into close and reporting, and adopt new tools as they roll out.

• Manage the existing close and regulatory reporting review process and look for ways to improve it.

Team management

• Lead and develop the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams, fostering strong performance, accountability, and collaboration.

• Drive a high-performance culture by setting clear objectives, developing future leaders, and ensuring the team has the skills to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.

Skills needed

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.

• At least 5 years as a Controller leading an accounting function.

• Experience in a bank, fintech or crypto business.

• Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and FRS 102, with experience preparing financial statements under both.

• Crypto asset accounting under IFRS, including fair value revaluation and on-chain reconciliations, backed by a working understanding of blockchain.

• Regulatory reporting experience, including Basel capital and liquidity returns (e.g. COREP). GFSC or FCA exposure is preferred.

• External audits experience.

• NetSuite proficiency is essential.

• Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. SQL or BI tools (e.g. BigQuery, Looker) are an advantage.

• Has used AI tools in previous finance roles and is comfortable working alongside AI-driven automations and checking their output.

• Experience leading and developing a finance team.

• Clear writer, able to explain complex numbers to non-finance colleagues and handle regulator and auditor correspondence in a fully remote team.

• Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and high standards of integrity.

Other requirements

• A dedicated workspace.

• A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.

• Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

• Shape the Future Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

• Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

• Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Multi Skilled Engineer
jobs.description:
Role: Multi Skilled Engineer

Career Step Level: Step level 2.0

Location: Blyth, Worksop

Salary: £62,868.47

Hours: A shift rotation with a mixture of days / nights and some weekend working. The working shifts days consisting of 6am to 6pm and nights consisting of 6pm-6am.

Fresh Food, Happy Dogs.

We believe dogs deserve the healthiest, most natural and tastiest meals - with none of the nasties. That’s why we make FRESHly prepared food, cooked just like you would at home and delivered direct to our customers in perfect portions. As a B-Corp certified company, you’re joining a sustainable business that genuinely cares about our people, our products and our impact on the planet. Our goal is simple: to help dogs live healthier, happier, and longer lives, while leaving humans smiling after every interaction.

We’ve come a long way since our co-founders (Kev & Dave), hand delivered the very first Butternut Box. Today, we feed hundreds of thousands of hungry dogs across the UK and Europe - but we won’t stop until we’re feeding dogs everywhere. To get there, we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition to come and work for us.

While Rudie's Kitchen and Ace's Pantry in Doncaster remain the heart of our UK operations, we’ve recently taken a massive leap forward with Sam’s Kitchen in Poland, going live in January this year. This expansion is a huge part of our story, allowing us to bring our gently cooked, human-quality meals to even more four-legged friends across Europe.

🐾 The job:

You might know this role as a Facilities Engineer, Maintenance Engineer, or Manufacturing Engineer, but here at Butternut Box, we call it a Multi-Skilled Engineer. As a Multi Skilled Engineer for a dual site operation, Rudie’s Kitchen, our Manufacturing Site and Ace’s Pantry, our UK Warehouse & Fulfilment Centre, you will have full accountability for the Efficient up-keep of all production, fulfilment and site services equipment.

The Engineer needs to be able to fault-find and problem-solve on a broad range of equipment and situations, which is key to resolving technical/engineering issues in a high-volume production environment where keeping the plant running safely and efficiently is the prime objective.

In this role, you can expect to…

• Partner with our production and fulfilment teams to ensure the full availability of people, knowledge, skills and equipment to keep us cooking (and to be able to cook more as we scale).

• Be an expert, guide and coach demonstrating shift leadership during the day-to-day running of the Kitchen, advising and sharing a view of how we can operate during proactive and reactive requirements with the shift leadership team.

• Be readily available and the first point of contact to diagnose and fix plant issues, including site services.

• Own and drive the reliability of our machinery and react promptly and proactively to breakdown issues escalated across the entire Kitchen whilst on duty.

• To provide the final port of call for our teams in diagnosing reasons for the plant not running to Standard Operating Conditions and being the highest technical skill within the factory's day-to-day operation.

• Carrying out Root Cause Analysis of efficiency losses & significant breakdowns.

• To drive the CI plan for your area of ownership, working alongside the days-based Engineering Team

• Being a key part of the operations team through short interval control meetings, collaborating cross functionally and supporting Op’s with coaching, SOP writing and Technical Training.

• Ensure a robust and informative handover to the oncoming shift to ensure activity continues cohesively, equally ensuring handover to the other side so we can always be moving things forward.

Rudies & Aces systems:

Provide site Services (Cooling systems, steam, air, water, gas and electricity) and full site asset install base (Mixing, Filling, Cooking, Freezing & Fulfilment).

👀 What we're looking for:

• Strong multi-skilled engineering background including completion of a recognised apprenticeship.

• Multi Skilled Engineer with electrical bias, ideally with strong experience in Electrical diagnostics.

• Qualified to HNC level in an Engineering discipline.

• Hungry for a challenge and keen to grow something to our next phase of growth

• Excellent Communication skills, able to engage with shift operations teams

• P.C literate in: Cloud based system, ideally Google Suite, etc.

• Minimum of 3 years experience in an Engineering or Senior Technician Role

• Supervisory experience with broad working knowledge of relevant safety legislation.

• Well practised planning, organisation and scheduling skills.

• Ability to coach and train, leading others by example.

• Easily approachable with good interpersonal skills, with creative thinking and analytical skills

• Loves dogs (naturally)

🙌 Our benefits:

• Enjoy 257.5 hours of holiday per year (equivalent to 33 days holiday)*

• Plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 5 days).*

• 39 hours of pre-booked paws days to support good wellbeing and self care.* (equivalent to 5 days)

• Unlock a £500 annual budget for personal learning and development.

• Enhanced parental leave (52 weeks’ maternity leave inclusive of 26 weeks fully paid and 6 weeks fully paid paternity/secondary leave)

• Get discounted Private Medical Insurance with Vitality Healthcare.

• Discounted Gym membership with “MyGymDiscounts” helping you stay fit and healthy

• Satisfy your taste buds with subsidised food from a variety of street food vans, and of course, pay day pizza!

• Treat your furry friend with an employee discount on Butternut Box.

• Say goodbye to parking woes with free parking and electric car charging.

• Team socials & events

• Prepare for adorable office dog overload—meet Cleo, Paxo, Cali, Ronnie, Harvey, Milo, and many more!

• Holidays and Paws days are pro-rata for those working part time or job share

⏳ The interview process:

• Initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner, carried out remotely.

• Skills interview, usually carried out in person.

• Behaviours interview, usually carried out in person.

💡 Important things to note:

• This role is 100% based in our kitchen in Blyth, Doncaster

• We aim to respond to all applicants personally, however, due to the high volume of applications we receive we are sometimes unable to respond to everyone

• As our business has grown so has our responsibility to our community, our planet and our business. We are not perfect, but we are committed to doing business the right way and continually improving our social and environmental performance

• We want strong, diverse teams built from different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We're ready for the ongoing work that goes into building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career. If it makes your application easier for you please feel free to complete the application form in your native language, we are really happy to translate it afterwards.Butternut Box is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of different nationalities, backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

• For this specific role, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so you’ll need the right to work in the UK.

❗️We believe in a seat at the table for everyone.

Butternut Box is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that to make the best food for all dogs, we need a team that represents all humans. We celebrate different nationalities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We are specifically committed to increasing representation from underrepresented groups. We want a strong, diverse team built from different identities and lived experiences. We’re not perfect, but we are dedicated to the ongoing work of building an inclusive, supportive place where you can do the best work of your career.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Asphalt Legends
jobs.description:
Job description

As Senior Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.
• Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.
• Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.
• Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.
• Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.

• Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).
• Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.
• Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.
• Excellent presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.
• Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

BONUS POINTS

• Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.
• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
• Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
• Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
• Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year

jobs.title: LAUNDRY ATTENDANT
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Laundry Attendant is responsible for delivering high-quality laundry services by ensuring all guest garments, hotel linen, towels, and staff uniforms are cleaned, finished, and handled according to hotel standards. The role supports exceptional guest satisfaction by maintaining cleanliness, quality, efficiency, and cost control while complying with all hotel policies, safety regulations, and brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Laundry Operations

• Report to duty on time according to the assigned roster.
• Review daily occupancy, arrivals, departures, VIP guests, and operational priorities.
• Sort, wash, dry, press, fold, and prepare hotel linen, towels, guest laundry, and staff uniforms.
• Ensure all laundry is processed according to fabric care instructions and hotel standards.
• Inspect all linen and garments for stains, damage, discoloration, or wear before and after washing.
• Maintain high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and quality.
• Handle guest laundry with care, confidentiality, and accuracy.
• Ensure timely delivery of guest laundry within the established service standards.
• Maintain proper records of guest laundry and special requests.

2. Linen & Uniform Control

• Monitor the condition of hotel linen and staff uniforms.
• Repair minor damages whenever applicable.
• Separate damaged or unusable linen for replacement.
• Conduct monthly inventories of hotel linen and staff uniforms.
• Report shortages, losses, or discrepancies immediately.
• Maintain accurate daily records of linen sent to and received from outsourced laundry.
• Verify quantities and quality before accepting returned linen.

3. Laundry Equipment & Chemical Management

• Operate laundry machines safely and efficiently.
• Understand the basic maintenance requirements of laundry equipment.
• Report machine defects or breakdowns immediately.
• Prepare maintenance reports for repair or replacement of equipment.
• Coordinate with Engineering for maintenance requirements.
• Ensure adequate stock of laundry chemicals and operating supplies.
• Monitor chemical consumption and report unusual usage.
• Store chemicals safely according to manufacturer instructions.

4. Outsourced Laundry Coordination

• Coordinate daily linen movement with outsourced laundry providers.
• Supervise outsourced laundry personnel while working on hotel premises.
• Verify quality, quantity, and turnaround time of outsourced laundry.
• Maintain proper documentation for all outsourced laundry transactions.

Health, Safety & Security

• Follow all hotel health, safety, hygiene, and security procedures.
• Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when handling chemicals.
• Follow safe lifting techniques and equipment operating procedures.
• Report accidents, hazards, unsafe conditions, or defective equipment immediately.
• Handle laundry chemicals according to Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
• Be familiar with fire, emergency evacuation, and bomb threat procedures.
• Ensure master keys are kept secure and returned after each shift.
• Report suspicious persons or activities immediately.
• Submit all lost-and-found items discovered in guest laundry or hotel linen to the Housekeeping Office following hotel procedures.

Quality & Guest Service

• Deliver prompt, professional, and courteous service at all times.
• Maintain guest confidentiality and privacy.
• Respond positively to guest requests and operational needs.
• Support the achievement of departmental quality objectives.
• Ensure guest laundry is returned in excellent condition and on time.
• Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction.

General Responsibilities

• Comply with all hotel policies, procedures, and brand standards.
• Maintain excellent personal grooming, hygiene, and professional appearance.
• Wear the prescribed uniform correctly.
• Arrive punctually for all scheduled shifts.
• Attend departmental meetings and training sessions.
• Cooperate with colleagues and other departments.
• Maintain cleanliness of the laundry area and equipment.
• Protect hotel property and equipment.
• Suggest improvements that enhance efficiency, productivity, or cost savings.
• Accept flexible working hours when required by operational needs.
• Perform any other duties assigned by the Laundry Supervisor or Facility Operations Manager.

Knowledge & Skills

• Basic knowledge of laundry operations.
• Understanding of different fabric types and garment care.
• Knowledge of stain removal techniques.
• Basic understanding of laundry chemicals.
• Ability to operate industrial laundry equipment.
• Good communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Good organizational and time management skills.
• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school education or equivalent preferred.
• Previous hotel laundry experience is an advantage.
• Basic English communication skills.
• Physically fit and able to lift laundry loads safely.

• Integrity
• Safety Awareness
• Quality Orientation
• Accountability
• Flexibility
• Professionalism

Key Competencies

• Customer Focus
• Attention to Detail
• Teamwork
• Time Management
• Reliability

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.

Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.

Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.

Your Role

Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.

The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.

The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios

• Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives

• Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process

What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

• Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)

• Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers

• Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics

• Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing

• Strong attention to detail in portfolio reviews, transaction monitoring and documentation, and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment

• Experience in manager selection or due diligence is a plus

• Basic financial modelling and portfolio analytics skills are a plus

• International exposure or experience working with non-Italian institutions is a plus

• Tech-savvy, with experience in a portfolio analytics or wealth reporting platform (Addepar is a plus)

• Effective communicator with a collaborative and multicultural mindset

• Highly motivated and proactive, with a hands-on and flexible attitude

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-growing environment

• Fluent in English. Other languages constitute a plus

Location: Remote work is fine, but being based at a Heritage office is a plus.

What We Offer

• An exceptional team and environment: You will work alongside highly talented professionals from leading global institutions such as Carlyle, CD&R, McKinsey, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and top technology companies. We operate with a high talent bar, intellectual rigor, and a strong focus on excellence.

• High ownership and client-facing scope: You will take ownership of the oversight of UHNW client portfolios, working closely with senior stakeholders, Relationship Managers and clients. You will have significant responsibility in assessing investment opportunities and shaping the quality of the portfolios we manage and advise on.

• Exposure to the intersection of wealth management and technology: You will work on complex multi-asset portfolios and sophisticated wealth structures, using Heritage's proprietary platform to consolidate and analyze portfolio data, and contribute to the continuous evolution of a technology-driven wealth management offering.

• International scope and strong culture: You will operate in a diverse, international team representing 15+ nationalities, with hiring across multiple geographies. We foster a collaborative and ambitious culture, supported by regular team offsites and opportunities to build strong relationships.

At Heritage, we are proud to have a diverse team representing over 15 nationalities, with all communication conducted in English. We are deeply committed to providing equal opportunities and work actively to remove potential biases in our hiring process by involving a Hiring Committee in all decision-making.

By applying to this job offer, you confirm that you have read and understood Heritage's privacy policy: http://bit.ly/privacypolicy121.

jobs.title: MBO Stage Chemie - Bodem Fysische Analyses (BFA)
jobs.description:
Binnen de afdeling Bodem Fysische Analyses (BFA) werk je met verschillende soorten grond en onderzoek je de eigenschappen van de bodem. Je helpt mee met het bepalen van onder andere het vochtgehalte, de hoeveelheid kalk en klei en of de bodem geschikt is voor bijvoorbeeld bouwprojecten zoals wegen.

Je werkt hierbij direct met bodemmonsters en leert hoe deze worden voorbereid en geanalyseerd. Veel van de analyses zijn gebaseerd op gewicht, waardoor je veel bezig bent met nauwkeurig afwegen en meten.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

• Het (voor)bewerken van bodemmonsters
• Het uitvoeren van fysische analyses op de bodem
• Het bepalen van bijvoorbeeld vocht-, kalk- en kleigehalte
• Het nauwkeurig wegen en registreren van resultaten

Binnen deze afdeling is het belangrijk dat je goed leert plannen en overzicht houdt, zodat ook tijdens drukkere momenten alle monsters op tijd worden verwerkt. Je wordt onderdeel van een team en doet waardevolle praktijkervaring op in het laboratorium.

Wat zoeken wij in een stagiaire?

• MLO niveau 3 of 4
• Interesse in laboratoriumwerk en/of bodemonderzoek
• Zorgvuldige en nauwkeurige werkhouding
• Oog voor kwaliteit
• Een gestructureerde manier van werken
• Collegialiteit en een positieve instelling

Je wordt onderdeel van het snelgroeiende en dynamische bedrijf Eurofins, waarmee je een stevige basis van studiegerelateerde werkervaring toevoegt aan je CV. Met een groeiend aantal vestigingen in binnen en buitenland biedt Eurofins kansen voor talent, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Daarnaast bieden we de garantie dat je op elke vestiging ambitieuze en gedreven collega’s treft.

• Veel vrijheid en autonomie om direct met jouw eigen projecten aan de slag te gaan;
• Maar toch ook voldoende begeleiding van onze ervaren HR Medewerker;
• Mogelijkheden om bij Eurofins te blijven werken na je stage;
• Een stagevergoeding van €300,- bruto op basis van een fulltime stage.

Heb je belangstelling voor deze vacature, dan nodigt Eurofins je graag uit om te reageren. Wij willen je verzoeken je je CV inclusief motivatiebrief achter te laten op onze sollicitatiepagina.

Over het bedrijf

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Onze mensen bij Eurofins leveren een belangrijke bijdrage aan wereldwijde thema’s op het gebied van onder meer milieu, voedselveiligheid en algehele gezondheid.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 600 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in de grote laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam) en Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico).

Asfalt

Binnen de asfaltgroep onderzoek je uit welke lagen asfalt is opgebouwd en of er schadelijke stoffen, zoals PAK’s, aanwezig zijn. Dit gebeurt onder andere om te bepalen of asfalt veilig en opnieuw gebruikt kan worden (recycling).

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

• Het bekijken en beoordelen van asfaltmonsters
• Het categoriseren van verschillende lagen binnen een monster
• Het zorgvuldig (voor)bewerken van materialen voor verdere analyses

Het werk vraagt om nauwkeurigheid en een scherpe blik, omdat asfalt een complexe opbouw kan hebben.

• Het uitvoeren van waterextracties
• Het meten van pH en geleidbaarheid
• Het ondersteunen bij langdurige proeven die meerdere weken kunnen duren

We're adding contract accountants to our finance team as revenue grows from $5M to $80M ARR. You'll work alongside our billing lead and help keep the books, collections, and vendor payments accurate and on schedule. This is a remote contract role.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This hire owns day-to-day accounting execution: monthly close, AR, AP, and billing-related tickets.

 - Support the monthly close: reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries.

 - Work AR: invoice follow-up, cash application, and aging.

 - Work AP: vendor bills, approvals, and payment runs.

 - Resolve billing-related tickets from customers and internal teams.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 2+ years of accounting experience covering month-end closes, AR, and AP.

 - Experience at a SaaS or other high-growth company.

 - Hands-on with accounting and billing tools (e.g., QuickBooks, Stripe, Bill.com)

 - Comfortable working remotely and independently.

Nice to have:

 - CPA or CPA candidate.

 - Experience with usage-based billing.




HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Accuracy: reconciliations that tie out.

 - Reliability: close tasks done on schedule without chasing.

 - Responsiveness on billing tickets.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You like clean books and a shrinking aging report.

 - You'd rather flag a problem early than fix it late.

 - You work well async with a small team.
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Intro & Live Exercise: reconcile a sample AR ledger (30 min)

 - Hiring manager conversation (30 min)
   
   


JOB DETAILS

 - Employment Type: Full-Time 1099 Contractor

 - Location: Remote

 - Hours: Must be open to working some overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.



 


THE ROLE

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.

 - Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 - Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 - Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 - Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 - Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 - Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 - Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 - Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 - Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 - Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 - Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 - Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.



THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 - Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 - Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 - Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 - Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - People who cannot go deep into product details.

 - People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Mechanic - Heavy Equipment
jobs.location: Sohar, Al Batinah North Governorate, Oman
jobs.description:
Primary Purpose of the Job

To inspect, diagnose, maintain, repair, and overhaul heavy mobile equipment and machinery, including mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and diesel-powered systems, ensuring equipment reliability, safety, and operational efficiency while minimizing equipment downtime.

Safety Responsibilities

• Comply with all HARSCO safety policies, procedures, and regulations always.
• Immediately report all accidents, incidents, hazards, and near misses, regardless of severity.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment inside and outside the workshop.
• Follow OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) safety guidelines and maintenance procedures.
• Ensure proper disposal of waste materials, including used oil, tires, batteries, and other consumables, in accordance with HMSA standards.
• Promote a strong safety culture by leading through example and encouraging safe work practices.

Key Responsibilities

• Test and inspect mechanical equipment following repair or assembly to ensure proper operation and compliance with manufacturer specifications.
• Diagnose equipment faults and malfunctions using diagnostic tools, computerized testing equipment, and calibration devices.
• Repair or replace defective, damaged, or worn mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical components.
• Operate and inspect heavy equipment and machinery to identify operational defects and determine repair requirements.
• Dismantle, repair, overhaul, and reassemble heavy equipment using appropriate hand tools, lifting equipment, hoists, jacks, and workshop machinery.
• Perform routine preventive maintenance activities, including cleaning, lubrication, adjustments, servicing, and inspections of equipment and vehicles.
• Inspect components for wear, damage, and serviceability using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, gauges, and other testing devices.
• Schedule and execute planned maintenance activities and accurately complete equipment service records, maintenance reports, and inspection documents.
• Read, interpret, and apply technical manuals, engineering drawings, schematics, and operating instructions.
• Conduct equipment overhauls, testing, and commissioning to ensure optimal performance and operating efficiency.
• Install, remove, and fit bearings, seals, and other components during maintenance and overhaul activities.
• Clean and prepare parts using approved cleaning solvents, degreasers, and workshop equipment.
• Repair and maintain major assemblies and subassemblies, including engines, transmissions, axles, hydraulic systems, and drivetrain components.
• Coordinate with the Maintenance Supervisor regarding preventive maintenance schedules and repair priorities.
• Ensure the correct repair methods, procedures, tools, and equipment are used for all maintenance activities.
• Maintain high standards of workshop housekeeping and ensure all housekeeping practices comply with Harsco standards.
• Follow OEM guidelines and best maintenance practices to maximize equipment reliability and availability.
• Assist during breakdown situations and respond effectively to emergency repair requirements.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability, availability, and maintenance efficiency.
• Perform any other duties related to the role as assigned by management.

Working Relationships

Internal Contacts

Regular interaction with:

• Maintenance Supervisor
• Maintenance Planner
• Operations Personnel
• Safety personal

Physical Demands

This position is hands-on and requires the employee to be physically fit and capable of working in demanding industrial environments. The role involves:

• Standing, bending, lifting, climbing, and manual handling of heavy components.
• Working in confined spaces and outdoor environments.
• Operating lifting devices, hand tools, and workshop equipment.
• Working under varying environmental and weather conditions.
• Maintaining both physical and mental fitness to perform maintenance tasks safely and effectively.

Minimum Requirements

Skills and Competencies

• Strong mechanical aptitude and technical knowledge of heavy equipment.
• Excellent troubleshooting and fault-finding skills.
• Good organizational and time management skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical documentation and engineering drawings.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a team.
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.

Language Requirements

• Good spoken English.
• Good written English. (additional benefit)

Experience

• Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of heavy construction, industrial, or mobile equipment.
• Mandatory experience working on CAT (Caterpillar), Doosan, and Komatsu equipment.
• Strong practical experience in diesel engines, hydraulic systems, transmissions, drivetrain components, pneumatic systems, and heavy equipment diagnostics.
• Proven experience in preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and major equipment overhauls.
• Experience using computerized diagnostic and testing equipment.
• Experience working on KAMAG equipment is highly preferred and will be considered a significant advantage.
• Knowledge of OEM maintenance standards, service procedures, and safety requirements for CAT, Doosan, and Komatsu equipment.

Preferred Equipment Experience

• Caterpillar (CAT), Doosan, Komatsu, KAMAG (Preferred)
• Other heavy construction, material handling, and industrial equipment

• High School Diploma or equivalent.
• Diploma or Technical Certificate in Heavy Equipment Diesel Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related trade discipline.
• Relevant trade certifications and manufacturer training will be an added advantage.

• Ability to work in a 24-hour operational environment.
• Flexibility to work overtime, extended shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
• Willingness to provide night shift coverage and emergency breakdown support as operational needs dictate.
• Ability to respond effectively to urgent maintenance requirements and equipment breakdowns.

Valid driving license for mobile equipment operation will be an advantage.

 - Hands-on with billing and finance tools (e.g., Stripe, NetSuite, QuickBooks).

 - Confident working with large customers' AP and procurement teams.

 - Solid accounting fundamentals: AR aging, cash application, reconciliations.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with usage-based or committed-spend contracts.

 - CPA or audit experience.

 - First finance ops hire at a startup.




HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Zero-to-one building: how you set up AR where none existed.

 - Collections results: lower DSO and fewer aged balances.

 - Judgment with large enterprise customers in invoice disputes.

 - Ownership under ambiguity.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than plan for a month.

 - You're equally at home in a spreadsheet and on a call with a customer's AP team.

 - You want to set the foundation for how we get paid.

 


JOB DETAILS

Cash: $190,000 - $230,000

Equity: 4-year vest / 1-year cliff

Location: Redwood City, California (Relocation support provided)

US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT).

 


OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement

 


COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - Best offer upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed

 - Top 1% talent: Above-market pay (top 5th percentile) to attract exceptional builders

 - High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity

 - Performance-based: Offers tied to interview performance, not tenure or past salary

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Recruiter round: background and a basic process design discussion (billing-to-cash flow)

 - First round (45 min): usage-to-invoice reconciliation working session; be ready to share your screen

 - Second round (30 min): hiring manager conversation

 - Onsite (about 3 hours):
   
   - Design billing and collections for an enterprise deal (1 hr)
   
   - Disputed invoice role-play with a customer's AP lead (30 min)
   
   - Cross-functional conversations (30 min)

jobs.title: Vice President, Relevance Strategy
jobs.description:
VaynerX

VaynerX is a family of companies building brands for the now. Founded by Chairman Gary Vaynerchuk in January 2017, the modern-day parent company is home to relevance-driving businesses including VaynerMedia, ChukMedia, Tamara Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, and VaynerSpeakers.

ABOUT VAYNERMEDIA

VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

Overall Purpose

Our Relevance Strategy team sits at the intersection of culture and brand, decoding social trends, subcultures, and movements to connect our clients to the moments and communities that matter, and translating that intelligence into creative work that resonates at scale.

As a Vice President of Relevance Strategy, you lead senior clients and large cross-functional teams, injecting cultural intelligence into brand strategy at the highest level and building the systems that allow the agency to move at the speed of culture.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

• Partner across departments to design and drive cultural strategy, creative thinking, and attention planning that delivers best-in-class execution across a diverse portfolio of business.

• Lead the development of new cultural insights, proprietary points of view, and real-time methodologies that keep brands embedded in the subcultures and movements that matter to their audiences.

• Compose high-impact briefs that inspire integrated creative teams, and steer fast-paced brainstorms and workshops grounded in what is happening in internet culture right now.

• Build and own senior client and external agency relationships by attending client briefings, diagnosing business needs, and understanding the cultural challenges beneath the brief

• Own the strategic portion of the new business process from start to finish, driving pitch deliverables, workshops, and high-stakes presentations.

• Accountable for the growth and development of direct reports from Senior Directors down to Strategists, setting clear goals, running performance conversations, and creating real opportunities for their advancement.

• Real practitioner experience in social commerce, live shopping, creator ecosystems, marketplaces or adjacent spaces

• Active participation in the kinds of communities that drive these businesses — trading cards, fashion, beauty, watches, coins, collectibles and other enthusiast communities

• A genuine understanding of how these communities behave because they have participated in them, worked directly within them or built for them — not simply studied them from the outside

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

• 12-20 years of experience strategically building brands at top agencies, consulting firms, or creative shops, with significant experience working for Fortune 500 clients.

• Strong understanding of how business strategy, digital platform behavior, and cultural intelligence intersect to ground big, purposeful creative ideas.

• Proven ability to move across quantitative and qualitative research tools and behavioral data platforms to draw out and act on insights quickly.

• Strategic thinking ability with a balanced analytical and creative approach to integrated marketing and attention planning.

• Proven leadership track record in developing talent, empowering teams, and maintaining high creative and strategic standards.

• Fluent in modern communication channels, creators, and platform mechanics, and how they shape brand and content marketing in real time.

• An understanding of how social content can create community and connection while also building pathways to commerce

• Fluency in creators, platforms, programming, distribution and the mechanics that actually make live commerce work

• Comfort thinking globally and understanding that community, platform and commerce behavior can vary significantly by market

• A builder mentality — someone excited to help define the Vayner approach to this space rather than applying a traditional strategy playbook

This position is currently designated as hybrid and is subject to the Company's workplace attendance and in-office work requirements, as in effect from time to time. The Company reserves the right to modify these requirements at any time.

All information submitted with this application and disclosed in the interview and screening processes must be truthful.  The Company reserves the right in its sole discretion, to disqualify a candidate from consideration, withdraw a conditional offer of employment, or terminate employment, if it discovers a candidate provided false, misleading, or materially incomplete information during the application process.

VaynerX is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military status, veteran status, citizenship or immigration status (as permitted by applicable law), or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Unsure if you meet the qualifications? We are always looking for talent which will continue to cultivate an inclusive and representative team that will enhance our perspectives, skill sets, background, and behaviors.  We encourage those who are passionate about what we do to apply!

• Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

• Employer-sponsored 401k with match

• Medical, Dental, and vision coverage

• Unlimited PTO

• Caregiver (Parental) Leave

• Health and Wellness benefits

Base Salary

$200,000—$240,000 USD

jobs.title: Auto Electrician - Heavy Equipment
jobs.location: Sohar, Al Batinah North Governorate, Oman
jobs.description:
Primary Purpose of the Job

To perform electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection, reconditioning, overhaul, and repair of mobile equipment, screening plants, metal recovery plants (MRP), air conditioning systems, and all other site equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations with minimal downtime.

Safety Responsibilities

• Comply with all HARSCO safety policies, procedures, and standards always.
• Immediately report all accidents, incidents, hazards, and near misses, regardless of severity.
• Strictly follow Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures during maintenance and repair activities.
• Maintain a high standard of housekeeping inside and outside the workshop.
• Ensure all work is carried out safely and in accordance with applicable electrical safety regulations.
• Always use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Promote a strong safety culture by leading through example and encouraging safe work practices.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform electrical repairs on heavy equipment and plant machinery during breakdowns and scheduled maintenance activities.
• Diagnose electrical faults and malfunctions using computerized diagnostic tools, electrical test equipment, and calibration devices.
• Inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair electrical systems on mobile equipment, cranes, screen plants, and metal recovery plants.
• Ensure all electrical gauges, indicators, warning systems, and safety devices are functioning correctly and maintained to OEM standards.
• Inspect, test, and maintain emergency stop switches, emergency pull cords, alarms, and other critical safety systems to ensure full operational readiness.
• Repair and maintain electrical wiring, sensors, relays, switches, alternators, starters, controllers, lighting systems, and electronic components.
• Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and condition monitoring of electrical systems and components.
• Troubleshoot and repair air-conditioning (A/C) electrical systems on heavy equipment and mobile machinery.
• Interpret and work from electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, technical drawings, and OEM manuals.
• Ensure all repairs and maintenance activities are completed to a high standard of quality and workmanship.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, and repair documentation within the maintenance management system.
• Coordinate with the Maintenance Supervisor to prioritize breakdowns, repairs, and preventive maintenance activities.
• Ensure the correct tools, equipment, and maintenance procedures are used for all repair activities.
• Assist in equipment commissioning, testing, and fault-finding activities following repairs or component replacement.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving equipment reliability and reducing downtime.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment always.
• Perform any other duties related to the position as assigned by management.

Working Relationships

Regular interaction with:

• Maintenance Supervisor
• Maintenance Team members
• Equipment Operators
• Operations Personnel
• Safety personal

Physical Demands

This position is hands-on and requires the employee to be physically and mentally fit. The role involves:

• Working on heavy equipment and industrial plant machinery.
• Standing, climbing, bending, lifting, and working in confined spaces.
• Working at heights when required.
• Exposure to outdoor industrial environments and varying weather conditions.
• Responding to equipment breakdowns and emergency repairs.

Minimum Requirements

Skills and Competencies

• Strong electrical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
• Good organizational and planning skills.
• Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams, schematics, and technical manuals.
• Strong communication and reporting skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Strong commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
• Knowledge of industrial electrical systems, PLC controls, sensors, and safety circuits is an advantage.

Language Requirements

• Good spoken & Written English.

Experience

• Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in electrical maintenance and repair of heavy construction equipment, industrial plant machinery, and material handling equipment.
• Proven experience working on metal recovery plants (MRP), screening plants, mobile equipment, and cranes.
• Strong experience in diagnosing and repairing electrical and electronic systems on heavy equipment.
• Experience in heavy equipment air-conditioning (A/C) diagnostics and repairs is required.
• Experience with computerized diagnostic equipment and electrical testing instruments.
• Strong knowledge of OEM electrical systems, safety devices, and control circuits.

Preferred Equipment Experience

• Caterpillar (CAT), Doosan, Komatsu, KAMAG (Preferred)
• Other heavy construction, material handling, and industrial equipment

• High School Diploma or equivalent.
• Diploma or Technical Certificate in Heavy Duty Equipment Electrical Technology, Industrial Electrical Maintenance, Automotive Electrical Systems, or a related field.

Relevant electrical certifications and manufacturer training will be an added advantage

• Ability to work in a 24-hour operational environment.
• Flexibility to work overtime, extended shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
• Willingness to provide night shift coverage and emergency breakdown support as operational needs dictate.
• Ability to respond effectively to urgent maintenance requirements and equipment breakdowns.

Valid driving license for mobile equipment operation will be an advantage.

jobs.title: Department Manager - Limassol
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO​

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

• Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
• Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.
• Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
• Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
• Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Cash Office Responsible—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with…​

• Experience in retail management and operations.
• Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up, using customer-centric tools and reporting.

And people who are…​

• Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
• Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution-focused mindset.
• Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.
• A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

• 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).​

• Performance bonus

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

This is a full-time and permanent position , based in Cyprus, Limassol.

Apply by sending in your CV as soon as possible but not later than 20th of October. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

jobs.title: Applied Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIGHTFIELD

Lightfield is reimagining CRM as a world model of a business. By learning from emails, meetings, and customer conversations, we’re building a living understanding of how a company works—so AI can help teams anticipate what comes next, make better decisions, and take action.

More than 5,000 companies have used the product since its November launch. We’ve raised more than $70M from Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue, Maverick Ventures, and Greylock to attack the biggest software category in the world. We previously built Tome, which reached more than 25 million users, and our team brings experience from Llama, Instagram, Google, and Salesforce.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Get customers to value. Own the path from a customer’s initial goals to successful activation. Define what success means, help them set up their workflows, and follow through until Lightfield is solving a meaningful problem for their business.

 - Understand what customers really need. Spend time with the people doing the work. Ask questions, observe their processes, and uncover the business problem behind a request. Understand where their existing tools and workflows fall short.

 - Turn customer problems into working solutions. Develop a deep understanding of Lightfield and how it fits into a customer’s GTM stack. Configure workflows, work through constraints, and help customers find effective ways to use the product.

 - Shape the roadmap with evidence. Identify patterns across customer engagements and prioritize the problems worth solving. Bring clear recommendations to the product team, grounded in customer impact, business value, and an understanding of what will help the broader customer base.

 - Work with design and engineering to close product gaps. Translate delivery experience into clear problem definitions. Help evaluate potential solutions, test them with customers, and follow up to understand whether they made a difference.

 - Make successful approaches repeatable. Turn what works into reusable workflows, examples, and playbooks. Find ways to reduce the time and effort it takes for each new customer to succeed.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have strong business judgment. You understand how companies operate and connect product decisions to business outcomes. You can distinguish a pressing request from a high-value problem and explain where we should focus.

 - You’re great at working with customers. You build trust, listen closely, and ask the questions that get beyond the first answer. You can challenge an assumption, set expectations, and guide a customer toward a better solution.

 - You know the GTM tool landscape. You understand how sales, marketing, and customer success teams work, the tools they rely on, and where those tools create friction. You can see how Lightfield fits into that environment and where it can improve it.

 - You have strong product instincts. You recognize when a customer’s experience points to a broader product opportunity. You think carefully about tradeoffs and can turn a collection of requests into a clear view of what matters.

 - You’re hands-on and take ownership. You’re comfortable moving between discovery conversations, product configuration, and discussions with engineering. You get into the details, work through ambiguity, and stay accountable for the outcome.

Your background might be in product management, solutions consulting, customer success, or GTM operations. We’re interested in your ability to understand a customer’s business, deliver a useful solution, and turn that experience into better product decisions.



WHY THIS ROLE

You’ll see firsthand where Lightfield changes how a customer works and where we still have work to do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn those insights into both immediate customer outcomes and lasting product improvements. Your work will help determine how customers adopt Lightfield and what we build next.




BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive salary

 - Meaningful early equity

 - Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

 - 3 weeks of PTO

 - 11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break

 - 3 months of paid family leave

 - Wednesdays work from home

 - Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats

 - 401k plan

 - Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Program Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects and strategic initiatives for one of our largest customers, from initial planning through execution, monitoring, governance, and closure. This role ensures initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with our customer’s priorities and strategy.

Working cross-functionally, the Program Manager partners with a wide range of internal stakeholders to drive alignment, clarify priorities, and maintain consistent momentum across the business operations and command center teams.

This position requires a highly motivated and self-directed individual who will take ownership of the customer account and make sure that operations are aligned with their needs. You will manage the existing business, take in new improvement ideas, and collaborate with both the customer and the internal business teams to prioritize them. You will ensure that projects are appropriately sized and measurable, and confirm that the right people and resources are available and assigned. You will also engage actively with your sales, business operations, and command center peers to enhance best practices, standards, tools, processes, and training related to project, program, and portfolio management.

Responsibilities and Duties:

• Own the end-to-end delivery of projects and strategic initiatives for a strategic global technology customer, from initial planning through execution, monitoring, governance, and closure.
• Take ownership of the customer account, managing the existing business and ensuring operations stay aligned with the customer’s needs, priorities, and strategy.
• Run intake for new improvements and ideas, and work with the customer and internal business teams to evaluate, prioritize, and schedule them.
• Scope each initiative so it is appropriately sized and measurable, with clear objectives, milestones, success metrics, and owners.
• Confirm that the right people and resources are available and assigned, and resolve priority or capacity conflicts before they put delivery at risk.
• Establish program governance, including regular status reporting, risk and issue tracking, decision logs, and business reviews with customer and internal stakeholders.
• Partner cross-functionally with business operations, command center, and sales teams to drive alignment, clarify priorities, and maintain consistent momentum.
• Lead rollouts of new sites, shippers, pilots, and technology, including GPS tracking device deployment, training, customer-specific SOPs, and site readiness.
• Oversee escalation management for shipment exceptions and security events, ensuring issues are resolved and root causes feed back into process improvements.
• Review shipment, device, inventory, and program performance data to measure outcomes and identify improvement opportunities.
• Engage with sales, business operations, and command center peers to enhance best practices, standards, tools, processes, and training for project, program, and portfolio management.

• Proven program or account management experience leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through closure, ideally for complex, high-volume enterprise customers.
• Highly motivated and self-directed, with strong ownership and accountability: proactively manages issues from identification through resolution with consistent follow-through.
• Demonstrated ability to size, scope, and measure projects, and to secure and align the people and resources needed to deliver them.
