jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Boltline Leadership Team
jobs.description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description

Reusable launch systems are the key to seamlessly connecting Earth and space. As an Executive Assistant supporting Boltline at Stoke Space, you will serve as a trusted partner to the General Manager and provide coordinated support to the leadership team. You will help leaders prioritize their time, stay prepared, and follow through on commitments.

This role combines GM-level expectations for judgment, discretion, and initiative with the varied, hands-on support required in a startup environment. Working closely with Business Operations and Stoke Space partners, you will anticipate needs, create structure, and own executive, administrative, and workplace coordination from request through completion.  You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

Responsibilities

Executive Support and Prioritization

• Manage the GM’s calendar and coordinate scheduling across the leadership team, using an understanding of business priorities to resolve conflicts and protect time for critical work

• Anticipate preparation needs, deadlines, and scheduling issues; surface tradeoffs early and recommend practical solutions

• Coordinate travel, itineraries, expenses, and related logistics, including adjustments when plans change

• Handle sensitive business and personnel information with sound judgment and discretion; communicate professionally on behalf of leaders when authorized

Leadership Meetings and Follow-Through

• Coordinate leadership meetings, planning sessions, business reviews, and offsites, including scheduling, agendas, materials, rooms, and logistics

• Partner with meeting owners to ensure inputs arrive on time and leaders have the information they need before discussions

• Capture decisions and action items as needed, maintain organized records, and follow up with owners on commitments and deadlines

• Help prepare and organize presentations, briefing materials, and internal communications for executive review

Team, Visitor, and Workplace Coordination

• Organize team events, all-hands meetings, customer and partner visits, and other activities that support a productive workplace

• Coordinate visitor arrangements, meeting spaces, catering, and onsite logistics with Boltline and Stoke Space partners

• Support office and facilities needs, supplies, vendor scheduling, purchases, and employee onboarding logistics in partnership with the responsible teams

Startup Operations and Special Projects

• Take ownership of varied administrative and operational projects, clarifying the outcome, coordinating contributors, and carrying work through completion

• Build simple, repeatable processes, templates, and checklists that improve coordination as the company grows

• Identify gaps, recurring friction, and upcoming needs; recommend improvements and act within agreed authority

• Balance support requests across leaders, making priorities and capacity tradeoffs visible when needs compete

Qualifications

• 5+ years of executive administrative experience, including direct support for a GM, CEO, or comparable senior business leader

• Experience supporting multiple executives and navigating competing priorities in a fast-moving organization; startup or growth-stage experience is strongly preferred

• Excellent judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills

• Strong calendar, travel, meeting, and event coordination skills, with a record of anticipating needs and following through reliably

• Comfort working with incomplete information: you ask useful questions, recommend a path forward, and adapt as priorities change

• A hands-on approach and willingness to handle both complex coordination and everyday administrative tasks

• Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, including calendars, email, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and shared workspaces

• Ability to build effective relationships across leadership, employees, external partners, and shared-services teams

Benefits

• Equity – We know that our employees are the reason we succeed. To give everyone a stake in our future, we are pleased to offer equity in the form of stock options to all regular, full-time employees.

• Comprehensive benefits program including subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Company-paid life and disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with employer match

• 4 weeks’ Paid Time Off

• Holidays – 10 days (including an end-of-year closure)

• Paid Family/Parental Leave

• On-site gym or monthly wellness stipend (depending on location)

• Dog friendly offices!

Compensation

Target Levels:

• Level 2 Range: $58,065 - $87,150

Our job posts are intentionally written to attract a wide variety of experience levels, and we make decisions about the right fit on a per-candidate basis.

Your actual level and base salary will be decided based on your specific experience and skill level.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S. (i.e., current Green Card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Equal Opportunity

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including with respect to disability and veteran status.  It is committed to compliance with all equal opportunity laws, including the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and Title VII.   It does not discriminate on the basis of nationality, race, citizenship, immigration status, or any other protected class when it comes to employment practices, including hiring.

Employment at the Company is contingent upon satisfactory completion of reference and background checks, and on your ability to prove your identity and authorization to work in the U.S. for the Company.  Employees must comply with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services employment verification requirements, and, therefore, they must complete an Employment Eligibility Verification Form I-9 at the start of employment and re-verify authorization to work periodically.

Separate from this I-9 process, as noted above, this position entails access to certain technology and technical data that is restricted under U.S. export control laws and regulations.  Employment or continued employment may be conditioned on your legal authorization to work with or have access to export control materials as necessary to perform your job.

Candidate Rights & Accommodations

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or participate in the interview process, please contact careers@stokespace.com. Requests will be handled in accordance with applicable laws. Please do not include medical or other confidential information in your initial request.

For more information about your rights, please refer to the "Know Your Rights" notice here.

E-Verify

Stoke Space uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

For more information on the right to work, please refer to the poster here.

jobs.title: Embedded Flight Software Engineer (TS/SCI Cleared)
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer on Apex's Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop the low level software that configures and drives the processor peripherals and communication interfaces on our avionics.

 - Write and debug the device drivers for the sensors, actuators, and components across the bus.

 - Implement onboard algorithms, including closed loop control and the logic that detects and responds to faults such as failed sensors or radiation upsets.

 - Design, develop, and own mission-critical software for satellite systems throughout the full software lifecycle, from initial architecture and development through deployment and operations.

 - Develop rapid, iterative software to support bench and development testing, as well as robust, rigorously reviewed and validated software delivered to manufacturing and flight systems.

 - Plan and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing of satellite components, diagnosing and resolving defects to ensure software quality, reliability, and performance.

 - With a focus on embedded software and hardware designs, collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and operations teams to establish product requirements, define technical roadmaps, and drive successful execution.

 - Support spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations, troubleshooting software and ensuring critical flight systems remain functional and reliable throughout critical mission activities.


REQUIREMENTS

 - U.S. Citizenship (must possess the ability to access export-controlled data)

 - Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility 

 - 8+ years writing C/C++ for embedded systems, ideally in spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware that interacts with the physical world

 - Bachelor’s degree in CS, EE, or equivalent

 - Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or Rust




PREFERRED 

 - 3+ years of flight software experience

 - Experience developing firmware for microcontrollers, either bare-metal or on an RTOS.

 - Comfort with hardware/software integration, including reading schematics and using tools like oscilloscopes and logic analyzers to bring up new hardware.

 - A solid understanding of microcontroller and microprocessor architecture, including memory, buses, and DMA.

 - FPGA development experience.

 - Experience bringing up new avionics or flight hardware from first power-on.

 - Experience with satellite attitude control systems (ACS), including reaction wheels, magnetorquers, and small thrusters, and sensors

 - Experience driving motors and power electronics or reading feedback sensors such as encoders and current monitors.

 - Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.

 - Experience with real-time software on distributed hardware platforms across multiple satellite products.

 - Knowledge of embedded and real-time operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, Yocto, Buildroot, FreeRTOS, VxWorks).

 - Experience writing and debugging low-level device drivers for hardware interfaces (e.g., SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, CAN, SpaceWire).

 - Familiarity with satellite communication standards and protocols (e.g., CCSDS, ECSS).

 - Familiarity with networking and secure communications (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, TLS), data serialization (e.g., Protobuf, JSON, MessagePack), and encryption (e.g., AES, RSA).

 - Experience translating requirements into technical solutions, defining technical roadmaps, and coordinating with cross-functional engineering teams to support project execution.

 - Experience supporting spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations.

 - Experience with version control, configuration management, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for software build, deployment, and release.


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.




YOUR ROLE

Compute is the scarcest input in AI, and the companies that secure it on the right terms will define the next decade. But the labs and enterprises we work with are not buying GPU hours. They are buying the ability to execute an AI roadmap: train the next model, post-train it on their own data, serve it in production, and do it again. Selling to them means understanding that roadmap and structuring a multi-year commitment around it.

As a Strategic Account Executive, you will own strategic customer acquisition and expansion for Prime Intellect's GPU infrastructure and Model Factory platform. You will build and close a portfolio of AI-native and enterprise accounts, working with CTOs, Heads of AI/ML, infrastructure leaders, and economic buyers to translate their training, post-training, and inference plans into committed capacity. You will construct deals around spend, term, workload expansion, and platform adoption — not feature checklists — and then grow every landed customer from compute into the full training stack.

You will work alongside our Solutions Architects on discovery, benchmarks, and POCs, and directly with leadership on the commercial structures that define how this category gets sold. The deals you close will shape what Prime Intellect commits to, builds, and becomes.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Acquisition

 - Build and close a portfolio of strategic AI-native and enterprise accounts

 - Develop relationships with CTOs, Heads of AI/ML, infrastructure leaders, and economic buyers

 - Translate customers' training, post-training, and inference roadmaps into multi-year GPU capacity commitments

 - Partner with Solutions Architects on technical discovery, benchmarks, and POCs so every deal is won on proof

Deal Construction & Expansion

 - Build commercial proposals around committed spend, term length, workload expansion, and Model Factory adoption

 - Negotiate and close seven- and eight-figure agreements with economics that work for both sides

 - Expand landed compute customers into Model Factory, post-training, inference, and additional capacity

 - Partner with Compute and Finance on supply, pricing, and margin so what you sell is what we can deliver

Pipeline Discipline

 - Maintain rigorous qualification, forecasting, and next-step discipline across the portfolio

 - Report pipeline, forecast, and deal status to leadership with accuracy you stand behind

 - Feed market, competitive, and customer signal back into product, pricing, and compute strategy




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven success selling highly technical infrastructure: cloud, GPU compute, AI/ML platforms, or adjacent developer infrastructure

 - Experience closing seven-figure enterprise agreements; eight-figure strongly preferred

 - Credibility with technical executives and ML/infrastructure teams — you can hold the room with a Head of AI and an engineer at the same time

 - Ability to sell economics, architecture, and strategic partnership, not just software features

 - Strong deal construction and negotiation skills, including multi-year commitments and consumption-based structures

 - Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-accountability environment where you own the number

 - High ownership — you see gaps and build the fix before anyone asks

 - AI-native in how you work: you use LLMs, automation, and programmatic tools to move faster

Bonus:

 - Experience selling GPU capacity, reserved compute, or AI training infrastructure specifically

 - Background at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler AI organization, or AI platform company

 - Existing relationships with AI labs, AI-native startups, or enterprise AI leaders

 - Experience as an early sales hire who helped define the playbook, pricing, and segmentation




HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

Committed contract value · Contract duration · New strategic customers · GPU capacity sold · Model Factory attach · Post-training and inference expansion · Forecast accuracy




WHY THIS ROLE

You will sell one of the most consequential products in technology to the people building the next generation of AI, in a market where the commercial playbook is still being written. You will work directly with leadership on deal structures that define the category, develop a network across the labs and enterprises shaping the industry, and build a track record in AI infrastructure sales that is increasingly rare and valuable.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - On-target earnings of $225–$300k++ and meaningful equity

 - Flexible work (remote or San Francisco), with travel to customers as needed

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Professional development budget

 - Team off-sites and conferences

 - A front-row seat to building the infrastructure layer for open AI

jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.




YOUR ROLE

Every serious AI team evaluating infrastructure asks the same question: will this actually run my workload better, faster, or cheaper than what I have today? Most vendors answer with slides. We want to answer with benchmarks on the customer's own workload, and then design the production architecture that delivers on them.

As our Founding Solutions Architect, your mission is to make Prime Intellect the technical winner in every deal. You will own the path from workload discovery through architecture, benchmark, proof of concept, and production design. You will sit with customers' ML engineers to understand what they are actually training and serving — GPU type, cluster requirements, networking, utilization and performance objectives — then design the right architecture on Prime infrastructure, run the POC against their baseline and the competitive alternatives, and turn latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a technical business case that holds up under scrutiny.

This is a founding role. There is no playbook yet for how we prove technical wins; you will write it. The benchmark methodologies, reference architectures, and POC frameworks you build will become how Prime Intellect sells to every lab and enterprise that follows.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Discovery & Architecture

 - Lead deep technical discovery across training, post-training, and inference workloads

 - Understand each customer's GPU requirements, cluster topology, networking, storage, utilization patterns, and performance objectives

 - Design customer architectures on Prime infrastructure that meet those objectives and are ready for production

 - Partner with engineering on migration and deployment requirements so what we design is what gets shipped

Benchmarks, POCs & the Technical Business Case

 - Own workload benchmarks and proofs of concept against customer baselines and competitive alternatives

 - Translate latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a defensible technical business case for ML engineers and executive buyers alike

 - Set the standard for benchmark quality: methodology, reproducibility, and honest comparison

 - Drive time to technical validation down with every deal

Playbooks & Platform Adoption

 - Develop repeatable benchmark and reference-architecture playbooks that scale beyond you

 - Support technical evaluation and adoption of Model Factory, bringing customers from compute onto the full training stack

 - Feed what you learn from customer workloads back into product and research priorities




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong ML infrastructure, distributed systems, cloud, or GPU-compute background

 - Working knowledge of modern training and inference stacks, CUDA/GPU environments, and model-serving patterns

 - Customer-facing experience in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a similar role

 - Ability to communicate fluently with both ML engineers and executive stakeholders — and to know which conversation you are in

 - A strong bias toward proving claims with real customer workloads and benchmarks rather than slides

 - High ownership — you see gaps and build the fix before anyone asks

 - AI-native in how you work: you use LLMs, automation, and programmatic tools to move faster

Bonus:

 - Hands-on experience running or optimizing large-scale distributed training (FSDP, Megatron, DeepSpeed, or similar) or high-throughput inference (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)

 - Experience benchmarking across hardware generations (H100, H200, GB200) and interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE)

 - Background at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler AI team, or frontier lab infrastructure team

 - Experience building a solutions or forward-deployed function from scratch




HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

Technical win rate · POC-to-commercial conversion · Time to technical validation · Benchmark quality · Deployment readiness · Model Factory technical attach




WHY THIS ROLE

You will be the technical face of Prime Intellect in every deal that matters, working directly with the ML teams at labs and enterprises deciding where to build — and with our own research and engineering teams on what the platform needs to win. You will see more real-world training and inference workloads in a year than most engineers see in a career, and you will define how a new category of infrastructure proves itself.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Flexible work (remote or San Francisco), with travel to customer sites as needed

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Professional development budget

 - Team off-sites and conferences

Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Preclinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
Senior Research Associate, Preclinical Pharmacology

Run in vivo studies that move Nurix's degrader programs toward the clinic. You'll execute mouse efficacy, PK/PD, and mechanism-of-action studies in oncology and inflammation models and generate the Western blot and flow cytometry data that show how our molecules work.

Position Description

The Opportunity

• Join the Research – Preclinical Pharmacology team as a full-time, onsite, hands-on member, reporting to a Scientist / Principal Scientist, Preclinical Pharmacology

• Perform mouse handling and in-life procedures, including dosing by oral (PO), intraperitoneal (IP), subcutaneous (SC), and intravenous (IV) routes, tumor cell implantation, tumor and body-weight measurements, and in-life and terminal blood collection

• Execute PK/PD, tolerability, and efficacy studies in oncology xenograft/syngeneic models and in murine models of inflammation, under the direction of study leads

• Prepare and formulate test articles and vehicles for dosing; monitor animal health, document observations, and escalate adverse events promptly

• Perform necropsy and collect, process, and bank tissues and blood for downstream biomarker and pharmacodynamic analyses

• Prepare tissue and cell lysates and perform Western blotting (including quantitative and automated capillary formats) to measure target degradation and pathway modulation

• Develop, run, and analyze multi-color flow cytometry panels for immune and tumor-cell phenotyping from blood, spleen, tumor, and other tissues

• Maintain and expand cell lines using sterile cell culture technique; support cell-based assays and the generation of cells for in vivo implantation

• Record experiments accurately and in a timely manner in the electronic lab notebook; analyze, graph, and summarize data and present results at team meetings

• Collaborate with Biology, Chemistry, DMPK, and Translational teams to design studies and troubleshoot models and assays

• Adhere to IACUC protocols, animal welfare regulations, and laboratory safety requirements, and maintain required training and certifications

• Contribute to the optimization and qualification of new models and assays and to the training of junior team members

• Maintain laboratory equipment and supplies and support vivarium coordination, including occasional weekend or off-shift study coverage; other essential duties as assigned; minimal travel (<5%)

What You’ll Bring

• BS/MS in Biology, Pharmacology, Immunology, Cancer Biology, or a related field, with a BS or equivalent plus 8 or more years of relevant experience, or an MS plus 4 or more years of relevant experience

• Industry (biotech or pharma) experience conducting in vivo pharmacology studies in mice

• Proficiency in mouse handling and dosing by PO, IP, SC, and IV routes, as well as blood collection and tissue harvest

• Hands-on experience with oncology models (e.g., xenograft, syngeneic) and with murine models of inflammation or immunology

• Demonstrated proficiency in Western blotting and flow cytometry, including sample preparation, staining, and data analysis

• Proficiency in sterile mammalian cell culture technique

• Working knowledge of IACUC regulations and humane animal care practices

• Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple studies simultaneously

• Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-paced, team-oriented research environment

• Ability to work in an animal facility and tolerate exposure to laboratory animals, and to work occasional weekends or off-shift hours as studies require

• Bonus: experience with targeted protein degradation (molecular glues, PROTACs) or other small-molecule oncology or immunology programs

• Bonus: experience with multi-spectral flow cytometry, automated Western (e.g., Jess/Wes), ELISA, or MSD cytokine/biomarker assays

• Bonus: experience with orthotopic, disseminated, PDX, or humanized mouse models, or with in vivo imaging

• Bonus: experience with inflammation models such as collagen-induced arthritis, colitis, or cytokine-challenge models

• Bonus: familiarity with PK/PD relationships, compound formulation, and dose-response study design

• Bonus: proficiency with GraphPad Prism and electronic lab notebook systems

Salary Range:  $131,400 - $139,900

About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Job Summary:

Ennoble Care is hiring for a full-time, Hospice Registered Nurse Case Manager who can work within the Camden County, NJ region. As a member of the interdisciplinary team, the RN Case Manager works under the general direction of the Director of Nursing, the attending physician and the interdisciplinary group in providing skilled nursing assessments, planning, and care in order to maximize the comfort and health of both patients and their loved ones/caregivers.  The RN Case Manager will be responsible for identifying patient and loved ones/caregiver needs and for providing supportive care in accordance with the attending physician’s orders and plan of care and the policies and procedures.

Responsibilities:

• Shall be assigned patient caseload by the Patient Care Coordinator or designee

• Assume primary responsibility for a patient caseload that includes the assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating phases of the nursing process

• Initiate communication with attending physicians, Hospice staff members and other agencies as needed to coordinate optimal care and use of resources for the patient and loved ones/caregivers

• Maintain regular communication with the attending physician concerning patient and loved ones/caregivers

• Seek input from other team members regarding the patient plan of care to obtain additional knowledge and support

• Provide accurate and timely documentation in electronic medical records.

• Participates in and contributes appropriate information for Interdisciplinary Group meetings

• Accept responsibility for coordinating physical care of the patient by teaching primary caregivers, volunteers, and employed caregivers or by providing direct care as appropriate

• Meet regularly with the Hospice nursing staff to review problems or unique issues from caseloads; share professional support; and exchange feedback aimed toward enhancing professional growth

• Attend patient care conferences and facilitate discussion of issues from caseload for full staff discussion, consultation and evaluation

• Supervise and document the NAC every two weeks or as assigned

• Inform the Patient Care Coordinator of unusual or potentially problematic patient/family issues

• Assume the role of associate nurse when responding to patient/loved ones/caregivers of other primary nurses during on-call time or as requested by the Patient Care Coordinator to fill patient/family needs during the absence of other primary nurses

• Provide appropriate support at time of death and period of bereavement

• Participate in the Hospice orientation and in-service training programs for professional staff

• Participate in agency and community programs as required to promote professional growth and understanding of hospice care

• Maintain familiarity with policies of the agency and rules and regulations of State and Federal bodies which govern hospice

• Accept other assignments as appropriate

Qualifications:

• Must be a graduate from an accredited School of Nursing.

• Must be licensed in NJ as a Registered Nurse by New Jersey State Board of Nursing in accordance with NJSA 45:11-23 et seq and NJAC 13:37.

• One year of RN experience. Hospice experience preferred.

• Must have excellent assessment skills and problem solving skills.

• Should be skillful in organization and in the principles of time management and have knowledge of case management processes.

jobs.title: Red Team Engineer, Product Security
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Red Team Engineer, you will attack our own products the way a capable adversary would: spacecraft, ground stations, cloud command-and-control software, and the pipelines and factory processes that produce them. You will run our internal assessments, lead the outside firms we bring in, build testing tools that keep up the pressure between assessments, and bring an attacker's perspective into design reviews while there is still time to change the design.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an audit, compliance, or security policy role.



About the Team

Apex builds spacecraft, the flight software that runs them, the ground systems and cloud software used to command them, and the test equipment and emulators used to develop them. In this industry a security failure can cost an entire mission, so we try to find the weaknesses before anyone else does.

Product Security is a small team with a big footprint. You would be its second core member, working directly with the Product Security Architect and alongside security engineers embedded in our flight software, ground software, and development infrastructure teams.



Responsibilities

 - Plan and run adversary emulation against our spacecraft, flight software, ground systems, and development pipeline, using SPARTA and MITRE ATT&CK to structure the work.

 - Look for attack paths that cross system boundaries, such as a ground-system compromise that leads to control of a spacecraft, instead of testing each component in isolation.

 - Lead our third-party security assessments: set the scope, give the testers the environments and engineering support they need, and bring their results together with our own.

 - Design and build our fuzzing and automated testing capability, including agent-driven test generation, so testing runs with every release and not just once a year.

 - Reverse engineer firmware and protocols, analyze embedded hardware interfaces, and review how cryptography is implemented.

 - Join design reviews and technical trade-offs to show how a proposed design could be attacked before it is built.

 - Co-chair our product security incident response process, helping triage reported vulnerabilities and coordinate fixes.

 - Work with engineering teams to fix the root causes of what you find and help other engineers learn to think like attackers.



Requirements

 - US Citizenship

 - 3-10 years of hands-on offensive security experience in penetration testing, red teaming, exploit development, or vulnerability research.

 - Track record of building your own tools, harnesses, or automation when nothing off the shelf would do the job.

 - Experience combining several smaller weaknesses into a realistic attack path.

 - Solid fundamentals in operating systems, networking, and applied cryptography, and comfort reading and debugging code you have not seen before.

 - Ability to own a technical project from start to finish with little direction.

 - Clear communication, whether walking an engineer through a fix or explaining risk to leadership.



Preferred

 - Experience with embedded or cyber-physical systems in space, aerospace, automotive, robotics, industrial/OT, medical devices, or autonomous vehicles.

 - Experience building fuzzing harnesses for embedded or protocol targets, and working with RTOS, embedded Linux, or hardware interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, SPI, I2C, or CAN.

 - Experience with AI-assisted security testing.

 - Familiarity with RF and satellite command links, GNSS spoofing and jamming, or ground station architecture.

 - Experience scoping or directing the work of outside assessment firms.

 - Public work such as CVEs, published research, conference talks, or CTF results, or space security training such as the Hack The Box Satellite Exploitation track.

 - Eligibility for a U.S. security clearance. An active clearance is not required, and the role focuses on unclassified work.



Other info

 - Reports to: Product Security Architect.

 - Level: Senior individual contributor. We will also consider strong mid-level candidates with deep hands-on experience.



#LI-RC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Developers and enterprises build on Claude through the Claude Platform. Our models are getting exponentially more intelligent, and our APIs and developer tools need to evolve just as quickly so developers can take advantage of that intelligence safely.

We're hiring Engineering Managers to lead teams that build these APIs and developer tools. We are shipping APIs and infrastructure for building and running agents in production. These APIs ship alongside SDKs, docs, and tooling that developers (and agents!) utilize in order to build high quality integrations. These abstractions are backed by our identity, verification, and trust platform, which lets us scale access to Claude responsibly.

Key responsibilities

• Lead a team of engineers to ship high quality work quickly, owning planning, prioritization, delivery, and operational health

• Partner with product to set your team's roadmap, and bring a strong point of view on what developers need

• Talk to customers directly and turn what you learn into engineering priorities

• Guide API design and architecture decisions for distributed systems that have to stay reliable as usage grows

• Work closely with Research, Safeguards, Security, and go-to-market teams to bring new model capabilities to developers safely

• Recruit, coach, and grow strong engineers

Minimum qualifications

• You have experience managing high-performing software engineering teams shipping developer products, including hiring, coaching, and performance management

• You're product-minded and customer-oriented. You care about who uses what your team builds, and you've shaped roadmaps alongside product partners

• You've built and scaled distributed systems in production, and you have the technical depth required to guide architecture and API design

• You've led teams that ship quickly and hold a high quality bar

• You collaborate well across functions and can align teams you don't manage

• You care about Anthropic's mission and about developing AI safely

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building agent infrastructure or products on top of LLMs

• Experience with identity, verification, access control, or trust and safety systems

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Job Summary:
The Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) plays a specialized and highly skilled role within Hope Services’ clinical framework, working directly with a Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). The RBT is responsible for implementing individualized behavior intervention plans for clients with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) who exhibit complex and often severe behavioral challenges. This role requires a deep understanding of applied behavior analysis (ABA), strong observational and data collection skills, and the capacity to navigate emotionally intense and physically demanding situations with professionalism and therapeutic intent. The RBT is integral to achieving measurable improvements in clients’ quality of life through consistent, ethical, and client-centered behavioral interventions.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Clinical Implementation and Monitoring
-Execute behavior intervention plans (BIPs) with precision and fidelity as directed
by a BCBA, incorporating real-time adaptations based on behavioral
responses.
-Provide intensive 1:1 support to individuals exhibiting challenging behaviors
such as aggression, self-injury, property destruction, or elopement, utilizing
proactive and reactive strategies rooted in ABA principles.
-Implement structured skill acquisition programs designed to build daily living
skills, emotional regulation, communication, and functional independence.
-Conduct and document daily therapeutic sessions, accurately recording
behavior data, antecedents, consequences, and client responses to
interventions.
Data Records and Documentation
-Maintain meticulous and objective data records used for ongoing assessment,
program modification, and interdisciplinary decision-making.
-Identify behavioral patterns, inconsistencies, or emergent issues based on
graphed data and collaborate in team discussions to address them.
-Administer preference assessments and contribute to functional behavior
assessments (FBAs) through structured observation and data sharing.
Crisis Prevention and Management
-Apply approved crisis prevention and intervention techniques (e.g., CPI or
PRO-ACT) to de-escalate unsafe situations while maintaining client dignity
and safety.
-Demonstrate sound judgment and composure in high-stress incidents, using
therapeutic rapport and established protocols to support behavioral recovery.
Collaboration and Teamwork
-Participate actively in clinical supervision, interdisciplinary meetings, family
training sessions, and behavior plan review discussions.
-Support seamless coordination of services by communicating client needs and
progress clearly with family members, coworkers, and other professionals
involved in care.
Professional Growth and Ethical Practice
-Engage in regular training to maintain RBT certification and stay current on best
practices in ABA and trauma-informed care.
-Uphold ethical standards outlined by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board
(BACB), including maintaining professional boundaries and client
confidentiality.
-Perform other duties as assigned.
 
Required Qualifications:
Associate’s degree and current certification as a Registered Behavior Technician (RBT).
Minimum of two years’ experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD), or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
 
Required Skills and Knowledge:
-Deep understanding of ABA terminology, reinforcement systems, and data-driven intervention models.
-Proven ability to work effectively in community-based environments with diverse
clients and behavioral profiles.
-Ability to interpret BIPs and translate technical guidance into compassionate,
real-world support.
-Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and data collection software used in ABA
practice.
-Strong organizational and communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability
to manage emotional demands of the job and demonstrate resilience and
empathy.
-Skilled in maintaining accurate documentation, safeguarding confidential
information, and responding appropriately in emergencies.
 
Environmental Conditions:
Work is conducted in both office and community-based settings, including homes, schools, and public environments. The role may require:
·       Standing, bending, kneeling, or physically assisting clients during 
 interventions.
·       Exposure to unpredictable behavior, emotional outbursts, or 
 environmental hazards.
·       Occasional outdoor work or travel between client locations.
·       Participation in sessions requiring physical stamina and emotional 
 maturity.
 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

You will be joining Valar Atomics' Electrical Engineering team within the Instrumentation, Control & Electrical (IC&E) organization. The team delivers the electrical infrastructure that powers Valar's facilities from utility interconnection through MV distribution, process area LV systems, and emergency power across the reactor program and fuel manufacturing operations. You will work alongside I&C, mechanical, process, and nuclear safety engineers in a hands-on environment where power system integrity directly supports production reliability and nuclear safety, with the opportunity to work on some of the most technically interesting power distribution challenges in the advanced nuclear sector. The team values technical depth, disciplined documentation, speed, and a safety-first culture.

The Role

Valar Atomics is seeking Senior Electrical Engineers to design and engineer the medium voltage (MV) and low voltage (LV) electrical systems for our reactor and nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role spans the full electrical discipline scope from power system studies through equipment specification, protection design, installation, and commissioning support covering capital project execution and ongoing plant operations. This is a senior position: you will own an electrical scope end-to-end, from studies and specifications through energization, and provide technical direction to contractors, vendors, and junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain electrical load lists; perform power system studies including load flow, short circuit (ANSI/IEC), voltage drop, motor starting, and harmonic analysis using SKM Power Tools, ETAP, or equivalent.

• Prepare arc flash hazard analysis to IEEE 1584; develop substation grounding calculations to IEEE 80; size transformers, cables, switchgear buses, capacitor banks, and UPS/battery systems.

• Develop single line diagrams for MV and LV distribution systems from utility interface through to MCCs and final distribution boards; prepare equipment arrangement and layout drawings, cable schedules, tray routing, and underground duct bank designs.

• Specify MV switchgear, LV switchboards, MCCs, distribution panelboards, transformers, bus ducts, VFDs, UPS systems, and standby generator packages; prepare electrical area classification drawings and specify hazardous area equipment to NEC/CEC 500 or IEC 60079 series.

• Prepare protection relay settings studies and time-current coordination plots for MV systems; specify protection relays and metering equipment; develop relay panel arrangement drawings, DC control schematics, and MCC control wiring diagrams.

• Prepare technical specifications and data sheets for electrical equipment; evaluate vendor bids; review vendor drawings, type test reports, and quality plans; witness factory acceptance tests.

• Lead vendor pre-qualification, technical bid evaluation, and award recommendation for major electrical packages; manage vendor document review cycles; lead factory audits for safety-related or nuclear-classified equipment.

• Prepare electrical installation specifications; support pre-commissioning activities including insulation testing, continuity checks, relay secondary injection, and equipment energisation; respond to site technical queries.

• Coordinate with I&C engineers on motor and drive control interfaces; coordinate with civil and structural disciplines on substation layout and cable penetration requirements.

jobs.title: SVP, Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description:

Its clinical-stage portfolio includes programs for chronic hepatitis delta and multiple PRO-XTEN® dual-masked T-cell engagers across validated targets in solid tumor indications. Vir Biotechnology also has a preclinical portfolio of programs across a range of infectious diseases and oncologic malignancies.

Vir Biotechnology has exclusive rights to the universal PRO-XTEN® masking platform for oncology and infectious disease. PRO-XTEN® is a trademark of Amunix Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a Sanofi company.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as the company's most senior regulatory leader, providing strategic counsel to executive leadership and influencing key portfolio, development, and business decisions

A highly experienced, strategic, and collaborative regulatory leader will thrive in this role. jobs.title: GTM Senior Solutions Consultant (Presales)
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

At Apollo, Senior Solutions Consultants don't just support deals, they shape them. This role sits at the intersection of revenue, product, and the customer, directly influencing how Apollo wins, retains, and expands its most strategic accounts. As a trusted technical and strategic advisor across the full customer lifecycle, this person drives complex, high-stakes deals forward, accelerates time-to-value, and influences long-term business outcomes for our customers. This person is not only an expert in solution architecture, but they also serve as player-coach who scales the impact of the SC function through mentorship, strategic influence, and repeatable playbooks and tools.

You will partner with AEs and AMs, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to architect end-to-end solutions, from discovery through customer onboarding and expansion. You will also help scale the Solution Consulting team by building repeatable playbooks and tools, documenting best practices, and mentoring peers.

What You’ll Do

• Discovery & Value Selling – Lead technical and business discovery to uncover pain, success metrics, and buying criteria. Align Apollo’s platform to ROI, operational efficiency, and revenue impact through tailored narratives and demos, presenting confidently to technical and non-technical executive audiences.

• Sales Partnership – Co-own complex deals with AEs by collaborating on deal strategy with a strong, informed point of view to influence stakeholders, navigate buying committees, and mitigate evaluation risk through deep cross-functional engagement.

• POC & Trial Execution – Design and run POC-based trials that validate business impact early, identify leading indicator success metrics, and accelerate decision-making. Facilitate the pre-sale to post-sale handoff to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion readiness for our customers.

• Technical Discovery & Solution Design – Engage technical stakeholders to design scalable, secure integrations. Produce system diagrams, data flows, and architecture recommendations that align with buyer objectives. Leverage REST APIs, CRM/marketing automation, and tools like Zapier or Workato to integrate Apollo into the GTM stack, decreasing customer time-to-value and long-term scalability.

• Product Strategy – Serve as the voice of the customer, advising on go-to-market solution optimization and surfacing actionable feedback from the field to influence product roadmap priorities, GTM strategy, and how Apollo wins and retains customers.

• Full-funnel Solution Management & Tooling – Co-create solutions that drive adoption, manage process change, and work closely with Onboarding and Success teams to mitigate post-sale risk and ensure customers achieve measurable value.

• Mentorship & Enablement – Coach peers on discovery, demos, and technical and solution strategy – while contributing to internal enablement sessions, building playbooks, demo environments, and competitive resources that elevate team performance and accelerate deals.

What We’re Looking For

• 8+ years in presales (Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Technical Success) with a track record of owning and influencing complex, high-stakes SaaS deals in a GTM technology environment.

• At least 4+ years of demonstrated experience selling to Enterprise-level accounts.

• Proven ability to lead technical solution validation with a consultative, customer-obsessed approach: Live our be customer obsessed value by deeply understanding each strategic account's goals to reduce evaluation risk, accelerate sales velocity, and put customer success at the center of every engagement.

• Experience with integration-heavy customer lifecycles within the sales tech stack ecosystem. Fluency with REST APIs, CRMs, data pipelines, and sales/marketing automation tools, with the ability to design scalable, integration-rich solutions.

• Executive-level communication skills: able to present credibly to VP- and C-level stakeholders by leveraging storytelling skills while adapting technical depth to the audience.

• Cross-functional Operator: proven ability to partner effectively with Sales, Customer-Onboarding, Success, Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver measurable customer outcomes and live our be “all for one” value.

• AI-Native Mentality: You have a demonstrated track record of taking extreme ownership, by embracing AI technology not as a nice-to-have but as a core part of how you work, backed by a builder’s mindset for applying AI in innovative ways to work smarter and solve problems faster.

Nice to Have

• Past experience at a fast-growing PLG or hybrid go-to-market SaaS company.

• Proven success as a player-coach: mentoring peers across both presales and cross-functional teams, contributing scalable assets, and elevating team performance.

• Recognized as a thought leader in sales technology, marketing automation, leveraging AI, or with RevOps best practices.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Marketing Activation - Dolls (US)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Support the development and execution of commercial marketing strategies for the Dolls portfolio across the United States. The Associate Marketing Manager will translate global brand strategies into locally relevant activation plans that drive brand growth, consumer engagement, and commercial performance across key retailers and omnichannel partners.

This role serves as a key cross-functional partner across Global Brand Marketing, Sales, Omnichannel Retail Marketing, Demand Planning, Consumer Insights, Finance, Licensing, and Retail customers to develop and execute integrated marketing programs that deliver business results.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, strong business acumen, project management excellence, analytical rigor, and exceptional communication skills. They are comfortable leading cross-functional initiatives, translating data into recommendations, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Marketing Planning & Activation

• Partner with the Senior Marketing Manager to develop integrated commercial marketing plans that translate global brand strategies into successful US activation plans.
• Lead the development of retailer and consumer activation plans, marketing briefs, launch strategies, and promotional calendars across assigned brands.
• Develop activation strategies that align with brand objectives, commercial priorities, retailer opportunities, and consumer insights.
• Manage execution of marketing initiatives across retail activations, partnerships, promotional events, and omnichannel campaigns.
• Define project timelines, key deliverables, success metrics, and cross-functional responsibilities to ensure flawless execution.
• Identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through innovation, new activation approaches, and learnings from previous programs.

Retail & Sales Support

• Partner closely with Sales, Omnichannel Retail Marketing, and retailer teams to develop customer-specific marketing plans that drive distribution, velocity, and category growth.
• Serve as the marketing expert for assigned brands, maintaining a comprehensive understanding of every SKU including product features, pricing, launch timing, retailer distribution, embargo dates, promotional support, historical performance, POS trends, and business objectives.
• Develop retailer presentations, seasonal selling materials, customer marketing plans, and business updates that support retailer line reviews and selling initiatives.
• Lead execution of retailer-exclusive programs, promotional events, and channel-specific marketing activations.
• Gather retailer feedback and marketplace insights to influence future commercial strategies.

Business Performance & Insights

• Analyze POS performance, retail trends, consumer insights, competitive activity, and category performance to identify business opportunities and risks.
• Monitor performance of marketing activations and recommend optimizations to maximize commercial results.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

The Team:

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly.
