• Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.

• Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

• Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

• Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

• Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

• Full-stack experience designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, or Node.js.

• Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend or full-stack projects in production.

• Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience serving as the frontend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical product surface.

• Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

• Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

• Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

• Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

• Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

• Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.description:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com.  Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

About the role

HeyGen is looking for an AI video creator who already lives on the frontier of generative video and has a portfolio to prove it. You’ll produce the videos that show the world what HeyGen can do: platform demos, campaign content, social-first videos, and internal projects, from concept to final cut. HeyGen and HyperFrames are your primary tools, but every other model in the stack is there to feed them. This is a full-time contractor role with the opportunity to convert to a permanent position based on performance.  We are an in-office work environment.

What you’ll do

• Produce high-quality AI video for campaigns, internal projects, and platform demos, from concept to final cut, with HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames at the center of the pipeline

• Build HyperFrames projects that render deterministic, editable video, and pair them with HeyGen avatars, voices, and translations to deliver finished assets

• Maintain deep, current expertise across MCPs and generative video models (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Hailuo, Wan, Pika) and know each model’s strengths, limits, and sweet spots, and when to route footage into a HeyGen or HyperFrames pipeline

• Develop advanced prompting techniques and multi-step pipelines that consistently produce realistic results, and build prompt libraries the team can reuse

• Build scroll-stopping hooks in the first 3 seconds and deliver multiple hook and creative variations so the team can test what performs

• Write short concepts, shot lists, storyboards, and prompts, and plan scenes before generating so every video has a clear idea

• Combine AI footage with traditional editing (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut): captions, subtitles, transitions, effects, basic color, and sound design

• Reframe and export every piece in the right format and aspect ratio (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube

• Experiment relentlessly: test new models and HeyGen features on release day, benchmark outputs, and turn findings into content ideas and team playbooks

• Track short-form trends, formats, and sounds and quickly turn them into content

Who you are

• Strong visual eye and storytelling instinct. Your videos communicate, not just impress

• Hands-on with HeyGen and HyperFrames: you can take a brief from blank page to rendered MP4 using HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames projects, and you have work that shows it

• 1+ years creating AI video content (professional, freelance, or prolific personal practice) with a portfolio to prove it

• Active creator with 10k+ followers on at least one platform (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X).

• Encyclopedic knowledge of current generative video models and a clear POV on when to use which

• Exceptional prompting skills: you understand how language and parameters translate to visual output across architectures

• Experience building agent-driven video workflows (HyperFrames skills, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI)

• Experience with traditional video editing Premiere, After Effects, CapCut)

Contractor Salary Range: $5,000-10,000/month

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only.  HeyGen considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, as well as location, market and business considerations when extending an offer.

HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join us at HeyGen and be part of a team that's making visual storytelling accessible to all!

jobs.title: Staff Project Manager AI product engineering
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Algorithm, Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll shape the next phase of Airwallex’s growth by building data science systems that improve how we acquire, activate, engage, retain, and expand customers globally.

 - Design, deploy, and iterate on predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, LLM-powered applications, incentive optimization frameworks, and causal inference models that drive measurable business outcomes.

 - Partner with Growth, Marketing, Product, Sales, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to turn data and AI into clear recommendations, stronger investment decisions, and effective go-to-market strategies.

 - Measure the causal impact of marketing and growth initiatives, identify what’s working, and translate those findings into action.

 - Raise the technical bar for the data science team through hands-on leadership, mentorship, and a clear vision for longer-term direction.

You’ll be based in Seattle and work from the office three days a week.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 7+ years of industry experience and an advanced degree, such as a PhD or MS, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, the Sciences, Computer Science, or Economics.

 - Expert knowledge of machine learning and statistical modelling for data-driven growth strategy.

 - Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models in production-grade systems, including cloud-based services and real-time or batch pipelines.

 - Strong experience with data querying languages such as SQL and scripting languages such as Python.

 - Experience applying machine learning and statistical models to measure the causal impact of marketing or growth initiatives.

 - Strong experience in AI harness and building AI agents.

 


PREFERRED

 - Experience with schema design and dimensional data modelling.

 - Experience communicating analysis and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams to influence strategy.

 - Experience in technology, financial services, or a high-growth environment.

 - Experience providing technical mentorship on machine learning and experimentation in an industry setting.
   
    


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You're not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.
   
    


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Data Science at Airwallex is evolving from individual analyses and standalone models into scalable systems of decision and action. We bring together two complementary capabilities: DS Analytics, which improves decision quality and reduces decision latency, and DS Algorithm, which directly optimizes product and business outcomes in real time.

You’ll build systems of decision that help teams understand what changed, determine what to do next, and learn whether the action worked. This means owning the AI analytics harness around the analysis—including semantic layers, context retrieval, evaluation infrastructure, validation gates, and governance—so decisions remain reliable, contextualized, and trustworthy at scale.

You’ll also build systems of action that use machine learning and AI to shape product behavior, ranking, pricing, risk, allocation, and customer experiences. The work extends beyond training models to designing how intelligent systems reason, use tools, operate within guardrails, execute workflows, and measure their incremental impact.

As AI makes ad hoc analysis increasingly accessible, the remaining advantage is scale, scientific method, and rigor. You’ll structure ambiguous problems, design experiments, identify confounding factors, challenge misleading conclusions, and build production systems that produce reliable outcomes repeatedly—not just one-off answers.

The work is moving up the stack: from analysis to system, from model to harness, and from answering a question once to building something that answers it correctly over time. If you want to create data science systems that compound decision quality and turn intelligence into measurable action, this is where that work happens.

 


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
BRAND DESIGNER



Firecrawl ships fast, and right now our visuals can’t keep up. We need a designer with real taste who makes every launch look as good as the product behind it. You’ll partner with our product marketing lead to build the brand system from the ground up, fill its library with on-brand motion and illustration, and help concept every launch we ship. This is a high-impact seat: your work will be the first thing millions of developers see from us. You’re a designer first, you care deeply about craft, and you use AI to make more, better, faster.



Salary Range: $196,000–$220,000 USD/year

Equity Range: Competitive equity. Details shared during the process.

Location: San Francisco, CA (SF HQ). In office 3+ days a week.

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 5+ years

Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States. We support candidates already in the US who need a transfer or existing status (H-1B transfers, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT), plus TN and E-3. We’re not able to start new H-1B sponsorship for candidates outside the US.




ABOUT FIRECRAWL

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. It's the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

In September 2026, we raised a $75M Series B led by Smash Capital, and we're spending it building the largest repository of knowledge in the world. We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 187k+ GitHub stars, putting us in the top 40 repositories of all time, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves. No hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web. That library is called Alexandria, and it starts now.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and animate launch videos, posters, and social assets for a constant launch cadence. Visuals should never be the thing slowing a launch down

 - Help build and codify our brand system, Alloy: type, color, composition, motion principles, and the rules that make it all feel like us

 - Fill Alloy’s library with reusable, on-brand animations and illustrations the whole team can pull from

 - Get your work into code with AI agents. Alloy runs on HyperFrames, so your motion work ships as code, not just exports

 - Be a creative partner on launch concepts from the first idea, not just the person who executes the brief

 - Build your own creative tools and workflows with AI when the ones you need don’t exist yet




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A designer first. You flex across formats (motion, print, social, illustration) and have a deep feel for motion, typography, composition, and color theory. This is the hard requirement

 - Launch videos we’d actually love. You’ve made beautiful launch videos and can show us exactly what you owned on each one

 - An eye for type and color. Poster work is one of the best signals we look for

 - Truly AI-native. You’ve built your own creative tools with AI and you’re comfortable shipping work into code with agents. You see AI as a way to raise your ceiling, not a threat to your craft

 - Taste and speed together. You can make something great fast, and you know when it’s done

 - Comfortable working directly with founders. No committee, no approval layers. You’ll work hand in hand with Rhys and have a direct line to Eric, and you’ll be expected to push back, make calls, and own the outcome

 - Nice to have: After Effects fluency

Backgrounds that often do well: a brand or motion designer at an AI or devtools startup who owns launches end to end, a designer at a design-forward studio who has started building their own tools with AI, a creative technologist with a portfolio that leads with craft.




WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR

 - Engineer-shaped designers. We want a designer who can work in code, not an engineer who can design

 - Anyone skeptical of AI in creative work

 - Static-only portfolios. Motion is core to the job

 - Art directors who direct but don’t make. You’ll be hands-on every day

 - Anyone who needs a long brief and a long timeline to do great work




A NOTE ON PACE

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings, but this role probably isn't for you.




BENEFITS & PERKS




AVAILABLE TO ALL EMPLOYEES

 - Salary that makes sense: $196,000–$220,000 USD/year, based on impact, not tenure

 - Own a piece: Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build

 - Generous PTO: 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded). Take the time you need to recharge

 - Parental leave: 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents

 - Wellness stipend: $100 USD/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human

 - Learning & Development: Expense up to $1,000 USD/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally

 - Team offsites: A change of scenery, minus the trust falls

 - Sabbatical: 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new




AVAILABLE TO US-BASED FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Full coverage, no red tape: Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for partner and kids). No weird loopholes, just care that works

 - Life & Disability insurance: Employer-paid basic life and AD&D, short-term disability, and long-term disability. Coverage for life's curveballs

 - Virtual care and a health guide: Teladoc for the couch doctor visit, plus Rightway to answer coverage questions and fight billing errors for you

 - Mental health: Talkspace, therapy and psychiatry on your schedule

 - Fertility and family building: Carrot, covering you and your partner

 - EAP: Free confidential counseling, legal and financial consults, and online will prep through Guardian

 - 401(k) plan: Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you

 - Pre-tax benefits: HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits to help your wallet out a bit

 - Supplemental options: Extra life and AD&D, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, plus pet, legal, and identity protection through MetLife




AVAILABLE TO SF-BASED EMPLOYEES

 - SF HQ perks: Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

 - E-Bike transportation: A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Application Review: Send us your work: your best launch video, a poster you’re proud of, and anything you’ve built with AI (a tool, a workflow, a piece that shipped as code). For each, tell us what you personally owned.

Intro Chat (~25 min): Meet Rhys, who leads product marketing. Walk us through your portfolio, how you think about motion and type, and how AI fits into your process. Time for your questions too.

Creative Deep Dive (~60 min): Meet Eric, our co-founder and CGO. Walk us through one launch end to end: the concept, the calls you made, what you’d change. Then a live prompt: how would you take one of our recent launches further? Come ready to think out loud. We care how you reason, not whether you have a rehearsed answer.

Paid Work Trial (~40 Hours): Work on a real launch with the team: concept it, design it, animate it, and get it into code. Paid at a contractor rate. We evaluate on taste, speed, and whether we’d ship it. Remote-friendly, and we’ll flex around your current commitments.

Decision: We move fast after the trial.



If you want to define how one of the fastest-growing developer tools on the internet looks and moves, and you’d rather make the work than talk about it, this is your shot.

👉 Apply now.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Manager, Claude Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Developer Relations Manager for Claude Platform at Anthropic, you will lead the team responsible for how developers discover, onboard, build, and scale applications using the Claude Platform. This role will be pivotal in growing our developer ecosystem, gathering crucial feedback to inform product development, and ensuring our Platform is used responsibly across a diverse range of implementations.

You'll set the vision and strategy for growing and engaging Claude Platform’s developer community. Your success in this role will directly shape Anthropic's growth trajectory and market position while ensuring our APIs are used to create safe, positive outcomes. Building strong relationships between our developer community and internal teams will be essential as we advance our mission of creating safe AI.

Key responsibilities

Set the Vision and Drive Strategic Impact

• Build and execute the strategy for how developers discover and grow their integrations on the Claude Platform

• Build and execute the strategy for content the team produces to educate developers on building high quality integrations on top of the Claude Platform

• Collaborate with product and engineering leadership to ensure developer feedback informs the roadmap

• Prioritize initiatives based on data, feedback, and the needs of both developers and

Build and Lead a World-Class Team

• Pioneer the definition of what world-class developer relations looks like in this quickly evolving field

• Recruit, inspire and scale a high-impact developer relations team with global reach and representation across key markets

• Foster a collaborative culture that embodies Anthropic's values while driving innovation in how we engage developers

• Create and implement scalable processes that evolve as both the team and developer ecosystem expand

• Establish clear growth paths and development opportunities for team members that align personal advancement with delivering exceptional value

Drive Alignment and Innovation Through Cross-Functional Leadership

• Act as an advocate for Claude Platform developer needs at Anthropic, translating developer feedback into strategic initiatives

• Collaborate with Research to translate AI capabilities into accessible educational resources

• Partner with Communications and Marketing teams to amplify developer success stories

• Ensure best practices for responsible AI use are adopted by developers building on the Claude Platform

Minimum qualifications

• You have experience building and leading developer relations, developer experience, or technical product teams, with a proven track record of measurably growing developer ecosystems

• You're technically credible. You understand AI/ML and API concepts and translate complex technical ideas for various audiences ranging from individual developers to enterprise executives

• You have hands-on technical abilities. You’re capable of creating your own code demos, critically reviewing developer content for quality and best practices, and providing specific technical feedback that elevates the work of your team

• You have insight into developer psychology and behavior. You know how to reach developers through the right channels, build authentic affinity for products, and design education programs that drive meaningful adoption

• You're passionate about AI's potential and deeply committed to ensuring it's developed responsibly, with a genuine interest in AI safety and ethical considerations

• You're a collaborative leader who can influence across teams without direct authority, building strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels

• You have experience scaling teams in high-growth environments and can adapt quickly as priorities evolve

Preferred qualifications

• Experience working specifically with AI developer platforms

• Public speaking experience at industry conferences and events

• Content creation experience (technical writing, video tutorials, etc.)

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$290,000—$435,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Relocation Consultant (1099 / Japanese Language)
jobs.description:
What Relocity is Doing

Relocity is reimagining the global mobility experience. We enable enterprises to attract, retain, and engage talent globally through our unique blend of mobility software solutions and high-touch destination services. Our personalized digital transferee experience accommodates all mobile talent and is enabled by our AI-driven native mobile app and workforce mobility platform. Our core values drive us to focus on our customers, innovation, integrity, and excellence. Relocity serves thousands of cities across the United States, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at www.relocity.com.

Services You’ll Provide…

As a Relocation Consultant (1099 Contractor), you will deliver high-touch, client-facing relocation services to employees and their families as they transition into a new city. You will act as a knowledgeable local resource, offering tailored guidance and hands-on support across key aspects of the relocation experience.

This opportunity is structured around individual client engagements, with service needs varying based on market activity and client demand. Services are delivered both remotely and in-person within your local area, depending on the nature of each engagement.

Success in this role requires strong local expertise, a consultative mindset, and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements while delivering a seamless, high-quality experience.

How You’ll Deliver Value…

Build trusted relationships with relocating employees by understanding their needs, preferences, and priorities. Provide guidance on neighborhoods, transportation, and local lifestyle considerations. Conduct housing and school research, including rental market insights, commute considerations, and general suitability. Support clients with local orientation and navigation of common relocation logistics. Curate personalized recommendations for dining, social, cultural, and lifestyle activities. Deliver tailored insights and recommendations using your local expertise and available tools. Facilitate area tours (virtual or in-person), offering real-time perspective and context. Communicate with clients through phone, email, video, and/or in-person interactions. Coordinate with relevant vendors, partners, or service providers as needed to support the client experience. Manage multiple client engagements independently, ensuring organization and follow-through. Document key updates and interactions to support continuity of service.

What Enables Success in This Role…

Established presence in Atlanta, with strong knowledge of local neighborhoods, housing, and lifestyle offerings. Experience in a client-facing, service-oriented capacity (e.g., relocation services, real estate, hospitality, concierge services, mobility, or similar). Ability to operate independently and manage multiple engagements simultaneously. Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills. Professional judgment and discretion when supporting clients through complex or high-touch situations. Familiarity with local service providers, vendors, or community networks is a strong advantage. Prior experience relocating individuals or clients is preferred.

What Past Experience and Current Skills Will Enable Your Success In This Role?

• Must have the legal right to work in the USA

• Must have at least 5 years of residency in Boise with extensive knowledge of the local rental market, education system, and local registration processes.

• Must own (not rent) a reliable, registered, and insured 4-door vehicle with a valid driv er’s license, as the role involves driving clients for area tours and rental searches.

• Must be flexible and available to work weekends.

• Friendly, outgoing personality, strong customer service orientation, and problem-solving abilities.

• Must be self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Prior personal or professional relocation or moving assistance experience is preferred, but not required.

Education and/or Technology Requirement

• Bachelor or Associate’s degree (or equivalent) preferred

• Extensive experience with technology tools such as Microsoft Office, Google GSuite, and CRM systems

• Must have a laptop, smartphone, and reliable internet connection

Language Skills

• Japanese Language Fluency Required: Full professional fluency in both Japanese and English is mandatory, with the ability to communicate confidently, accurately, and naturally in both languages, verbally and in writing. Conversational proficiency alone is not sufficient.

• Ability to read and interpret documents such as contracts, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

• Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

• Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of an organization.

Nature of Engagement

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. Contractors are engaged on a per-assignment basis, with service volume varying by client demand and market activity. There is no guarantee of ongoing or minimum volume of work. Contractors maintain discretion over how services are delivered, in alignment with client needs and engagement expectations. Contractors are responsible for maintaining any required licenses, insurance, or local compliance applicable to their services.

Additional Considerations

Strong familiarity with the local market is essential to delivering a high-quality client experience. This opportunity is well-suited for individuals already operating in a client-facing or service-based capacity within their local market. Compensation varies based on location, scope, and complexity of each engagement

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to run hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK scales globally.

Hiring sets the pace here. How quickly we build the team decides how quickly everything else moves.

You will run multiple roles at once and close them in weeks rather than months. That only works when one person owns the full cycle, so you do: post, source, screen, assess, interview, offer. Coordinators and assessors support the individual steps. The outcome is yours.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Run recruitment end to end for your assigned roles.

 - Take proper briefs from hiring managers, and tell them when the profile does not match the market.

 - Source and screen directly through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards and outreach. Inbound and outbound both matter, and neither fills a role on its own.

 - Map the market and build pipelines before the role opens.

 - Keep the ATS accurate and give hiring managers a straight read on where each role stands.

 - Run interviews and scheduling so candidates get a fast, clear process.

 - Improve how we hire: screening quality, process, employer brand.



THE RIGHT FIT HAS

 - 2 to 5 years in talent acquisition, in-house, agency, executive search or staffing.

 - You have run several roles in parallel against a deadline, not one at a time.

 - Real sourcing skill. You can find people who are not looking.

 - You move fast because your process is good, not because you work late.

 - Hiring experience across more than one function, corporate and tech.

 - You read candidates well and can defend a call to a skeptical hiring manager.

 - Startup, high-growth or agency experience preferred. Slow environments will not suit.

 - Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Your roles close on time, and hiring managers know where each one stands without having to ask.

 - Every role you run draws strong volume, because you treat the job post as something to be tested and improved rather than published once.

 - Shortlists hold up. Hiring managers interview the people you send and rarely ask for a different batch.

 - Candidates move through the process quickly. Nothing sits waiting on you.

 - Offers get accepted, not just issued.

 - Hiring works better a year from now than it does today, because of changes you made.



WHY JOIN BJAK

 - Above-market remuneration.

 - Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

 - Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

 - Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

 - High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

 - Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

 - Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Lines Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto is building its own P&C insurance agency — moving from a third-party referral model to a first-party, payroll-integrated experience that protects small businesses as they grow. We have policies in force and a growing book of business. What we don't yet have is a licensed account manager inside the company servicing it. You'll be our first, and the foundation of the service function: owning daily servicing of the book, running the proactive outreach that keeps clients correctly covered, and turning every recurring case into a product spec so the next hundred don't need a human.

About the Team:

The Business Insurance team is building Gusto's P&C insurance agency from the ground up, across core small commercial lines including Workers' Compensation. We partner closely with carrier counterparts and work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, design, data, sales, and licensed insurance professionals to ship a quote, bind, and service experience that's fast, accurate, and easy to manage over time. The team is small, cross-functional, and highly execution-oriented — ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants to build durable operations in a zero-to-one environment.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Own daily servicing of the assigned book: endorsements, certificates of insurance, coverage questions, premium audits, billing disputes, cancellations, reinstatements, and renewals.

• Accountable for outcomes connected to Business Insurance customers.

• Serve as the liaison between insureds, carriers, and our licensed producers — explaining coverage, exclusions, and exposures in plain language.

• Run proactive outreach using payroll data a traditional agency doesn't have: catching FEIN mismatches, new-state hires, and class code drift before they become coverage gaps.

• Work the pending cancellation and non-pay queue — find out what's actually driving each cancellation, fix what's fixable, and secure reinstatement or replacement coverage.

• Handle claims intake and status reporting, and coordinate hand-offs to the carrier's adjusting team.

• Document every recurring case as a product spec, partnering with product and engineering to automate certificate generation, endorsement submission, and intake triage — using AI tools daily for drafting, summarization, and triage.

• Write the SOPs, escalation paths, and service standards for the team

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 5+ years of commercial lines service experience at an independent agency, brokerage, or carrier, servicing small commercial accounts end to end.

• Workers' Compensation depth — class codes, experience modifiers, premium audits, and state-specific requirements. Pay-as-you-go WC experience is a strong plus.

• Experience working in carrier portals (Hartford, AmTrust, etc) and coordinating with carrier underwriting/servicing teams to service an agency book of business.

• AI and automation fluency — you've used AI tools in real service work (drafting, summarization, triage, outreach) and have opinions about where they hold up and where they don't.

• Evidence you build, not just execute — a process you documented, a workflow you redesigned, or a tool you got built. We'll ask for specifics.

• A compliance instinct: you know when something needs a licensed person, a carrier's sign-off, or a documented file, and you don't improvise around it.

• An active Property & Casualty producer license (Colorado resident preferred), or willingness to obtain one within 90 days of starting — we sponsor the coursework and exams — plus willingness to obtain nonresident licenses across our footprint over time.

Preferred: industry designations (CISR, CIC, AAI, ACSR, or CPCU); multi-state or nonresident licensing already in place; experience at a digital agency, insurtech, or MGA, or having stood up a service function from scratch.

If you don't think you meet every point above but you're excited about this work, apply anyway.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is between $83,265 - $102,000/year in Denver. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Acceleration
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As of May 2026, Claude authored more than 80% of the code we merge. Writing a change is fast now, and the hard part is knowing it's correct and safe to ship. Platform Acceleration builds the internal tools that close that gap for Anthropic's product engineers, who own the Claude API, our SDKs, and the rest of the Claude Platform. We work like a small product team whose customers are other Anthropic engineers.

We're looking for Staff+ engineers with a backend and infrastructure background who care about developer experience and have built tools other engineers rely on. We prefer candidates who can work from our San Francisco office, and we'll also consider candidates based in Seattle.

What you'll do

• Own the technical strategy and roadmap for your area, and make sure its hardest problems get solved, by you or through others

• Stay hands-on: design, build, and operate the tools that help Platform teams ship code faster

• Define what it takes to trust a change, including changes written by Claude, and build the tooling that holds that bar before and after merge

• Build agents that take on repetitive engineering work, such as diagnosing failures, fixing broken tests, and running migrations

• Embed with partner teams to find their biggest sources of friction, validate a solution with them, and turn the fix into a product other teams can adopt

• Measure developer experience and adoption, and use the data to decide what to build next

• Move between building new tools and improving the shared systems teams already depend on, as priorities shift

You might be a good fit if you:

• Experience building and operating large-scale backend services or distributed systems in production

• Proficiency in Go, Python, Rust, or TypeScript

• Deep experience with developer tooling, CI/CD, test infrastructure, or deployment systems

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

• Experience leading large, complex technical projects across teams, from an ambiguous problem to a tool people use

• Clear written and verbal communication, with experience supporting internal partner teams

• Interest in Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience at a startup or on a similarly small team, taking a product from zero to one and talking directly to your users

• Substantial experience with agents that do engineering or other technical work

• Experience building widely adopted CLI tools, developer-facing services, GitHub automation, or open source developer tools

• Depth in progressive delivery, observability, VM orchestration, sandboxed execution, or workflow orchestration

• Experience working in a large monorepo

• Enough full-stack ability to put a usable interface on your tools

• A point of view on how software engineering changes as agents write more of the code

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Delivery Driver(06721) 2007 N Laurent
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

FULL AND PART TIME POSITIONS AVAILABLE

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

At Domino's, we are a brand of honesty, transparency and accountability and we want exceptional people like you to join our team! We have continued to prove we “Put our People First” by making sure our work environment is safe and provides stability for you as a team member. The brand continues to deliver the “Power of Possible” to local Domino’s store owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores!

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Senior Power Distribution Engineer, Ground Power
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.




WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.




WHO YOU ARE:

Astro Mechanica is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer focused on power systems development to join our growing team. You will be working across aviation and ground power teams to enable Astro Mechanica’s ground power product, a 13 MW aeroderivative generator, built to deliver fast, on-site power for data centers and industrial sites that can't wait years for grid capacity. In this role, you will be responsible for the medium-voltage electrical system that turns aircraft engines into ground power plants. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you will set the architecture, run the studies, specify the equipment, lead validation and commissioning, and be the technical authority on electrical safety. You will work closely with mechanical, controls, and manufacturing teams and represent the product with customers, utilities, and certification bodies. If you want to build a real power product rather than a slice of one, this role is for you.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Translate product requirements into electrical specifications, one-line diagrams, schematics, and BOMs

 - Own the electrical architecture and design of the plant including transformers, switchgear, cabling, protection, and grounding

 - Perform and review power system studies- load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, grounding, harmonics, and transient analysis

 - Ensure compliance with NEC, IEEE, IEC, UL, NFPA 70E, and utility interconnection requirements; own electrical safety and certification for the product

 - Mentor engineers, review designs, and serve as the technical interface to customers, utilities, and suppliers




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - BS, MS, or PhD with a focus on electrical engineering

 - 5+ years of experience designing, building, testing, and shipping electrical power systems

 - Deep experience with medium-voltage systems (1–38 kV): generators, transformers, switchgear, protective relays, and paralleling/grid-interconnect schemes

 - Strong command of power system analysis (symmetrical components, fault calculations, protection coordination, arc flash) and proficiency in ETAP, SKM, or EasyPower

 - Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IEC, UL, NFPA 70E) and experience taking a product through certification

 - Hands-on field experience commissioning and troubleshooting MV equipment and generator control systems

 - Track record of owning a complex electrical product from concept through production with cross-functional teams

 - Familiarity with power electronics (inverters, rectifiers, excitation systems) and controls integration (SCADA, PLC, communication protocols) is a plus




PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
   
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
