jobs.title: Manager, Business Insurance Servicing
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto is building its own P&C insurance agency, and our servicing team is growing right alongside it. You'll lead the licensed team that keeps our commercial book correctly covered — endorsements, renewals, claims, carrier relationships — while building the systems, SOPs, and automation that let that team scale without headcount scaling at the same rate. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll hire, coach, and grow a small licensed team, own service quality and compliance for the function, and still pick up the phone when it matters.

About the Team:

The Business Insurance team is building Gusto's P&C insurance agency from the ground up, across core small commercial lines including Workers' Compensation. We partner closely with carrier counterparts and work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, design, data, sales, and licensed insurance professionals to ship a quote, bind, and service experience that's fast, accurate, and easy to manage over time. You'll lead the licensed servicing arm of that team — small today, growing fast — reporting into Financial Services leadership.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Hire, onboard, and lead a small team of licensed account managers, setting the service standards, escalation paths, and quality bar they work against.

• Own service-level performance for the book — response and resolution time, endorsement cycle time and accuracy, save rate on the cancellation queue, client satisfaction — and report on it to Financial Services leadership.

• Carry the toughest escalations yourself: contested or rescinded broker-of-record situations, complex coverage disputes, and carrier issues your team can't yet close alone.

• Own the carrier relationship on servicing matters — appointment paperwork, escalation channels, SLA negotiation — and represent the servicing function in cross-functional planning with product and engineering.

• Translate recurring manual work into product requirements, partnering with product and engineering on automation (certificate generation, endorsement submission, intake triage), and push your team's fluency with AI tools in daily service work.

• Own the compliance backbone of the function — supervision documentation, continuing education tracking, and record retention for licensed communications — in partnership with Legal and Compliance.

• Coach your team's growth through regular 1:1s and performance conversations, and build the hiring plan that keeps pace with the book.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 5+ years of commercial lines service experience at an independent agency, brokerage, or carrier, including 1–2+ years leading or supervising a service team.

• Workers' Compensation depth — class codes, experience modifiers, premium audits, pay-as-you-go WC experience is a strong plus — and the ability to turn that depth into training and SOPs for a team.

• Experience working in carrier portals (Hartford, AmTrust, etc) and comfort partnering directly carrier relationship managers.

• AI and automation fluency — you've used AI tools in real service work, can coach a team to use them well, and have a track record of turning manual processes into automated ones.

• A compliance instinct sharp enough to carry supervisory responsibility for licensed staff — you know what needs a licensed sign-off, a carrier's approval, or a documented file, and you build that discipline into your team.

• A coaching-first leadership style: you'd rather build a team that outgrows the need for you on any single case than be the best individual servicer in the room.

• An active Property & Casualty producer license (Colorado resident preferred, or obtainable within 90 days with Gusto's support), plus willingness to obtain nonresident licenses across our operating footprint.

Preferred: prior experience building or scaling a service function from scratch (agency, insurtech, or MGA); industry designations (CIC, CPCU, CISR, AAI); multi-state or nonresident licensing already in place.

If you don't think you meet every point above but you're excited about this work, apply anyway.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $92,245.00-$113,000.00 in Denver. Additional locations will vary based on our geographical pay approach. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Staff Power Electronics Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Power Electronics Engineer, Energy Storage designs and develops power conversion systems for Redwood's next-generation Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), including converters that interface with battery packs, battery modules, photovoltaic systems, and the grid for utility-scale and data center applications. This is a fully on-site role at 100 Hooper, San Francisco. The engineer independently owns complex circuit- and system-level problems spanning converter topology selection, power-stage component selection, magnetics design, PCB/PCBA layout, thermal analysis, and validation, adapting existing approaches and precedent to new and unusual design challenges. The role partners extensively with Mechanical, Firmware/Controls, Systems, Compliance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to take designs from concept through production. Success depends on sound engineering judgment, hands-on lab validation skills, and the ability to resolve ambiguous technical trade-offs with limited direction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Design high-voltage (800V – 25kVdc, 480–800Vac) and high-power (10kW–500kW) converters tailored for utility-scale BESS and industrial infrastructure.

• Conduct comprehensive topology comparison and trade-off analyses evaluating efficiency, power density, cost, and manufacturability.

• Perform power-stage component sizing and Si/SiC MOSFET selection based on loss modeling and thermal management.

• Design robust gate driver circuits and dedicated gate driver power supplies to ensure safe, high-frequency switching operations.

• Lead the design, modeling, and specification of custom magnetic components, including transformers and inductors utilizing Litz-wire or PCB-winding architectures.

• Architect the low-voltage (LV) subsystem, including auxiliary power supplies, sensing circuitry (voltage/current/temperature), and hardware-level protection.

• Design and optimize EMI filters, including differential-mode and common-mode inductors, X/Y-caps, and damping elements.

• Drive high-voltage, high-power PCB/PCBA layout design, ensuring clearance/creepage rules and signal integrity under high-noise environments.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Mechanical, Controls/Firmware, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Compliance) to define requirements, test specifications, and achieve industry certifications

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, with a focus on power electronics.

• 5-7 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a strong focus on power conversion or energy storage products, ideally for mass production.

• Hands-on experience in high-voltage (up to 1.5kVdc and 800Vac) hardware design. Experience in high voltage (up to 25kVdc, 34.5kVac) for SST is a plus.

• Experience with power semiconductor selection, gate drive design, and hardware protection circuits.

• Deep understanding of power electronics topologies and fundamentals (AC/DC, DC/DC).

• Proficiency with circuit simulation, FEA simulation, and CAD tools (e.g., Simulink, LTspice, Ansys Maxwell/Q3D, Altium Designer).

• Demonstrated ability to perform detailed layout of high-power, noise-sensitive PCBs in Altium or equivalent CAD software.

• Proficiency with lab equipment, including oscilloscopes, impedance analyzers, network analyzers, and signal generators.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across diverse cross-functional teams.

• Foundational knowledge of control theory and embedded systems.

• Strong analytical and systematic problem-solving skills.

• Proven track record of rapid prototyping and hardware iterations based on cross-functional and supplier feedback.

• Strong ability to select circuit components considering both electrical performance and manufacturability (DFM).

• Experience mentoring test technicians to execute design verification, interpret test data, and define component maturity criteria.

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills.

California Pay Range:

$160,000—$200,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Specialty Account Manager, Sunosi (San Antonio, TX)
jobs.description:
Axsome Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company leading a new era in the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) conditions. We deliver scientific breakthroughs by identifying critical gaps in care and develop differentiated products with a focus on novel mechanisms of action that enable meaningful advancements in patient outcomes. Our industry-leading neuroscience portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for major depressive disorder, agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease, excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and migraine, as well as multiple novel product candidates addressing a broad range of serious neurological and psychiatric conditions that impact over 150 million people in the United States. Together, we are on a mission to solve some of the brain’s biggest problems so patients and their loved ones can flourish. For more information, please visit us at www.axsome.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

About This Role

Axsome Therapeutics is seeking a Specialty Account Manager (SAM) to execute commercial activities for the assigned geography and establish relationships with customers to drive demand for Sunosi (solriamfetol) in approved patients. SUNOSI is indicated to improve wakefulness in adults with excessive daytime sleepiness due to obstructive sleep apnea or narcolepsy. This role is field-based and will require gaining access to customers in a clinic or hospital setting while also maximizing the ability to engage through digital channels.

The Field SAM will be responsible for product performance at a territory level, be expected to be a disease category expert and a product champion, provide account management support, and exhibit business knowledge of the local landscape to assess key stakeholders plus future trends within the marketplace.

• Maximize use of marketing resources to maintain and develop customer relationships for the purpose of growing the customers’ confidence to prescribe Axsome medications for appropriate patients.

• Communicate territory activity in an accurate and timely manner as directed by management.

• Provide feedback to sales and commercial leadership, colleagues, marketing, and other internal departments about changing environment and results.

• Successfully complete all training classes.

• Complete administrative duties in an accurate and timely fashion.

• Manage efforts within assigned promotional budget.

• Must be able to effectively collaborate across all corporate functions.

• Attend medical congresses and society meetings as needed.

• Ensure timely access for patients through patient services and savings programs.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.

• Minimum of 5 years of field customer experience and/or account management.

• Demonstrated experience delivering outstanding results.

• Minimum of 3 years Healthcare Professional experience with relevant CNS/Psychiatry experience will also meet the qualifications for this role.

• Previous pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales experience with at least five years in specialty sales preferred.

• CNS/Psychiatry experience preferred, but not required.

• Launch experience strongly preferred.

• Experience strategizing within cross-functional teams, utilizing differential resources to achieve business goals.

• Proven ability to successfully manage multiple tasks concurrently under aggressive timelines in a dynamic environment.

• Comfortability with uncertainty and high expectations.

• Patient support services experience a plus.

• Strong digital marketing aptitude.

• Strong interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

• Frequent driving, including extended periods of time behind the wheel.

• Prolonged sitting and standing as part of daily job functions.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 30lbs regularly.

• Overhead reaching required to close and secure liftgates or similar equipment.

Salary & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000. The salary offer will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, internal equity and location. Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

About Oula:
Oula is redesigning maternity care from the ground up. Our modern maternity centers combine the best of obstetrics and midwifery care to deliver a more evidence-based and personalized pregnancy experience. From our collaborative medical team and welcoming clinics to our remote care platform, we are setting a new standard for pregnancy that unifies modern medicine and human intuition. Since opening our first tech-enabled, collaborative care clinic in 2021, we have grown across multiple markets and continue to expand.

About the role:
We are looking for a Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) to join our growing maternity care practice. We’re searching for someone who is thoughtful and passionate about delivering patient-centric, judgment-free care, and is excited to join a dynamic and innovative team.

This is the perfect opportunity for a CNM who is excited to expand their skill set and help define and build a new best-in-class maternity care experience. You will be responsible for delivering full-spectrum perinatal care, as well as helping to shape and refine Oula’s clinical care model.

At Oula, midwives lead their own panels within a truly collaborative model — OB-GYNs are integrated members of the same team, not a separate referral tier — and our patients deliver at our partner hospital. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach delivers better outcomes for the communities we serve. This is the autonomy-with-backup practice many midwives are looking for and rarely find.

This is a full-time position with a flexible schedule that varies based on market and operational needs. At steady-state staffing, a typical schedule includes approximately two office days per week, an average of 24 hours of on-call coverage per week (with a protected post-call day off where applicable), and dedicated administrative and didactic time. During the launch of new markets or other ramp-up periods, scheduling needs—including on-call responsibilities—may temporarily be greater as the practice grows. Part-time and per-diem arrangements may be available depending on clinic needs.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provides full-scope midwifery care during pregnancy, labor, birth, and postpartum across a variety of settings: our clinics, our partner hospital, and virtually.

• Works collaboratively with Oula’s product & engineering team to give feedback on the patient portal to create a more personalized, inclusive, and consistent approach to care.

About you:

• Are passionate about improving maternity care through a combination of clinical care, technology, patient empowerment, and education

• Are enthusiastic about collaborative care models leveraging diverse teams with a wide variety of skill-sets

• Exude empathy and compassion for patients and team members alike and can rally your team to provide exceptional patient experience regardless of the situation

• Uphold the core principles of reproductive justice to support principles of body autonomy, self-determination and cultural respect

• Are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and energized by building processes from the ground up

• Are excited about realizing the Oula mission, and building the kind of collaborative practice that midwives and patients dream about

Desired Experience & Qualifications:

• Must hold active state licensure as required to practice midwifery in the clinic’s state (or be eligible to obtain it before start), and current certification by the AMCB as a Certified Nurse-Midwife or Certified Midwife

• Two or more years of full-scope clinical midwifery experience preferred; we also welcome strong earlier-career candidates who are approaching that mark

• Experience caring for diverse communities with a wide variety of needs

• Great professional references and a reputation for providing exceptional patient care valued by your patients and colleagues

• Experience with telemedicine or elements of virtual care

• Installation, modifications, and repairs of fire sprinkler systems.

• Follow safety regulations, including wearing safety equipment.

jobs.title: Growth Manager - CONFIDENTIAL
jobs.description:
Growth Manager – AI-Native Consumer Brand Platform (Confidential)

New York · Hybrid (NYC area) or remote with one working week per month in NYC · Full-time

About the Company

Our client is an early-stage, venture-backed startup building an AI General Manager for consumer brands. Starting a brand has become easier, but running and growing one is still hard. Founders have more tools, agencies, and channels than ever, yet they’re still the ones making the decisions and holding everything together.

The company helps brands launch and grow in the US by understanding the whole business, identifying what matters next, and getting the work done across growth and operations. They’re building the software and AI workflows that let a small team do this for a growing number of brands.

They started with international consumer brands entering the US, mostly beauty and CPG, and now also work with US brands facing the same challenges. Creator seeding is their largest revenue stream today, and D2C is being built into the next major growth driver. D2C helps brands prove demand, improve conversion and repeat purchase, and build the economics to support further growth, including retail.

The company is backed by a top-tier venture accelerator, has a growing roster of signed brands with several already live, and is led by a small, founder-led team.

The Role

You’ll own D2C growth across the company’s merchant portfolio. You’ll start with roughly ten merchants at different stages of launch and growth, and the portfolio will expand as more brands go live. Working with the CEO on overall D2C direction, you’ll independently decide what each merchant should do next, why, and in what order, and then make it happen.

Account Managers own the merchant relationship and overall account growth. You’ll work closely with them and with the creator and engineering teams, while owning D2C strategy, execution, and results.

At the start, this is a deeply hands-on individual-contributor role. Meta is the core channel, with TikTok and creator-led content close behind, at roughly $1k/week per merchant to start. You’ll build and run the accounts, brief and test creative, improve landing pages, and own conversion. Where engineering is needed, you’ll turn the growth decision into a clear, testable spec and stay accountable until it works in production.

The harder, more valuable part is turning what works into a system: scorecards, decision rules, AI workflows, automations, and product requirements that let one exceptional operator support a growing portfolio without proportional headcount. The mandate is simple: help merchants grow profitably, then make that success repeatable.

What You’ll Do

 - Diagnose the real constraint on each merchant’s profitable D2C growth, quickly, in businesses you didn’t build

 - Prioritize growth time, budget, and engineering work across the portfolio based on each merchant’s stage and opportunity

 - Personally ship the highest-leverage work across acquisition, creative, conversion, offer, lifecycle, and retention

 - Build the merchant growth operating system: scorecards, prioritized backlogs, decision logs, weekly reviews, and simulations

 - Identify recurring workflows that should become software and give engineering clear requirements and acceptance criteria

 - Own performance against agreed merchant D2C sales targets and the revenue those sales generate for the company

Your First 90 Days

 - Every active D2C merchant has an agreed growth plan: stage, primary constraint, 12-week target, next actions, and portfolio priority

 - At least two merchants have a repeatable acquisition or retention loop meeting agreed contribution-margin and payback targets

 - Every active D2C merchant runs through the same growth planning and review process

 - The three most valuable recurring workflows are documented as product requirements, with at least one live as an automation across three or more merchants

Who You Are

 - 3+ years hands-on in paid social. Meta is your home platform, and you’re comfortable running TikTok and creator-driven campaigns

 - You’ve worked both sides: agency, juggling a book of accounts with competing priorities, and in-house at a DTC or CPG brand selling physical products

 - Creative-led: you brief creators, cut ads, test hooks, and own the landing page, not just optimize bids

 - You understand account structure, creative testing, measurement, and how to make decisions with limited budgets

 - You think in systems and reach for AI and automation by default; you can articulate what a tool or agent should do even if you don’t build it

 - You’ve operated inside small companies (under 200 people) and are comfortable making calls with incomplete data

Nice to Have

 - Beauty, skincare, or Asia-to-US brand experience

 - TikTok Shop, affiliate, or creator program experience

 - AEO/GEO or SEO

 - Built something from zero to one before

Location

Hybrid in NYC if you’re local. If you’re outside the New York area, remote with one required working week per month in the NYC office, with travel and lodging covered.

Compensation and Benefits

 - Base salary: $200,000

 - Equity: 2.00% stock options (founding-level ownership)

 - Performance bonus: 1% of total platform net collected D2C revenue, paid annually, uncapped

 - Health insurance, company equipment and remote-work support, and flexible PTO with a minimum of 15 days off per year

jobs.description:
The Regional Doctor Recruiter is responsible for the full lifecycle recruitment of optometrists and optometry students across an assigned region. This role serves as a strategic partner to business and clinical leaders, providing recruiting expertise, market insights, workforce planning support, and hiring recommendations. The Regional Doctor Recruiter develops talent pipelines, manages candidate relationships from sourcing through onboarding, and drives successful hiring outcomes to support National Vision's business objectives.

• Serve as a strategic talent advisor to Regional Vice Presidents, Regional Clinical Directors, District Managers, Area Doctors, and other business leaders by providing workforce planning recommendations, market insights, hiring forecasts, and recruitment strategies.
• Source, recruit, interview, and assess licensed optometrists and optometry students for employment, telehealth, and lease opportunities within the National Vision Doctor of Optometry Network.
• Develop and execute sourcing and recruiting strategies to build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.
• Consult with business leaders on market conditions, compensation, incentives, and hiring strategies to attract, negotiate, and successfully close top optometry talent.
• Educate candidates on career opportunities, practice models, compensation, benefits, contractual requirements, and the value of partnering with National Vision.
• Manage the candidate experience from initial contact through onboarding, serving as the primary point of contact and coordinating licensure, credentialing, board examination results, and other pre-employment requirements.

• Represent National Vision at optometry schools, industry conferences, career fairs, professional association events, and networking opportunities while leading recruiting projects and process improvement initiatives that support organizational growth.

We provide training programs, access to educational courses and pride ourselves on the ever-increasing amount of promotions from within.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world's largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re headquartered in San Francisco, CA and backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As a growth stage startup employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by eliminating up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.



About the Role
Our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) work alongside practitioners at the world's largest audit firms. They build prototype agents on those firms' real workflows and ship production code. One current problem is producing verifiable citations from dense Excel workbooks, because an auditor has to trace every conclusion back to the exact evidence.
Our Senior Manager, Deployed Engineering role will start as a player-coach role where you will need to be hands on as we build and scale this effort. At the start, you'll be working directly in customer deployments, writing production code and solving the hardest technical problems yourself. You'll also build and lead the team around you.
As the team grows, your focus will move toward leadership, but you'll always be close to the work. You'll report to our CTO/co-founder and work closely and with Product, Engineering and Customer leadership.



What You'll Do
As a player:

 - Lead important deployments yourself. Own technical delivery for some of our largest enterprise customers, from scoping through production. This includes single-tenant and government-cloud environments, regulated data, and audit methods that differ from firm to firm.

 - Write production code. Build agents, integrations and tools alongside the team, and handle the hardest technical problems directly.

 - Be the senior technical voice with customers. Act as a trusted advisor to partners, CIOs and audit leaders on how AI agents fit their practice.

As a coach:

 - Build the FDE team. Hire, coach and grow strong engineers who can both build and work directly with customers. Set the bar through your own work first.

 - Make deployment repeatable. Turn what you learn from hands-on work into playbooks, tools and metrics that speed up time-to-value as we grow upmarket.

 - Turn field work into product. Spot patterns across deployments and work with Product and Engineering so solutions built for one customer become reusable platform features.



What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years of leadership experience in forward deployed, deployment, solutions or customer engineering. That might mean FDE leadership at Palantir or a similar company, a Field CTO role, or leading technical work with large enterprise customers.

 - You still build. You've written production software recently and want to keep doing it. This role isn't a fit for someone looking for a manage-only role.

 - Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and excitement about building a team from an early stage.

 - Comfort in front of senior enterprise stakeholders, especially in regulated or complex environments.

 - Good judgment about building for one customer versus the platform, and the ability to push back on scope when it matters.

 - Excitement about bringing AI agents into high-stakes professional work.



Bonus Points

 - Experience at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) or a major consulting firm such as Accenture, McKinsey, BCG or Bain.

 - Knowledge of audit, accounting, risk or compliance.

 - Experience deploying LLM or agent-based systems in production.



More about Fieldguide

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.



Some of our benefits include

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits starting on your first day

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain Technology
jobs.description:
The Senior Product Manager, Supply Chain Technology is a strategic leader responsible for the vision, development, implementation, and optimization of critical supply chain technology solutions that support a complex, multi-billion-dollar enterprise. This role leads the development of a new enterprise supply chain platform that serves as a foundational business system, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and business performance. Leveraging deep expertise in supply chain technology, JDA platforms, software development, and packaged software solutions, this leader partners cross-functionally with business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into technology capabilities that drive innovation, improve supply chain execution, and deliver measurable business value.

What Would You Do? The Specifics.

• Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for supply chain technology platforms, aligning with company goals and market demands
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and mentor teams across engineering, data science, merchandising, accounting, and supply chain operations to deliver high-quality solutions
• Technical Product Ownership: Work closely with engineering and IT to ensure seamless integration of supply chain systems, APIs, and data platforms, ensuring scalability and performance
• Process Optimization: Identify and implement process improvements in supply chain workflows, leveraging technology to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve visibility
• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with supply chain teams, vendors, and partners to align on forecasts, inventory strategies, and delivery timelines
• Performance Measurement: Define and track KPIs for product success, including adoption rates, system uptime, order fulfillment speed, and cost savings

Work Experience

• 8+ years Supply Chain experience (Required)
• 6+ years Software engineering, product management, technical program management (Required)

Education

• Four year college degree or equivalent experience. (Required)

Additional Skills

• Strong understanding of supply chain processes, systems, and KPIs. (Required)
• Proficiency in product management tools (Required)
• Data analysis, reporting, and visualization skills. (Required)
• Experience with JDA or AS400 or Blue Yonder (Preferred)
• ERP (Required)
• Merchandising Systems (Preferred)
• WMS (Preferred)
• Inventory Management (Required)
• Experience and optical or healthcare industry (Preferred)
• TMS (Preferred)
• Cross-cultural communication and stakeholder management. (Required)
• Business requirements gathering and analysis (Required)
• UX/UI processes (Required)
• Travel Requirements10% Travel Required

Taking Care of our People!

We understand the importance of financial health and security, and because of that, we provide competitive compensation to all associates. We provide training programs and access to educational courses and pride ourselves on the ever-increasing amount of promotions from within.#LI-SH1

Job Summary:

LifeSafety Management is seeking a motivated, organized, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative / Service Dispatcher to join our team. This position plays an important role in ensuring excellent customer service, coordinating daily service operations, scheduling technicians, and maintaining accurate service records.

The ideal candidate has experience in customer service, dispatching, and administrative support. Experience in the construction, fire alarm, or life safety industry is preferred. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, communicate effectively, and can manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail, we encourage you to apply.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Answer incoming customer calls, respond to service requests, and provide professional, courteous customer support.

• Schedule, dispatch, and track service technicians and drivers to ensure efficient service delivery and timely completion of work orders.

• Create and maintain service work orders, ensuring accurate documentation and follow-up.

• Communicate service updates, scheduling information, and job status to customers throughout the service process.

• Maintain and renew fire alarm system certificates and update company databases as required.

• Enter low-voltage repair reports into the Compliance Engine database.

• Develop a working knowledge of company services, products, procedures, and pricing to assist customers accurately.

• Address customer complaints and service concerns professionally, coordinating with management when necessary.

• Work closely with service technicians, management, and other departments to support daily operations and improve efficiency.

• Assist in improving customer service processes, dispatch procedures, and administrative workflows.

• Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable safety requirements.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to multitask, prioritize competing demands, and work effectively under pressure.

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to learn customer management, scheduling, and dispatch software.

• A professional, customer-focused attitude and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in the fire alarm, fire protection, construction, or life safety industry.

• Experience scheduling and dispatching service technicians, drivers, or field personnel.

• Familiarity with fire alarm systems, service work orders, compliance documentation, or low-voltage repair reporting.

This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing, movement around the office or job site, and operation of standard equipment. Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. jobs.title: Sales Manager, Independent Retail – South Mid-Atlantic
jobs.description:
The Sales Manager has responsibility over FIJI Water as the main contact between assigned Independent large and small format Chain customers. Manage all assigned Chain Retailers, Non-Exclusive Direct Store Delivery (DSD), Grocery Wholesalers and Broadliner Partners with the goal of increasing share of mind and retail execution.

• Conduct regular field visits to customer accounts, partnering with the FIJI Water Retail Trade Execution (RTE) team, distributor representatives, or independently.
• Identify and develop new business opportunities, as well as drive SKU expansion and incremental distribution within existing accounts.
• Develop and deliver fact-based selling presentations incorporating actionable business, category, and market insights for retailers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
• Lead and participate in customer and sales meetings with appropriate frequency to increase share of mind, distribution, programming, and feature activity.
• Communicate key brand priorities, brand performance, and category/market insights to internal and external customers.
• Drive execution of merchandising, assortment, pricing, and shelving objectives in alignment with portfolio and brand strategy, customer objectives, and trade investment goals.
• Sell in incremental displays, equipment, and promotional programs while ensuring execution and compliance at the store level.
• Evaluate and negotiate CMAs (Customer Marketing Agreements) in alignment with business objectives and trade investment strategies.
• Analyze, interpret, and communicate data and insights from Power BI, VIP, IDIG, IRI, and other syndicated sources to inform customer recommendations and internal business decisions.
• Transport, install, replace, and maintain point-of-sale materials and advertising as appropriate for each account.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Retail Trade Execution, Marketing, Operations, and other internal teams to drive customer and business objectives.

• 5+ years of food and/or beverage sales experience, including distributor management and key account management.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field preferred.
• Demonstrated experience leveraging syndicated data and analytics to develop fact-based selling stories and achieve business objectives; experience with IRI, Nielsen, Mintel, or similar platforms preferred.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to effectively sell to customer needs and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience with sales planning and business management, including evaluating post-event performance and applying learnings to future customer programming.
• Effective organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
• Customer-service mindset with a commitment to providing high-quality support to internal and external partners.
• Demonstrated market and category knowledge, with the ability to adapt to changing business needs.
• Collaborative, flexible, and team-oriented approach.

jobs.title: Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position: Data Coordinator
Job Location: Remote 
Position Type: TemporaryFull-Time, Exempt 
Position Classification: Not Union Eligible
Compensation: $63,000 - $70,000 per year
Travel Percentage: 5-10 %
Reports to: National Data & Analytics Director
ABOUT FOR OUR FUTURE
Founded in 2016, For Our Future Action Fund and For Our Future run the largest, permanent progressive field program across key states. Our vision is to expand the progressive infrastructure and advance economic prosperity for all, strong community schools, climate justice, and racial and social justice. Along with community partners and volunteers, we consistently engage with people in face-to-face conversations around what issues matter most to them. By organizing people in lasting relationships, we win elections, drive local progress, make a community’s collective voice heard, and help build the transformative power needed to improve people’s lives.
POSITION CLASSIFICATION
For Our Future recognizes a staff bargaining unit, affiliated with the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW) 2304, a labor union. This position is NOT included in the For Our Future bargaining unit.
JOB SUMMARY
For Our Future Action Fund seeks a Data Coordinator to play a key role in supporting For Our Future’s national data team. We are looking for campaign experts interested in a professional opportunity to learn and develop new data skills while working to support the electoral and grassroots programs run in all of For Our Future’s states.  For Our Future is proud to run a data-driven program, and this is made possible by our dynamic and mission-driven data team helping to drive our program nationwide. The Data Coordinator shall serve as the point person for extracting, transforming and loading field data across voter contact platforms, assist in compliance reporting, and work with the data team to develop materials and curricula for trainings directed at technical and non-technical audiences. This role will also help states leverage organizational data to advance progressive change, and empower teams that build power, and contribute to winning elections.
This position is anticipated to run through at least November 28, 2024.
Essential Functions  (Updated scope for 2026)
Reviewing voter contact materials including door, phone and sms scripts 
Refreshing turf daily and making sure the correct universe is being used for all canvass programs
Implementing quality control and technical assistance for state programs, including daily reviews of turf management tools to confirm staff activity is logged correctly, and turf is ready for the days program
Building scripts in VAN, including survey, questions, script, content, and MiniVAN Campaigns, and testing script flow before launch
Collaborating with state staff to ensure voter contact materials are administered smoothly, including daily check-in to confirm scripts and program for the next day
Checking active texting campaigns for correct script branching, and providing texting admin coverage
Monitoring the data team slack support channel, responding to staff requests, and troubleshooting VAN access issues
Reconciling MiniVAN Activity report reports against state Turf Trackers to make sure all information about the canvas program is being properly maintained and reported
Logging and escalating persistent data problems, staff data issues, or bottlenecks to the national data team
Supporting staff onboarding and training on VAN, MiniVAN, and data processes, including setting up VAN accounts for new hires
Working with state staff to ensure that voter contact materials are executed in a culturally competent fashion
Working with the National Data Team and National Organizing Team on other program tasks as assigned
Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Skills and Qualifications 
At least 2-3 years working in a competitive field experience; electoral campaigns, progressive politics or advocacy
Demonstrated knowledge of effective and successful electoral plans, including targeting, voter contact, GOTV and best practices with each.
Exceptional communications skills and extraordinary attention to detail
Proficiency with Google and Microsoft platforms, in particular Google Slides/Powerpoint and Google Sheets/Excel 
Proficiency in VoteBuilder/VAN 
Flexibility and a willingness to take on new tasks and work long hours as needed
Experience working on projects in a fast-paced environment
Experience working for a community-based nonprofit organization a plus 
Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to successfully relate to voters and volunteers from a wide range of backgrounds.
Full Time: This position comes with a comprehensive benefits package.
Health Insurance Coverage - 95% Employer Paid 
Paid parental leave
Retirement Savings Plan with matching contributions up to the first 5%
$150 Monthly Cell Phone and Internet Reimbursement
Monthly Mileage Stipend
13 days paid time off every calendar year, as well as other paid holidays.
Expected Hours of Work
Normal hours of business are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time Monday through Friday, however,employees may be required to work outside of normal business hours including weekends, holidays, and nights.
Employees are required to abide by certain blackout dates during a campaign cycle or other key deadlines, and generally not allowed to take off during blackout periods. Emergencies are not affected by this policy.
Work Environment
This position is based in our Washington, DC headquarters, which is currently remote and will have a remote option until further notice. Employees will therefore work and interact primarily in a virtual environment. Employees may be required to periodically travel to and/or work out of office locations in Washington, DC or at state offices.
Health and Safety
For Our Future Action Fund ("FOF") is fully committed to the health and safety of our colleagues, candidates and the communities we serve. We encourage all employees to stay “up to date” with their COVID-19 vaccines and once eligible, to get COVID-19 boosters; however, this is not a requirement for employment at FOF.
 
All employees are required to adhere to the health and safety policies and procedures, when appropriate as implemented by the organization. Upon request, reasonable accommodations will be considered on a case-by-case basis for exemptions to this requirement in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may request a reasonable accommodation form by emailing Human Resources at hr@forourfuturefund.org
Be advised that health and safety policies and procedures around COVID-19 may change in the future to stay in compliance with public health guidance and applicable laws.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in supporting children with autism to reach their fullest potential? Then this is the position for you!

Starting Pay Rate: $23-25

At BAYADA Home Health Care, our clients come first and our employees are our greatest asset. We are looking for dedicated employees who have their Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential or are interested in pursuing their Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential. The RBT credential is a professional credential for paraprofessionals offered through the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB). The RBT credential is required for individuals providing services on any Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) or insurance-based contracts in Hawaii. This position includes working 1:1 in the clinic, home and community with children and young adults diagnosed with autism.

We have current Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) openings in the following:

• Clinic: (Waipio)

• In-home

• Community

Scheduling:

• Mon- Fri

• Hours: (8am - 2:30pm) and/or (2:30pm - 5:30pm)

BAYADA Offers Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs):

• Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off

• Scholarships

• Employee Appreciation Events

• Weekly Pay Schedule

Qualifications for Registered Behavior Technician (RBT):

• One year experience working with children with developmental/ intellectual disabilities preferred

• CPR/BLS (AHA)

Responsibilities for Registered Behavior Technician (RBT):

• Work directly with clients and follow the established treatment plan/behavior support plan for implementing skill acquisition and behavior reduction procedures.

• Establish and maintain effective, supportive, and therapeutic relationships with clients & families. Respect the values, thoughts, beliefs, and attitudes of clients and families.

• Implement behavior therapy techniques as instructed by the Behavioral Services Manager and Behavior Specialist.

• Document interventions and progress towards goals accurately and in a timely manner.

• Collect behavior data as specified in client behavior support plan.

• Review data and progress reports with Behavioral Services Manager and Behavior Specialist in order to strategize program improvements.

• As applicable to the treatment plan, provide habilitation, training, instruction, and assistance to help the client acquire and maintain skills and to help meet identified goals.

• As applicable, provide transportation related to the implementation of activities as directed by the treatment plan.

• Provide training and/or support to the client in interpersonal skills, the development and maintenance of personal relationships, and in living in his/her community.

• Monitor health status and physical condition and reports any changes in the client’s condition or other incidents to the office.

BAYADA recognizes and rewards our RBTs who set and maintain the highest standards of excellence. Join our caring team today!

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Psychiatric Part Time Nights
jobs.description:
At this time, Palos Hospital is not considering external ADN candidates for our RN openings. We appreciate your interest in Northwestern Medicine and encourage you to apply to other opportunities at https://jobs.nm.org/. Internal ADN candidates are still encouraged to apply.

The Staff Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The registered professional nurse assumes accountability and responsibility for the individualized, age-specific care of a patient along the continuum from admission to discharge. She/He gives direct care to assigned patients and assists with other patient care when necessary. The registered professional nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of the patient/family are determined in an ethical manner. She/He collects and analyzes the assessment data in determining nursing diagnoses, collaborates with the patient/family and other health care team members, develops a plan of care to attain realistic outcomes, provides education founded on evidence-based practice, and systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and records patient status and identifies patient care needs upon admission/point of care entry.
• Organizes the assessment health data so that it is accurate, complete and accessible.
• Identifies problems that need immediate attention.
• Validates diagnoses with patient/family and other health care team members.
• Documents diagnoses in a manner that facilitates the determination of expected outcomes and plan of care.
• Initiates Problem List at the time of admission and updates as needed. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the patient’s plan of care.
• Documents that the patient’s individualized plan of care has been discussed with and agreed upon by the patient/family.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with patient/family and health care team members regarding discharge plan.
• Identifies patient teaching needs on admission and throughout hospital stay.
• Arranges conferences with patient and/or family and other members of health team when indicated to plan care.
• Prioritizes and organizes nursing interventions that are evidence based and reflective of established standards of care.
• Provides individualized, mutually agreeable, patient and family education that is founded on evidence-based practice and research guidelines.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient responses.
• Reviews consistently the patient’s health data to keep the Plan of Care updated.
• Assures that revisions to the plan of care are systematic and ongoing and are driven by measurable realistic goals.
• Documents the patient’s progression toward identified outcomes
• Identifies unmet outcomes and provides direction for continuity of care.
• Reassesses nursing actions for effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes.
• Communicates with patient/family and health care team members re: patient care and nursing’s role in the provision of care.
• Collaborates with patient/family and healthcare team members re: the patient’s progress/plan of care.
• Presents relevant patient information at multidisciplinary meetings/conferences for feedback from peers.
• Makes appropriate referrals as needed for continuity of care.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.
• Additional Requirements for the Emergency Room: ACLS, PALS/ENPC & TNCC within one year of hire Additional Requirements for the Pediatric Emergency Room: Pediatric Advanced Life Support TNCC within one year of hire Additional Requirements for Non-Invasive Cardiology: ACLS Preferred: Experience in specific clinical area Additional Preferences for the Emergency Room and the Pediatric Emergency Room: Trauma Nurse Specialist (TNS) Emergency Communications Registered Nurse Certified Pediatric Nurse Certified Emergency Nurse

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Care Experience
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Care Experience team builds the systems and tools Toast’s care agents rely on to support restaurants every day—the foundation behind every phone call, chat conversation, and support case.

This work directly determines how quickly restaurants get back up and running. When agents have fast, reliable tools with the right context, they resolve issues in minutes. When they don’t, resolution slows—and every delay in fixing a payment issue, menu problem, or device failure costs restaurants real revenue.

We’re rebuilding this experience from the ground up: migrating to a new omnichannel contact center platform and creating a true “single pane of glass” for agents. That means bringing together customer data, account context, device state, case history, and operational tools into one unified system—so agents can focus on solving problems, not piecing together information.

As an engineer on this team, you’ll help define and build that foundation for how hundreds of care agents support tens of thousands of restaurants. You’ll drive the migration while also shaping what comes next—integrating backend systems, designing workflows, and continuously improving the experience based on how agents actually work.

This work requires strong empathy for internal customers and a willingness to operate within real constraints. You’ll navigate complex integrations, vendor platform limitations, and real-time system dependencies—all while ensuring the system is reliable enough to support a high-throughput, always-on support organization.

As a Staff Software Engineer Tech Lead, you’ll own projects end-to-end: building agent-facing features, improving system performance and reliability, and iterating based on real operational feedback. You’ll partner closely with product, care operations, and engineering teams to turn day-to-day support challenges into tools that measurably improve how support is delivered.

If you’re motivated by building for internal customers, care about usability as much as system design, and want to see your work directly improve how teams operate at scale, this is a role with clear, tangible impact.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Drive end-to-end development of care agent tooling—from design through production—owning the full lifecycle and iterating based on agent feedback and operational metrics.

• Lead the design and development of next-generation Toast software services and applications that connect the contact center platform with backend systems, giving support teams real-time access to customer, account, device, and case information to deliver a seamless customer experience.

• Own the reliability and performance of business-critical agent tools, ensuring they remain fast and available in a high-throughput, always-on support environment.

• Partner closely with Product Management, Care, QA and other Software teams on the product roadmap and requirements to build a long term vision for Toast and translate operational needs into solutions that improve resolution speed and efficiency.

• Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance vendor platform capabilities, integration complexity, system reliability, and delivery speed—operating effectively within real-world constraints.

• Lead technical design and architecture decisions, helping shape the foundation of Toast’s care tooling as the platform evolves and scales.

• Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, fostering a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.

• Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record building and operating production systems using Java, Kotlin, or other object-oriented languages.

• Experience designing and implementing AWS-native integrations, including Lambda-based access to backend services and event-driven architectures using services such as EventBridge or Kinesis.

• Proven ability to set technical direction for complex systems and lead work from architecture and design through launch, operation, and iteration.

• Demonstrated technical leadership, including driving alignment across engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders.

• Experience integrating with third-party platforms and vendor systems while navigating external constraints and evolving APIs.

• Strong focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence, with an understanding of how system performance affects customers and business outcomes.

• Ability to turn operational workflows and evolving requirements into effective technical solutions, while building relationships and driving work across teams.

• Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools, such as Cursor, Claude, or MCP servers.

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Electrical Engineer, Energy Storage designs and develops the system controller hardware that serves as the brain of Redwood's next-generation high-power electromechanical products — power converters that interface with battery packs, battery modules, photovoltaic (PV) systems, and the grid for large-scale energy storage applications, including AI data centers. This is a fully on-site role, based at 100 Hooper or LH 2. The engineer independently owns the low-voltage (LV) electrical system architecture, including system controller PCBA design, MCU selection and communication protocols, isolated sensing circuits, auxiliary power supplies, and protective circuits (breaker/contactor drivers, E-stop loops), devising solutions to new and unusual system-integration challenges from limited precedents. The role partners extensively with Mechanical, Firmware/Controls, Systems, Compliance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to define requirements and take designs from concept through production. Success depends on sound engineering judgment, hands-on lab validation skills, and the ability to resolve ambiguous system-level trade-offs with limited direction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Own low-voltage (LV) electrical system architecture for power electronics products, including the system controller PCBA that coordinates parallel/series-connected power converter modules

• Design and integrate system controller hardware, including MCU selection, communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, etc.), and control logic for module synchronization, current-sharing, and startup/shutdown sequencing

• Design isolated sensing circuits (current, voltage, temperature feedback) and auxiliary power supply architecture across LV subsystems (~100W)

• Design and coordinate protective circuits (breaker/contactor drivers, hardware interlock/E-stop loops), ensuring insulation coordination and high-voltage safety compliance at the system level

• Define LV wiring architecture, grounding, and interconnect strategy across the entire product and sub power modules

• Lead electrical testing and validation for system controller PCBA and complete power electronics products, including power cycling, fault analysis, and performance characterization

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Mechanical, Controls/Firmware, Validation, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Reliability, Compliance) to define system requirements, test specifications, and achieve industry certifications (e.g., IEEE 1547, UL 1741)

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, with a focus on embedded systems, controls, or power electronics

• 3–5 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a strong focus on system-level control architecture for power conversion or energy storage products

• Hands-on experience designing MCU-based system controllers, including MCU selection, memory/peripheral budgeting, and system-level control for power converters

• Experience with industrial communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet) for module-to-controller and controller-to-grid/BMS interfaces

• Deep understanding of protection coordination (breaker/contactor drivers, hardware interlock and E-stop loops, fault detection and sequencing logic) and proficiency with circuit simulation/CAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, LTspice, Simulink)

• Demonstrated ability to lay out control PCBs in noise-sensitive, high-power environments, and proficiency with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic/protocol analyzers, signal generators)

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Spacecraft Solar Technician
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Solar Technician to support the assembly, integration, and testing of solar array systems for our spacecraft platforms. In this hands-on role, you will work closely with engineering and production teams to build high-quality, flight-ready hardware while supporting Apex's mission to manufacture spacecraft at scale.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong mechanical assembly background, attention to detail, and experience working with precision hardware. You'll be directly involved in building critical spacecraft components, troubleshooting production challenges, and continuously improving manufacturing processes as we scale production.

Responsibilities: 

 - Perform mechanical assembly, integration, and testing of spacecraft solar array systems and associated hardware.

 - Assemble precision mechanical components using engineering drawings, work instructions, and established manufacturing procedures.

 - Install and integrate solar panels, deployment mechanisms, hinges, brackets, fasteners, and associated components.

 - Perform torque operations, bonding, adhesive applications, and other precision assembly processes.

 - Use hand tools, power tools, measurement equipment, and specialized fixtures to complete hardware builds.

 - Inspect completed assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards, and workmanship requirements.

 - Identify, document, and troubleshoot assembly issues, nonconformances, and manufacturing challenges.

 - Collaborate with manufacturing engineers, quality inspectors, and other technicians to resolve production issues.

 - Support functional testing, deployment testing, and verification activities for solar array assemblies.

 - Maintain accurate build records, traceability documentation, and production data.

 - Follow established safety, FOD prevention, and ESD control procedures.

 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, efficiency, and repeatability.

Basic Qualifications:

 - 3+ years of experience in mechanical assembly, manufacturing, integration, or production environments.

 - Experience assembling precision mechanical or electromechanical hardware.

 - Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions, and technical documentation.

 - Proficiency with hand tools, torque tools, measurement equipment, and precision assembly techniques.

 - Familiarity with mechanical fastening, bonding, and hardware installation processes.

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, safety, and workmanship standards.

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced production environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, spacecraft, defense, or other high-reliability manufacturing environments.

 - Hands-on experience assembling or integrating spacecraft solar arrays, deployable structures, or mechanical mechanisms.

 - Familiarity with solar panel handling, deployment mechanisms, and sensitive flight hardware.

 - Experience with adhesives, bonding, staking, and aerospace mechanical assembly processes.

 - Understanding of FOD prevention, ESD controls, and cleanroom procedures.

 - Experience supporting functional testing, mechanical deployment testing, or hardware qualification.

 - Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), electronic work instructions, and production documentation.

 - Experience identifying manufacturing issues and contributing to process improvements.

Additional Requirements: 

 - Ability to work onsite at Apex's Factory One facility in Los Angeles.

 - Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and perform repetitive assembly tasks.

 - Comfortable working with delicate, high-value flight hardware in a production environment.

 - Willingness to support production schedules and occasional overtime as needed.


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
