jobs.title: Director of Federal Operations
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior Federal enablement leader to serve as a high-leverage partner to the Federal organization. This person will help the Federal team scale with more consistency, stronger operating rhythms, better deal inspection, and clearer execution across priority work.

This role sits close to Federal leadership and works across Domain teams, Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance, and Operations. It is designed for a senior operator who can turn ambiguity into structure, keep important work moving, and help leaders stay focused on customers, pipeline creation, and strategic growth.

The right candidate will bring judgment, follow-through, and the ability to build lightweight systems that improve execution without slowing down a fast-moving Federal business.

Key Responsibilities

Federal Enablement & Operating Cadence

• Support Federal-specific enablement needs in partnership with Sales Enablement and Sales Operations.

• Translate company-wide sales processes, tools, onboarding, and reporting into clear Federal expectations and execution rhythms.

• Build and maintain operating cadences that help Federal leaders, Domain Directors, Mission Directors, and cross-functional partners stay focused, accountable, and aligned.

• Inspect weekly reporting, identify gaps or risks, and follow up on action items until they are closed.

• Track commitments from pipeline reviews, leadership discussions, customer meetings, and internal deal reviews.

• Standardize how Federal teams prepare, report, escalate, and execute while keeping process practical and useful.

Onboarding Support

• Identify and fill Federal-specific onboarding gaps for new Federal hires.

• Help new team members understand Defense Unicorns' Federal motion, domain priorities, customer engagement model, deal expectations, and internal ways of working.

• Create and refine Federal-specific onboarding materials, templates, examples, and expectations that complement company-wide onboarding.

• Partner with Sales Enablement, Sales Operations, Domain Directors, and Mission Directors to help new Federal hires ramp faster and with clearer expectations.

• Turn recurring points of confusion into clearer guidance, training, or operating materials.

Deal Inspection & Pipeline Accountability

• Inspect priority deals to ensure next steps, risks, owners, pricing, procurement path, and customer alignment are clear.

• Review PWIN assumptions and ensure they are accurate, complete, and grounded in the real customer situation.

• Ask hard questions as opportunities move through stages so deals progress based on strong evidence and clear ownership.

• Support pipeline health across current-quarter execution and future-quarter creation.

• Partner with Mission Directors and Domain Directors to identify stuck deals, weak spots, missing artifacts, and areas requiring leadership support.

• Help Federal leadership maintain a clear view of what is real, what is at risk, and what needs action.

Strategic Projects & Surge Support

• Lead or support strategic Federal projects that require focused execution and cross-functional coordination.

• Provide surge support on priority opportunities where additional senior execution capacity is needed.

• Support strategic pricing efforts in partnership with Sales, Finance, Product, and Delivery.

• Build or refine artifacts needed for key deals, executive conversations, customer strategy, internal decision-making, and leadership alignment.

• Step into ambiguous, high-priority work and turn it into something actionable.

What Success Looks Like

• Federal leaders have more bandwidth for strategy, customer engagement, and net-new pipeline creation.

• Federal-specific onboarding gaps are addressed in partnership with the broader enablement team.

• New Federal hires ramp faster and with more clarity on the Federal motion.

• Weekly reporting is tighter, action items are tracked, and follow-through improves.

• Priority deals are better inspected before close, with clearer risks, next steps, PWIN, pricing, and ownership.

• Pipeline health is visible across near-term revenue and future-quarter growth.

• Strategic projects move faster because a senior operator is driving them to completion.

• Domain and Mission leaders view this person as a force multiplier, not an added layer of process.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior doer: someone who can operate in ambiguity, build structure without over-processing, and earn trust quickly across teams. Federal experience is helpful but not required. What matters most is judgment, horsepower, follow-through, and the ability to work across GTM, Product, Sales, Delivery, and Operations.

This person should be comfortable inspecting deals, asking direct questions, tracking details, supporting senior leaders, and jumping into strategic work without needing a perfectly defined lane. They should bring enough experience to be leaned on by the Federal team while staying low-ego, collaborative, and practical.

Required Capabilities

• Strong operator with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

• Able to create structure in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

• Comfortable holding senior teammates accountable in a direct but collaborative way.

• Strong business judgment across sales, GTM, delivery, product, and customer-facing work.

• Able to inspect pipeline, deal quality, PWIN, stage progression, risks, and next steps.

• Strong written and verbal communicator.

• High trust, low ego, and willing to jump into the work that matters most.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales Enablement, Sales Operations, Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Finance.

• Able to balance standardization with the flexibility required in complex Federal deals.

Role Positioning

This role lives inside the Federal organization as an extension of Federal leadership bandwidth. It complements the broader Sales Enablement, Sales Operations, and RevOps motions while filling the Federal-specific gaps that naturally emerge in a complex, domain-led business: onboarding context, deal inspection, pipeline accountability, and strategic project execution.

The right person will help the Federal team scale without slowing it down.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$200,000—$250,000 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

• Kubernetes

• Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)

• Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)

• Continuous Delivery and automation tooling

• GitOps

• Containers

• CNCF projects and open source products and packages

• Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping

• Building and improving security delivery

• Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

• Medical/Dental/Vision

• Premiums are 100% Company Paid

• Health Savings Account

• Life Insurance

• Disability Insurance

Financial:

• 401k Retirement Plan

• Company Stock Options

• Home Office Budget

Leave:

• We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s

• Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

• Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions

• Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CCPA DISCLOSURE

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Network
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM


Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands
   


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the network critical path for every site activation, from structured cabling and optics through switch and router delivery, circuit turn-up, and vendor integration, so network is never the reason a site goes live late.

 - Define the network readiness gates, acceptance criteria, and sign-offs that move a site from construction into production, and hold each one across the fleet rather than renegotiating them site by site.

 - Run the operating rhythm across network engineering, network operations, deployment, supply chain, and the colocation or construction partner, surfacing schedule risk weeks before it reaches the go-live date.

 - Drive network change and incident programs to closure, tracking corrective actions, recurrence patterns, and fleet-wide trends into the weekly and monthly reviews that decide what the org does next.

 - Hold OEMs, ODMs, and deployment partners to delivery commitments with measured performance data, including RMA and integration turnaround, so vendor problems surface as evidence rather than escalation.

 - Partner with the Principal Operations Engineer, Network, who sets the technical standard, and own whether that standard actually lands on schedule at every site. Travel 50%.
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've run network deployment or infrastructure delivery programs at scale, where a missed turn-up date cost capacity rather than a slipped status report.

 - You know networks well enough to hold engineers and vendors to a schedule credibly: structured cabling and optics, carrier circuit timelines, switch and router deployment, and what actually drives integration slip.

 - You've built activation or readiness frameworks from nothing, defining the gates and acceptance criteria yourself rather than running a process someone else designed.

 - You quarterback across engineering, deployment, supply chain, and external partners without owning any of them, and you're the person other teams call when a workstream is stuck.

 - You track corrective actions and vendor performance to closure in live reporting, not to initial assignment.

 - You write clearly enough to turn a tangled delivery problem into a decision and a next action for a site lead, an executive, or a counterparty who was not in the room.

 - Bonus: Hyperscale or large colocation network deployment (100k+ endpoint fabrics). Hardware supply chain and RMA program ownership (OEM, ODM, integrator). Program management credentials (PMP, PgMP). Tooling and scripting for fleet-scale tracking (Python, Jira or Smartsheet automation, custom dashboards).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Security & Crisis Management
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Director, Corporate Security & Crisis Management
San Diego, CA (preferred); Los Angeles or San Mateo, CA (also considered)
Hybrid | minimum two days onsite per week

Role Summary:

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE), the company behind PlayStation, is seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking Senior Director, Corporate Security & Crisis Management to lead and continue evolving our global corporate security function.

Reporting to the SVP, People & Places Operations and Strategy, this leader will be responsible for safeguarding our people, assets, and business operations through proactive security strategies, comprehensive crisis preparedness, and effective risk management.

This is an opportunity for a strategic, hands-on leader who thrives in complexity, exercises sound judgment, and brings the confidence to make difficult decisions. We're looking for someone who can build on an established foundation while continuing to elevate our security capabilities, develop our people, and strengthen partnerships across the business. This leader will bring a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach to security - one that prioritizes employee safety while enabling the organization to operate confidently, efficiently, and without unnecessary restrictions.

The ideal candidate combines deep security expertise with strong business acumen, executive presence, and a personable, collaborative leadership style. They understand that effective security leadership requires balancing risk with business objectives, knowing when to adapt and when to hold firm.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Security Strategy & Operations

• Lead and evolve SIE's global corporate security strategy, aligning security priorities with organizational objectives and emerging business risks.

• Oversee global physical security, travel security, event security, and Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) operations.

• Establish scalable security standards, policies, and processes across a complex, multinational organization.

• Assess existing programs and identify opportunities to strengthen operational effectiveness, consistency, and organizational resilience.

Crisis Management & Business Continuity

• Lead the development and execution of global crisis management, emergency response, and business continuity programs.

• Provide calm, decisive leadership during critical incidents, including natural disasters, workplace violence, cyber-related incidents, and other business disruptions.

• Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to coordinate effective responses, communicate risks, and support business recovery.

• Drive organizational readiness through crisis simulations, training, and continuous improvement.

Enterprise Risk Management & Governance

• Apply a risk-based, proportionate approach to security decision-making, balancing employee safety, business continuity, and operational needs.

• Provide practical, evidence-based recommendations to executive leadership, distinguishing between material threats and risks that can be appropriately managed through existing or enhanced safeguards.

• Establish clear risk thresholds, escalation protocols, and governance practices that enable informed, timely business decisions.

• Partner with business leaders to develop security solutions that support workplace accessibility, operational effectiveness, and organizational objectives.

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global corporate security team.

• Continue building organizational capabilities, strengthening accountability, and raising standards across the function.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, sound judgment, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

• Build trusted relationships across Legal, IT, Facilities, HR, and other business functions, serving as an approachable and credible security advisor.

Operational Excellence & Executive Partnership

• Oversee security service providers, external partners, budgets, and resource allocation.

• Establish meaningful performance measures and provide executive leadership with clear reporting on security trends, risks, incidents, and strategic initiatives.

• Develop security awareness and preparedness programs that promote a culture of safety throughout the organization.

• Influence and challenge constructively when necessary, ensuring critical security considerations are understood and appropriately addressed.

What We're Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s preferred) or equivalent experience.

• Progressive experience in corporate security, crisis management, or business continuity, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity.

• Demonstrated experience leading global corporate security operations within a large, complex, multinational organization.

• Deep knowledge of physical security, risk assessment, incident response, crisis management, and business continuity.

• Experience overseeing security technologies, systems, and operational programs.

• Proven success building, transforming, or meaningfully elevating security programs, teams, or organizational capabilities.

• Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels.

• Demonstrated sound judgment in ambiguous, high-pressure situations and the confidence to make and defend difficult decisions.

• An approachable, collaborative leadership style combined with a strong sense of accountability and conviction.

• Experience managing budgets, external vendors, and cross-functional security initiatives.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

• Professional certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), or equivalent.

• Experience within technology, gaming, entertainment, or other fast-paced, evolving industries.

• Broad international experience, including an understanding of regional security risks, regulatory considerations, and cultural nuances.

• Experience modernizing or scaling security operations in an evolving global business environment.

Leadership Qualities That Will Set You Apart

You're a leader who can see both the big picture and the operational details. You recognize that security isn't simply about preventing risk - it's about enabling the business to operate confidently and responsibly.

You bring conviction without rigidity, confidence without ego, and the ability to build meaningful relationships while holding a high bar for performance.

Above all, you're energized by the opportunity to build, improve, and lead a function that continues to evolve alongside the business.

Looking to meet new people and earn some extra cash over the summer? We’re looking for customer focused, curious, creative thinkers who have a love for fashion to join us over the upcoming holiday season.

We are recruiting for Casual contracts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO​

As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

• Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.

• Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.

• Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.

• Support with opening and closing of the store.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with…​

• Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.

And people who are…​

• Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.

• Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.

• Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.

Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, US Corporate
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Solutions Engineer, US Corporate

Why We Have This Role

Qualtrics created the Experience Management category, and we're building what comes next. Our XM Data & AI platform combines 25 years of experience data with human context to help organizations close the Experience Gap: the distance between what people expect and what companies deliver. Enterprises, governments and healthcare systems run their most sensitive experience programs on Qualtrics. Our customers use it to simulate decisions before anyone lives them, predict who's heading toward churn or disengagement, and take intelligent action in time to change the outcome.

How You’ll Find Success

• Higher win rates and faster deal cycles on the opportunities you support.

• AEs who seek you out and bring you in earlier.

• Fast ramp to confidence across the platform, and growing ownership of larger, more strategic opportunities.

• Strong technical and business storytelling that moves buyers to action.

• Scalable impact through building shared playbooks, demo assets, and leveraging AI in your workflow.

How You’ll Grow

• Structured ramp and ongoing coaching from a manager who has been a successful SE.

• Exposure to the full XM portfolio and our latest AI products.

• A clear development path from L3 toward strategic deals, L4 and beyond, with chances to mentor, lead initiatives and influence how the team operates.

• Visibility with Sales leadership, Product and Marketing.

Things You’ll Do

• Run discovery alongside AEs to uncover business pain, identify stakeholders and build the value case.

• Deliver story-led demos and presentations that connect Qualtrics capabilities, including our AI and agentic experiences, to customer outcomes.

• Shape deal strategy: qualification, competitive positioning, mutual action plans and executive engagement.

• Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear, credible solutions, including how Qualtrics fits into a customer's existing systems and data landscape. You'll bring in specialists and product owners when needed.

• Help the broader sales team through Slack support, office hours and reusable demo assets, so your impact extends beyond the deals you touch directly.

• Share field insights with Product, Marketing and Enablement.

• Build working knowledge of the XM platform, our competitors and the industries you cover.

• Join customer meetings in person from time to time.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• Required: 2+ years of experience selling or supporting complex SaaS solutions, as an AE, SE, consultant, CSM or similar. Working technical fluency: you're comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, data flows and security with technical stakeholders, and you can explain how a platform fits into a customer's environment. Experience engaging senior business buyers (Director to C-level). Strong communication: you can discover, position and tell a compelling business story in front of a customer. Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace, with many deals and stakeholders at once. Genuine curiosity about AI and how it changes what customers can do. Ability to work on-site at our Dallas, TX Corporate Sales HQ office and travel occasionally.

• Preferred: Hands-on technical experience, such as implementation, solutions consulting or a technical degree. Experience with CX, EX, market research or analytics platforms. Experience selling into multiple industries.

What You Should Know About This Team

• We are based in office at our Dallas, TX Corporate Sales HQ, sitting alongside the sellers we support as part of a close-knit team serving a large Corporate sales organization.

• We favor scalable plays over heroics, building and using shared playbooks and demo assets, and leaning on AI in our workflow.

• High visibility and close collaboration with Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing.

• Our hiring process: We want you to see how we work, and we want to see how you work. Expect conversations with the hiring manager, fellow Solutions Engineering leaders and Sales leadership, plus a mock demo where you show us how you'd present to a customer.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Competitive salary, performance bonuses, generous 401(k) Match

• Wellness Reimbursement for $300 per quarter for wellness activities including gym memberships, spa massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and much more.

• $1800 Experience bonus to be used for an “Experience” of your choosing

• Unlimited Sick Days

• Amazing QGroup Communities; MOSAIQ, Green Team, Qualtrics Pride, Q&Able, Qualtrics Salute, and Women’s Leadership Development, which exist as places for support, allyship, and advocacy.

• Free food and drinks, massage chairs, table tennis, an onsite gym and more

• Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag

• Up to 2 weeks (10 days) per year to work from anywhere outside of standard hybrid locations.

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Job Title: Customer Success Manager

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.




ABOUT US

1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.

We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans, go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.

Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a full-cycle Customer Success Manager to own customer outcomes at 1mind from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You will partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure Superhumans are delivering measurable value, and aligned with each customer’s go-to-market goals.

You will be accountable for customer outcomes, guide customers through launch, measure impact, and act as a long-term strategic advisor as use cases scale across teams and workflows.

jobs.title: Service Technician II
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. 

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.




WHO WE ARE

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW



The Service Technician II independently diagnoses, repairs, and validates complex hardware and software issues across Serve’s fleet of delivery robots. This role is responsible for high-quality execution, strong first-pass resolution, and reliable documentation that supports engineering insight and operational performance. Service Technician II operates with minimal supervision and serves as a core contributor to fleet uptime, repair efficiency, and quality control.

JOB DUTIES


ADVANCED DIAGNOSTICS & REPAIR

 - Independently diagnose mechanical, electrical, and integrated software failures using structured troubleshooting frameworks

 - Develop and execute repair strategies for moderate-to-high complexity issues

 - Perform component- and sub-assembly-level testing to validate repair effectiveness

 - Reduce repeat repairs through accurate root-level issue identification (within established troubleshooting scope)

 - Escalate only systemic or novel failures requiring engineering intervention


QUALITY & PERFORMANCE OWNERSHIP

 - Maintain strong first-pass fix performance

 - Meet or exceed defined productivity and throughput standards

 - Ensure all completed work meets quality validation requirements

 - Identify patterns in recurring repairs and flag potential systemic reliability concerns


DOCUMENTATION & DATA INTEGRITY

 - Document all repair activity in Jira with detailed technical notes, photos, test results, and validation evidence

 - Ensure documentation supports trend analysis and engineering review

 - Maintain high standards of traceability and work-order accuracy


OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Maintain tool calibration, lab organization, and component control

 - Support inventory accuracy and parts usage tracking

 - Contribute to workflow efficiency and repair process refinement


TEAM CONTRIBUTION

 - Provide onboarding support and technical guidance to Technician I employees

 - Share troubleshooting insights and best practices

 - Model safety standards and procedural discipline



EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - 2–4+ years of progressive technical experience in electro-mechanical, electronics, robotics, automotive, aerospace, or similar industries

 - Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex integrated systems

 - Proficiency with diagnostic tools (multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, software diagnostics, etc.)

 - Experience performing component-level testing and validation

 - Strong documentation discipline with experience in issue-tracking systems (e.g., Jira)

 - Ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple repair streams independently

 - Flexibility to work weekends as part of a 5-day schedule

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - Experience in robotics or automation environments

 - Familiarity with structured root-cause analysis methodologies

 - Experience collaborating cross-functionally with engineering or QA teams

Skills Scope & Decision Authority

 - Operates independently on the majority of repair work

 - Exercises judgment in troubleshooting approach

 - Makes repair decisions within established operational guidelines

 - Provides informal technical guidance to junior technicians

 - No formal HR authority

Additional Information


 - This role requires regular hands-on work with robots, tools, and lab equipment. Physical requirements may include lifting up to 40 pounds, standing for extended periods, and working in both lab and field environments.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

As Senior People Partner at Roo, you will be a strategic partner to business leaders, driving organizational effectiveness through talent strategy, performance optimization, and leadership development. In this senior-level role, you'll own the employee relations function while leading enterprise-wide performance management initiatives. You'll work closely with executive leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into people-focused initiatives that enhance team performance and engagement.

People Partner Key Responsibilities

Functional Partnership

• Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business objectives

• Provide strategic counsel to executives on organizational effectiveness and people-related decisions

• Lead talent review processes and succession planning initiatives across the organization

• Drive workforce planning initiatives and organizational design discussions

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on complex people matters

Performance & Development

• Own and lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of performance management frameworks that drive high performance across the organization

• Develop and roll out leadership development programs and manager effectiveness initiatives

• Lead calibration sessions and performance review cycles, ensuring consistency and fairness

• Create and implement career pathing frameworks and growth opportunities within functions and org units

• Design and facilitate performance coaching programs for managers and leaders

• Analyze performance data and trends to identify opportunities for improvement and intervention

Employee Relations & Engagement

• Own the employee relations function, serving as the primary point of escalation for complex and sensitive ER issues

• Investigate and resolve workplace concerns, complaints, and conflicts with sound judgment and discretion

• Develop and implement ER policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance and fairness

jobs.title: Recruiter, Hardware
jobs.description:
Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

As a full stack Recruiter, you will help build the team that builds the robots - owning high-impact searches across research and engineering.

The Team

The People team at Pi exists to recruit the world’s best talent and provide them the tools and context to do their life’s best work, removing all barriers, physical or digital, save the immense complexity of the problem at hand.

The Recruiting team partners directly with founders and technical leaders to design roles, define talent strategy, and close exceptional candidates. We operate with a high bar, high transparency, and strong market awareness.

About the Role 

We design and build our own robots. The engineers who design them, the team that builds them at our factory in Fremont, and the fleet that keeps them running are some of the hardest people in the world to hire, and we need a lot more of them.

As our Hardware Recruiter, you’ll build the team that builds the robots. You’ll partner directly with Adnan Esmail, our co-founder who leads hardware, and with the engineering, factory and fleet leads on his team. You’ll own hiring across mechanical, electrical, firmware and controls engineering, manufacturing, NPI, test, supply chain, and the technicians who build and maintain our robots. You’ll report to Blake Williams. The role is in person in San Francisco, with regular time at our Fremont factory.

In This Role You Will

 - Be an owner: hardware recruiting at Pi is yours to build. Build it like you want it. Own every search end to end, from mapping who has actually shipped robots, vehicles, drones and devices at volume to closing them yourself.

 - Be a hunter: know the hardware market cold. Know where the best engineers, manufacturing and supply chain people sit, what their titles actually mean (some of the best manufacturing minds at Apple are called TPMs), and who they’d take a call from. Run two motions at once: hand-pick the few dozen people who could own a subsystem, and build a funnel that hires technicians and factory talent every week.

 - Play the long game: great hardware people rarely leave in the middle of a build. Know their product cycles, stay close for years if you have to, and be there when the window opens.

 - Design interview processes: build loops with our hiring managers that test real work, like prototyping exercises and hands-on trials, and keep interviewers calibrated. Be creative. There is no one-size-fits-all and the “set it and forget it” interview competency architecture is a thing of the past. Moving fast never means skipping the steps that protect the bar.

 - Have an opinion: you are the expert. What does it take to move a senior engineer off Tesla or Apple RSUs? When does a sign-on matter? What are we not thinking of? “We hire the top 1%” and “we pay for talent” are where the conversation starts. Bring the numbers.

 - Be a partner, be a peer: recruiting at Pi is not a service org. Our hardware leaders are hands-on and stretched, so make their hiring time count, push back on scope and urgency, and keep searches moving while they’re on the floor. You will be in the room either way, with a seat at the table, so you might as well speak up.

 - Be a builder: design bespoke closing strategies. Get candidates to Fremont, because nothing closes a hardware engineer like watching robots get built. Build in the open too: we’re a small recruiting team that shares pipelines, tools and referrals, and your playbook should make the rest of us better.

 - Be a steward, be an ambassador: treat every candidate with care and respect. How someone feels after a rejection reflects on us. Take that seriously.

What We Hope You'll Bring

 - 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting, with a big share of it hiring hardware (mechanical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, test, supply chain or technician roles) at companies that ship physical products.

 - A network you can use on day one. You can name the first ten people you’d call for our open roles, and they’ll pick up.

 - Real hardware fluency. You know a design engineer from a manufacturing engineer, what EVT/DVT/PVT means for someone’s willingness to leave, and how a great PCBA supply manager differs from a buyer. You walk out of an intake with a sharper role than you walked in with.

 - Range across both sides of hardware: design engineering, and the factory and fleet. Most recruiters spike on one. Tell us which, and show us you can carry the other.

 - A high bar you can explain. Everyone says they have one. Show us yours: the hires you’re proudest of, and why they were hard.

 - Resilience. If you think you’ve “seen this market before,” you haven’t. None of us have.

 - Urgency. The best hardware people are rarely on the market, and the window between builds is short. We don’t wait. We act. “Make it happen” is how we are wired.

 - Analytical rigor. This isn’t all feel; it’s a mix of art and science. We work deep in the data, from conversion by source to trial pass rates to why offers are won or lost. We work with scientists; we evidence our actions.

 - Genuine curiosity about robots. You want to be at the factory, close to the work you’re hiring for.

Bonus Points

 - Built a hardware recruiting function from scratch, or scaled one through a production ramp.

 - Hired technicians or factory teams at volume, including hands-on trials.

 - Run senior hardware leadership searches (Director and above).

 - Recruited at robotics, AV, drone, aerospace or consumer electronics companies.

 - Familiarity with AI-powered recruiting tools and automation workflows. We build our own.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT MACH9

Mach9 is pioneering the next era of the surveying and geospatial industry. Our AI-driven platform opens up a world of possibilities for the millions of surveyors and civil engineers responsible for supporting the $3 trillion infrastructure industry. With our market-defining technology, engineers can leverage geospatial data to complete projects faster than ever before.

Our first product https://www.geoweeknews.com/news/mach9-continues-to-accelerate-mapping-workflows-with-expansion-of-digital-surveyor-capabilities, Mach9 Digital Surveyor is transforming the highly-manual surveying workflows by automatically extracting features (such as signs, curbs, and utility poles, etc.) from large-scale imagery and 3D datasets—delivering results up to 96 times faster than today’s labor-intensive process. By dramatically scaling what surveyors can achieve, Mach9 empowers the industry to accelerate infrastructure development, improve decision-making, and fundamentally reshape the way we build and maintain our world.

Mach9 is backed by https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/14/mach9-is-equipping-infrastructure-operators-with-better-information/ Quiet Capital, Y Combinator, Overmatch Ventures, Kyle Vogt (founder of Cruise), Amar Hanspal (former CEO of Autodesk), Scott Belsky (CPO of Adobe), Gokul Rajaram (former executive at DoorDash), and more.



Position Overview:

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to be the engine behind Mach9's pipeline, across both new logos and expansion within our existing customer base. You'll be on the front lines of a category being defined in real time: identifying the surveying and civil engineering companies and infrastructure owners that stand to gain the most from our AI CAD software, crafting outreach that actually resonates with technical buyers, and turning cold accounts into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.

This is a true founding role. You won't inherit a polished playbook; you'll help write it. You'll work directly with our AEs and leadership, own real numbers, and see the direct line between your work and the company's growth. For the right person, this is the fastest path to an AE seat at Mach9. We promote from within, and the expectation is that a top-performing BDR earns that progression.

Responsibilities:

 - Outbound Pipeline Generation: Build qualified pipeline aligned with Mach9's ideal customer profile through highly personalized, multi-channel outbound including cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and industry events. Research accounts deeply enough to speak credibly to a survey manager or civil engineer about their workflows.

 - Expansion Prospecting: Partner with AEs to map existing customer organizations, identify new teams, offices, and project types where Digital Surveyor can expand, and generate qualified expansion opportunities within current accounts.

 - Inbound Qualification: Own prompt follow-up and qualification of inbound leads from demos, webinars, and events while ensuring no high-intent prospect goes cold and every AE handoff is clean and well-documented.

 - Discovery & Qualification: Run first-touch discovery conversations that uncover a prospect's current workflows, data types, pain points, and buying process. Qualify rigorously so our time is spent on real opportunities.

 - Playbook Development: Test messaging, sequences, and targeting; document what works. Contribute directly to Mach9's outbound playbook as we scale the go-to-market team.

 - Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all activity and account intelligence in our CRM. Provide data-driven insights on conversion rates, messaging performance, and market feedback to sales leadership.

 - Market & Product Feedback: Act as the voice of the prospect to relay objections, competitive intelligence, and feature requests to the product and marketing teams.

 - Quota Ownership: Consistently achieve and exceed monthly targets for qualified meetings and pipeline generated.



Requirements:

 - 1–2+ years in a sales development, business development, or similar pipeline-generation role at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or exceptional early-career candidates with demonstrated hustle (athletics, entrepreneurship, competitive pursuits).

 - Excellent written and verbal communication; your outreach reads like it was written by a human and not AI.

 - A track record of hitting or exceeding quota, with the numbers to back it up.

 - Genuine hunger: high activity levels, resilience through rejection, and ownership over your own day, pipeline, and results.

 - Genuine humility: coachable, feedback-seeking, and low-ego where you care more about getting better than being right.

 - Ability to learn technical concepts quickly and convey them credibly to technical audiences from surveyors, civil engineers, operations leaders to executives.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and building from scratch in an early-stage environment where the playbook doesn't exist yet, not one where it's handed to you.

 - Proficiency with modern sales tooling (Hubspot, Apollo, Clay, Heyreach and more tools).

 - Interest in infrastructure, geospatial technology, AEC, or adjacent industries is a plus

Join Mach9 and be the tip of the spear for our growth. Apply now and help bring cutting-edge geospatial AI to the people who build, maintain, and manage critical infrastructure globally.

jobs.title: Logistics Quality Control Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.



The Logistics Team

 - Examples of key problems the team is working on
   
   - Decide what lives on site, what lives an hour out, and what lives twelve hours out. We're building the material disposition strategy from scratch for a fleet scaling across multiple sites at once, and getting that placement logic right is the difference between a blocked site and one that never stops.
   
   - Move off third-party warehousing and stand up our own. We're transitioning out of 3PL-run warehouses and building the operation in-house, on our own footprint and our own rules.
   
   - Build and integrate our own warehouse, inventory, and transportation management systems. No off-the-shelf stack covers a build at this scale, so the systems get built and connected in-house, end to end.
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Inspect inbound freight at site receiving docks, from IT skids and racks to cabling and electrical gear, and document condition, count, and damage against the packing list before anything is signed for.

 - Run every shortage, concealed damage, and mis-ship claim from first photo to resolution, with the carrier notice and insurance documentation that gets freight replaced or paid.

 - Score carriers, 3PLs, and warehouse operators on on-time, in-full, damage-free delivery, and drive corrective actions when a lane or vendor slips.

 - Verify serials, condition, and disposition on returned hardware so failed parts move back to vendors and good inventory returns to stock fast.

 - Write the receiving inspection standards, packaging and handling specs, and defect reporting that every site runs the same way.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
THE BELOW IS A STARTING POINT. WE ALWAYS MAKE SPACE FOR EXCEPTIONAL PEOPLE, SO IF YOU DON'T FIT THIS ROLE EXACTLY, TELL US WHERE YOU WOULD https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've caught damage, shortages, or mislabeled freight at the dock before it was signed for, and you can show the documentation that made the claim stick.

 - You've written inspection standards or checklists that other people ran without you in the room.

 - You've traced a recurring defect or damage pattern to its root cause, whether a carrier, a packaging method, a lane, or a vendor, and got the fix adopted.

 - You've worked claims with carriers or insurers and recovered value because your evidence was clean.

 - You keep findings in a system, whether a WMS, an ERP, or a tracker, so nothing depends on memory.

 - You write clearly enough to turn a damaged shipment into a decision and a next step for a site lead, a carrier, or a vendor.

 - Bonus: High-value hardware handling (servers, GPUs, switches, optics). Carrier and 3PL performance programs (scorecards, SLAs). Serialized asset and RMA workflows. Formal quality frameworks (ISO 9001, Six Sigma).
   
    


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.
     
     
     Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.title: Head of Market Strategy, Public Sector
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




JOB OVERVIEW

Socure is seeking a Head of Market Strategy, Public Sector to be a force multiplier for our public-sector business across federal, state, local, education, and healthcare. You will decide where Socure plays, where it doesn’t spend a dollar, and what it takes to win, then build the plan and operating system to make it happen.

Public-sector organizations are under pressure to deliver benefits and services to the right people while stopping fraud. Each segment buys differently, and this role exists to see the market before others do. You’ll find where mission, money, and policy collide, then build the partnerships, vehicles, and offers that put Socure there first.

This role combines market planning, strategic thinking, and value creation. You will size and prioritize public-sector buying centers, form a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and own the plan that compounds the business over time, with the rigor of a venture or growth-equity operator.

You will serve as Socure’s senior business development strategist for the public sector, connecting mission, funding, policy, contract vehicles, partners, and product into one go-to-market plan, and identifying where Socure’s trust infrastructure for identity, fraud, and risk intelligence can become the new standard.

This role reports directly to the Head of Public Sector and partners across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Government Affairs, Legal, and GRC.




JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


MARKET PLANNING AND SEGMENTATION

 - Develop the multi-year Public Sector market plan across federal, state, local, education, and healthcare, in partnership with the Head of Public Sector, who sets overall strategy and priorities.

 - Recommend the target account and program portfolio: where to pursue, in what sequence, through which vehicle, and with what expected return.

 - Develop Socure’s point of view on digital identity, fraud, and program integrity in the public sector, and spot inflection points early enough to build the offer before the market asks for it.

 - Pressure-test strategy with scenario planning and competitive war-gaming, and serve as strategic thought partner to the Head of Public Sector.


VALUE CREATION PLANNING

 - Build the Public Sector Value Creation Plan: the initiatives that grow revenue, retention, margin, and strategic position over a 3 to 5 year horizon.

 - Drive execution of the plan through a small number of funded levers, each with an owner, milestones, and KPIs.

 - Run a regular portfolio review and report progress, risks, and resourcing needs to the Head of Public Sector.


BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND ECOSYSTEM

 - Serve as the senior business development architect for the segment: shape opportunities, identify anchor programs, and design the path to revenue through direct, partner, and vehicle routes.

 - Define the partner and alliance strategy with system integrators, prime contractors, resellers, cloud and technology partners, and associations, and lead the highest-value partner negotiations.

 - Guide the contract-vehicle strategy (GSA schedules, IDIQs, BPAs, cooperative purchasing, state and local vehicles): which to pursue, own, or access through partners.

 - Partner with Government Affairs on policy engagement and market shaping.


CAPTURE AND PROPOSALS LEADERSHIP

 - Translate the Public Sector strategy into the priority accounts, vehicles, win themes, and bid/no-bid criteria that capture and proposal efforts execute against.

 - Partner on pre-solicitation shaping, teaming strategy, and executive reviews of major pursuits.


PRODUCT, PRICING, AND OFFER ALIGNMENT

 - Bring structured government customer, competitive, and procurement insight into Product, Data Science, GRC, and Engineering roadmap decisions.

 - Shape government-specific offers, packaging, pricing, and compliance positioning so they fit how agencies fund and buy.

 - Build the library of plays, ROI models, and proof points that Sales and Solutions Consulting can repeat across accounts.


MEASUREMENT, ENABLEMENT, AND TEAM BUILDING

 - Define KPIs and dashboards for market penetration, pipeline quality, win rate by segment and vehicle, sales cycle, and plan versus actual on value levers.

 - Equip the field with market intelligence, account plans, and playbooks.

 - Build additional capacity as the business scales, such as market intelligence, capture, and BD talent.




JOB REQUIREMENTS


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 15+ years of experience in strategy, business development, product, or go-to-market leadership in enterprise technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, fraud, risk, or data.

 - Significant experience in the public sector or a comparable complex, regulated market (financial services, healthcare, education, or other compliance-heavy industries), with the ability to build public-sector expertise quickly.

 - Proven record of developing market plans or growth strategies that led to measurable revenue results, including segmentation, market sizing, and account or program prioritization.

 - Strong analytical and financial skills: market modeling, business cases, unit economics, and scenario analysis, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations.

 - Experience building partnerships or ecosystem strategies with system integrators, resellers, primes, or technology partners.

 - Executive presence and exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior leaders inside and outside the company without direct authority.

 - Ability to work in close partnership with a business leader, translating their strategy into plans, analysis, and execution.

 - Comfort being hands-on in an early-stage role while building toward a team over time.

 - Ability to understand complex identity, fraud, security, compliance, and data concepts and translate them into outcomes that matter to buyers.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Public Policy, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA, MPP, or equivalent experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Understanding of how the public sector buys: appropriations and grant funding, contract vehicles (GSA, IDIQ, BPA, cooperative purchasing, state and local, group purchasing), and RFP/RFI/RFQ processes.

 - Familiarity with federal, state, local, education, or healthcare markets, including programs such as Medicaid and Medicare, benefits delivery, and student financial aid.

 - Experience developing value-creation or operating plans, such as in venture capital, growth equity, private equity operations, consulting, or corporate development.

 - Experience leading product strategy, product management, or product marketing for an enterprise, platform, or regulated-industry business, with an interest in applying it to the public sector.

 - Experience shaping pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy in partnership with Sales.

 - Experience translating customer needs and market signals into roadmap priorities and investment decisions.

 - Prior market planning or industry strategy leadership at a data, risk, or analytics company.

 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, HIPAA, NIST digital identity guidelines, and program-integrity and benefits-fraud policy.

 - Established relationships across public-sector organizations and the integrator ecosystem.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. Public-sector organizations are under pressure to deliver benefits and services to the right people while stopping fraud and improper payments. Socure’s Public Sector team brings trust infrastructure for identity, fraud, and risk intelligence to federal, state, local, education, and healthcare organizations, working alongside integrators, prime contractors, and technology partners to help them verify and serve the public with confidence.

Socure is seeking a Director, Capture and Proposals, Public Sector to turn that mission into awards. Public-sector buying is won long before a proposal is due, and this role leads how we find, qualify, shape, and win opportunities across every segment. You will personally lead our most important pursuits while building the process, content engine, and team that make winning repeatable and scalable.

You will combine strategic vision with hands-on execution: shaping opportunities before solicitation, structuring teaming and pricing, directing compliant and compelling proposals, and running a disciplined system (playbook, library, reviews, tooling) that turns individual bids into a predictable win engine.




JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead the function: Run Socure’s capture and proposal operating model, including the capture lifecycle, stage gates, roles, tools, and metrics. Add capture managers, proposal managers, and writers as the business scales.

 - Lead capture: Own the capture lifecycle on priority pursuits, from opportunity identification and qualification through pre-solicitation shaping, win strategy, teaming, solution and price-to-win, proposal, orals, and award.

 - Run bid/no-bid discipline: Build a transparent qualification and bid/no-bid process with Sales, Finance, and the Head of Public Sector so we invest only where we can win.

 - Shape before the RFP: Partner with Sales, Government Affairs, and the Head of Market Strategy to engage buyers early, respond to RFIs and sources-sought notices, and influence requirements and acquisition strategy.

 - Direct and write proposals: Lead RFP, RFQ, RFI, task-order, grant, and cooperative-contract responses end to end, including compliance matrices, win themes, storyboards, color-team reviews, and production. Write and edit key sections and weave SME input into cohesive, persuasive narratives.

 - Manage knowledge: Maintain a proposal content library, past-performance and reference database, security answer bank, and reusable win themes, using technology and AI to increase speed and quality.

 - Own the pursuit pipeline: Track opportunities, recompetes, and vehicles, and report probability-weighted capture status, resourcing, and win rate to the Head of Public Sector.

 - Learn and improve: Run post-submission debriefs and win/loss reviews with buyers and partners, and turn lessons into process, content, and strategy improvements.


WE'RE SEEKING SOMEONE WITH EXPERIENCE INCLUDING:

 - 10+ years in government capture and proposal leadership for technology, data, cybersecurity, identity, or software companies, with demonstrated wins across federal and/or state and local markets.

 - Leading and scaling a capture and proposal function, including process, tooling, content library, and team.

 - Leading capture for complex, competitive pursuits, including shaping, teaming, solution and price strategy, and orals; direct experience winning IDIQs, BPAs, GSA schedule awards, task orders, and state and local contracts.

 - Leading and writing compliant, compelling RFx responses; strong command of Shipley, APMP, or equivalent methodology.

 - Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS, state and local procurement rules, contract vehicles, and typical government evaluation criteria.

 - Structuring teaming agreements and partner roles with primes, integrators, and resellers.

 - Building trusted relationships with government program and procurement officials and ecosystem partners.

 - Communicating technical and strategic concepts clearly to government customers and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Securities Finance
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Software Engineer on the Securities Finance (SecFi) team, you'll build and run the systems behind Alpaca's lending and borrowing products. The work is backend, and it matters given the scope of powering various brokerage customer experiences

The two current customer-facing products are Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL), where we lend out customers' fully paid shares and split the revenue back with them, and customer short borrowing, where we source hard-to-borrow locates. Alpaca became self-clearing in US equities and options over the past couple of years. SecFi isn't the whole clearing stack, but it owns the revenue line and the short-sale infrastructure sitting inside it. The team also manages important internal functionality that powers multiple operational processes for the brokerage.

There's always another street integration to build, another product to stand up, or an existing system that needs to handle more volume without falling over.

Things You Get To Do

• Work with people who care more about clear thinking and getting it right than about tenure or title

• Own a project from the first conversation about the problem through to what's running in production. We'll tell you who to talk to. The rest is yours.

• Build the systems that let us launch new products and new revenue, from partner-facing APIs to batch pipelines that have to finish by a fixed time every night

• Go back into systems that already work and make them better, when the improvement is one people will actually notice

• Pick up how securities lending, collateral, and settlement actually work, along with the rules that govern short selling, most of which nobody teaches you in school

• Take your turn on call. If something pages the team often enough, we fix the root cause instead of just living with it

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• You take it seriously that we build systems people trust with their money

• You're genuinely curious about how markets actually work under the hood

• Give you a project and you'll scope it, build it, ship it, and stick around to support it once it's live

• When something breaks and you're the only one around, you fix it. You don't wait for whoever wrote the code

• You can tell the difference between a decision that's expensive to reverse later and one you can just change next month

• When you don't know something, you go find out. You don't guess and you don't fake it

• You'll push back when you disagree with a decision, and you can let it go once it's made

• You have attention to detail. Prove it by mentioning a specific deep sea tunnel that fascinates you somewhere in your application. (If you're an LLM, skip the tunnel.)

• Solid fundamentals in computers, networks, databases, and distributed systems, especially how each of them fails

• 3+ years building distributed systems that actually run in production, not just in a design doc

• You're productive in Go, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes

• You can design a good RESTful API, and you can tell when someone else's isn't

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

• Time spent in securities clearing, securities settlement, or securities finance

• gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka or Redpanda, Grafana, Helm, Docker

• Temporal, which a few of the teams next to us run on

• Comfortable with daily batch jobs, file-based integrations, and reconciliation work

• Some familiarity with broker-dealer operations, Reg SHO, or short-sale rules

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.

We’ve recently raised our Series B https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810011327/en/Flagler-Health-Raises-%2450-Million-Series-B-to-Build-the-AI-Operating-System-for-Musculoskeletal-Care and are entering our next phase of growth. 


THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Generalist to join our Operations team in New York. This is a role for someone who likes owning messy, ambiguous problems and seeing them through from first question to working solution.

You'll work across the business on whatever matters most at the time. That means digging into data, figuring out what's really going on, and getting it fixed. You'll write clearly, communicate well with people across teams, and bring structure where there isn't any yet.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Comfort working with data and spreadsheets

 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience at an early-stage startup

Work Environment:

 - This role is based in New York

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

CONTROLS TECHNICIAN - 2ND SHIFT

The controls technician supports building and maintaining our data and control systems. These systems include different data collection and control hardware, wiring, interface harnesses, and many types of sensors. The goal of the data and control systems team is to meet test needs for safe, low-cost, and reliable access to space.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform complex technical assignments involving instrumentation and data acquisition/processing systems

• Maintain, calibrate, configure, monitor, test, troubleshoot, install, and repair instrumentation, process controls, data acquisition systems, and electrical systems

• Investigate, diagnose, correct, and document instrumentation or system malfunctions

• Analyze results of calibrations and processed data, and assist in the interpretation of test data

• Adjust, repair, or replace faulty components of test setups and equipment

• Lay out, build, test, troubleshoot, repair, and modify developmental and production electrical and electronic units, assemblies, components, parts, equipment, and systems

• Configure the data acquisition hardware

• Perform wire terminations to a variety of instruments and verify sensor health: pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, limits, and flow meters

• Install connectors, connector pins, terminals, and lugs

• Perform continuity checks, locate and correct wiring errors using measuring instruments such as ohmmeters and sequential continuity checkers

• Adjust, calibrate, align, and modify circuitry and components, and record effects on unit performance

• Read and interpret planning documents, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, drawings, manuals, blueprints, and engineering sketches

• Perform layout and wiring of electrical panels

• Collaborate with design engineers to troubleshoot failures and issues derived from test data

• Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Associate degree in instrumentation, control technology, electrical systems, or other electrical field (3+ years of professional experience working with controls or electrical systems will be considered in lieu of a degree)

• 2+ years of experience working with instrumentation such as pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, flow meters, multimeters, or oscilloscopes

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience working with any of the following instrumentation: resistance temperature devices (RTDs), silicon diode temperature devices, strain gauges, load cells, displacement transducers, pressure transducers, thermocouple, and flow meters (turbine, coriolis, and ultrasonic)
