• Background should include experience with the following devices: DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) installations, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
About us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the role

As a (Sr) Business Recruiter on our growing Talent Acquisition team, you’ll partner closely with business leaders on attracting and acquiring top talent for our non-technical, non-sales functions across the business.

This is a full-cycle recruiting role with total ownership across sourcing, screening, and candidate / pipeline management. You’ll be directly responsible for growing our corporate non-tech team while maintaining an extremely high bar which will require creative thinking and partnering across the business. This is an exciting opportunity with high exposure, visibility, and business partnering!

This role is full-time and only open to NYC-based candidates who are open to coming into the office 2+ days/week. Our office is in the heart of Gramercy.

Key responsibilities:

• Manage the full recruiting lifecycle end-to-end for all corporate variable openings

• Partner with functional leaders and greater TA team to understand hiring needs and execute effective recruiting processes

• Provide a stellar candidate experience that is transparent, considerate, and timely

• Proactively attract and engage world-class talent through various strategies (active and passive sourcing campaigns, job boards, conferences, social media, employee networks, outside agencies, internal hires, etc)

• Continuously strengthen the Nourish employer brand & hiring process. Our success depends on how well we hire and you’ll introduce new ideas, best practices, influence the business to set a gold standard for talent acquisition

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 4+ years of recruiting experience

• You’ve worked at a startup that has experienced fast growth

• You enjoy every part of the hiring process, from sourcing to signing, and love having end-to-end ownership. You have a headhunter mindset - you go find the best talent; you don’t wait for it to come to you

jobs.title: Director, Statistician Real-World Analytics
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Director Statistician Real‑World Analytics will provide statistical leadership for real-world evidence (RWE), epidemiology, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) studies supporting Revolution Medicines' oncology development programs.

This individual will serve as the statistical lead for observational research studies across the drug development lifecycle, partnering closely with HEOR/RWE scientists, real-world analytics programmers, clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, safety, market access, and other stakeholders. The role will be lead the development of statistical analysis plans (SAPs) for observational research studies including statistical methodology and causal inference strategy when appropriate.

The successful candidate will have deep expertise in oncology real-world data (RWD), comparative effectiveness research, external control arm methodologies, and advanced causal inference approaches, with the ability to generate evidence supporting regulatory, payer, HTA, and scientific decision-making.

Responsibilities:

• Serves as the statistical lead for real-world studies from concept development through final study delivery.

• Partners with HEOR/RWE scientists and cross-functional stakeholders to design observational studies addressing clinical, regulatory, market access, and scientific objectives.

• Collaborates with HEOR/RWE scientists and study teams to develop study protocols and lead development of statistical analysis plans (SAPs) and statistical analysis specifications for HEOR/RWE, healthcare resource utilization (HCRU), epidemiology, and post-approval safety studies, as well as comparative effectiveness and safety studies, and when appropriate provide statistical rationale for implementation of external control arm studies, all using real-world data. Studies are used to inform internal stakeholder groups (e.g., clinical development) as well as external groups (e.g., regulatory decision making).

• Collaborates with HEOR/RWE scientists to design statistical thinking to evaluate indirect treatment comparison (ITC), matching-adjusted indirect comparison (MAIC), simulated treatment comparison (STC), and network meta-analysis (NMA) approaches where appropriate.

• Partners with HEOR/RWE and cross-functional stakeholders to develop evidence strategies supporting HTA, JCA, payer, reimbursement, and access decision-making.

• Applies advanced causal inference methodologies, including propensity score methods, inverse probability weighting, matching, stratification, doubly robust approaches, marginal structural models, and target trial emulation frameworks.

• Develops strategies to address confounding, selection bias, missing data, immortal time bias, and other common challenges in observational research.

• Provide statistical oversight of analysis implementation performed by real-world statistical programmers.

• Interprets study findings and communicate results to multidisciplinary stakeholders.

• Contributes to publications, scientific presentations, regulatory interactions, payer engagements, and HTA submissions.

• Stays current with evolving regulatory guidance and methodological advances related to oncology RWE, causal inference, and evidence generation.

• Provide statistical leadership and methodological guidance for studies utilizing claims, EHR, genomic, registry, and linked clinical-genomic datasets.

• Evaluates data fitness-for-purpose, study feasibility, endpoint availability, follow-up completeness, and potential sources of bias across major oncology and healthcare real-world data assets, including Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, COTA, Tempus, Guardant, Merative MarketScan, Komodo, Optum, TriNetX, and similar data sources.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• PhD or MS in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Data Science, or related quantitative discipline.

• 10+ years of relevant experience.

• Demonstrated experience leading statistical strategy for observational research, comparative effectiveness studies, HEOR, HCRU, epidemiology, or real-world evidence studies.

• Strong understanding of causal inference methodology and observational study design.

• Experience developing study protocols, SAPs, and statistical specifications.

• Experience designing and evaluating propensity score methodologies and confounding adjustment approaches.

• Experience interpreting and communicating observational research findings to scientific and non-scientific audiences.

• Experience working with large healthcare databases including claims, EHR, genomic, registry, and linked datasets.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory and methodological guidance relevant to RWE, including guidance and best practices from FDA, EMA, ISPOR, ISPE, NICE, or related organizations.

Preferred Skills:

• Oncology drug development experience.

• Experience supporting external control arm development.

• Experience supporting regulatory-grade real-world evidence studies.

• Experience supporting HTA, JCA, payer, or market access evidence generation.

• Experience conducting or overseeing indirect treatment comparisons (ITC), MAIC, STC, or network meta-analyses.

• Experience designing target trial emulation studies.

• Experience working with major oncology and healthcare real-world data assets, including Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, COTA, Tempus, Guardant, Komodo, Optum, TriNetX, and Merative MarketScan.

• Experience designing and evaluating oncology-specific real-world endpoints, including real-world overall survival, real-world progression-free survival, treatment duration, time to treatment discontinuation, response-based endpoints, and healthcare resource utilization measures.

• Publication record in oncology, epidemiology, HEOR, or real-world evidence.

• Experience working in a fast-paced biotechnology environment.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

In this role, you will support the day-to-day operations and continuous improvement of a business-critical application supporting cloud infrastructure and GPU capacity deployment workflows. You will partner with business stakeholders and engineering teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into functional specifications, coordinate feature delivery, and support testing, user acceptance, and production releases. You will also manage incoming user questions, coordinate incident resolution, track enhancement requests, validate functionality, and maintain clear documentation throughout the software development lifecycle. This position offers hands-on exposure to technical product operations, business analysis, cloud infrastructure, and cross-functional software delivery, with opportunities to take ownership of operational workflows and drive improvements that support business continuity.

Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operational support for an enterprise application, including triaging user questions, investigating issues, coordinating troubleshooting, and tracking resolutions.

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business needs for application enhancements, maintenance requests, and new features.

• Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows for engineering teams.

• Coordinate application enhancements and maintenance requests throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through development, testing, and production deployment.

• Maintain and prioritize backlogs, track deliverables, monitor dependencies, and follow up on outstanding actions to ensure timely execution.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to investigate production incidents, coordinate issue resolution, communicate status updates, and drive corrective actions through closure.

• Perform initial functional validation in sandbox and test environments before coordinating business user acceptance testing.

• Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), document test results and defects, collect stakeholder feedback, and track issues through resolution and business sign-off.

• Support production releases by coordinating deployment readiness, communicating release updates, and confirming that delivered functionality is available to business users.

• Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, incidents, testing results, decisions, feature requests, and release activities.

• Prepare for and support recurring application business reviews by tracking open issues, feature requests, action items, decisions, and stakeholder responsibilities.

• Develop status updates, project documentation, and presentations to communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes to stakeholders.

• Apply established project management and software development processes to support application quality, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Approximately 2–4 years of experience in technical product management, product operations, program management, business analysis, or enterprise application support.

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.

• Experience coordinating technology or software delivery initiatives across business stakeholders and engineering teams.

• Understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, deployment, release management, and production support.

• Experience managing feature requests, maintenance activities, or application enhancements from initial requirements through implementation.

• Experience supporting enterprise applications, including troubleshooting coordination, issue tracking, and resolution of production problems.

• Knowledge of functional testing, defect tracking, user acceptance testing, and business sign-off processes.

• Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to maintain backlogs, track dependencies, manage competing priorities, and drive outstanding items to closure.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, and cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to assess risks, identify blockers, and coordinate solutions across multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to learn complex business processes and enterprise applications quickly while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent operational execution.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Azure DevOps or similar tools for backlog management, work-item tracking, requirements documentation, and delivery coordination.

• Familiarity with incident management systems and processes, including incident tracking, escalation, status communication, and resolution follow-through.

• Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, supply chain applications, capacity planning, GPU deployment, or related technical business operations.

• Experience working with business-critical applications that serve multiple stakeholder groups or organizations.

• Exposure to cloud supply chain environments, including those associated with major cloud service providers.

• Familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools, including Teams, Outlook, and related documentation and communication workflows.

• Experience coordinating application maintenance requests, feature enhancements, testing cycles, production releases, and post-release support.

• Experience preparing operational reports, business review materials, status presentations, and stakeholder communications.

• Project management certification, such as PMP or PMI, or progress toward a relevant certification.

• MBA or another relevant advanced degree.

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $45-$52 USD/hourly. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

Location: 5 days per week onsite in Redmond, WA

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Competitive paid time off

• Parental leave

• Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

jobs.title: Data Visualization Engineer
jobs.description:

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

This Data Visualization Engineer is a versatile, hands-on builder who owns how 𝕏 turns data into decisions. They will administer our current BI platform, build dashboards quickly, and partner with the business to shape a modern, unified reporting and analytics solution.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

jobs.title: Physical Performance Coach
jobs.description:
At Angel City FC, we are building a world-class organization that uses sport to drive equity. One of the most valuable women’s sports teams in the world, we are redefining how sport, entertainment, and purpose intersect.

Our vision is to create engaging and unique experiences that bring our mission to life while building a sustainable, high-growth business. We lead with passion, innovation, and a commitment to doing things differently.

We are stronger together, have more impact together, and have more fun together.

Role Overview:
The Physical Performance Coach, working within the wider performance department, will support the Director of Performance in creating a high-performance culture driven by an individualized, player-centred approach and a commitment to individual and team development. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality on-field physical preparation, speed development and recovery, aligning it with the team's periodisation model. Working closely with the Director of Performance and wider High Performance team, the Performance Coach will support the implementation of the club’s physical performance strategy through the delivery of training, monitoring, and athlete development initiatives.

As part of a multidisciplinary Performance and Medical team, the successful candidate will communicate effectively with High Performance and Medical staff to support training delivery, athlete management, and performance planning. The role will contribute practical insights into physical preparation, training load management, and athlete readiness to support performance outcomes, reduce injury risk, and facilitate the long-term athletic development of Angel City FC players. All aspects of the role will be delivered in alignment with the performance philosophy and periodization model established by the Director of Performance.

Responsibilities:

• In collaboration with the Director of Performance, deliver high-quality coaching across on-field physical preparation and training sessions, ensuring exercises are delivered with appropriate technical detail, intent, and coaching standards that support performance outcomes and player development.

• Work closely with the Director of Performance to support the delivery of the on-field periodization plan, using training load, monitoring, and performance data to inform session delivery, evaluate athlete responses, and adapt training in line with athlete readiness and training / match demands.

• Collaborate with the High Performance team to develop players' movement quality, speed, acceleration, deceleration, and change-of-direction capabilities through the delivery of targeted on-field interventions aligned with individual player needs and performance objectives.

• Contributing to the collection, interpretation, and application of performance data to inform athlete development.

• Collaborate with the High Performance team to support the design, delivery, and monitoring of individual physical development programmes, including off-season programs, ensuring alignment with performance objectives and long-term athlete development goals.

• Assist the Strength and Conditioning Performance Coach and Return-to-Play Performance Coach with the delivery of gym-based strength and conditioning programmes, ensuring consistency between on-field and gym-based interventions.

• Support the planning and delivery of performance strategies during travel and competition periods, including travel preparation, recovery implementation, player monitoring, and schedule adjustments to optimize player readiness and performance throughout the season.

• Actively support community, commercial, and club initiatives where appropriate.

• Demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development and the ongoing advancement of applied performance practice.

• Enforce team standards, policies, and league regulations applicable to players and staff.

Essential:

• Strong understanding of soccer-specific periodization principles and the ability to interpret GPS and performance data to inform coaching and performance decisions

• Experience working with performance data systems, including GPS (e.g., Catapult), athlete management systems, and force/strength diagnostics (e.g., VALD)

• Proven experience working in an elite or high-performance sport environment, ideally within professional female football or comparable team sports, for more than 3 years.

• Proven experience delivering high-quality on-field physical preparation, including conditioning, speed development, warm-ups, within an elite team sport environment.

• Demonstrated ability to coach and develop movement quality, acceleration, deceleration, speed, and change-of-direction capabilities within a performance programme.

• Experience supporting match day performance operations, including pre-match preparation, warm-up delivery, player readiness activities, and post-match recovery and conditioning implementation.

• Certified Performance and Sport Scientist (CPSS) or the ability to get the accreditation within the next 6 months.

• Strong understanding of football game models, sports science, and related disciplines, including their impact on athletic performance

• High level of organization and attention to detail, with the proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-performance team environment.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear, actionable information for coaches, High Performance staff, and athletes.

• Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence within a multidisciplinary high-performance team. With a clear commitment to diversity and inclusion

Desirable:

• Experience of working within the NWSL

• Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) qualification

• Demonstrated commitment to continuous professional development and innovation.

• Experience of working with AMS (e.g., Kitman)

• Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy and the ability to build positive relationships with athletes.

• Strong commitment to personal development and training

Qualifications:

• BSc/BA in Exercise/Sports Science (or a related discipline)

• MSc in Strength & Conditioning, Sports Science, Data Science, or a related discipline (strongly desired)

• CPSS and/or CSCS or UKSCA or equivalent

ACFC Perks & Benefits:

• Fully funded comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401K plan

• Flexible PTO policy

• Paid Parental Leave

• Catered breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages

• Complimentary tickets to home games

Compensation:

In addition to the benefits above, this role has a pay range between $90,000 and $100,000 annually.

Angel City FC is committed to building an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and fosters belonging. We believe our differences make us stronger, and we are proud to build a team that reflects the communities we serve.

jobs.title: Scientist, TEM
jobs.description:
Join our Advanced Microscopy team and play a key role in solving complex materials and semiconductor challenges using cutting-edge Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM). We are seeking talented Scientists who are passionate about hands-on analysis, advanced characterization techniques, and delivering impactful results for clients across a wide range of industries.

In this production focused role, you'll spend significant time operating state-of-the-art TEM instrumentation, analyzing advanced materials, and providing high-quality, site specific insights that drive critical client decisions. The ideal candidate is a technically strong contributor who thrives in a fast-paced laboratory environment, enjoys working directly with sophisticated tools, and takes pride in delivering accurate, timely results while meeting client expectations.

The TEM Scientist will be responsible for:

• Partnering with team members to provide high quality analysis service to clients.
• Operating TEM tools to obtain TEM/STEM images, SAED, EDS and EELS data from samples.
• Developing TEM analysis protocols/techniques to meet clients’ requests.
• Creating summary reports to capture the project objectives, analysis data and interpretation of the results.

A typical day would involve-

• Operating the TEM tools (FEI or JEOL electron microscopes) and collecting TEM/STEM images based on customers' requests.
• Performing elemental analysis such as EDS/EELS (collecting/process the data and creating the reports).
• Engaging in discussions with customers to solve their questions and concerns.

Work Schedule: *5pm-2am, Tuesdays to Saturdays OR Sundays to Thursdays

*10% shift differential will apply

Lab locations: Milpitas or Sunnyvale, CA

• 3+ years hands-on TEM operation, not simply general electron microscopy or materials characterization
• Independent operation of TEM/STEM instrumentation
• Hands-on SAED
• Hands-on EDS and EELS acquisition, processing, and interpretation
• 4D-STEM experience
• Demonstrated understanding of TEM operating principles
• Experience developing TEM-specific analysis protocols/techniques
• Experience producing reports that interpret TEM results

What would set you apart:

• FEI/Thermo Fisher and/or JEOL instrument experience
• Preferred experience with semiconductor chips and wafer samples

Compensation is aligned with market standards for the region and tailored to individual qualifications and experience.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods of time (4 or more hours).
• Ability to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead.
• Ability to communicate clearly and understandably ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting.
• Ability to handle small and fragile devices with tweezers and /or fingers.
• Require close distance visual acuity with or without correction (Glasses, Contacts, etc.).
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position 80% of the time.

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What It’s Like to Work Here

At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. • Utilizing AI resources, develop Agentic Agents for daily operations, including test scripts development, internal qualification, and integration to Test Management System.

• Candidate must possess enthusiasm and willingness to learn on their own, as they must be able to work independently without much supervision

Preferred Qualifications:

• Understanding of Storage and NVMe SSDs and NVMe controllers.

• Experience with various Operating Systems, VMWare ESXi and other Hypervisors

• Understanding of networking between hosts and devices.

• Understanding of PCIe and NVMe concepts.

• Experience with VMWare ESXi and other Hypervisors

jobs.title: Lead Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models. We seek people who share our passion for real-time computer graphics and commitment to our mission of helping make our Nation’s pilots safer. We will give you a chance to work with some of the most talented people in the graphics industry.

Own and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) for Aechelon Technology’s simulation products, programs, and services within Shield AI. Drive quality from development through delivery and support, working across Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Contracts and Procurement to turn requirements into clear actions and verified results.

Serve as the primary quality liaison for customers, suppliers, and subcontracts.  Ensure customer quality commitments flow down to suppliers and subcontractors and are met throughout execution, with Aechelon retaining accountability for subcontracted work.

This is an individual-contributor role that leads through subject-matter expertise, cross-functional influence, and process ownership, with no direct people-management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management System

• Maintain QMS policies, procedures, records, and objective evidence appropriate to software, hardware, simulation, and systems integration.

• Plan and conduct risk-based internal, program, supplier, and subcontractor audits; support customer and third-party assessments, including audits required to maintain ISO 9001:2015 certification.

• Coordinate with responsible functions to incorporate applicable contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, export-control, configuration-management, and documentation requirements into quality planning.

• Establish measurable quality objectives and KPIs, and regularly report quality performance, trends, significant risks, and recommended actions to Aechelon Technology and Shield AI leadership.

• Use quality data, audit findings, and lessons learned to identify systemic issues, prioritize process improvements, and verify their effectiveness.

Customer and Program Quality

• Serve as a primary customer quality contract and coordinate responses to customer quality inquiries, Corrective Action Requests (CARs), nonconformances, and quality concerns.

• Ensure required quality documentation, certifications, inspection records, test results, and other deliverables are complete and provided to customers as required.

• Partner with Program Management and functional-teams to incorporate customer quality commitments into program execution and verified completion before customer acceptance and delivery.

Subcontractor and Supplier Quality

• Identify applicable customer requirements and work with Contracts, Procurement, Engineering, and Program Management to incorporate them into subcontracts, purchase orders, statements of work, and supplier quality clauses.

• Define expectations for processes, documentation, inspection, testing, configuration control, traceability, reporting, and acceptance.

• Assess supplier capability, technical competency, quality performance, and risk; establish scorecards and monitor performance throughout execution.

Nonconformance and Corrective Action Management

• Establish and administer processes for documenting, investigating, dispositioning, and closing nonconforming products, software, documentation, or services within established approval authorities.

• Lead Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, including structured root-cause analysis for significant or recurring internal and customer quality issues; track resulting corrective actions to closure and verify their effectiveness.

• Analyze quality data to identify systemic trends and recurring failure modes.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Responsibilities

• Coordinate quality execution across functional teams, establishing agreed deliverables, milestones and dependencies.

• Track quality commitments and escalate missed milestones, unresolved issues, and resource constraints to the appropriate leaders.

• Provide training and guidance to employees regarding quality processes, customer requirements, subcontractor quality expectations, and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

As a Security Officer you play an important role in protecting Mattel’s employees, guest (s), product(s) and brands. The ideal candidate is flexible, collaborative, detail oriented, has strong communication skills, and prioritization skills. This position is located at Mattel’s global headquarters in El Segundo Ca.   This is an on-site position and includes weekend and holiday work. Schedules may vary based on business needs.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Support Mattel’s GlobalSecurity Strategy to protect people, assets, and Mattel’s reputation by providing exceptional customer service and consistently applying policies and practices.
• Enforce Mattel Global Security policies and practices to create a safe and secure environment for all employees and visitors.
• Completes security duties and related tasks as defined in the Contingency Operations and SOP manuals under the direction of the Security Leader/Shift Supervisor and Security Manager.
• Completes security patrols on foot patrols, in a vehicle and digitally to monitor the Mattel campuses for physical security, safety and facilities-related concerns. Effectively monitors the access control system, CCTV system, and the “guard tour” management system.

• Flexibility to work on multiple shifts and or shift times to support business needs.

What We’re Looking For:

We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ingestion Execution Platform
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


SOFTWARE ENGINEER — INGESTION EXECUTION PLATFORM


BUILD THE ALWAYS-ON ENGINE BEHIND SNOWFLAKE INGESTION

Snowflake’s ingestion products land customer data into the AI Data Cloud at petabytes scale, on a path to much larger scale. Those products run on a shared, always-on ingestion execution platform: a multi-tenant control plane that owns pipeline lifecycle, durable work queues, single-owner execution, step orchestration across control plane and compute, multi-tenant scheduling, source monitoring, and cluster topology.

You will build the substrate other ingestion teams ship on. Reliability, fairness, and efficiency at this layer multiply across ingestion products.

As a Software Engineer, you will own substantial platform work end to end: take a hard distributed-systems problem from design through production, make neighboring teams more successful, and raise the bar on correctness, isolation, and operability.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and ship core platform capabilities. Work on areas such as multi-tenant isolation, fair scheduling, ownership and placement, durable queues, source monitoring, or compute allocation. You own the work from design through production.

 - Strengthen isolation and fairness. Build and evolve the primitives that let many products and pipelines share one platform safely: quotas, backpressure, resource accounting, and intelligent placement.

 - Raise reliability and observability. Improve availability and latency for pipeline health, ingest APIs, and compute allocation. Instrument the system so behavior is visible and actionable.

 - Build a clean platform surface. Give product teams a consistent way to express pipelines and processing steps, so they can ship on shared primitives rather than special-casing the stack.

 - Scale the control plane. Design for more concurrent pipelines, higher ingest volume, and efficient use of compute and metadata as customer usage grows.

 - Operate what you ship. This platform sits on the critical path for production ingest. You will participate in production support, improve observability, and automate operational work. Mentorship of junior engineers is part of the job. You will also work closely with engineers on larger platform bets.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–6+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud infrastructure in production. You have shipped something hard that other teams depend on, not only application features.

 - Track record of end-to-end ownership: you took an ambiguous, cross-cutting problem, wrote the design, landed the code, and lived with it in production. Comfortable operating above your level, influencing adjacent teams and helping sequence larger bets without waiting to be told what to do.

 - Strong proficiency in Java (this codebase is Java-first). C++ or systems-level experience is a plus. You write concurrent, failure-aware code and you care about the invariants.

 - Experience in at least one of: multi-tenant control planes, durable queues and at-least-once processing, distributed locking / leases / membership, cluster scheduling, or streaming/ingest execution engines.

 - Instinct for correctness under failure. You think carefully about crashes, retries, redelivery, and exclusive ownership.

 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design for engineers on neighboring product teams, and you can hold a technical argument without ego.

 - BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


BONUS POINTS

 - Background in multi-tenant isolation and fairness: resource accounting, request throttling, quota systems, or load-aware placement.

jobs.description:

We partner with technical and business leaders to turn advances in AI into useful products and sustainable businesses. Strategic Finance supports complex infrastructure programs by evaluating investment choices, commercial opportunities and operating performance.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on finance professional with direct experience supporting silicon design or semiconductor development programs. You will own financial models, deal analysis, forecasts and operating reviews, working with engineering, research and commercial teams to translate technical milestones and investment needs into clear business decisions. You will partner with the finance leader on priorities, resource allocation and significant decisions.

In this role, you will:

 - Own financial models, budgets, forecasts and performance reporting for priority programs, including headcount and investment tracking.

 - Translate silicon development milestones, cost drivers and infrastructure requirements into investment and pricing recommendations.

 - Evaluate customer and partner economics, including engineering support, compute, tooling, licensing and contingent commitments.

 - Build and maintain customer- and program-level revenue, cost of goods sold, gross margin and cash reporting with Engineering, Finance Operations and Accounting.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Demonstrated ownership of complex financial models, forecasts, deal economics and recurring management reporting.

jobs.title: Pay Transparency
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Training Specialist - Welding owns welding training at their site. You will teach technicians to weld to a written standard across TIG, MIG and mechanized processes, run the evaluations that confirm they are ready, and keep the training records and documentation that the program is audited against. The role works closely with our naval customer as a representative of Hadrian.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will report to the site Training Operations Manager, with a dotted line to our welding training lead, who sets the welding curriculum and standard. You will set your own course with minimal oversight, direct trainees day to day without managing them, and make recommendations to leadership when the program needs them.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will lead welding training at your site, delivering hands-on instruction in the booth and on the floor and acting as the technical expert for the technicians you train. You will bring technicians to weld to the written standard across TIG, MIG and mechanized welding, with consistent execution across every shift, and you will learn new processes and methods as they are introduced and turn them into clear, teachable steps.

You will own the evaluation process, including weld tests, practical assessments, quizzes, progress reporting and evaluation criteria across hard and soft skills. You will record training, evaluations and qualifications in our training software so records are complete and current, and you will maintain version-controlled, audit-ready welding training documentation and conduct training audits for procedural compliance.

You will develop and refine welding curriculum with our welding training lead, adapting the core training system to your site. You will give trainees day-to-day direction and escalate performance concerns to the Training Operations Manager, and you will carry Hadrian's standards and culture into your work with our naval customer.




WHAT YOU BRING

Required

 - Experience in multiple welding disciplines, including TIG (GTAW), MIG (GMAW) and mechanized welding

 - 3+ years in a training, instructing or teaching role focused on entry-level individual contributors

 - At least 1 year welding in a production environment

 - Proven ability to train people from entry level to mid level to weld to a written standard

 - Openness to learning new processes and methods, and to reteaching as they change

 - Comfort working with software to record training, evaluations and qualifications

 - Experience maintaining training documentation to an audit-ready standard

 - Ability to recognize patterns in how people learn and give objective, actionable recommendations to leadership

 - A self-starter who manages their own time and priorities with minimal oversight

 - Willingness to travel around 25%, primarily to our Los Angeles facility for training purposes

Preferred, not necessary

 - Experience welding or training to NAVSEA standards

 - Experience with robotic welding; this can be learned and trained in role

 - Welding certifications such as AWS Certified Welder, Certified Welding Educator or Certified Welding Inspector

 - Experience building welding curriculum or training documentation from the ground up

 - Ability to influence without direct authority

 - Comfort representing a company in front of a customer

 - High emotional intelligence; improves on feedback and coaches others

 - Passion for training, career development and Hadrian's mission of reindustrializing the nation's workforce


OUR VALUES

 - Surgical Precision: welds, evaluations, records and documentation have to be exact.

 - Own the Outcome: you own the training outcome at your site and meet the intent of the standard.

 - Build, Edit, Scale: our welding curriculum is moving from pilot to scale, and you will help refine it.


COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $27 - $45 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. 

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.




WHO WE ARE

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning, analysis, and decision-making processes, with a focus on budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario modeling.

JOB DUTIES

 - Lead the preparation, analysis, and maintenance of detailed financial models and forecasts to inform business decisions.

 - Perform regular variance analysis and provide insights into budget versus actual results, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.

 - Develop and maintain dynamic scenario models to assess the financial impact of various business strategies and decisions.

 - Leverage advanced Excel/Google Sheets and ChatGPT to automate and simplify complex reporting processes, ensuring higher efficiency and accuracy.

 - Act as a trusted financial partner to business units, collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand their financial needs and deliver actionable insights.

 - Prepare clear, concise, and insightful financial commentary to explain variances, trends, and forecasts to stakeholders at all levels.

 - Apply solid knowledge of accounting principles to ensure the integrity of financial reporting and assist in closing processes.

Note: The list of responsibilities is intended to capture essential duties and responsibilities for incumbents in the job. An incumbent may perform additional duties as assigned

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - 3+ years of experience in financial analysis, preferably in a tech, robotics, or fast-paced environment.

 - Proficiency in advanced Google Sheets and Excel, with the ability to create and manipulate complex financial models.

 - Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting.

 - "Comfort using emerging productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT, scripting, workflow automation) to enhance efficiency."

 - Strong business acumen, with the ability to communicate financial information effectively to non-financial stakeholders.

 - Knowledge of accounting principles and a solid understanding of financial statements.

 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - Experience with scenario modeling and financial forecasting tools, as well as ERP tools like NetSuite; experience implementing FP&A planning tools (Planful, Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive) a plus!



Additional Information

 - Travel will be required 2-4 times per year for around 4-5 business days each time.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We’re hiring an Internal Communications Manager to shape how True Anomaly talks to itself. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you will own the strategy, voice, and rhythm of internal communications for a fast-growing team of engineers, operators, and builders working on some of the most consequential problems in national security space. Your work will make sure every employee at every one of our locations, understands where the company is headed, why it matters, and how their work connects to the mission.

This is a builder role. You will create the channels, cadences, and standards that keep a scaling company aligned and connected, and you will partner closely with our executives to turn strategy, program milestones, and change into communication that is clear, candid, and worth reading. The ideal candidate is a sharp writer and trusted advisor with a passion for storytelling, who takes ownership from idea to execution, exercises sound judgment in a security-conscious environment, and cares deeply about culture.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build and own True Anomaly’s internal communications strategy, editorial calendar, and operating rhythm, and manage each plan from ideation through execution.

• Advise the Chief People Officer, CEO, and executive team on communication gaps and opportunities, and write leadership messages, company-wide updates, and talking points that are clear, candid, and true to our voice.

• Plan and produce all-hands meetings, lunch and learns, leadership forums, and build a leadership speaking program that spans live, filmed, and written formats, in partnership with our marketing and brand team.

• Lead change communications for company-wide and cross-functional initiatives so employees understand what is changing, why, and what it means for their work, and equip managers with the context and toolkits to cascade messages to their teams.

• Own and scale our intranet and internal channels, including Slack, SharePoint, Confluence, and email, and set standards so teams use the right channel to reach the right audience.

• Tell the stories behind our work by celebrating mission wins, launches, and team achievements, and help build a connected, unified culture across locations, functions, and newly joined teams.

• Partner with People Partners, Talent, and Total Rewards on communications for onboarding, benefits and open enrollment, performance cycles, engagement surveys, and employee programs.

• Partner with Marketing and Communications so internal and external messages stay consistent, especially around launches, contract awards, and major announcements.

• Work with Security, Legal, and Program teams to ensure internal communications meet ITAR, classification, and information-handling requirements.

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to scale communications, personalize content, and raise quality, within our security and data-handling requirements.

• Define how we measure communications and change efforts, track reach and engagement, gather employee feedback, and use what you learn to refine content, channels, and timing.

• Create voice, tone, and style guidelines, templates, and toolkits that make it easy for leaders and teams to communicate well.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in internal, employee, or corporate communications, ideally in a high-growth technology, aerospace, or defense environment.

• An exceptional writer and editor who can turn complex technical or strategic information into clear, compelling, human messages for varied audiences.

• Proven experience advising and writing for senior executives, with the confidence and judgment to push back constructively.

• A track record of building communication programs, channels, or cadences from the ground up, not just maintaining existing ones.

• Experience leading communications and supporting change management through organizational change, rapid growth, or sensitive situations.

• Strong project management skills and a high degree of ownership, with the ability to run multiple long-term projects with distinct timelines and drive them to completion with little direction.

• Proficiency with modern collaboration and content tools such as Slack, Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, and Confluence, plus comfort with basic design or video tools.

• A data-informed mindset, using metrics and feedback to measure impact and keep improving.

• Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of integrity.

• Passionate about culture and about helping people feel connected to a mission that matters.

• Ability to share writing samples and examples of past internal communications campaigns, events, or leadership content.

• Willingness to travel to True Anomaly locations as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in aerospace, defense, government contracting, or national security.

• Experience communicating in export-controlled (ITAR) or classified environments.

• Practical experience using AI tools to draft, produce, personalize, or scale communications.

• Experience building employee communications and engagement across multiple locations or business units.

• Experience producing video, podcast, or other multimedia content for internal audiences.

• Experience coordinating with external agencies, freelancers, or vendors.

• Familiarity with employee engagement survey tools and communication analytics.

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $115,000 - $170,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver or Colorado Springs. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

• Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

jobs.title: Design Manager - Ports & Maritime
jobs.description:
Lead the design of complex maritime infrastructure.

We are seeking an experienced Ports & Maritime Design Manager to guide the technical delivery of major projects, from feasibility and concept development through to detailed design and construction support.

This opportunity will suit an experienced marine, structural, civil or coastal engineer with significant consulting experience and a strong record of delivering complex maritime infrastructure.

How you’ll make a difference

• Lead multidisciplinary design activities across port, marine and coastal developments, establishing design programmes, deliverable schedules and resource requirements.
• Manage delivery through feasibility, concept design, Front-End Engineering Design (FEED), preliminary and detailed design, and construction support.
• Coordinate interfaces across structural, coastal, civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical and environmental disciplines.
• Provide technical oversight for wharves, jetties, container terminals, bulk export facilities, LNG and energy marine facilities, berthing and mooring structures, breakwaters, revetments and defence maritime infrastructure.
• Review and approve designs, calculations, reports and specifications within your expertise and delegated authority, ensuring alignment with client requirements and applicable Australian and international standards.
• Monitor budgets, schedules, risks, quality and commercial performance, addressing issues throughout delivery.
• Lead design reviews and support hazard identification (HAZID) workshops and independent verification processes.
• Build relationships with ports, government agencies, resource companies and private sector clients, leading technical meetings and presentations.
• Prepare and review proposals, fee estimates and project execution plans, contributing to business development and strategic account management.
• Mentor engineers and project managers, support capability growth and promote a collaborative, inclusive design culture.

The qualities that help you thrive

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

• A degree in Civil, Structural, Coastal or Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Extensive consulting experience in ports and maritime infrastructure, with demonstrated leadership of complex multidisciplinary design projects.
• Strong design management capability across the project lifecycle, including design planning, resource coordination and technical governance.
• Relevant expertise in marine structures, port infrastructure or coastal engineering, with sound knowledge of applicable standards and design practices.
• Proven ability to manage design interfaces, technical risk, quality assurance and review processes.
• Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing budgets, project performance, fee estimates and proposals.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical solutions and build trusted client relationships.
• A collaborative leadership approach and a commitment to mentoring and developing others.

Chartered Professional Engineer status will be highly regarded.

Why you’ll love working with us

• Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, job-sharing and hybrid work options

• Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year

• Volunteer and representation leave

• Flex public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. AECOM acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the lands on which we, our clients and our communities live and work around Australia. We pay our respects to their cultures and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging. We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses.  Find out more about our Australian Reconciliation Action Plan here: https://aecom.com/au/our-vision-for-reconciliation/.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

jobs.title: Healthcare Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Healthcare Account Manager

Why We Have This Role

We're looking for an Account Executive to build deep, strategic relationships with healthcare providers and help them expand how they use the Qualtrics Experience Management SaaS platform. This account management role focuses on growing existing customer accounts, rather than prospecting for new logos. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, Fluids Analysis
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Fluids Analysis Engineer specializing in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), you will play a critical role in bringing Form Energy's multi-day energy storage systems from R&D and pilot stages to full-scale commercial utility deployment. You will own physics-based modeling to inform architectural strategies and design details for our Electrolyte, Thermal, Hydrogen, and Air Delivery Systems within our 100-hour iron-air battery systems. Your technical ownership will directly enable the optimization of system-level architectures, ensuring safe, predictable operation and long-term grid stability. Relocation assistance is available.



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Build high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and transient thermal modeling strategies across multiple physical scales, spanning from micro-scale electrochemical cell fields to macro-scale containerized systems.

 - Validate and anchor numerical physics-based models against empirical data, collaborating with test and instrumentation teams to close the gap between simulation and physical testing.

 - Support the development of automated simulation and optimization workflows to systematically evaluate fluid routing, pressure drops, and cooling loop efficiencies.

 - Partner with electrochemical, mechanical, and power electronics teams to resolve complex, multi-factor thermal-fluid anomalies during product integration.

 - Suggest and exercise judgment in selecting simulation methodologies, mesh structures, and boundary condition assumptions to proactively identify hot spots and thermal risks.

 - Drive the standardization of internal modeling workflows and establish rigorous peer design reviews to ensure technical simulation excellence.

 - Model initiative by identifying limitations in our physics-based toolsets and building customized, robust tools to eliminate engineering development blocks.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Experience with a Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of related work experience, or a Master's degree and multiple years of experience, or a PhD with deep focus on thermal-fluid sciences and some industry experience.

 - Deep technical expertise in commercial computational fluid dynamics codes and meshing software, such as Ansys Fluent, Star-CCM+, or Comsol Multiphysics.

 - Strong foundational knowledge of conjugate heat transfer, fluid dynamics, multiphase flow, and closed-loop cooling systems.

 - Applied experience using scripting languages like Python or MATLAB to post-process, visualize, and automate massive multi-physics datasets.

 - Demonstrated track record of translating complex simulation results into actionable, physical system-level requirements that guide design decisions.

 - Ability to build formal networks outside your immediate area of expertise to achieve technical alignment on multi-variable design trade-offs.

 - Intellectual curiosity that drives a continuous pursuit of understanding novel, complex physical phenomena from the microscale to complete grid integration.

 - Pragmatic problem-solving skills to navigate design ambiguity and balance modeling fidelity with rapid execution speed.

 - Thriving on complexity and enjoying the challenge of decomposing abstract, highly integrated physical problems into clean, high-performing thermal systems.
