jobs.title: SCADA Field Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.
 
Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.
 
Location & Team Gatherings
 
Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016.  We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.
 
We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.


About this role
 
As a SCADA Field Engineer on Intersect's Engineering team, you will serve as the essential on-site representative of our centralized engineering organization across utility-scale clean energy facilities. You will partner directly with EPC contractors, commissioning teams, and OEMs to ensure critical SCADA, protection, and automation infrastructure is built, tested, and delivered functionally to specification.
 
You will act as the crucial technical link connecting active field operations with long-term engineering design, conducting physical inspections, resolving communication discrepancies, and providing ground-truth operational context. This role includes a training period of 4 weeks to reach full productivity.
 
Team overview
 
This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition. The Engineering team ensures that our large-scale power infrastructure operates with maximum reliability, safety, and compliance across its entire lifecycle. Joining this team means stepping onto the front lines of high-voltage power automation, solving technical challenges in real time, and growing alongside dedicated engineers committed to operational excellence and long-run value.
 
What you'll do
 
Oversee SCADA and Automation System Commissioning
Conduct comprehensive physical inspections of SCADA nodes, RTUs, PLCs, network switches, and field instrumentation to verify installation quality and strict adherence to engineering designs.
Review and validate EPC-provided commissioning reports, pre-functional checklists, and point-to-point telemetry documentation to certify operational readiness and flag deficiencies.
 
Provide On-Site Technical Expertise and Protocol Diagnostics
Serve as the primary technical authority for EPCs and field technicians on SEL protective relay logic, SEL-RTAC configurations, and substation communication architectures.
Perform in-depth network packet inspection using Wireshark to diagnose protocol-level anomalies across Modbus, DNP3, and IEC 61850 networks under live operating conditions.
 
Drive Cross-Functional Field Coordination
Represent centralized engineering in daily on-site coordination meetings with EPC contractors, commissioning agents, and transmission system operators to align on schedules and critical milestones.
Maintain proactive, transparent communication channels with centralized engineering, delivering timely site context to accelerate decision-making and resolve technical escalations.
 
Standardize Fleet Documentation and Asset Excellence
Track open punch-list items, commissioning deviations, and site revisions in Jira to establish rigorous as-built documentation.
Feed real-world field observations back into centralized design standards, continuously refining commissioning test procedures and technical specifications across Intersect's fleet.
 
What you'll bring
 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
3+ years of hands-on field engineering experience in utility-scale clean energy facilities, power generation plants, or high-voltage substation environments.
Demonstrated expertise configuring and commissioning SEL protective relays and SEL-RTACs using SEL Quickset and SEL Acselerator.
Proven proficiency in industrial network troubleshooting and packet analysis using Wireshark across DNP3, Modbus, and IEC 61850 protocols.
Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting HMI screens and data visualizations within Ignition Perspective.
Familiarity with NERC CIP compliance frameworks, grid telemetry standards, and utilizing Jira for issue tracking and resolution.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to travel up to 50% to project sites, maintaining safety-first discipline, composure, and resourcefulness in remote field environments.
Collaborative mindset with exceptional communication skills to influence contractors and cross-functional teams without formal authority.
Commitment to technical integrity, continuous improvement, and operational excellence, aligned with Intersect's values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Noctrix Health is redefining the treatment of chronic neurological disorders with clinically validated therapeutic wearables. Our team of medical device specialists, neuroscientists, and consumer electronics engineers is dedicated to delivering prescription-grade therapy with an outstanding user experience. We have pioneered the world’s first drug-free wearable therapy, clinically proven to alleviate symptoms in adults with drug-resistant Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS). Be part of our mission to transform healthcare, improve lives, and drive meaningful change with Noctrix Health.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Clinical Research Scientist to lead the strategy and execution of clinical research supporting the development and validation of emerging therapeutic technologies. This role will have direct responsibility for study design and analysis, physiological data collection, algorithm development, external research collaborations, and the communication of scientific findings through grants, publications, and conference presentations.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative scientist who is equally comfortable developing research strategy and working directly with engineering, clinical affairs, investigators, and research partners to execute studies and solve complex scientific problems. This individual will play a critical role in translating physiological and clinical data into meaningful product insights, clinical evidence, and future research opportunities.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Pleasanton, CA, with a minimum of three days onsite per week, or more depending on business needs. Travel is expected to be approximately 10%.

Responsibilities

• Design and lead the execution of multiple clinical research studies in parallel

• Lead the analysis and interpretation of physiological and clinical data sets

• Develop research strategies, study plans, protocols, case report forms, and statistical analysis plans that produce scientifically meaningful and operationally feasible data

• Develop proof-of-concept algorithms that generate clinically meaningful insights from physiological data, including IMU, PPG, EMG, and other biosensor signals

• Collaborate with embedded systems engineers to develop and refine systems for collecting physiological sensor data

• Partner closely with Clinical Affairs, Engineering, Product, Regulatory, and other cross-functional teams to support research and product-development priorities

• Write and submit grant reports, white papers, abstracts, manuscripts, and peer-reviewed publications

• Present research findings at scientific and medical conferences

• Develop and manage partnerships and collaborations with investigators, research sites, subject matter experts, and other external research partners

• Provide training, technical guidance, and ongoing support to external research partners

• Translate research findings into product specifications, user requirements, clinical strategies, and patent applications

• Identify opportunities to expand the clinical research program through feasibility studies, external collaborations, publications, and grant applications

• Maintain accurate study documentation and ensure research activities are conducted in accordance with applicable Good Clinical Practice standards, company procedures, and regulatory requirements

• Manage multiple research projects, priorities, timelines, and stakeholders within a collaborative and fast-paced environment

• Maintain a high level of ownership, accountability, scientific rigor, and hands-on involvement throughout study planning, execution, analysis, and reporting

Requirements

• PhD in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a closely related scientific or technical field

• 3+ years of experience leading clinical research projects, preferably within the medical device industry

• 2+ years of experience with physiological signal analysis and algorithm development

• Strong first-author publication and/or grant-writing record demonstrating excellent technical writing ability

• Proficiency in Python or advanced proficiency in a comparable programming language with the ability to work effectively in Python

• Strong data-analysis skills ranging from interpreting small exploratory data sets to analyzing large and complex data sets

• Experience designing research studies and developing protocols, analysis plans, and scientific documentation

• Experience managing collaborations with investigators, subject matter experts, research sites, or external research partners

• Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear scientific, technical, and regulatory documentation

• Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences

• Enthusiasm for providing hands-on support throughout the planning and execution of clinical research studies

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities within a complex and rapidly changing environment

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability, organization, and scientific integrity

• Ability to travel approximately 10% as business needs require

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing NIH-funded clinical trials or contributing to successful grant applications

• Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice standards and applicable CFR requirements for clinical research

• Experience supporting research and development within an FDA-regulated medical device product-development environment

• Experience with wearable technologies, neuromodulation, sleep medicine, neuroscience, or neurological disorders

• Experience analyzing IMU, PPG, EMG, EEG, or other physiological and biosensor data

• Experience translating clinical and physiological research findings into product requirements, development priorities, or intellectual property

• Experience working within a startup, growth-stage, or rapidly evolving medical device organization

Compensation

• Base pay: $130,000–$150,000 per year

• Annual bonus eligibility

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The world’s most critical infrastructure—banking, airlines, utilities—is held together by millions of lines of COBOL and mainframe logic written decades ago. The engineers who built it are retiring and the documentation is fading. These systems are "too big to fail" and "too complex to change," leaving global infrastructure frozen in the 1970s.

At Hypercubic, we’re building AI systems that can understand, reason about, and rearchitect large-scale legacy applications. We work at the intersection of program analysis, knowledge extraction, and agentic systems, applied to some of the most critical enterprise software in the world. 

Learn https://www.hypercubic.ai/insights/mainframe-modernization-is-a-hard-and-fun-problem-to-solve why we're excited about mainframe modernization.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a true generalized specialist with unusually strong technical and product taste. You will work directly with the CTO to design, prototype, and productionize AI-powered systems from first principles. This is a founding role with meaningful ownership over architecture, product direction, and engineering culture. It is suited for someone with strong fundamentals and comfortable operating across abstraction layers, from low-level system reasoning to high-level product UX.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Rapidly prototype new concepts and features to validate ideas before full implementation.

 - Ship AI-driven features end to end, from model interaction to user-facing workflows.

 - Set early engineering standards around testing, reliability, and code quality.

 - Translate ambiguous problem statements into concrete experiments, constraints, and working systems.

 - Lead architecture decisions and long-term technical direction with the CTO.

 - Collaborate with a highly diverse group of subject matter experts and customers from various industries (banks, insurance, airlines, and more)




YOU ARE A FIT IF…

 - You care deeply about your work and the product.

 - You are comfortable with uncertainty and enjoy figuring out what to build before how to build it.

 - You think in systems and feedback loops, not just features.

 - You can move fast and slow. Prototyping ideas in hours, then building enterprise-grade features to a high-quality bar.

 - You want to become world-class at AI engineering.

 - You have a bias for action and a track record of working in fast-paced environments with urgency.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Strong testing intuition, including TDD and property-based testing.

 - Experience building and maintaining production-grade agentic or autonomous systems.

 - Exposure to legacy systems (especially mainframes or COBOL), compilers, program analysis techniques, or high-performance computing (HPC).

 - Familiarity with enterprise software constraints.




LOGISTICS

 - Location: This role is in-person based in San Francisco, California.

 - Benefits: Hypercubic offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, and relocation support as needed.

 - Sponsorship: Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor new H1B employment visas at this time. However, we can support H1B transfers and OPT.

jobs.title: Art Director, Packaging
jobs.description:
ABOUT THRIVE MARKET

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

The Art Director of Packaging leads the creative strategy, quality, and consistency of Thrive Market’s Owned Brands packaging. This role manages a team of designers and production artists, collaborates cross-functionally to align packaging with brand goals, and oversees the production process from concept to print. Additionally, the Art Director drives innovation, optimizes design workflows, and ensures packaging meets industry trends and consumer expectations.

The ideal candidate is organized, process-oriented, has extreme attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced working environment.

Core Responsibilities

• Creative Vision and Art Direction: Drive quality and consistency across all Thrive Market Owned Brands, providing daily creative feedback to the design team and aligning with stakeholders in bi-weekly meetings. Ensure all packaging designs adhere to brand standards and contribute to a cohesive brand identity.

• Team Management and Development: Oversee a team of packaging designers, delegating projects effectively and setting team members up for success. Conduct mid-year and annual performance reviews, manage career pathing, and establish clear OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) to support growth and skill development.

• Mentorship and Skill Building: Mentor designers, helping them optimize their processes, develop creative efficiencies, and achieve high standards in their work. Inspire team members through constructive feedback and fostering a collaborative team environment.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with teams in photo, content, and merchandising marketing to define creative objectives, packaging style, and strategic approaches. Interpret and follow Creative Briefs closely to ensure packaging aligns with broader brand and product objectives.

• Editorial and Content Alignment: Collaborate with the Content team to define the editorial direction for packaging, ensuring that brand storytelling aligns seamlessly across all packaging touchpoints.

• Brand Style Guides: Build, manage, and update brand style guides, including packaging standards (such as substrates, design elements, and typography) to maintain a strong visual identity across all Thrive Market brands.

• Production Oversight: Manage the production process from design to printing, identifying and flagging any design inconsistencies and ensuring quality through all production stages. Collaborate with production teams on mechanicals and printing best practices.

• Proofing and Press Checks: Review proofs and lead press checks (on-site or remote), approving or rejecting against brand standards and printer specifications.

• New Product Development: Provide creative support for product development, particularly for new categories like home goods, textiles, and specialty products, ensuring alignment with the overall brand aesthetic.

• Market and Competitive Research: Conduct ongoing competitive research to stay informed about industry trends and consumer preferences, bringing innovative ideas to enhance Thrive Market's presence in the packaging space.

• Process Optimization: Develop and implement operational efficiencies to streamline the packaging design process, reducing unnecessary revisions and improving productivity.

• Presentation and Leadership Communication: Create presentation materials, including packaging mockups and competitive landscape analysis, for leadership review, ensuring clear communication of strategic decisions and design rationale.

• Photography and Retouching Oversight: Guide the on-pack photography process, providing direction and retouching feedback to ensure consistency and quality across all product images.

• Innovation in Packaging: Identify new opportunities to elevate the Thrive Market brand within the packaging industry by staying current on best practices in design, printing, and branding.

Qualifications

• Experience: 5+ years in packaging design and art direction, with a strong background in brand development, preferably within the CPG, food, or wellness industries.

• Leadership Skills: Proven experience managing a creative team, including mentorship, performance reviews, and project delegation, with a minimum of 2 years of direct people management experience.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and knowledge of print production processes, packaging substrates, and materials.

• Design Systems: Proven experience building, documenting, and maintaining scalable packaging design systems (templates, modular layouts, typography, color, substrates, and component libraries) that keep multiple product lines and brands cohesive and speed up production.

• Proofing & Press Checks: Hands-on experience with proofing workflows and on-site or remote press checks, including color-matching, evaluating print quality, and approving or rejecting proofs against brand standards and printer specs.

• AI Tools & Efficiency: Experience evaluating and implementing AI tools to increase team efficiency, including assessing fit, quality, and risk, and integrating approved tools into design and production workflows.

• Photography & Retouching: Experience directing on-pack product photography and giving retouching feedback to maintain consistent image quality.

• Creative Vision: Strong eye for design, typography, and color; ability to create cohesive brand identities and maintain quality standards across multiple products.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams, including content, photography, product development, and merchandising, to align packaging with overall brand and product goals.

• Project Management: Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Market Knowledge: Understanding of current trends in packaging, sustainability, and consumer behavior, with the ability to conduct competitive research and apply insights.

• Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication abilities for presenting design concepts and rationale to stakeholders.

• Problem-Solving: Skilled in identifying and addressing design inconsistencies and production issues, with a proactive approach to improving design processes and workflows.

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field is preferred, though equivalent professional experience may also be considered.

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability)

• Competitive salary (DOE) + equity

• 401k plan

• 9 Observed Holidays

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Subsidized ClassPass Membership with access to fitness classes and wellness and beauty experiences

• Ability to work in our beautiful office in Playa Vista

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Manager (13-month Contract)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Prenuvo is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Manager (13-month Contract) to step into a full-time interim role while a member of our Finance team is on extended leave. Beyond keeping day-to-day billing operations running smoothly, this role carries a mandate to critically assess and revamp our end-to-end Accounts Receivable process — from invoicing through collections to close — across a multi-entity, multi-currency healthcare organization. You'll be trusted to drive outcomes independently from day one, working closely with Finance, Sales, and Development leadership.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

AR Process Transformation

• Assess the current end-to-end AR process — invoicing, collections, billing systems, and month-end close — and identify structural gaps, inefficiencies, and risk points

• Design and implement a revamped AR process, including updated workflows, controls, and documentation that will outlast the interim term

• Bring in leading practices from prior roles to modernize how AR is run, balancing quick wins with durable, scalable process design

• Build the case for changes with Finance leadership and drive adoption across the teams the new process touches

Invoicing & Billing Systems

• Take full ownership of the end-to-end invoicing cycle — generating and distributing monthly and ad hoc B2B invoices, validating accuracy, and processing adjustments and credits with care

• Maintain clean, reliable customer billing records that stay aligned with contract terms and delivered services, and identify opportunities to tighten controls as you go

• Administer billing operations across Stripe and NetSuite, including customer accounts, payment methods, ACH/direct debit authorizations, payment links, refunds, credits, and account consolidations

• Act as the senior escalation point for billing, payment, invoicing, and synchronization issues spanning Stripe, NetSuite, and Salesforce

• Lead Finance's side of the Stripe–NetSuite connector project, working directly with Engineering to shape how the two systems are integrated

Collections

• Own the aging receivables portfolio end to end, setting the pace on proactive follow-up for overdue accounts

• Field customer payment inquiries and resolve billing disputes with professionalism, clarity, and sound judgment

• Negotiate payment arrangements where appropriate, and exercise independent judgment on escalating higher-risk accounts to protect cash flow and minimize outstanding AR

Travel Platform Administration (Egencia)

• Oversee platform access and permissions in a single sign-on (SSO) environment, stepping in for exceptions that fall outside automated provisioning

• Support travelers with profile and permission questions, troubleshoot booking issues, and liaise with the vendor when needed

Month-End Close Support

• Reconcile AR balances, prepare supporting reports, and contribute accounting entries and audit documentation during month-end close, with minimal oversight

What You’ll Bring

• 4-5 years experience leading an AR or credit control process transformation, ideally within a multi-entity or multi-currency environment

• Significant, demonstrated experience in AR, collections, or B2B invoicing, including time in a manager or lead capacity

• Deep, hands-on NetSuite fluency is essential; strong working knowledge of Stripe is expected

• A confident, senior collaborator who can represent Finance credibly with Sales, Development, and Legal leadership, and who can step into an ambiguous transition with minimal ramp-up

• Comfortable diagnosing broken or outdated processes and building the case for change, not just running the process as-is

• Experience in healthcare, imaging, or another regulated industry is a plus, though not required

• Proven ability to support external audit requests and prepare accounting entries and reconciliations during close with a high degree of independence

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

• Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

• We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

• We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

• An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health

• Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family

• The base salary for this role ranges from $75,000-$85,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [prenuvo.com]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

jobs.title: Analyst, Privacy (Privacy Assessments)
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Privacy Analyst on the Privacy Operations team within Security, you'll play a central role in how Coinbase identifies and manages privacy risk across its products and platforms. This team partners with Legal, Product, and Engineering to perform privacy assessments, manage privacy issues through the product lifecycle, and continuously improve the frameworks and tooling that keep customer data safe. You'll own the execution of complex privacy assessments for new products and features, drive issue remediation, and build scalable processes that embed privacy by design into how Coinbase ships.

What you'll do:

• Own end-to-end privacy assessments for new products and features, synthesizing findings and driving remediation with cross-functional partners across Legal, Product, and Engineering.

• Perform regulatory requirement mapping against the privacy common controls framework and identify where control updates are needed to address evolving obligations.

• Track privacy requirements and issues throughout the product lifecycle, managing escalations and driving timely resolution with business owners.

• Partner with Product and Engineering teams by embedding into roadmap planning processes and advising on privacy-by-design principles for onchain and web3 products.

• Identify and implement automation and AI-driven process improvements to streamline privacy assessments and issue management workflows.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 3+ years in technology risk management with a focus on privacy or security, including hands-on experience conducting privacy assessments (DPIAs/PIAs, data flow reviews, or equivalent).

• Demonstrated ability to map regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, ePrivacy) to operational controls and validate remediation efforts.

• Proven ability to translate privacy legal guidance and product specs into functional requirements and actionable remediation plans.

• Experience managing a high volume of concurrent assessments while balancing strategic priorities and stakeholder escalations across technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with applying privacy principles to blockchain, onchain, and web3 products or willingness to develop this expertise rapidly.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Principal Coastal Engineer - Maritime
jobs.description:
Bring your coastal expertise to complex maritime projects.

We are seeking a Principal Coastal Engineer to lead the design and assessment of coastal protection and maritime infrastructure, including rock revetments, seawalls, breakwaters, marine retaining walls and port developments.

Working within multidisciplinary teams, you will provide technical leadership from concept development through to detailed design and construction support. You will combine specialist engineering expertise with project delivery, client engagement and mentoring, helping develop practical solutions for new infrastructure and existing assets.

How you’ll make a difference

• Lead the design and assessment of rock revetments, seawalls, breakwaters, shoreline stabilisation works and port and harbour infrastructure.
• Undertake and review coastal and hydraulic analyses, including wave, current and sediment transport assessments.
• Provide technical oversight of structural design and stability assessments for coastal protection structures and maritime infrastructure.
• Guide coastal modelling studies using industry standard software and translate findings into engineering recommendations.
• Prepare and review engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications and design documentation.
• Lead condition assessments and inspections, recommending rehabilitation measures and supporting marine asset management.
• Coordinate with clients, contractors, regulators and multidisciplinary teams, managing deliverables to agreed quality, budget and schedule requirements.
• Provide construction support through site inspections, technical reviews and resolution of engineering queries.
• Contribute to proposals, business development and client relationship management, while mentoring engineers and sharing technical knowledge.

The qualities that help you thrive

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

• A degree in Civil, Coastal or Maritime Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Extensive relevant experience, including technical leadership in the design and assessment of coastal protection and maritime infrastructure.
• Demonstrated expertise in rock revetments, seawalls, breakwaters and shoreline stabilisation.
• Strong knowledge of coastal processes, hydraulic loading, structural behaviour and stability assessment.
• Experience applying coastal modelling tools and interpreting results to inform design.
• Proven ability to prepare and review technical deliverables and coordinate multidisciplinary project inputs.
• Experience managing project scope, budgets, schedules and technical quality.
• Strong communication and client engagement skills, with a collaborative approach to mentoring and team development.

Experience in marine asset assessments and construction support, along with Chartered Professional Engineer status, will be highly regarded.

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.



Our culture:

 - We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. 

 - We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

 - We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.



Location:

 - Remote - United States, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, United Kingdom, Portugal, or Australia



About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Enterprise Business Development Representative to focus on researching and strategizing target account lists. This role is crucial for expanding our presence in enterprise companies, specifically within the fintech, financial services, marketplaces, ecommerce, and high-risk verticals. 

The ideal candidate should possess an insatiable curiosity, a strong drive for success, a collaborative spirit, and the resilience to consistently put in the hard work required to exceed quota.



What you’ll be doing:

 - Develop and implement strategies for targeting enterprise account lists in specified verticals, including tailored outreach and social selling on LinkedIn to build trust with senior stakeholders.

 - Confidently overcome objections and guide prospects through the sales funnel, consistently doing the preparation and follow-up needed to help the team exceed revenue goals.

 - Support a sales team of almost 20 AEs for a smooth transition of outbound leads, ensuring meetings are high-quality, well-qualified, and set up for successful handoffs.

 - Use Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo to optimize prospecting, tracking, and account management, including building and maintaining clean account and contact lists.

 - Identify key accounts and event attendees, proactively reaching out to schedule meetings for the team in advance of conferences and industry events, and attending select conferences to help network in person.

 - Partner with Sales Operations to streamline and optimize sales processes through automation, while consistently following a repeatable, process-driven outbound motion.



What you’ll need :

 - 2+ years of experience in an enterprise BDR role, preferably within the fraud, risk, or compliance space, or experience in consulting or financial investment.

 - Strong work ethic and discipline, with a demonstrated history of putting in the hard work to exceed quota and owning outcomes rather than just activities.

 - Proficiency in outbound sales processes and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo).

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while staying organized, process-oriented, and accountable to goals.

 - Highly motivated and hungry for success, with a track record of creating opportunities through both traditional outbound and modern LinkedIn-based social selling.

 - Creative problem-solver with the ability to find innovative ways to break into top accounts and build multi-threaded relationships with key decision-makers.

 - Excellent time management, communication skills (both written and verbal), and interpersonal abilities, with a focus on building long-term relationships the right way, not just transactional outreach.

 - Process-oriented mindset with a track record in prospecting and scheduling meetings with potential clients across complex enterprises.

 - Willingness to travel (10–20%) for conferences and industry events.





Benefits we offer:

 - Generous compensation in cash and equity

 - Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

 - Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

jobs.title: Hydrologist (Contract)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLUMEN

Blumen is building the regulatory intelligence layer for American infrastructure. Our platform combines regulatory information with more than 2,500 geospatial datasets to help energy companies and environmental consultants understand the permits, constraints, and risks facing a project in hours instead of weeks.
We are a small, fast-moving team tackling a huge market at the moment AI is beginning to reshape professional services. Someone joining now will help define both Blumen and the future of environmental work in infrastructure development.

The role

We are looking for a hydrologist to serve as Blumen’s go-to expert on water as it affects energy and infrastructure siting.
You will review how Blumen evaluates water-related constraints on real projects: wetlands and waters of the U.S., floodplains, stormwater, groundwater, and water supply. You will make sure our findings are accurate.
This is a contract engagement with flexible hours. It suits an independent consultant, a semi-retired practitioner, or someone with capacity alongside other work who wants to help build the tools their field will use next.

What you will do

 - Review and correct water-related findings in critical issues analyses, permit matrices, and environmental screens.

 - Assess wetland, floodplain, stormwater, groundwater, and water-supply risks for proposed energy and infrastructure sites.

 - Research unresolved questions using authoritative sources.

 - Help define how Blumen should evaluate water issues, including methods, evaluation cases, and product requirements.

Who should apply

You have professional experience in hydrology, water resources, wetlands, floodplain management, or stormwater. That might come from consulting, government, or infrastructure development. You know the federal framework (Clean Water Act Sections 404 and 401, NPDES, FEMA flood mapping) well, and you can work through state-level variation without losing rigor.
You are detail-oriented and care about citations and factual accuracy.

Compensation: Hourly / 1099


OUR VALUES

 1. Put yourself in the customer’s shoes. We care deeply about serving our customers above all else.

 2. No job is too small. Details matter, even if nobody will ever see them.

 3. Every problem is an opportunity. Any solution that is clever, difficult to reproduce, or takes serious guts is an opportunity to widen our moat.

 4. To go far, go together. We trust, respect, win, and lose together, as a team.

 5. Own the problem. Not your solution. Best idea wins.

 6. It doesn’t get easier. We just get faster. There is no finish line. Every day is a step toward compounding success. This is a marathon toward excellence.

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FRESHPAINT: 

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.


FRESHPAINT ELIMINATES THAT TRADE-OFF.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.


BACKED BY TOP INVESTORS

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

 - Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

 - Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Support Engineer who thrives at the intersection of customer experience and deep technical problem-solving. You’re someone who enjoys digging into complex systems, reading code, and figuring out how things work under the hood to resolve customer issues. You take full ownership from first report to final resolution, and you’re driven to not just fix problems, but to improve the overall customer experience. You’re an empathetic communicator who can translate technical details clearly, and a proactive partner who surfaces insights to improve the product and support processes.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

In this role, you’ll serve as a frontline technical expert, helping customers navigate and troubleshoot a complex product. You’ll investigate issues by working directly in the codebase and across systems, using tools like Go, TypeScript, and SQL to identify root causes and deliver solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Product to resolve issues, improve workflows, and advocate for customer needs. Your work will directly shape both the customer experience and the evolution of the product.




PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and drive customer issues to resolution end-to-end

 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack

 - Investigate application behavior using Go, TypeScript, and SQL

 - Analyze system architecture and code to identify root causes

 - Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Customer Success, and Account teams

 - Support customers across the full lifecycle, including onboarding and ongoing usage

 - Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Create and maintain internal runbooks and customer-facing documentation

 - Surface customer feedback and insights to inform product improvements


DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years in a technical support, solutions engineering, or software engineering role

 - 2+ years in a customer-facing position

 - Ability to read and write code (Go, JavaScript/TypeScript preferred)

 - Experience troubleshooting across frontend and backend systems

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a self-service mindset

 - Clear and effective communicator across a range of audiences

 - Highly organized, able to manage multiple issues and priorities simultaneously

 - Customer-first mindset with strong empathy and ownership

 - Familiarity with databases & SQL


NICE TO HAVES

 - Familiarity with debugging production environments

 - Experience working with SQL and data-heavy systems

 - Background collaborating closely with Product and Engineering teams

 - Contributions to technical documentation, help centers, or knowledge bases


PERKS & BENEFITS

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

 - Competitive pay + generous equity

 - Half-day Fridays, every Friday

 - 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

 - Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

 - Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

 - Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page https://www.freshpaint.io/careers for the full list.

jobs.description:
About TEAM LEWIS

TEAM LEWIS is a global marketing agency that has grown from start-up to multi-national in a little over two decades. Its success is due to a combination of factors: talented creatives delivering award winning campaigns; expanding client relationships into new markets or services; its independence from outside investors. The agency, its people and client campaigns have won many awards, including Cannes Lions, PRovoke Media, ICCO, European Excellence, PRCA Digital, Digital Impact, Global Digital Excellence.

At the heart of the business is the TEAM LEWIS Foundation (TLF), a non-profit charitable entity. Since its launch in 2021, it has funded over 2,700 causes. The TLF promotes a wide variety of social, cultural, and environmental causes that benefit society. It aims to strengthen the bonds between the creative industries, businesses, government, and non-profits. Community charities are championed by employees who, in addition to the financial donation, volunteer their time and skills to maximize the grants’ effectiveness.

Purpose of the role
The Campaign Director is a senior strategic and creative client-facing position providing leadership to a team of campaign executives and campaign managers. This person will work with the senior management team to ensure that their office delivers a creative and forward-thinking client service. They are responsible for meeting client expectations and ensuring the client is kept fully up to date with critical activity on the account. In addition, they are responsible for developing that relationship by identifying and selling additional services, thereby impacting revenues and income.

Key responsibilities and tasks

Client Management

• Engages in and ensures a strategic relationship with the client, providing insight and partnership across all aspects of the marketing and communications spectrum

• Responsible for ensuring excellent client communication at all levels; defining KPIs, deadlines and service agreements

• Delivers an added-value consultancy and works closely with clients to deliver campaigns, services and products across traditional and emerging communications channels

• Plays an integral role in the senior management team, ensuring account profitability and optimizing the impact of revenues on the business

• Leads the new business process in collaboration with the Business Development Director, making key decisions and playing a crucial role in selling TEAM LEWIS credentials throughout the tender process

Media relations

• Maximizes their team’s understanding of current affairs by promoting a commitment to understanding the news agenda

Content

• Works with the client to develop and implement an impactful content strategy

• Works with the creative team to improve own and others knowledge of content trends, driving a commitment to excellent story-telling across the business

Digital / Social media

• Uses social media to recognize trends and proactively promotes new tools, solutions and processes to continuously evolve and optimize client PR campaigns across the business

• Provides social media insight as well as strategic management of client activity

• Works collaboratively with the digital team to increase the utilization and selling of digital services

Team working and development

• Takes overall leadership responsibility for the account servicing team, including coaching, supervision, assessment and reviews of all team members

• Sets strategic team objectives on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual basis

• Defines deliverable client objectives and sets standards of excellence for all client activity, driving commitment from all levels of the team

• Monitors team activity levels against budget, increasing fees and negotiating with clients and suppliers where necessary

• Plays a leading role in the new business process, project managing pitch teams and delivering credible solutions to new business challenges

• Acts as leader in guiding colleagues on how to best manage campaigns and projects

• Acts as a respected line manager, working closely with line reports to maximize strengths, improve weaknesses and support career development

• Works with the Talent team to recruit high caliber candidates into the team and develop and initiate hiring strategy in line with projected organizational requirements

• Work with the HR team to reward, retain and develop the team and resolve any performance issues

Reporting and analysis

• Ensures profitability on all accounts and effectively manages budgets

• Understands and maximizes the impact of client revenues on the business

• Communicates account performance internally and provide strategic advice to the client based on measurable analysis

• Monitors and reports on account KPIs and ensure accurate reporting by junior team members

• Provides detailed reports to the senior management team on request

General

• Runs and supports training sessions, with a view to maximizing opportunities to expand team skills and grow revenues

• Take a proactive role in promoting the TEAM LEWIS brand, its identity, values and work

• Support the HR / talent team by promoting both internal and external opportunities at TEAM LEWIS across social media and via the referral scheme

• Overall, be a guardian of best marketing practice

About you

• Highly commercial, with strong strategic client consultancy skills

• 5+ years of experience working in a B2B, corporate, consumer or digital communications agency environment at a Senior Campaign Manager or Campaign Director level

• Well versed in social media and the integration of digital marketing into the PR landscape

• A track record of retention and the profitable growth of existing accounts

• Considered, assertive and influential; a leader with the aptitude to develop and motivate a team

• Able to provide consultancy on PR requirements as well as broader marketing strategy

Benefits

• Generous PTO

• Paid parental leave

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits + life insurance (eligible day 1 of employment)

• 401k with employer match

jobs.title: Insider Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

INSIDER THREAT ANALYST

SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world’s most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. The work we do will literally safeguard mankind becoming an interplanetary species.

You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. This role will triage anomalous event data and analyze insider threat program datasets to respond to threats posed to SpaceX. You will use comprehensive understanding of various collection methods and platforms to explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct comprehensive investigations and analysis in support of SpaceX intellectual property and security

• Uphold investigation and analytic tradecraft standards including confidentiality, objectivity, lawfulness, timeliness, and use of all available sources of information

• Collect and analyze available program data to evaluate insider threat risk to SpaceX infrastructure, programs, and operations

• Triage anomalous event data associated with indicators of data exfiltration, data destruction and other key indicators of concern

• Conduct internal investigations working with Information Security, HR, Legal, Government Security, Physical Security, and external partners based on information derived from internal and external sources

• Utilize network monitoring, data analytic, and other tools (DLP/SIEM/UEBA) to identify anomalous activity, initiate investigations and decipher underlying trends

• Extract and organize insider threat program data to build metrics, reports and case studies addressing mission requirements and timelines

• Communicate findings in a timely and accurate manner to team members, management, and relevant stakeholders

• Support employee training and briefings for internal and external audiences

• Liaise with external industry and government partners to benchmark insider threat program, share threat intelligence, and further investigations

• Continuously identify and help implement program improvement methods

• Manage and safeguard sensitive information, including case files, employee PII, and intelligence reports

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of professional experience in internal investigations, information security, or counterintelligence; OR 4+ years professional experience in information security, internal investigations, or counterintelligence in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 1+ year using a SIEM and/or conducting digital forensic investigations in a government or corporate environment

• Working level understanding of insider threat program missions, internal stakeholders, and manifestations of insider threats

• Proficiency in Microsoft Purview for eDiscovery

• Experience performing business process automation or constructing data pipelines

• Familiarity with risk-based alerting, detection, and tuning concepts for insider risk

• Experience conducting preliminary assessments, determining scope, investigation planning, evidence collection/handling, interviewing and reporting findings to internal and external stakeholders

• Ability to conduct interviews on short notice according to established internal guidelines.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise reports

• Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Can swiftly adapt to new technical environments and workflows

• Ability to exercise discretion when conducting confidential investigations

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical efforts and operations

• Must be willing to travel ad hoc

• Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000 - $110,000
Level 2: $100,000 - $135,000

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise reports

• Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Can swiftly adapt to new technical environments and workflows

• Ability to exercise discretion when conducting confidential investigations

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. jobs.title: Training Specialist, Welding
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Training Specialist - Welding owns welding training at their site. You will teach technicians to weld to a written standard across TIG, MIG and mechanized processes, run the evaluations that confirm they are ready, and keep the training records and documentation that the program is audited against. The role works closely with our naval customer as a representative of Hadrian.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will report to the site Training Operations Manager, with a dotted line to our welding training lead, who sets the welding curriculum and standard. You will set your own course with minimal oversight, direct trainees day to day without managing them, and make recommendations to leadership when the program needs them.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will lead welding training at your site, delivering hands-on instruction in the booth and on the floor and acting as the technical expert for the technicians you train. You will bring technicians to weld to the written standard across TIG, MIG and mechanized welding, with consistent execution across every shift, and you will learn new processes and methods as they are introduced and turn them into clear, teachable steps.

You will own the evaluation process, including weld tests, practical assessments, quizzes, progress reporting and evaluation criteria across hard and soft skills. You will record training, evaluations and qualifications in our training software so records are complete and current, and you will maintain version-controlled, audit-ready welding training documentation and conduct training audits for procedural compliance.

You will develop and refine welding curriculum with our welding training lead, adapting the core training system to your site. You will give trainees day-to-day direction and escalate performance concerns to the Training Operations Manager, and you will carry Hadrian's standards and culture into your work with our naval customer.




WHAT YOU BRING

Required

 - Experience in multiple welding disciplines, including TIG (GTAW), MIG (GMAW) and mechanized welding

 - 3+ years in a training, instructing or teaching role focused on entry-level individual contributors

 - At least 1 year welding in a production environment

 - Proven ability to train people from entry level to mid level to weld to a written standard

 - Openness to learning new processes and methods, and to reteaching as they change

 - Comfort working with software to record training, evaluations and qualifications

 - Experience maintaining training documentation to an audit-ready standard

 - Ability to recognize patterns in how people learn and give objective, actionable recommendations to leadership

 - A self-starter who manages their own time and priorities with minimal oversight

 - Willingness to travel around 25%, primarily to our Los Angeles facility for training purposes

Preferred, not necessary

 - Experience welding or training to NAVSEA standards

 - Experience with robotic welding; this can be learned and trained in role

 - Welding certifications such as AWS Certified Welder, Certified Welding Educator or Certified Welding Inspector

 - Experience building welding curriculum or training documentation from the ground up

 - Ability to influence without direct authority

 - Comfort representing a company in front of a customer

 - High emotional intelligence; improves on feedback and coaches others

 - Passion for training, career development and Hadrian's mission of reindustrializing the nation's workforce


OUR VALUES

 - Surgical Precision: welds, evaluations, records and documentation have to be exact.

 - Own the Outcome: you own the training outcome at your site and meet the intent of the standard.

 - Build, Edit, Scale: our welding curriculum is moving from pilot to scale, and you will help refine it.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Restaurant Host
jobs.description:
A Senior Host is the first and last point of contact with guests at a restaurant and is responsible for greeting, seating and saying goodbye to guests as well as maintaining the flow of the restaurant during service. A Senior Host diligently and efficiently manages seating in Eataly’s restaurants. Reports to the Restaurant Floor Manager.

• Train all new host hires, including floor plan/table numbers, OpenTable features (timeline, booking reservations), guest interactions, and hospitality standards.
• Allocate time to check voicemails and return calls to confirm reservations; forward event inquiries to the Events Team and escalate guest recovery issues to management as needed.
• Assist with responding to Guest Relations emails.
• Maintain menu inventory to reduce paper waste; print menus as needed.
• Support the overall appearance of the restaurant by ensuring details are maintained (e.g., flowers on tables, candles lit, pillows fluffed and arranged, feminine hygiene baskets in restrooms stocked, etc.).
• Oversee seating for both AM and PM shifts (working Wednesday–Sunday, 12 PM–8 PM); ensure smooth shift flow by reviewing timelines, maximizing walk-ins while retaining reservation space, and adjusting as needed.
• Assist management with checking in private events and ensuring spaces are properly allocated and arranged.
• Share important reservation details with management each shift (e.g., birthdays, anniversaries, VIPs) to ensure proper guest recognition.
• Prepare and organize Tanti Auguri cards for birthdays and anniversaries, placing them on the appropriate tables to add a personalized touch of hospitality.
• Act as liaison between management and the host team by communicating updates, expectations, and feedback both ways.
• Oversees the general functioning of the dining room during meal service, relaying information to managers and service personnel
• Maintains an accurate, fair and up-to-date waitlist and seating chart using a computerized system
• Takes and manages reservations in restaurants that allow reservations
• Balances the guest flow among the service stations, taking into account requests for a particular table or server depending on availability
• Informs guests when tables are ready, escorts them to table, provides menus and introduces the server
• Assists with the duties of servers and bus persons as needed to maintain service effectiveness and efficiency
• Performs other duties as required or assigned

• 1+ year of experience in a high-volume restaurant
• Basic computer skills
• Excellent communication skills
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred

Job Requirements

• Availability to work onsite with a flexible schedule often including evenings and weekends
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
• Ability to exert well-paced mobility for up to 8 hours, including standing, walking, bending and squatting

Compensation: Pay Range for this position is $20 – $25 an hour

Benefits and Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• Paid Time Off
